Andhere ko jama ke lafz se aur noor ko wahid ke lafz se lana noor ki sharafat ki wajah se hai, jaise farman-e-Rabbani ayat (Anil-yameeni wash-shama'il) mein aur is surat ke aakhri hissay ki ayat (Wa anna haza sirati mustaqiman fattabi'uhu wala tattabi'us-subula fatafarraqa bikum an sabilihi zalikum wassakum bihi la'allakum tattaqun) (Surah Al-An'am: 153) mein, yahan bhi rah-e-rast ko wahid rakha aur ghalat rahon ko jama ke lafz se bataya. Allah hi qabil-e-hamd hai, kyunke wohi khaliq-e-kul hai magar phir bhi kafir log apni nadani se us ke shareek thehra rahe hain, kabhi biwi aur aulad qaim karte hain kabhi shareek aur saajhi sabit karne baithte hain. Allah Ta'ala in tamam baton se pak hai, us Rabb ne tumhare baap Hazrat Adam (A.S) ko mitti se paida kiya aur phir tumhein us ki nasl se mashriq-o-maghrib mein phaila diya, maut ka waqt bhi usi ka muqarrar kiya hua hai, aakhirat ke aane ka waqt bhi usi ka muqarrar kiya hua hai. Pehli ajal se murad dunyawi zindagi, dusri ajal se murad qabr ki rahaish, goya pehli ajal khaas hai yani har shakhs ki umr aur dusri ajal aam hai yani duniya ki inteha aur us ka khatma. Ibn Abbas (R.A) aur Mujahid (R.H) waghera se marwi hai ke qaza ajlan se murad muddat-e-duniya hai aur ajal-e-musamma se murad umr-e-insan hai. Bohat mumkin hai ke is ka istidlal aane wali ayat (Wa huwallazi yatawaffakum billaili wa ya'lamu ma jarahtum binnahari summa yab'athukum fihi liyuqda ajalun musamma) (Surah Al-An'am: 60) se ho. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ke ayat (Summa qaza ajlan) se murad neend hai jis mein rooh qabz ki jati hai, phir jaagne ke waqt lauta di jati hai aur ajal-e-musamma se murad maut hai, yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Indahu se murad us ke ilm ka Allah hi ke sath makhsoos hona hai jaise farmaya ayat (Qul innama ilmuha inda Rabbi la yujalliha liwaqtiha illa huwa) (Surah Al-A'raf: 187).

(Al-A'raf: 187) Ya'ni Qayamat ka ilm toh sirf mere Rab ke paas hi hai, Surah Naziyat mein bhi farman hai ke log tujh se Qayamat ke sahih waqt ka haal daryaft karte hain halankeh tujhe is ka ilm kuch bhi nahin woh toh sirf Allah hi ko maloom hai, bawajood itni pukhtagi ke aur bawajood kisi qisam ka shak shuba na hone ke phir bhi log Qayamat ke aane na aane mein taraddud aur shak kar rahe hain is ke baad jo irshad-e-Janab-e-Bari ne farmaya hai, is mein mufassireen ke kayi ek aqwal hain lekin kisi ka bhi woh matlab nahin jo Jahmiya le rahe hain ke Allah Ta'ala apni zaat se har jagah hai, Na'uzubillah Allah ki bartar-o-bala zaat is se bilkul paak hai, aayat ka bilkul sahih matlab yeh hai ke aasmanon mein bhi usi ki zaat ki ibadat ki jaati hai aur zameeno mein bhi, usi ki uluhiyat wahan bhi hai aur yahan bhi, oopar wale aur neeche wale sab Allah Ta'ala hi ko pukarte hain, sab ki usi se ummeedein wabasta hain aur sab ke dilon mein usi ka khauf hai, jin-o-ins sab usi ki uluhiyat aur badshahi maante hain jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (WAHUWAL-LAZII FIS-SAMA'I ILAHUN-WAFIL-ARDHI ILAHUN WAHUWAL-HAKIMUL-'ALIM) (43. Az-Zukhruf: 84) ya'ni wahi aasmanon mein mabood-e-barhaq hai aur wahi zameen mein mabood-e-barhaq hai, ya'ni aasmanon mein jo hain, sab ka mabood wahi hai aur isi tarah zameen walon ka bhi sab ka mabood wahi hai, ab is aayat ka aur jumla aayat (YA'LAMU SIRRAKUM WA JAHRAKUM WA YA'LAMU MA TAKSIBOON) (6. Al-An'am: 3) khabar ho jayega ya haal samjha jayega aur yeh bhi qaul hai ke Allah woh hai jo aasmanon ki sab cheezon ko is zameen ki sab cheezon ko chahe woh zahir hon ya posheeda, jaanta hai. Pas ya'lamu muta'alliq hoga fis-samawati wa fil-ard ka aur taqdeer-e-aayat yun ho jayegi aayat (WA HUWALLAHU YA'LAMU SIRRAKUM WA JAHRAKUM FIS-SAMAWATI WA FIL-ARD WA YA'LAMU MA TAKSIBOON) ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke aayat (WA HUWALLAHU FIS-SAMAWATI) par waqf-e-taam hai aur phir jumla musta'nafa ke taur par khabar hai ke aayat (WA FIL-ARDHI YA'LAMU SIRRAKUM WA JAHRAKUM) Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) isi teesre qaul ko pasand karte hain. Phir farmata hai tumhare kul a'maal se khair-o-sharr se woh waqif hai.

Kuffar ko nafarmani par sakht intibah. Kuffar ki sarkashi ki inteha bayan ho rahi hai ke har amr ki takzeeb par goya unhon ne kamar bandh li hai, niyat kar ke baithe hain ke jo nishani dekhenge, usi ka inkar karenge, un ki yeh khatarnak raush unhein ek din zaleel karegi aur woh zaiqa aayega ke hont kaat-te rahenge, yeh yun na samjhein ke hum ne unhein chhod diya hai nahin balkay anqareeb unhein Allah ki pakad hogi, kya un se pehle ke aise sarkashon ke halaat un ke kaan mein nahin pade? Kya un ke ibratnak anjam un ki nigahon ke samne nahin? Woh to quwwat-o-taqat mein aur zor mein un se bohat badhe chadhe hue thay, woh apni rahaish mein aur zameen ko basane mein un se kahin zyada aage thay, un ke lao-lashkar, un ki jah-o-izzat, ghuroor-o-tamakunat un se kahin zyada thi, hum ne unhein khoob mast bana rakha tha, barishein pay-dar-pay husn-e-zaroorat un par barabar barsa karti thin, zameen har waqt taro-taza rehti thi charon taraf pani ki rail-peel ki wajah se aabsharon aur chashme saaf shaffaf pani ke behte rehte thay. Jab woh takabbur mein aa gaye, hamari nishaniyon ki haqarat karne lage to aakhir natija yeh hua ke barbad kar diye gaye. Tehas-nehas ho gaye, bhoosi ud gayi. Logon mein un ke fasane baqi reh gaye aur un mein se ek bhi na bacha harf-e-ghalat ki tarah safha-e-hasti se mita diye gaye aur un ke baad un ke qaim-maqam aur zamana aaya. Agar woh bhi isi raush par chala to yahi sulook un ke sath bhi hota, itni nazrein jab tumhari aankhon ke samne maujood hain phir bhi tum ibrat hasil nahin karte, yeh kis qadar tumhari ghaflat hai, yaad rakho tum kuch Allah ke aise ladle nahin ho ke jin kamon ki wajah se auron ko woh tabah kar de woh kaam tum karte raho aur tabahi se bach jao. Isi tarah jin rasoolon ko jhutlane aur un ko na manne ki wajah se woh halak hue un rasoolon se kisi tarah yeh Rasool kam darje ke nahin balkay un se zyada Allah ke han yeh ba-izzat hain. Yaqeen mano ke pehlon se bhi sakht aur nihayat sakht azab tum par aayenge, pas tum apni is ghalat raush ko chhod do, yeh sirf Allah Ta'ala ka lutf-o-karam hai ke us ne tumhari badtareen aur intehai shararaton ke bawajood tumhein dheel de rakhi hai.

In hauzon ki nigahbani ke liye ek hazaar farishte noor ki lakriyan liye hue muqarrar honge jo kafiron ko wahan se hata denge, yeh hadith Ibn Marduyah mein hai lekin hai gareeb. Tirmidhi Sharif ki hadith mein hai har Nabi ke liye hauz hoga mujhe umeed hai ke sab se zyada log mere hauz par aayenge. Jo log Allah par imaan nahin rakhte aur us din ko nahin maante woh apni jaanon se khud hi dushmani rakhte hain aur apna nuqsan aap hi karte hain. Zameen-o-aasman ki saakin cheezein yani kul makhlooq Allah ki hi paida karda hai aur sab uske matahat hai, sab ka maalik wahi hai, woh sab ki baatein sunne wala aur sab ki harkatein jaanne wala hai, chupa khula sab us par roshan hai. Phir apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko jinhein tauheed-e-khalis ke sath aur kaamil shariat ke sath mab'oos farmaya hai, hukum deta hai ke aap elaan kar dein ke aasman-o-zameen paida karne wale Allah ke siwa main kisi aur ko apna dost-o-madadgar nahin jaanta, woh saari makhlooq ka raaziq hai sab uske mohtaj hain aur woh sab se beniyaaz hai. Quba ke rehne wale ek Ansari (R.A) ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ) ki dawat ki. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) farmate hain, hum bhi aap (ﷺ) ke sath gaye, jab Huzoor (ﷺ) khana tanawul farma kar hath dho chuke toh aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Allah ka shukr hai jo sab ko khilata hai aur khud nahin khata, uske bahut bade ehsaan hum par hain ke usne hamein hidayat di aur khane peene ko diya aur tamam bhulaiyan ata farmayin. Allah ka shukr hai jise hum poora ada kar hi nahin sakte aur na use chhod sakte hain, hum uski nashukri nahin karte, na us se kisi waqt hum beniyaaz ho sakte hain. Qur'an-e-Hakim ka baghi jahannam ka indhan. Allah Ta'ala khabar de raha hai ke nafa-o-nuqsan ka malik wahi hai, apni makhlooq mein jaisi woh chahe tabdiliyan karta hai, uske ahkam ko koi taal nahin sakta, uske faislon ko koi rad nahin kar sakta. Isi aayat jaisi aayat (Ma yaftahillahu linnasi mir-rahmatin fala mumsika laha, wa ma yumsik fala mursila lahu mim-ba'dihi, wa huwal-azizul-hakim) (35. Fatir: 2) hai, yani Allah muqtadir-e-aala jise jo rahmat dena chahe use koi rok nahin sakta, aur jis se woh rok le use koi de nahin sakta. Is aayat mein khaas apne Nabi ko khitab kar ke bhi yahi farmaya. Sahih hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmaya karte the: "Ae Allah! Jise tu de us se koi rok nahin sakta aur jis se tu rok le use koi de nahin sakta." Iske baad farmata hai woh apne bandon par qahir-o-ghalib hai, sab ki gardanein uske samne past hain, sab bade uske samne chhote hain, har cheez uske qabze aur qudrat mein hai, tamam makhlooq uski tabe-dar hai, uske jalal, uski kibriyai, uski azmat, uski bulandi, uski qudrat tamam cheezon par ghalib hai, har ek ka malik wahi hai, hukm usi ka chalta hai, haqiqi shehanshah aur kamil qudrat wala wahi hai. Apne tamam kamon mein woh ba-hikmat hai, woh har chhoti badi chhupi khuli cheez se ba-khabar hai, woh jise jo de woh bhi hikmat se aur jis se jo rok le woh bhi hikmat se. Phir farmata hai, "Poochho to sab se bada aur zabardast aur bilkul saccha gawah kaun hai?" Jawab de kar, "Mujh mein tum mein Allah hi gawah hai, jo main tumhare paas laya hoon aur jo tum mujh se kar rahe ho use woh khoob dekh bhaal raha hai aur ba-khoobi jaanta hai." Meri janib is Qur'an ki wahi ki gayi hai taake main tum sab hazireen ko bhi is se aagah kar doon aur jise bhi yeh pahunchi us tak mera paigham pahunch jaye. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa may-yakfur bihi minal-ahzabi fan-naru mau'iduhu, fala taku fi miryatim-minhu) (11. Hud: 17) yani duniya ke tamam logon mein se jo bhi is Qur'an se inkar kare uska thikana jahannam hi hai. Hazrat Muhammad bin Ka'ab (R.H) farmate hain, jise Qur'an pahunch gaya usne goya khud Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko dekh liya, balki goya aap se baatein kar lein aur us par Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Allah ka deen pesh kar diya. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) ka qaul hai, Allah ka paigham uske bandon ko pahunchao, jise ek aayat-e-Qur'ani pahunch gayi use Allah ka amr pahunch gaya. Hazrat Rabi bin Anas (R.H) ka qaul hai, Allah ke Nabi ke tamam tabe'i logon par haq hai ke woh misl-e-da'wat-e-Rasool ke logon ko da'wat-e-khair dein aur jin cheezon aur kamon se aap ne dara diya hai yeh bhi is se darate rahein. Mushriko! Aur fi-alwaqay is se bhi zyada zalim koi nahin jo sach ko jhoot kahe aur apne Rab ki baton aur us ki atal hujton aur roshan daleelon se inkar kare, aise log falah se, kamyabi se, apna maqsad paane se aur nijat-o-aaram se mehroom-e-mehaz hain.

Qayamat ke din mushrikon ka hashr. Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala tamam makhlooq ka hashr apne samne karega, phir jo log Allah ke siwa auron ki parastish karte thay unhein la-jawab, sharminda aur be-daleel karne ke liye un se farmayega ke jin jin ko tum mera shareek thehrate rahe aaj woh kahan hain? Surah Qasas ki aayat (Wa yauma yunadeehim fayaqoolu aina shuraka'iyallazeena kuntum taz'amoon) (28-Al-Qasas: 62) mein bhi yeh majood hai. Is ke baad ki aayat mein jo lafz fitnatuhum hai is ka matlab fitna se murad hujjat-o-daleel, uzr-o-ma'zarat, ibtila aur jawab hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se kisi ne mushrikeen ke is inkar-e-shirk ki babat sawal kiya to aap ne jawab diya ke ek waqt yeh hoga ke aur ek aur waqt hoga ke Allah se koi baat chupayenge nahin. Pas in dono aayaton mein koi ta'aruz-o-ikhtilaf nahin. Jab mushrikeen dekhenge ke muwahid namazi jannat mein jaane lage to kahenge aao hum bhi apne mushrik hone ka inkar kar dein, is inkar ke baad un ki zabanen band kar di jayengi aur un ke hath paon gawahiyaan dene lagenge to ab koi baat Allah se na chupayenge. Yeh tawajo bayan farma kar Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne farmaya ab to tere dil mein koi shak nahin raha? Suno baat yeh hai ke Quran mein aisi cheezon ka dusri jagah bayan-o-taujeeh majood hai lekin be-ilmi ki wajah se logon ki nigahein wahan tak nahin pahunchtin. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke yeh aayat munafiqon ke bare mein hai, lekin yeh kuch theek nahin. Is liye ke aayat Makki hai aur munafiqon ka wajood Makkah Shareef mein tha hi nahin. Haan munafiqon ke bare mein aayat (Yauma yab'asuhumullahu jamee'an fayahlifoona lahu kama yahlifoona lakum wa yahsaboona annahum 'ala shai'in, ala innahum humul kaziboon) (58-Al-Mujadilah: 18) hai. Dekh lo ke kis tarah unhon ne khud apne upar jhoot bola? Aur jin jhoote maboodon ka iftira unhon ne kar rakha tha kaise un se khali hath ho gaye? Chunancha dusri jagah hai ke jab un se yeh sawal hoga khud yeh kahenge zalloo 'anna, woh sab aaj hum se door ho gaye, phir farmata hai ba'z in mein woh bhi hain jo Quran sunne ko tere paas aate hain lekin is se koi faida nahin uthate.

Un ke dilon par parde hain woh samajhte hi nahin. Un ke kaan unhein yeh mubarak aawazein is tarah sunate hi nahin ke yeh is se faida utha sakein aur ahkaam-e-Qurani ko qabool karein, jaise aur jagah un ki misaal un chopaye janwaron se di gayi jo apne charwahe ki aawaz to sunte hain lekin matlab khaak nahin samajhte. Yeh woh log hain jo bakasrat dalail-o-barahin aur mojizaat aur nishaniyan dekhte hue bhi imaan qabool nahin karte, in azali bad-qismaton ke naseeb mein imaan hai hi nahin, yeh be-insaf hone ke sath hi be-samajh bhi hain. Agar ab in mein bhalai dekhta to zaroor unhein sunne ki taufiq ke sath hi taufiq-e-amal-o-qabool bhi marhamat farmata. Haan unhein agar soojhti hai to yeh ke apne batil ke sath tere haq ko daba dein, tujh se jhagarte hain aur saaf keh jate hain ke yeh to aglon ke fasane hain jo pehli kitabon se naqal kar liye gaye hain. Is ke baad ki aayat ka ek matlab to yeh hai ke yeh kuffar khud bhi imaan nahin late hain aur dusron ko bhi imaan lane se rokte hain. Huzoor (ﷺ) ki himayat karte hain, aap ko bar-haq jante hain aur khud haq ko qabool nahin karte, jaise ke Abu Talib ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ka bada hi himayati tha lekin imaan naseeb nahin hua. Aap (ﷺ) ke das chacha the jo alaniya to aap (ﷺ) ke sathi the lekin khufiya mukhalif the. Logon ko aap (ﷺ) ke qatl waghera se rokte the lekin khud aap (ﷺ) se aur aap (ﷺ) ke deen se door hote jate the. Afsos is apne fe'l se khud apne hi tayin gharat karte the lekin jante hi na the ke is kartoot ka wabaal hamein hi pad raha hai.

Kuffar ka haal aur un ka bura anjam bayan ho raha hai ke jab yeh jahannam ko wahan ke tarah tarah ke azabon, wahan ki badtareen sazaon, tauq-o-zanjeer ko dekh lenge us waqt haye-waye machayenge aur tamanna karenge ke kya achha ho ke duniya ki taraf lautaye jayen taake wahan ja kar nekiyan karein, Allah ki baton ko na jhutlayen aur pakke sachche muwahhid ban jayen. Pashimani magar Jahannam dekh kar! Qayamat ko jhutlane walon ka nuqsan, unka afsos aur unki nadamat-o-khajalat ka bayan ho raha hai jo achanak Qayamat ke aa jane ke baad unhein hoga. Nek a'maal ke tark ka afsos alag, bad-a'maliyon par pachtawa juda hai. Fiha ki zameer ka marja' mumkin hai Hayat ho aur mumkin hai A'maal ho aur mumkin hai Dar-e-Akhirat ho, yeh apne gunahon ke bojh se lade hue honge, apni bad-kirdariyan apne upar uthaye hue honge. Aah! Kya bura bojh hai? Hazrat Abu Marzooq R.H farmate hain kafir ya fajir jab apni qabr se uthega usi waqt uske samne ek shakhs aayega jo nihayat bhayanak, khaufnak aur bad-surat hoga uske jism se ta'affun wali sarand ki sakht badbu aa rahi hogi woh uske paas jab pahunchega yeh dehshat-o-wahshat se ghabra kar usse puchega tu kaun hai? Woh kahega khwab! Kya tu mujhe pehchanta nahin? Yeh jawab dega hargiz nahin sirf itna janta hoon ke tu nihayat bad-surat, karih-manzar aur tez badbu wala hai tujhse zyada bad-surat koi bhi na hoga, woh kahega sun main tera khabis amal hoon jise tu duniya mein maze le kar karta raha. Sun tu duniya mein mujh par sawar raha ab kamar jhuka main tujh par sawar ho jaunga chunancha woh us par sawar ho jayega yahi matlab hai is aayat ka ke woh log apne bad-a'maal ko apni peeth par lade hue honge. Hazrat Suddi R.H farmate hain ke jo bhi zalim shakhs qabr mein jata hai uski laash ke qabr mein pahunchte hi ek shakhs uske paas jata hai sakht bad-surat, sakht bad-budar, sakht maile aur qabil-e-nafrat libas wala yeh use dekhte hi kehta hai tu to bada hi bad-surat hai bad-bu dar hai yeh kehta hai tere a'maal aise hi gande the woh kehta hai tera libas nihayat muta'affin hai, yeh kehta hai tere a'maal aise hi qabil-e-nafrat the woh kehta hai achha bata to sahi ae manhoos tu hai kaun? Yeh kehta hai tere amal ka mujassama, ab yeh uske sath hi rehta hai aur iske liye azabon ke sath hi ek azab hota hai jab Qayamat ke din yeh apni qabr se chalega to yeh kahega thehar ja duniya mein to ne meri sawari li hai ab main teri sawari lunga chunancha woh us par sawar ho jata hai aur use marta peetta zillat ke sath janwaron ki tarah hankata hua Jahannam mein pahunchata hai. Yahi ma'ani hain is aayat ke is jumle ke hain. Duniya ki zindagani bajuz khel tamashe ke hai hi kya, aankh band hui aur khwab khatam, albatta Allah se darne wale logon ke liye Akhirat ki zindagani badi cheez hai aur bahut hi behtar cheez hai tumhein kya ho gaya ke tum aql se kaam hi nahin lete?

Haq ke dushman ko us ke haal par chhoriye aap ﷺ sachay hain. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi-e-Mohtaram Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ ko tasalli deta hai ke aap apni qoum ko jhutlane, na maanne aur eizayein pohanchane se tang-dil na hon, farmata hai ke hamein in ki harkat khoob maloom hai, aap in ki is laghwiyat par malaal na karo, kya agar yeh imaan na layein to aap in ke peechay apni jaan ko rog laga len ge? Kahan tak in ke liye hasrat-o-afsos karenge? Samjha dijiye aur in ka mamla supurd-e-Ilah kijiye. Yeh log darasal aap ko jhoota nahin jaante balkay yeh to haq ke dushman hain. Chunancha Abu Jahl ne saaf kaha tha ke hum tujhe nahin jhutlate lekin tu jo le kar aaya hai usay nahin maante, Hakim ki riwayat mein hai ke isi baaray mein yeh aayat nazil hui, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Abu Jahl ko Huzoor ﷺ se musafa karte hue dekh kar kisi ne us se kaha ke is be-deen se tu musafa karta hai? To us ne jawab diya ke Allah ki qasam mujhe khoob ilm hai aur kaamil yaqeen hai ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ke sachay Nabi hain. Hum sirf khandani bina par in ki nabuwat ke mat-hat nahin hote. Hum ne aaj tak Bani Abd-e-Manaf ki tabedari nahin ki. Al-garz Huzoor ﷺ ko Rasoolullah maante hue aap ki farmanbardari se bhaagte thay, Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H ne bayan farmaya hai ke Hazrat Zuhri R.H is qissay ko bayan karte hue jis mein Abu Jahl, Abu Sufyan, Sakhr bin Harb, Akhnas bin Shariq ka raat ke waqt posheeda tor par aa kar ek dusre ki be-khabri mein Rasoolullah ﷺ ka zabani Quran sunna hai kehte hain ke in logon ne subh tak Quran suna roshni zara si namoodar hui thi to yeh wapas chalay. Ittefaqan ek chowk mein ek dusre se mulaqat ho gayi hairat se ek dusre se poochte hain ke is waqt yahan kahan? Phir har ek dusre se saaf saaf keh deta hai ke Huzoor ﷺ se Quran sunne ke liye chup-chap aa gaye thay. Ab teeno baith kar mu'ahida karte hain ke aayinda aisa na karna warna agar auron ko khabar hui aur woh aaye to woh to sachay pakkay musalman ho jayenge. Dusri raat ko har ek ne apne tor yeh guman kar ke ke kal raat ke waaday ke mutabiq woh dono to aayenge nahin main tanha kyun na jaaun? Mere jaane ki kisay khabar hogi? Apne ghar se pichli raat ke andheray aur suftay mein har ek chala aur ek konay mein dab kar Allah ke Nabi ki zabani tilawat-e-Quran ka maza leta raha aur subh ke waqt wapas chala. Ittefaqan aaj bhi usi jagah teeno ka mel ho gaya. Har ek ne ek dusre ko bari malamat ki bohat ta'an-o-malamat ki aur naye siray se ahd kiya ke ab aisi harkat nahin karenge. Lekin teesri shab phir sabr na ho saka aur har ek isi tarah posheeda tor par pohancha aur har ek ko dusre ke aane ka ilm bhi ho gaya, phir jama ho kar apne tayin bura bhala kehne lagay aur bari sakht qasmein kha kar qaul-o-qarar kiye ke ab aisa nahin karenge.

Subh hote hi Akhnas bin Shariq kapray pehan kar tayyar ho kar Abu Sufyan bin Harb ke paas us ke ghar mein gaya aur kehne laga ae Abu Hanzala imaan se batao sach sach kaho jo Quran tum ne Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani suna us ki babat tumhari apni zaati raye kya hai? Us ne kaha Abu Sa'laba suno! Wallah bohat si aayaton ke alfaaz ma'ani aur matlab to main samajh gaya aur bohat si aayaton ko un ki muraad ko main jaanta hi nahin. Akhnas ne kaha wallah yehi haal mera bhi hai, ab yahan se uth kar Akhnas seedha Abu Jahl ke paas pohancha aur kehne laga Abu Al-Hakam tum sach batao jo kuch tum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sunte ho us mein tumhara khayal kya hai? Us ne kaha sun jo suna hai usay to ek taraf rakh de baat ye hai ke Banu Abd-e-Manaf aur hum mein chashmak hai woh hum se aur hum un se barhna aur sabqat karna chahte hain aur muddat se ye rassa-kashi ho rahi hai, unhon ne mehmandariyan aur dawatain keen to hum ne bhi keen unhon ne logon ko sawariyan deen to hum ne bhi yehi kiya. Unhon ne awam-un-naas ke sath ehsan-o-sulook kiye to hum ne bhi apni theliyon ke munh khol daalay goya hum kisi mamlay mein un se kam nahin rahe, ab jabke barabar ki takkar chali ja rahi thi to unhon ne kaha hum mein ek Nabi hai, suno chahe idhar ki duniya udhar ho jaye na to hum us ki tasdeeq karenge na maanein ge. Akhnas mayoos ho gaya aur uth kar chal diya. Isi aayat ki tafseer mein Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Badr wale din Akhnas bin Shariq ne qabeela Banu Zuhra se kaha ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhari qarabat ke hain tum un ki nanhiyal mein ho tumhein chahiye ke apne bhanjay ki madad karo, agar woh waqai Nabi hai to muqabla besood hi nahin balkay sarasar nuqsan-deh hai aur bilfarz na bhi ho to bhi woh tumhara hai, achha thehro dekho main Abu Al-Hakam (ya'ni Abu Jahl) se bhi milta hoon suno! Agar Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ghalib aa gaye to woh tumhein kuch nahin kahen ge tum salamti ke sath wapas chale jao ge aur agar tumhari qoum ghalib aa gayi to un mein to tum hi ho, isi din se us ka naam Akhnas hua asal naam Ubay tha, ab Akhnas tanhai mein Abu Jahl se mila aur kehne laga sach bata Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhare nazdeek sachay hain ya jhootay? Dekho yahan mere aur tumhare siwa koi aur nahin dil ki baat mujh se na chupaana, us ne kaha jab yehi baat hai to sau Allah ki qasam Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bilkul sachay aur yaqeenan sadiq hain umar bhar mein kisi choti si choti baat mein kabhi bhi aap ne jhoot nahin bola. Hamara rukne aur mukhalifat karne ki wajah ek aur sirf ek hi hai woh ye ke jab Banu Qusai ke khandan mein jhanday aur phir-heray chale gaye jab hajj ke hajiyon ke aur Baitullah Sharif ke mohtamim-o-muntazim yehi ho gaye phir sab se barh kar ye ke nabuwwat bhi isi qabeelay mein chali gayi to ab aur Quraishiyon ke liye kaun si fazeelat baqi reh gayi? Isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai, pas Aayat-e-Ilahi se muraad zaat-e-Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai.

Phir dobara tasalli di jati hai ke aap apni qoum ki takzeeb-e-eeza rasani waghera par sabr kijiye jaise Ulul-Azm paighambaron ne sabr kiya aur yaqeen maaniye ke jis tarah anjam-e-kaar guzashta nabiyon ka ghalba raha aur unke mukhalifeen tabah-o-barbad hue usi tarah Allah Ta'ala aap ko ghalib karega aur aap ke mukhalifeen maghloob honge. Donon jahan mein haqeeqi bulandi aap ki hi hogi. Rabb toh yeh baat farma chuka hai aur Allah ki baton ko koi badal nahin sakta jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Walaqad sabaqat kalimatuna li-ibadin-al-mursaleen) (Surah As-Saffat: 171) yani hum toh pehle se hi yeh farma chuke hain ke hamare rasoolon ko madad di jayegi aur hamara lashkar hi ghalib rahega aur aayat mein farmata hai aayat (Kataballahu la-aghlibanna ana wa rusuli innallaha qawiyyun aziz) (Surah Al-Mujadilah: 21) Allah Ta'ala yeh likh chuka hai ke main aur mere rasool hi ghalib aayenge yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala quwwat wala aur ghalba wala hai, in nabiyon ke aksar qisse aap ke samne bayan ho chuke hain unke halaat aap ko pahunch chuke hain, aap khoob jante hain ke kis tarah unki nusrat-o-ta'eed hui aur mukhalifeen par unhein kamyabi hasil hui, phir farmata hai agar inki yeh berukhi tujh par garan guzarti hai agar tujh se ho sake toh zameen mein koi surang khod le aur jo mojiza yeh tujh se mangte hain la de ya tere bas mein ho toh koi zeena laga kar aasman par chadh ja aur wahan se inki chahat ki koi nishani le aa. Main ne tujhe itni nishaniyan is qadar mojize diye hain ke ek andha bhi shak na kar sake. Ab inki talab-e-mojizat mahaz mazaq hai aur inaad-o-zid hai koi zaroorat nahin ke tu inhein inki chahat ke mojize har waqt dekhta phire, ya agar woh tere bas ke na hon toh gham kar ke raho, agar Allah chahta toh in sab ko hidayat par muttafiq kar deta, tujhe nadanon mein na milna chahiye jaise aur riwayat mein hai ke agar Rabb chahta toh roo-e-zameen ki makhlooq ko momin bana deta, aap ki hirs thi ke sab log imandar ban kar aap ki tabedari karein toh Rabb ne farma diya ke yeh sa'adat jis ke hisse mein hai tawfeeq ki usi ki rafeeq ho gayi. Phir farmaya ke aap ki dawat par labbaik kehna use naseeb hogi jo kaan laga kar aap ke kaam ko sune samjhe yaad rakhe aur dil mein jagah de, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke yeh use aagah karta hai jo zinda ho, kuffar par toh kalma-e-azab sabit ho chuka hai. Allah Ta'ala murdon ko utha kar bithayega phir usi ki taraf sab ke sab lautaye jayenge. Murdon se murad yahan kuffar hain kyunke woh murda dil hain toh unhein murda jismon se tashbeeh di. Jis mein unki zillat-o-khwari zahir hoti hai.

Phir dobara tasalli di jati hai ke aap apni qoum ki takzeeb-e-eeza rasani waghera par sabr kijiye jaise Ulul-Azm paighambaron ne sabr kiya aur yaqeen maaniye ke jis tarah anjam-e-kaar guzashta nabiyon ka ghalba raha aur unke mukhalifeen tabah-o-barbad hue usi tarah Allah Ta'ala aap ko ghalib karega aur aap ke mukhalifeen maghloob honge. Donon jahan mein haqeeqi bulandi aap ki hi hogi. Rabb toh yeh baat farma chuka hai aur Allah ki baton ko koi badal nahin sakta jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Walaqad sabaqat kalimatuna li-ibadin-al-mursaleen) (Surah As-Saffat: 171) yani hum toh pehle se hi yeh farma chuke hain ke hamare rasoolon ko madad di jayegi aur hamara lashkar hi ghalib rahega aur aayat mein farmata hai aayat (Kataballahu la-aghlibanna ana wa rusuli innallaha qawiyyun aziz) (Surah Al-Mujadilah: 21) Allah Ta'ala yeh likh chuka hai ke main aur mere rasool hi ghalib aayenge yaqeenan Allah Ta'ala quwwat wala aur ghalba wala hai, in nabiyon ke aksar qisse aap ke samne bayan ho chuke hain unke halaat aap ko pahunch chuke hain, aap khoob jante hain ke kis tarah unki nusrat-o-ta'eed hui aur mukhalifeen par unhein kamyabi hasil hui, phir farmata hai agar inki yeh berukhi tujh par garan guzarti hai agar tujh se ho sake toh zameen mein koi surang khod le aur jo mojiza yeh tujh se mangte hain la de ya tere bas mein ho toh koi zeena laga kar aasman par chadh ja aur wahan se inki chahat ki koi nishani le aa. Main ne tujhe itni nishaniyan is qadar mojize diye hain ke ek andha bhi shak na kar sake. Ab inki talab-e-mojizat mahaz mazaq hai aur inaad-o-zid hai koi zaroorat nahin ke tu inhein inki chahat ke mojize har waqt dekhta phire, ya agar woh tere bas ke na hon toh gham kar ke raho, agar Allah chahta toh in sab ko hidayat par muttafiq kar deta, tujhe nadanon mein na milna chahiye jaise aur riwayat mein hai ke agar Rabb chahta toh roo-e-zameen ki makhlooq ko momin bana deta, aap ki hirs thi ke sab log imandar ban kar aap ki tabedari karein toh Rabb ne farma diya ke yeh sa'adat jis ke hisse mein hai tawfeeq ki usi ki rafeeq ho gayi. Phir farmaya ke aap ki dawat par labbaik kehna use naseeb hogi jo kaan laga kar aap ke kaam ko sune samjhe yaad rakhe aur dil mein jagah de, jaise aur aayat mein hai ke yeh use aagah karta hai jo zinda ho, kuffar par toh kalma-e-azab sabit ho chuka hai. Allah Ta'ala murdon ko utha kar bithayega phir usi ki taraf sab ke sab lautaye jayenge. Murdon se murad yahan kuffar hain kyunke woh murda dil hain toh unhein murda jismon se tashbeeh di. Jis mein unki zillat-o-khwari zahir hoti hai.

Haq ke dushman ko us ke haal par chhoriye aap ﷺ sachay hain. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi-e-Mohtaram Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa ﷺ ko tasalli deta hai ke aap apni qoum ko jhutlane, na maanne aur eizayein pohanchane se tang-dil na hon, farmata hai ke hamein in ki harkat khoob maloom hai, aap in ki is laghwiyat par malaal na karo, kya agar yeh imaan na layein to aap in ke peechay apni jaan ko rog laga len ge? Kahan tak in ke liye hasrat-o-afsos karenge? Samjha dijiye aur in ka mamla supurd-e-Ilah kijiye. Yeh log darasal aap ko jhoota nahin jaante balkay yeh to haq ke dushman hain. Chunancha Abu Jahl ne saaf kaha tha ke hum tujhe nahin jhutlate lekin tu jo le kar aaya hai usay nahin maante, Hakim ki riwayat mein hai ke isi baaray mein yeh aayat nazil hui, Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke Abu Jahl ko Huzoor ﷺ se musafa karte hue dekh kar kisi ne us se kaha ke is be-deen se tu musafa karta hai? To us ne jawab diya ke Allah ki qasam mujhe khoob ilm hai aur kaamil yaqeen hai ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ke sachay Nabi hain. Hum sirf khandani bina par in ki nabuwat ke mat-hat nahin hote. Hum ne aaj tak Bani Abd-e-Manaf ki tabedari nahin ki. Al-garz Huzoor ﷺ ko Rasoolullah maante hue aap ki farmanbardari se bhaagte thay, Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq R.H ne bayan farmaya hai ke Hazrat Zuhri R.H is qissay ko bayan karte hue jis mein Abu Jahl, Abu Sufyan, Sakhr bin Harb, Akhnas bin Shariq ka raat ke waqt posheeda tor par aa kar ek dusre ki be-khabri mein Rasoolullah ﷺ ka zabani Quran sunna hai kehte hain ke in logon ne subh tak Quran suna roshni zara si namoodar hui thi to yeh wapas chalay. Ittefaqan ek chowk mein ek dusre se mulaqat ho gayi hairat se ek dusre se poochte hain ke is waqt yahan kahan? Phir har ek dusre se saaf saaf keh deta hai ke Huzoor ﷺ se Quran sunne ke liye chup-chap aa gaye thay. Ab teeno baith kar mu'ahida karte hain ke aayinda aisa na karna warna agar auron ko khabar hui aur woh aaye to woh to sachay pakkay musalman ho jayenge. Dusri raat ko har ek ne apne tor yeh guman kar ke ke kal raat ke waaday ke mutabiq woh dono to aayenge nahin main tanha kyun na jaaun? Mere jaane ki kisay khabar hogi? Apne ghar se pichli raat ke andheray aur suftay mein har ek chala aur ek konay mein dab kar Allah ke Nabi ki zabani tilawat-e-Quran ka maza leta raha aur subh ke waqt wapas chala. Ittefaqan aaj bhi usi jagah teeno ka mel ho gaya. Har ek ne ek dusre ko bari malamat ki bohat ta'an-o-malamat ki aur naye siray se ahd kiya ke ab aisi harkat nahin karenge. Lekin teesri shab phir sabr na ho saka aur har ek isi tarah posheeda tor par pohancha aur har ek ko dusre ke aane ka ilm bhi ho gaya, phir jama ho kar apne tayin bura bhala kehne lagay aur bari sakht qasmein kha kar qaul-o-qarar kiye ke ab aisa nahin karenge.

Subh hote hi Akhnas bin Shariq kapray pehan kar tayyar ho kar Abu Sufyan bin Harb ke paas us ke ghar mein gaya aur kehne laga ae Abu Hanzala imaan se batao sach sach kaho jo Quran tum ne Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki zabani suna us ki babat tumhari apni zaati raye kya hai? Us ne kaha Abu Sa'laba suno! Wallah bohat si aayaton ke alfaaz ma'ani aur matlab to main samajh gaya aur bohat si aayaton ko un ki muraad ko main jaanta hi nahin. Akhnas ne kaha wallah yehi haal mera bhi hai, ab yahan se uth kar Akhnas seedha Abu Jahl ke paas pohancha aur kehne laga Abu Al-Hakam tum sach batao jo kuch tum Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sunte ho us mein tumhara khayal kya hai? Us ne kaha sun jo suna hai usay to ek taraf rakh de baat ye hai ke Banu Abd-e-Manaf aur hum mein chashmak hai woh hum se aur hum un se barhna aur sabqat karna chahte hain aur muddat se ye rassa-kashi ho rahi hai, unhon ne mehmandariyan aur dawatain keen to hum ne bhi keen unhon ne logon ko sawariyan deen to hum ne bhi yehi kiya. Unhon ne awam-un-naas ke sath ehsan-o-sulook kiye to hum ne bhi apni theliyon ke munh khol daalay goya hum kisi mamlay mein un se kam nahin rahe, ab jabke barabar ki takkar chali ja rahi thi to unhon ne kaha hum mein ek Nabi hai, suno chahe idhar ki duniya udhar ho jaye na to hum us ki tasdeeq karenge na maanein ge. Akhnas mayoos ho gaya aur uth kar chal diya. Isi aayat ki tafseer mein Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Badr wale din Akhnas bin Shariq ne qabeela Banu Zuhra se kaha ke Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhari qarabat ke hain tum un ki nanhiyal mein ho tumhein chahiye ke apne bhanjay ki madad karo, agar woh waqai Nabi hai to muqabla besood hi nahin balkay sarasar nuqsan-deh hai aur bilfarz na bhi ho to bhi woh tumhara hai, achha thehro dekho main Abu Al-Hakam (ya'ni Abu Jahl) se bhi milta hoon suno! Agar Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ghalib aa gaye to woh tumhein kuch nahin kahen ge tum salamti ke sath wapas chale jao ge aur agar tumhari qoum ghalib aa gayi to un mein to tum hi ho, isi din se us ka naam Akhnas hua asal naam Ubay tha, ab Akhnas tanhai mein Abu Jahl se mila aur kehne laga sach bata Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tumhare nazdeek sachay hain ya jhootay? Dekho yahan mere aur tumhare siwa koi aur nahin dil ki baat mujh se na chupaana, us ne kaha jab yehi baat hai to sau Allah ki qasam Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bilkul sachay aur yaqeenan sadiq hain umar bhar mein kisi choti si choti baat mein kabhi bhi aap ne jhoot nahin bola. Hamara rukne aur mukhalifat karne ki wajah ek aur sirf ek hi hai woh ye ke jab Banu Qusai ke khandan mein jhanday aur phir-heray chale gaye jab hajj ke hajiyon ke aur Baitullah Sharif ke mohtamim-o-muntazim yehi ho gaye phir sab se barh kar ye ke nabuwwat bhi isi qabeelay mein chali gayi to ab aur Quraishiyon ke liye kaun si fazeelat baqi reh gayi? Isi ka zikr is aayat mein hai, pas Aayat-e-Ilahi se muraad zaat-e-Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hai.

Mu'jizat ke adam-e-izhar ki hikmat: Kafir log bator-e-aitraz kaha karte the ke jo mu'jiza hum talab karte hain yeh kyun nahin dikhate? Maslan Arab ki kul zameen mein chashmon aur aabsharon ka jaari ho jana waghera, farmata hai ke qudrat-e-Ilahi se toh koi cheez bahar nahin lekin us waqt hikmat-e-Ilahiya ka taqaza yeh nahin. Is mein ek zahiri hikmat toh yeh hai ke tumhare chahe hue mu'jize ko dekh lene ke baad bhi agar tum iman na laye toh usool-e-Ilahiya ke mutabiq tum sab ko usi jagah halak kar diya jayega jaise tum se agle logon ke sath hua, Thamudiyon ki nazeer tumhare samne majood hai hum toh jo chahein nishan bhi dikha sakte hain aur jo chahein azab bhi kar sakte hain, charne chugne wale janwar udne wale parind bhi tumhari tarah qisam qisam ke hain maslan parind ek ummat, insan ek ummat, jinnat ek ummat waghera, ya yeh ke woh bhi sab tumhari hi tarah makhlooq hain, sab par Allah ka ilm muheet hai, sab us ki kitab mein likhe hue hain, na kisi ka woh rizq bhoole na kisi ki haajat atke na kisi ki husn-e-tadbeer se woh ghafil khushki tari ka ek ek jaandar us ki hifazat mein hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (Wa ma min daabbatin fil-ardi illal-lahi rizquha wa ya'lamu mustaqarraha wa mustawda'aha, kullun fi kitabin mubeen) (11. Hud: 6) yani jitne jaandar zameen par chalte phirte hain sab ki roziyan Allah ke zimme hain wahi un ke jeete jee ke thikane ko aur marne ke baad sonpe jane ke maqam ko bakhoobi janta hai us ke paas Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein yeh sab kuch darj bhi hai, un ke naam, un ki ginti, un ki harkat-o-saknat sab se woh waqif hai us ke wasee ilm se koi cheez kharij aur bahar nahin aur maqam par irshad hai aayat (Wa ka-ayyin min daabbatin la tahmilu rizqaha, Allahu yarzuquha wa iyyakum, wa huwas-samee'ul aleem) (29. Al-Ankabut: 60) bahut se woh jaandar hain jin ki rozi tere zimme nahin unhein aur tum sab ko Allah hi roziyan deta hai woh bareek awaz ko sunne wala hai aur har chhoti badi cheez ka janne wala hai, Abu Ya'la mein Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah R.A se marwi hai ke Hazrat Umar R.A ki do saal ki khilafat ke zamane mein se ek saal tiddiyan dikhayi hi nahin dein toh aap ko bahut khayal hua aur Shaam, Iraq, Yaman waghera ki taraf sawar doraye ke daryaft kar aayen ke tiddiyan is saal kahin nazar bhi parin ya nahin? Yaman wala qasid jab wapas aaya toh aap ke sath mutthi bhar tiddiyan bhi leta aaya aur Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ke samne daal din aap ne unhein dekh kar teen martaba takbeer kahi aur farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne ek hazar ummatein paida ki hain jin mein se chhe sau tari mein hain aur char sau khushki mein.

In tamam ummaton mein se sab se pehle tiddi halak hogi us ke baad to halak hogi us ke baad to halakat ka silsila shuru ho jaye ga bilkul is tarah jaise kisi tasbeeh ka dhaga toot gaya aur moti yakke baad deegare jhadne lag gaye, phir farmata hai sab ka hashr Allah ki taraf hai yani sab ko maut hai, chopayon ki maut hi un ka hashr hai, ek qaul to yeh hai, dusra qaul yeh hai ke maidan-e-mahshar mein baroz-e-qayamat yeh bhi Allah Jalla Shanuhu ke samne jama kiye jayenge jaise farmaya aayat (Wa izal wuhushu hushirat) (81. At-Takwir: 5). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke do bakriyon ko aapas mein ladte hue dekh kar Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) se daryaft farmaya ke jante ho yeh kyun lad rahi hain? Jawab mila ke main kya janun? Farmaya lekin Allah Ta'ala janta hai aur un ke darmiyan woh faisla bhi kare ga, Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek aur riwayat mein itni ziyadati bhi hai ke udne wale har ek parind ka ilm bhi hamare samne bayan kiya gaya hai, Musnad ki aur riwayat mein hai ke be-seeng bakri qayamat ke din seeng wali bakri se apna badla le gi. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se marwi hai ke tamam makhlooq chopaye bahaim parind waghera garz tamam cheezein Allah ke samne hazir hongi. Phir un mein yahan tak adl hoga ke be-seeng wali bakri ko agar seeng wali bakri ne mara hoga to us ka bhi badla dilwaya jaye ga phir un se Janab-e-Bari farmaye ga tum mitti ho jao. Us waqt kafir bhi yahi aarzoo karenge ke kaash hum bhi mitti ho jate. Soor wali hadith mein yeh marfoo'an bhi marwi hai. Phir kafiron ki misaal bayan ki gayi hai ke woh apni kam-ilmi aur kaj-fehmi mein un behron goongon ke misl hain jo andheron mein hon. Batao to woh kaise rah-e-rast par aa sakte hain? Na kisi ki sunen na apni kahen na kuch dekh saken. Jaise Surah Al-Baqarah ki ibtida mein hai ke un ki misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jo aag sulgaye jab aas paas ki cheezein us par roshan ho jayen us waqt aag bujh jaye aur woh andheriyon mein reh jaye aur kuch na dekh sake. Aise log behre goonge andhe hain woh rah-e-rast ki taraf laut nahin sakte aur aayat mein hai aayat (Au ka-zulumatin fi bahrin lujjiyyin yaghshahu maujun min fauqihi maujun min fauqihi sahabun, zulumatum ba'duha fauqa ba'din) (24. An-Nur: 40). Yani misl un andheron ke jo gehre samundar mein hon jis ki maujon par maujein uth rahi hon aur upar se abr chhaya ho andheron par andheriyan hon ke hath bhi nazar na aa sake. Jise qudrat ne noor nahin bakhsha woh be-noor hai. Phir farmaya sari makhlooq mein Allah hi ka tasarruf hai woh jise chahe Sirat-e-Mustaqeem par kar de.

Farmaya lekin Allah Ta'ala janta hai aur un ke darmiyan woh faisla bhi kare ga, Ibn-e-Jarir ki ek aur riwayat mein itni ziyadati bhi hai ke udne wale har ek parind ka ilm bhi hamare samne bayan kiya gaya hai, Musnad ki aur riwayat mein hai ke be-seeng bakri qayamat ke din seeng wali bakri se apna badla le gi. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) se marwi hai ke tamam makhlooq chopaye bahaim parind waghera garz tamam cheezein Allah ke samne hazir hongi. Phir un mein yahan tak adl hoga ke be-seeng wali bakri ko agar seeng wali bakri ne mara hoga to us ka bhi badla dilwaya jaye ga phir un se Janab-e-Bari farmaye ga tum mitti ho jao. Us waqt kafir bhi yahi aarzoo karenge ke kaash hum bhi mitti ho jate. Soor wali hadith mein yeh marfoo'an bhi marwi hai. Phir kafiron ki misaal bayan ki gayi hai ke woh apni kam-ilmi aur kaj-fehmi mein un behron goongon ke misl hain jo andheron mein hon. Batao to woh kaise rah-e-rast par aa sakte hain? Na kisi ki sunen na apni kahen na kuch dekh saken. Jaise Surah Al-Baqarah ki ibtida mein hai ke un ki misaal us shakhs jaisi hai jo aag sulgaye jab aas paas ki cheezein us par roshan ho jayen us waqt aag bujh jaye aur woh andheriyon mein reh jaye aur kuch na dekh sake. Aise log behre goonge andhe hain woh rah-e-rast ki taraf laut nahin sakte aur aayat mein hai aayat (Au ka-zulumatin fi bahrin lujjiyyin yaghshahu maujun min fauqihi maujun min fauqihi sahabun, zulumatum ba'duha fauqa ba'din) (24. An-Nur: 40). Yani misl un andheron ke jo gehre samundar mein hon jis ki maujon par maujein uth rahi hon aur upar se abr chhaya ho andheron par andheriyan hon ke hath bhi nazar na aa sake. Jise qudrat ne noor nahin bakhsha woh be-noor hai. Phir farmaya sari makhlooq mein Allah hi ka tasarruf hai woh jise chahe Sirat-e-Mustaqeem par kar de.

Mu'jizat ke adam-e-izhar ki hikmat: Kafir log bator-e-aitraz kaha karte the ke jo mu'jiza hum talab karte hain yeh kyun nahin dikhate? Maslan Arab ki kul zameen mein chashmon aur aabsharon ka jaari ho jana waghera, farmata hai ke qudrat-e-Ilahi se toh koi cheez bahar nahin lekin us waqt hikmat-e-Ilahiya ka taqaza yeh nahin. Is mein ek zahiri hikmat toh yeh hai ke tumhare chahe hue mu'jize ko dekh lene ke baad bhi agar tum iman na laye toh usool-e-Ilahiya ke mutabiq tum sab ko usi jagah halak kar diya jayega jaise tum se agle logon ke sath hua, Thamudiyon ki nazeer tumhare samne majood hai hum toh jo chahein nishan bhi dikha sakte hain aur jo chahein azab bhi kar sakte hain, charne chugne wale janwar udne wale parind bhi tumhari tarah qisam qisam ke hain maslan parind ek ummat, insan ek ummat, jinnat ek ummat waghera, ya yeh ke woh bhi sab tumhari hi tarah makhlooq hain, sab par Allah ka ilm muheet hai, sab us ki kitab mein likhe hue hain, na kisi ka woh rizq bhoole na kisi ki haajat atke na kisi ki husn-e-tadbeer se woh ghafil khushki tari ka ek ek jaandar us ki hifazat mein hai. Jaise farman hai aayat (Wa ma min daabbatin fil-ardi illal-lahi rizquha wa ya'lamu mustaqarraha wa mustawda'aha, kullun fi kitabin mubeen) (11. Hud: 6) yani jitne jaandar zameen par chalte phirte hain sab ki roziyan Allah ke zimme hain wahi un ke jeete jee ke thikane ko aur marne ke baad sonpe jane ke maqam ko bakhoobi janta hai us ke paas Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein yeh sab kuch darj bhi hai, un ke naam, un ki ginti, un ki harkat-o-saknat sab se woh waqif hai us ke wasee ilm se koi cheez kharij aur bahar nahin aur maqam par irshad hai aayat (Wa ka-ayyin min daabbatin la tahmilu rizqaha, Allahu yarzuquha wa iyyakum, wa huwas-samee'ul aleem) (29. Al-Ankabut: 60) bahut se woh jaandar hain jin ki rozi tere zimme nahin unhein aur tum sab ko Allah hi roziyan deta hai woh bareek awaz ko sunne wala hai aur har chhoti badi cheez ka janne wala hai, Abu Ya'la mein Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah R.A se marwi hai ke Hazrat Umar R.A ki do saal ki khilafat ke zamane mein se ek saal tiddiyan dikhayi hi nahin dein toh aap ko bahut khayal hua aur Shaam, Iraq, Yaman waghera ki taraf sawar doraye ke daryaft kar aayen ke tiddiyan is saal kahin nazar bhi parin ya nahin? Yaman wala qasid jab wapas aaya toh aap ke sath mutthi bhar tiddiyan bhi leta aaya aur Hazrat Farooq-e-Azam R.A ke samne daal din aap ne unhein dekh kar teen martaba takbeer kahi aur farmaya main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se suna hai ke Allah Azza-wa-Jal ne ek hazar ummatein paida ki hain jin mein se chhe sau tari mein hain aur char sau khushki mein.

At-Takwir: 5). Sakht log aur kasrat-e-daulat. Matlab yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala Qadir-e-Mutlaq hai, tamam makhlooq us ke aage past-o-lachar hai. Jo chahta hai hukum karta hai, us ka koi irada badalta nahin, us ka koi hukum talta nahin, koi nahin jo us ki chahat ke khilaf kar sake ya us ke hukum ko taal sake ya us ki qaza ko pher sake. Woh sare mulk ka tanha malik hai, us ki kisi baat mein koi shareek ya dakhil nahin. Jo us se mange woh use deta hai, jis ki chahe dua qabool farmata hai. Pas farmata hai khud tumhein bhi in tamam baton ka ilm-o-iqrar hai, yahi wajah hai ke aasmani sazaon ke aa padne par tum apne tamam shareekon ko bhool jate ho aur sirf Allah-e-Wahid ko pukarte ho. Agar tum sache ho ke Allah ke sath us ke kuch aur shareek bhi hain to aise kathan mauqon par un mein se kisi ko kyun nahin pukarte? Balkeh sirf Allah-e-Wahid ko pukarte ho aur apne tamam maboodan-e-batil ko bhool jate ho. Chunancha aur aayat mein hai ke samundar mein jab zarar pahunchta hai to Allah ke siwa har ek tumhari yaad se nikal jata hai. Hum ne agli ummaton ki taraf bhi Rasool bheje, phir un ke na manne par hum ne unhein faqr-o-faqa mein, tangi-o-turshi mein, bimariyon aur dukh dard mein mubtala kar diya ke ab bhi woh hamare samne girya-o-zari karein, aajizana taur par hamare samne jhuk jayen, hum se dar jayen aur hamare daman se chimat jayen. Phir unhon ne hamare azabon ke aa jane ke baad bhi hamare samne aajizi kyun na ki? Maskeeni kyun na jitayi? Balkeh un ke dil sakht ho gaye, shirk, dushmani, zid, ta'assub, sarkashi, nafarmani waghera ko Shaitan ne unhein bada husn mein dikhaya aur yeh is par jame rahe. Jab yeh log hamari baton ko faramosh kar gaye, hamari kitab ko pas-e-pusht daal diya, hamare farman se munh mod liya to hum ne bhi unhein dheel de di ke yeh apni buraiyon mein aur aage nikal jayen. Har tarah ki roziyan aur zyada se zyada maal unhein dete rahe yahan tak ke maal, aulad-o-rizq waghera ki wus'at par woh bhoolne lage aur ghaflat ke gehre garhay mein utar gaye to hum ne unhein nagahan pakad liya, us waqt woh mayoos ho gaye. Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) ka sufiyana maqoola hai ke jis ne kushadgi ke waqt Allah Ta'ala ki dheel na samjhi woh mehez be-aql hai aur jis ne tangi ke waqt Rab ki rahmat ki umeed chhod di woh bhi mehez bewaqoof hai. Phir aap isi aayat ki tilawat farmate hain, Rab-e-Ka'aba ki qasam aise log bhi hain jo apni chahaton ko poori hote hue dekh kar Allah ko bhool jate hain aur phir Rab ki giraft mein aa jate hain. Hazrat Qatada ka farman hai ke jab koi qoum Allah ke farman se sartabi karti hai to awwal to unhein duniya khoob mil jati hai, jab woh ne'maton mein pad kar bad-mast ho jate hain to achanak pakad liye jate hain. Logo! Allah ki dheel ko samajh jaya karo, nafarmaniyon par ne'matein milein to ghafil ho kar nafarmaniyon mein badh na jao.

Is liye ke yeh toh badkar aur benaseeb logon ka kaam hai, Zuhri farmate hain har cheez ke darwaze khol dene se murad duniya mein aasayish-o-aaram ka dena hai, Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain jab tum dekho ke kisi gunahgar shakhs ko us ki gunahgari ke bawajood Allah ki ne'matein duniya mein mil rahi hain toh usey istidraj samajhna yani woh ek muhlat hai, phir Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi aur hadith mein hai ke jab kisi qoum ki barbadi ka waqt aa jata hai toh un par khayanat ka darwaza khul jata hai yahan tak ke woh un di gayi hui cheezon par itrane lagte hain toh hum unhein nagahan pakad lete hain aur us waqt woh mahaz na-umeed ho jate hain. Phir farmaya zalimon ki baag-dor kaat di jati hai. Tareefon ke laiq woh Mabood-e-Barhaq hai jo sab ka palanhar hai (Musnad waghera).

Har tarah ki roziyan aur zyada se zyada maal unhein dete rahe yahan tak ke maal, aulad-o-rizq waghera ki wus'at par woh bhoolne lage aur ghaflat ke gehre garhay mein utar gaye to hum ne unhein nagahan pakad liya, us waqt woh mayoos ho gaye. Is ke haram karda kamon ko karte the aur us ke bataye hue kamon se bhagte the.

Mahroom aur Kamran Kaun? Farman hai ke in mukhalifeen-e-Islam se pucho to ke agar Allah Ta'ala tum se tumhare kaan aur tumhari aankhein chheen le jaise ke us ne tumhein diye hain jaise farman hai aayat (وَهُوَ الَّذِيْٓ اَنْشَاَ لَـكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَالْاَفْـــِٕدَةَ ۭ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Mu'minun: 78) yani Allah Khaliq-e-Kul woh hai jis ne tumhein paida kiya aur tumhein sunne ko kaan aur dekhne ko aankhein dein, yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke murad chheen lene se shar'i nafa na pahunchana ho is ki daleel is ke baad ka jumla dil par mohar laga dena hai, jaise farman hai aayat (اَمَّنْ يَّمْلِكُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَمَنْ يُّخْرِجُ الْـحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَمَنْ يُّدَبِّرُ الْاَمْرَ) (Surah Yunus: 31) kaun hai jo kaan ka aur aankhon ka maalik ho? Aur farman hai aayat (وَاعْلَمُوْٓا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَحُوْلُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْءِ وَقَلْبِهٖ وَاَنَّهٗٓ اِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Anfal: 24) jaan lo ke Allah Ta'ala insaan ke aur us ke dil ke darmiyan hail hai, yahan un se sawal hota hai ke batlao to ke Allah ke siwa aur koi in cheezon ke wapas dilane par qudrat rakhta hai? Yani koi nahin rakhta, dekh le ke main ne apni Tauheed ke kis qadar zabardast, purzor saaf aur jache tule dalail bayan kar diye hain aur yeh sabit kar diya ke mere siwa sab bebas hain lekin yeh mushrik log bawajood is qadar khuli roshan aur saaf daleelon ke haq ko nahin maante balkeh auron ko bhi haq ko tasleem karne se rokte hain, phir farmata hai zara is sawal ka jawab bhi do ke Allah ka azab tumhari bekhabari mein ya zahir khulam khulla tumhare paas aa jaye to kya siwa zalimon aur mushrikon ke kisi aur ko bhi halakat hogi? Yani na hogi. Allah ki ibadat karne wale is halakat se mehfooz rahenge jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (اَلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَلَمْ يَلْبِسُوْٓا اِيْمَانَهُمْ بِظُلْمٍ اُولٰۗىِٕكَ لَهُمُ الْاَمْنُ وَهُمْ مُّهْتَدُوْنَ) (Surah Al-An'am: 82) jo log imaan laye aur apne imaan ko shirk se kharab na kiya un ke liye aman-o-aman hai aur woh hidayat yafta hain. Phir farmaya ke Rasoolon ka kaam to yahi hai ke imaan walon ko un ke darjon ki khushkhabriyan sunayein aur kuffar ko Allah ke azab se darayein, jo log dil se aap ki baat maan lein aur Allah ke farman ke mutabiq aamal baja layein, unhein aakhirat mein koi dar khauf nahin aur duniya ke chhorne par koi malal nahin, un ke baal bachon ka Allah wali hai aur un ke tarke ka wahi hafiz hai kafiron ko aur jhutlane walon ko un ke kufr-o-fisq ki wajah se bade sakht azab honge kyunke unhon ne Allah ke farman chhor rakhe the aur us ki nafarmaniyon mein mashghool the. Is ke haram karda kamon ko karte the aur us ke bataye hue kamon se bhagte the.

Musalmano! Tabaqati asabiyat se bacho. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ) se farmata hai ke logon mein elaan kar do ke main Allah ke khazanon ka maalik nahin, na mujhe un mein kisi tarah ka ikhtiyar hai, na main yeh kehta hoon ke main ghaib ka janne wala hoon, Rabb ne jo cheezein khaas apne ilm mein rakhi hain mujhe un mein se kuch bhi maloom nahin, haan jin cheezon se khud Allah ne mujhe muttala kar de un par mujhe ittila ho jati hai, mera yeh bhi dawa nahin ke main koi farishta hoon, main toh insaan hoon, Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe jo sharaf diya hai yani meri taraf jo wahi nazil farmayi hai main usi ka amal paira hoon, is se ek balisht idhar udhar nahin hatta. Kya haq ke tabe-daar jo basarat wale hain aur haq se mehroom jo andhe hain barabar ho sakte hain? Kya tum itna gaur bhi nahin karte? Aur aayat mein hai ke kya woh shakhs jo jaanta hai ke jo kuch teri taraf tere Rabb ki janib se utra hai haq hai us shakhs jaisa ho sakta hai jo nabina hai? Nasihat toh sirf wahi hasil karte hain jo aqalmand hain. Ae Nabi (ﷺ) aap Quran ke zariye inhe raah-e-raast par layein jo Rabb ke samne khade hone ka khauf dil mein rakhte hain, hisab ka khatka rakhte hain, jaante hain ke Rabb ke samne pesh hona hai us din us ke siwa aur koi un ka qareebi ya sifarishi na hoga, woh agar azab karna chahe toh koi shafa'at nahin kar sakta. Yeh tera darana is liye hai ke shayad woh taqi ban jayein, Haakim-e-Haqiqi se dar kar nekiyan karein aur Qayamat ke azabon se chhootein aur jannat ke mustahiq ban jayein. Phir farmata hai yeh musalman ghurbaa jo subh-o-sham apne Parwardigar ka naam japte hain khabardar inhe haqeer na samajhna, inhe apne paas se na hatana balkay inhi ko apni sohbat mein rakh kar inhi ke saath baith uth. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wastabir nafsaka ma'allazina yad'una rabbahum bil-ghadati wal-ashiyyi yuriduna wajhahu wala ta'du aynaka anhum) (18. Al-Kahf: 28) yani inhi ke saath reh jo subh-o-sham apne Parwardigar ko pukarte hain usi ki raza-mandi ki talab karte hain, khabardar un ki taraf se aankhein na pherna ke duniya ki zindagi ki aasayish talab karne lago, us ka kaha na karna jis ke dil ko hum ne apni yaad se ghafil kar diya hai aur us ne apni khwahish ki pairwi ki hai aur us ka har kaam had se guzra hua hai, balkay un ka saath de jo subh-o-sham Allah ki ibadat karte hain aur usi se duayein maangte hain. Ba'az buzurg farmate hain murad is se farz namazein hain aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa qala rabbukumud'uni astajib lakum innallazina yastakbiruna an ibadati sayadkhuluna jahannama dakhireen) (40. Al-Ghafir: 60).

Ghafir: 60) Tumhare Rab ka elaan hai ke mujh se duayein karo main qubool karunga. In itaat-on aur ibadat-on se unka irada Allah Kareem ke deedar ka hai, mehez khuloos-o-ikhlas wali unki niyatein hain, unka koi hisab tujh par nahin na tera koi hisab un par. Janab-e-Nuh (A.S) se jab unki qoum ke shurfa ne kaha tha ke hum tujhe kaise maan lein tere manne wale toh aksar ghareeb maskeen log hain toh aap ne yahi jawab diya ke unke aamaal ka mujhe kya ilm hai unka hisab toh mere Rab par hai lekin tumhein itna bhi shaoor nahin. Phir bhi tum ne in ghareeb maskeen logon ko apni majlis mein na baithne diya. Un se zara bhi berukhi ki toh yaad rakhna tumhara shumar bhi zalimon mein ho jayega. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Quraish ke bade log Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas gaye us waqt aap ki majlis-e-mubarak mein Hazrat Suhaib (R.A), Hazrat Bilal (R.A), Hazrat Khabbab (R.A), Hazrat Ammar (R.A) the, inhe dekh kar yeh log kehne lage dekho toh hamein chhod kar kin ke sath baithe hain? Toh aayat (Wa anzir bihi se bish-shakireen tak) utri. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke in logon aur in jaise auron ko Huzoor (ﷺ) ki majlis mein dekh kar mushrik sardaron ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke kya yahi log reh gaye hain ke Allah ne hum sab mein se chun chun kar inhi par ehsan kiya? Yeh kaise ho sakta hai ke yeh pe dar pe sahara log bhi hum amiron raeeson ke barabar baithein. Dekhiye Hazrat agar aap inhe apni majlis se nikal dein toh woh aap ki majlis mein baith sakte hain. Is par aayat (WALA TATRUDIL-LAZEENA YAD'OONA RABBAHUM BIL-GHADATI WAL-ASHIYYI YUREEDOONA WAJHAH) (6. Al-An'am: 52) shakireen tak utri. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Quraish ke in moazzizeen logon mein se do ke naam yeh hain Aqra bin Habis Taimi, Uyaynah bin Hisn Fazari. Is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke tanhai mein mil kar unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ko samjhaya ke in ghulam aur gire pade be-haisiyat logon ke sath hamein baithte hue sharm maloom hoti hai, aap ki majlis mein Arab ka wafd aaya karte hain woh hamein in ke sath dekh kar hamein bhi zaleel khayal karenge toh aap kam se kam itna hi kijiye ke jab hum aayein tab khaas majlis ho aur in jaise gire pade log is mein shamil na kiye jayein, haan jab hum na hon toh aap ko ikhtiyar hai. Jab yeh baat tay ho gayi aur aap ne bhi is ka iqrar kar liya toh unhon ne kaha hamara yeh muahida tehreer mein aa jana chahiye. Aap ne kagaz mangwaya aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko likhne ke liye bulwaya, musalmanon ka yeh ghareeb tabqa ek kone mein baitha hua tha isi waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) utre aur yeh aayat nazil hui. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne kagaz phenk diya aur hamein apne paas bula liya aur hum ne phir se Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko apne halqe mein le liya, lekin yeh hadees ghareeb hai, aayat Makki hai aur Aqra aur Uyaynah hijrat ke bahut sare zamane ke baad Islam mein aaye hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) bhi the, hum log sab se pehle khidmat-e-Nabwi mein jate aur aap ke gird-o-pesh baithte taake poori tarah aur shuru se aakhir tak aap ki hadeesein sunen.

Quraish ke bade logon par yeh baat garan guzarti thi is ke bar-khilaf yeh aayat utri (Mustadrak Hakim). Phir farmata hai isi tarah hum ek dusre ko parakh lete hain aur ek se ek ka imtehan le lete hain ke yeh umra in ghuraba se mutaliq apni raye zahir kar dein ke kya yahi log hain jin par Allah ne ehsan kiya aur hum sab mein se Allah ko yahi log pasand aaye? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sab se pehle tasleem karne wale yahi bechare be-maya ghareeb ghuraba log thay, mard, aurat, laundi, ghulam waghera, bade bade aur zi-waqat logon mein se toh us waqt yunhi koi akka-dukka aa gaya tha. Yahi log darasal Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ke muti aur farman-bardar hote rahe. Qaum-e-Nuh ne kaha tha (Wa ma nara-ka ittaba-aka illa-llazina hum araazilu-na badi-yar-rayi) (Surah Hud: 27) yani hum toh dekhte hain ke teri tabedari razeel aur be-waqoof logon ne hi ki hai. Shah-e-Room Heraclius ne jab Abu Sufyan se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki babat yeh daryaft kiya ke shareef logon ne is ki pairwi ikhtiyar ki hai? Ya zaeef logon ne? Toh Abu Sufyan ne jawab diya tha ke zaeef logon ne, badshah ne is se yeh natija nikala ke fi-waqai tamam nabiyon ka awwal pairu yahi tabqa hota hai. Al-gharaz mushrikeen-e-Makkah in imandar-on ka mazaq udate aur unhein satate thay, jahan tak bas chalta unhein sazayein dete aur kehte ke yeh namumkin hai ke bhalai inhein toh nazar aa jaye aur hum yunhi reh jayein? Quran mein un ka qaul yeh bhi hai ke aayat (Lau kana khairam-ma sabaquna ilaih) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 11) agar yeh koi achi cheez hoti toh yeh log hum se aage na badh sakte. Aur aayat mein hai jab un ke samne hamari saaf aur wazeh aayatein tilawat ki jati hain toh yeh kuffar imandaron se kehte hain ke batao toh martabe mein, izzat mein, hasab-nasab mein kaun shareef hai? Is ke jawab mein Rabb ne farmaya aayat (Wa kam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu asasan wa riya) (Surah Maryam: 74) yani in se pehle hum ne bohat si bastiyan tabah kar di hain jo ba-aitbar-e-saman-o-asbab ke aur ba-aitbar-e-numood-o-riya ke in se bohat hi aage badhi hui thin. Chunancha yahan bhi un ke aise hi qaul ke jawab mein farmaya gaya ke shukar-guzaron ko Allah khoob janta hai jo apne aqwal-o-af'aal aur qawi iradon ko durust rakhte hain. Allah Ta'ala unhein salamatiyon ki rahein dikhata hai aur andheron se nikal kar noor ki taraf lata hai aur sahih raah ki rehnumai karta hai, jaise farman hai aayat (Wallazina jahadu fina la-nahdiyannahum subulana wa innallaha la-ma'al muhsineen) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 69).

Al-Ankabut: 69) Jo log hamari farmanbardari ki koshish karte hain hum unhein apni sahih rah par laga dete hain, Allah Ta'ala nek karon ka sath deta hai. Sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala tumhari suraton aur rangon ko nahin dekhta balkeh niyaton aur a'maal ko dekhta hai. Ikrimah farmate hain Rabi'ah ke dono bete Utbah aur Shaibah aur Adi ka beta Mut'im aur Naufal ka beta Harith aur Amr ka beta Qurtah aur Ibn-e-Abd-e-Manaf ke qabile ke kafir sab ke sab jama ho kar Abu Talib ke paas gaye aur kehne lage dekh aap ke bhatije agar hamari ek darkhwast qabool kar lein to hamare dilon mein un ki azmat-o-izzat hogi aur phir un ki majlis mein bhi aamad-o-raft shuru kar denge aur ho sakta hai ke un ki sachai samajh mein aa jaye aur hum bhi maan lein. Abu Talib ne qoum ke baron ka yeh paigham Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein pahunchaya. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) bhi us waqt us majlis mein the, farmane lage ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aisa karne mein kya harj hai? Allah Azzawajal ne Wa-anzir se bil-shakireen tak ayatein utarein. Yeh ghuraba jinhein yeh log faiz-e-sohbat se mehroom karna chahte the yeh the Bilal, Ammar, Salim, Subaih, Ibn-e-Mas'ud, Miqdad, Mas'ud, Waqid, Amr Zul-Shamalin, Yazid aur inhi jaise aur hazrat (R.A) ajma'een. Inhi dono jamaton ke bare mein ayat (وَكَذٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لِّيَقُوْلُوْٓا اَهٰٓؤُلَاۗءِ مَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنْۢ بَيْنِنَا ۭ اَلَيْسَ اللّٰهُ بِاَعْلَمَ بالشّٰكِرِيْنَ) (Al-An'am: 53) bhi nazil hui. Hazrat Umar in ayaton ko sun kar uzr-o-ma'zarat karne lage, is par ayat (وَاِذَا جَاۗءَكَ الَّذِيْنَ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلٰي نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ ۙ اَنَّهٗ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنْكُمْ سُوْۗءًۢا بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ وَاَصْلَحَ ۙ فَاَنَّهٗ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ) (Al-An'am: 54) nazil hui. Aakhri ayat mein hukum hota hai ke iman wale jab tere paas aa kar salam karein to un ke salam ka jawab do, un ka ehtram karo aur unhein Allah ki wasee rahmat ki khabar do ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne fazl-o-karam se apne nafs par rahmat ko wajib kar liya hai. Ba'az salaf se manqool hai ke gunah har shakhs jahalat se hi karta hai. Ikrimah farmate hain dunya sari jahalat hai. Gharz jo bhi koi burai kare phir us se hat jaye aur poora irada kar le ke aaindah kabhi aisi harkat nahin karega aur aage ke liye apne a'mal ki islah bhi kar le to woh yaqeen mane ke Ghafoor-o-Rahim Allah use bakhshega bhi aur us par meherbani bhi karega. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne jab makhlooq ki qaza-o-qadr muqarrar ki to apni kitab mein likha jo us ke paas Arsh ke oopar hai ke meri rahmat mere ghazab par ghalib hai.

Ibn-e-Marduyah mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke jis waqt Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ke faislay kar de ga apne Arsh ke neeche se ek kitab nikale ga jis mein yeh tahrir hai ke mera raham-o-karam mere ghussay aur ghazab se zyada barha hua hai aur main sab se zyada rahmat karne wala hoon. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ek baar mutthiyan bhar kar apni makhlooq ko jahannam mein se nikale ga jinhon ne koi bhalai nahin ki, un ki peshaniyon par likha hua hoga ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ke azaad karda hain. Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) farmate hain ke Taurat mein hum likha dekhte hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne zameen-o-aasman ko paida kiya aur apni rahmat ke sau hissay kiye, phir sari makhlooq mein un mein se ek hissa rakha aur nannaway (99) hissay apne paas baqi rakhay. Isi ek hissa-e-rahmat ka yeh zuhoor hai ke makhlooq bhi ek dusre par meherbani karti hai aur tawazo se pesh aati hai aur aapas ke talluqat qaim hain, oontni, gaye, bakri, parind, machli waghera janwar apne bachon ki parwarish mein takleefain jhelte hain aur un par pyar-o-mohabbat karte hain. Roz-e-Qayamat mein is hissay ko kaamil karne ke baad is mein nannaway (99) hissay mila liye jayenge. Fi-alwaqai Rabb ki rahmat aur us ka fazl bahut hi wasee aur kushada hai. Yeh hadith dusri sanad hai marfoo'an bhi marwi hai aur aisi hi aksar hadeesain aayat (وَرَحْمَتِيْ وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ) (Surah Al-A'raf: 156) ki tafseer mein aayengi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Aisi hi ahadees mein se ek yeh bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) se poocha jante ho Allah ka haq bandon par kya hai? Woh yeh hai ke woh sab usi ki ibadat karein aur us ke sath kisi ko shareek na karein. Phir farmaya jante ho banday jab yeh kar lein to un ka haq Allah Ta'ala ke zimma kya hai? Yeh hai ke woh unhein azaab na kare. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh hadith barwayat Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) marwi hai.

Yeh tera darana is liye hai ke shayad woh taqi ban jayein, Haakim-e-Haqiqi se dar kar nekiyan karein aur Qayamat ke azabon se chhootein aur jannat ke mustahiq ban jayein. Phir farmata hai yeh musalman ghurbaa jo subh-o-sham apne Parwardigar ka naam japte hain khabardar inhe haqeer na samajhna, inhe apne paas se na hatana balkay inhi ko apni sohbat mein rakh kar inhi ke saath baith uth. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wastabir nafsaka ma'allazina yad'una rabbahum bil-ghadati wal-ashiyyi yuriduna wajhahu wala ta'du aynaka anhum) (18. Al-Kahf: 28) yani inhi ke saath reh jo subh-o-sham apne Parwardigar ko pukarte hain usi ki raza-mandi ki talab karte hain, khabardar un ki taraf se aankhein na pherna ke duniya ki zindagi ki aasayish talab karne lago, us ka kaha na karna jis ke dil ko hum ne apni yaad se ghafil kar diya hai aur us ne apni khwahish ki pairwi ki hai aur us ka har kaam had se guzra hua hai, balkay un ka saath de jo subh-o-sham Allah ki ibadat karte hain aur usi se duayein maangte hain. Ba'az buzurg farmate hain murad is se farz namazein hain aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa qala rabbukumud'uni astajib lakum innallazina yastakbiruna an ibadati sayadkhuluna jahannama dakhireen) (40. Al-Ghafir: 60).

Ghafir: 60) Tumhare Rab ka elaan hai ke mujh se duayein karo main qubool karunga. In itaat-on aur ibadat-on se unka irada Allah Kareem ke deedar ka hai, mehez khuloos-o-ikhlas wali unki niyatein hain, unka koi hisab tujh par nahin na tera koi hisab un par. Janab-e-Nuh (A.S) se jab unki qoum ke shurfa ne kaha tha ke hum tujhe kaise maan lein tere manne wale toh aksar ghareeb maskeen log hain toh aap ne yahi jawab diya ke unke aamaal ka mujhe kya ilm hai unka hisab toh mere Rab par hai lekin tumhein itna bhi shaoor nahin. Phir bhi tum ne in ghareeb maskeen logon ko apni majlis mein na baithne diya. Un se zara bhi berukhi ki toh yaad rakhna tumhara shumar bhi zalimon mein ho jayega. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Quraish ke bade log Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas gaye us waqt aap ki majlis-e-mubarak mein Hazrat Suhaib (R.A), Hazrat Bilal (R.A), Hazrat Khabbab (R.A), Hazrat Ammar (R.A) the, inhe dekh kar yeh log kehne lage dekho toh hamein chhod kar kin ke sath baithe hain? Toh aayat (Wa anzir bihi se bish-shakireen tak) utri. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke in logon aur in jaise auron ko Huzoor (ﷺ) ki majlis mein dekh kar mushrik sardaron ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke kya yahi log reh gaye hain ke Allah ne hum sab mein se chun chun kar inhi par ehsan kiya? Yeh kaise ho sakta hai ke yeh pe dar pe sahara log bhi hum amiron raeeson ke barabar baithein. Dekhiye Hazrat agar aap inhe apni majlis se nikal dein toh woh aap ki majlis mein baith sakte hain. Is par aayat (WALA TATRUDIL-LAZEENA YAD'OONA RABBAHUM BIL-GHADATI WAL-ASHIYYI YUREEDOONA WAJHAH) (6. Al-An'am: 52) shakireen tak utri. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Quraish ke in moazzizeen logon mein se do ke naam yeh hain Aqra bin Habis Taimi, Uyaynah bin Hisn Fazari. Is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke tanhai mein mil kar unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ko samjhaya ke in ghulam aur gire pade be-haisiyat logon ke sath hamein baithte hue sharm maloom hoti hai, aap ki majlis mein Arab ka wafd aaya karte hain woh hamein in ke sath dekh kar hamein bhi zaleel khayal karenge toh aap kam se kam itna hi kijiye ke jab hum aayein tab khaas majlis ho aur in jaise gire pade log is mein shamil na kiye jayein, haan jab hum na hon toh aap ko ikhtiyar hai. Jab yeh baat tay ho gayi aur aap ne bhi is ka iqrar kar liya toh unhon ne kaha hamara yeh muahida tehreer mein aa jana chahiye. Aap ne kagaz mangwaya aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko likhne ke liye bulwaya, musalmanon ka yeh ghareeb tabqa ek kone mein baitha hua tha isi waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) utre aur yeh aayat nazil hui. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne kagaz phenk diya aur hamein apne paas bula liya aur hum ne phir se Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko apne halqe mein le liya, lekin yeh hadees ghareeb hai, aayat Makki hai aur Aqra aur Uyaynah hijrat ke bahut sare zamane ke baad Islam mein aaye hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) bhi the, hum log sab se pehle khidmat-e-Nabwi mein jate aur aap ke gird-o-pesh baithte taake poori tarah aur shuru se aakhir tak aap ki hadeesein sunen.

Quraish ke bade logon par yeh baat garan guzarti thi is ke bar-khilaf yeh aayat utri (Mustadrak Hakim). Phir farmata hai isi tarah hum ek dusre ko parakh lete hain aur ek se ek ka imtehan le lete hain ke yeh umra in ghuraba se mutaliq apni raye zahir kar dein ke kya yahi log hain jin par Allah ne ehsan kiya aur hum sab mein se Allah ko yahi log pasand aaye? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sab se pehle tasleem karne wale yahi bechare be-maya ghareeb ghuraba log thay, mard, aurat, laundi, ghulam waghera, bade bade aur zi-waqat logon mein se toh us waqt yunhi koi akka-dukka aa gaya tha. Yahi log darasal Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ke muti aur farman-bardar hote rahe. Qaum-e-Nuh ne kaha tha (Wa ma nara-ka ittaba-aka illa-llazina hum araazilu-na badi-yar-rayi) (Surah Hud: 27) yani hum toh dekhte hain ke teri tabedari razeel aur be-waqoof logon ne hi ki hai. Shah-e-Room Heraclius ne jab Abu Sufyan se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki babat yeh daryaft kiya ke shareef logon ne is ki pairwi ikhtiyar ki hai? Ya zaeef logon ne? Toh Abu Sufyan ne jawab diya tha ke zaeef logon ne, badshah ne is se yeh natija nikala ke fi-waqai tamam nabiyon ka awwal pairu yahi tabqa hota hai. Al-gharaz mushrikeen-e-Makkah in imandar-on ka mazaq udate aur unhein satate thay, jahan tak bas chalta unhein sazayein dete aur kehte ke yeh namumkin hai ke bhalai inhein toh nazar aa jaye aur hum yunhi reh jayein? Quran mein un ka qaul yeh bhi hai ke aayat (Lau kana khairam-ma sabaquna ilaih) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 11) agar yeh koi achi cheez hoti toh yeh log hum se aage na badh sakte. Aur aayat mein hai jab un ke samne hamari saaf aur wazeh aayatein tilawat ki jati hain toh yeh kuffar imandaron se kehte hain ke batao toh martabe mein, izzat mein, hasab-nasab mein kaun shareef hai? Is ke jawab mein Rabb ne farmaya aayat (Wa kam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu asasan wa riya) (Surah Maryam: 74) yani in se pehle hum ne bohat si bastiyan tabah kar di hain jo ba-aitbar-e-saman-o-asbab ke aur ba-aitbar-e-numood-o-riya ke in se bohat hi aage badhi hui thin. Chunancha yahan bhi un ke aise hi qaul ke jawab mein farmaya gaya ke shukar-guzaron ko Allah khoob janta hai jo apne aqwal-o-af'aal aur qawi iradon ko durust rakhte hain. Allah Ta'ala unhein salamatiyon ki rahein dikhata hai aur andheron se nikal kar noor ki taraf lata hai aur sahih raah ki rehnumai karta hai, jaise farman hai aayat (Wallazina jahadu fina la-nahdiyannahum subulana wa innallaha la-ma'al muhsineen) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 69).

Al-Ankabut: 69) Jo log hamari farmanbardari ki koshish karte hain hum unhein apni sahih rah par laga dete hain, Allah Ta'ala nek karon ka sath deta hai. Sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala tumhari suraton aur rangon ko nahin dekhta balkeh niyaton aur a'maal ko dekhta hai. Ikrimah farmate hain Rabi'ah ke dono bete Utbah aur Shaibah aur Adi ka beta Mut'im aur Naufal ka beta Harith aur Amr ka beta Qurtah aur Ibn-e-Abd-e-Manaf ke qabile ke kafir sab ke sab jama ho kar Abu Talib ke paas gaye aur kehne lage dekh aap ke bhatije agar hamari ek darkhwast qabool kar lein to hamare dilon mein un ki azmat-o-izzat hogi aur phir un ki majlis mein bhi aamad-o-raft shuru kar denge aur ho sakta hai ke un ki sachai samajh mein aa jaye aur hum bhi maan lein. Abu Talib ne qoum ke baron ka yeh paigham Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein pahunchaya. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) bhi us waqt us majlis mein the, farmane lage ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aisa karne mein kya harj hai? Allah Azzawajal ne Wa-anzir se bil-shakireen tak ayatein utarein. Yeh ghuraba jinhein yeh log faiz-e-sohbat se mehroom karna chahte the yeh the Bilal, Ammar, Salim, Subaih, Ibn-e-Mas'ud, Miqdad, Mas'ud, Waqid, Amr Zul-Shamalin, Yazid aur inhi jaise aur hazrat (R.A) ajma'een. Inhi dono jamaton ke bare mein ayat (وَكَذٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لِّيَقُوْلُوْٓا اَهٰٓؤُلَاۗءِ مَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنْۢ بَيْنِنَا ۭ اَلَيْسَ اللّٰهُ بِاَعْلَمَ بالشّٰكِرِيْنَ) (Al-An'am: 53) bhi nazil hui. Hazrat Umar in ayaton ko sun kar uzr-o-ma'zarat karne lage, is par ayat (وَاِذَا جَاۗءَكَ الَّذِيْنَ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلٰي نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ ۙ اَنَّهٗ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنْكُمْ سُوْۗءًۢا بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ وَاَصْلَحَ ۙ فَاَنَّهٗ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ) (Al-An'am: 54) nazil hui. Aakhri ayat mein hukum hota hai ke iman wale jab tere paas aa kar salam karein to un ke salam ka jawab do, un ka ehtram karo aur unhein Allah ki wasee rahmat ki khabar do ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne fazl-o-karam se apne nafs par rahmat ko wajib kar liya hai. Ba'az salaf se manqool hai ke gunah har shakhs jahalat se hi karta hai. Ikrimah farmate hain dunya sari jahalat hai. Gharz jo bhi koi burai kare phir us se hat jaye aur poora irada kar le ke aaindah kabhi aisi harkat nahin karega aur aage ke liye apne a'mal ki islah bhi kar le to woh yaqeen mane ke Ghafoor-o-Rahim Allah use bakhshega bhi aur us par meherbani bhi karega. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne jab makhlooq ki qaza-o-qadr muqarrar ki to apni kitab mein likha jo us ke paas Arsh ke oopar hai ke meri rahmat mere ghazab par ghalib hai.

Ibn-e-Marduyah mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke jis waqt Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ke faislay kar de ga apne Arsh ke neeche se ek kitab nikale ga jis mein yeh tahrir hai ke mera raham-o-karam mere ghussay aur ghazab se zyada barha hua hai aur main sab se zyada rahmat karne wala hoon. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ek baar mutthiyan bhar kar apni makhlooq ko jahannam mein se nikale ga jinhon ne koi bhalai nahin ki, un ki peshaniyon par likha hua hoga ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ke azaad karda hain. Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) farmate hain ke Taurat mein hum likha dekhte hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne zameen-o-aasman ko paida kiya aur apni rahmat ke sau hissay kiye, phir sari makhlooq mein un mein se ek hissa rakha aur nannaway (99) hissay apne paas baqi rakhay. Isi ek hissa-e-rahmat ka yeh zuhoor hai ke makhlooq bhi ek dusre par meherbani karti hai aur tawazo se pesh aati hai aur aapas ke talluqat qaim hain, oontni, gaye, bakri, parind, machli waghera janwar apne bachon ki parwarish mein takleefain jhelte hain aur un par pyar-o-mohabbat karte hain. Roz-e-Qayamat mein is hissay ko kaamil karne ke baad is mein nannaway (99) hissay mila liye jayenge. Fi-alwaqai Rabb ki rahmat aur us ka fazl bahut hi wasee aur kushada hai. Yeh hadith dusri sanad hai marfoo'an bhi marwi hai aur aisi hi aksar hadeesain aayat (وَرَحْمَتِيْ وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ) (Surah Al-A'raf: 156) ki tafseer mein aayengi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Aisi hi ahadees mein se ek yeh bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) se poocha jante ho Allah ka haq bandon par kya hai? Woh yeh hai ke woh sab usi ki ibadat karein aur us ke sath kisi ko shareek na karein. Phir farmaya jante ho banday jab yeh kar lein to un ka haq Allah Ta'ala ke zimma kya hai? Yeh hai ke woh unhein azaab na kare. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh hadith barwayat Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) marwi hai.

Musalmano! Tabaqati asabiyat se bacho. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ) se farmata hai ke logon mein elaan kar do ke main Allah ke khazanon ka maalik nahin, na mujhe un mein kisi tarah ka ikhtiyar hai, na main yeh kehta hoon ke main ghaib ka janne wala hoon, Rabb ne jo cheezein khaas apne ilm mein rakhi hain mujhe un mein se kuch bhi maloom nahin, haan jin cheezon se khud Allah ne mujhe muttala kar de un par mujhe ittila ho jati hai, mera yeh bhi dawa nahin ke main koi farishta hoon, main toh insaan hoon, Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe jo sharaf diya hai yani meri taraf jo wahi nazil farmayi hai main usi ka amal paira hoon, is se ek balisht idhar udhar nahin hatta. Kya haq ke tabe-daar jo basarat wale hain aur haq se mehroom jo andhe hain barabar ho sakte hain? Kya tum itna gaur bhi nahin karte? Aur aayat mein hai ke kya woh shakhs jo jaanta hai ke jo kuch teri taraf tere Rabb ki janib se utra hai haq hai us shakhs jaisa ho sakta hai jo nabina hai? Nasihat toh sirf wahi hasil karte hain jo aqalmand hain.
