Aur aayat mein hai jab un ke samne hamari saaf aur wazeh aayatein tilawat ki jati hain toh yeh kuffar imandaron se kehte hain ke batao toh martabe mein, izzat mein, hasab-nasab mein kaun shareef hai? Is ke jawab mein Rabb ne farmaya aayat (Wa kam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu asasan wa riya) (Surah Maryam: 74) yani in se pehle hum ne bohat si bastiyan tabah kar di hain jo ba-aitbar-e-saman-o-asbab ke aur ba-aitbar-e-numood-o-riya ke in se bohat hi aage badhi hui thin. Chunancha yahan bhi un ke aise hi qaul ke jawab mein farmaya gaya ke shukar-guzaron ko Allah khoob janta hai jo apne aqwal-o-af'aal aur qawi iradon ko durust rakhte hain. Allah Ta'ala unhein salamatiyon ki rahein dikhata hai aur andheron se nikal kar noor ki taraf lata hai aur sahih raah ki rehnumai karta hai, jaise farman hai aayat (Wallazina jahadu fina la-nahdiyannahum subulana wa innallaha la-ma'al muhsineen) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 69).

Al-Ankabut: 69) Jo log hamari farmanbardari ki koshish karte hain hum unhein apni sahih rah par laga dete hain, Allah Ta'ala nek karon ka sath deta hai. Sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala tumhari suraton aur rangon ko nahin dekhta balkeh niyaton aur a'maal ko dekhta hai. Ikrimah farmate hain Rabi'ah ke dono bete Utbah aur Shaibah aur Adi ka beta Mut'im aur Naufal ka beta Harith aur Amr ka beta Qurtah aur Ibn-e-Abd-e-Manaf ke qabile ke kafir sab ke sab jama ho kar Abu Talib ke paas gaye aur kehne lage dekh aap ke bhatije agar hamari ek darkhwast qabool kar lein to hamare dilon mein un ki azmat-o-izzat hogi aur phir un ki majlis mein bhi aamad-o-raft shuru kar denge aur ho sakta hai ke un ki sachai samajh mein aa jaye aur hum bhi maan lein. Abu Talib ne qoum ke baron ka yeh paigham Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein pahunchaya. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) bhi us waqt us majlis mein the, farmane lage ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aisa karne mein kya harj hai? Allah Azzawajal ne Wa-anzir se bil-shakireen tak ayatein utarein. Yeh ghuraba jinhein yeh log faiz-e-sohbat se mehroom karna chahte the yeh the Bilal, Ammar, Salim, Subaih, Ibn-e-Mas'ud, Miqdad, Mas'ud, Waqid, Amr Zul-Shamalin, Yazid aur inhi jaise aur hazrat (R.A) ajma'een. Inhi dono jamaton ke bare mein ayat (وَكَذٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لِّيَقُوْلُوْٓا اَهٰٓؤُلَاۗءِ مَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنْۢ بَيْنِنَا ۭ اَلَيْسَ اللّٰهُ بِاَعْلَمَ بالشّٰكِرِيْنَ) (Al-An'am: 53) bhi nazil hui. Hazrat Umar in ayaton ko sun kar uzr-o-ma'zarat karne lage, is par ayat (وَاِذَا جَاۗءَكَ الَّذِيْنَ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلٰي نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ ۙ اَنَّهٗ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنْكُمْ سُوْۗءًۢا بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ وَاَصْلَحَ ۙ فَاَنَّهٗ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ) (Al-An'am: 54) nazil hui. Aakhri ayat mein hukum hota hai ke iman wale jab tere paas aa kar salam karein to un ke salam ka jawab do, un ka ehtram karo aur unhein Allah ki wasee rahmat ki khabar do ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne fazl-o-karam se apne nafs par rahmat ko wajib kar liya hai. Ba'az salaf se manqool hai ke gunah har shakhs jahalat se hi karta hai. Ikrimah farmate hain dunya sari jahalat hai. Gharz jo bhi koi burai kare phir us se hat jaye aur poora irada kar le ke aaindah kabhi aisi harkat nahin karega aur aage ke liye apne a'mal ki islah bhi kar le to woh yaqeen mane ke Ghafoor-o-Rahim Allah use bakhshega bhi aur us par meherbani bhi karega. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne jab makhlooq ki qaza-o-qadr muqarrar ki to apni kitab mein likha jo us ke paas Arsh ke oopar hai ke meri rahmat mere ghazab par ghalib hai.

Ibn-e-Marduyah mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke jis waqt Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ke faislay kar de ga apne Arsh ke neeche se ek kitab nikale ga jis mein yeh tahrir hai ke mera raham-o-karam mere ghussay aur ghazab se zyada barha hua hai aur main sab se zyada rahmat karne wala hoon. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ek baar mutthiyan bhar kar apni makhlooq ko jahannam mein se nikale ga jinhon ne koi bhalai nahin ki, un ki peshaniyon par likha hua hoga ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ke azaad karda hain. Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) farmate hain ke Taurat mein hum likha dekhte hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne zameen-o-aasman ko paida kiya aur apni rahmat ke sau hissay kiye, phir sari makhlooq mein un mein se ek hissa rakha aur nannaway (99) hissay apne paas baqi rakhay. Isi ek hissa-e-rahmat ka yeh zuhoor hai ke makhlooq bhi ek dusre par meherbani karti hai aur tawazo se pesh aati hai aur aapas ke talluqat qaim hain, oontni, gaye, bakri, parind, machli waghera janwar apne bachon ki parwarish mein takleefain jhelte hain aur un par pyar-o-mohabbat karte hain. Roz-e-Qayamat mein is hissay ko kaamil karne ke baad is mein nannaway (99) hissay mila liye jayenge. Fi-alwaqai Rabb ki rahmat aur us ka fazl bahut hi wasee aur kushada hai. Yeh hadith dusri sanad hai marfoo'an bhi marwi hai aur aisi hi aksar hadeesain aayat (وَرَحْمَتِيْ وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ) (Surah Al-A'raf: 156) ki tafseer mein aayengi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Aisi hi ahadees mein se ek yeh bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) se poocha jante ho Allah ka haq bandon par kya hai? Woh yeh hai ke woh sab usi ki ibadat karein aur us ke sath kisi ko shareek na karein. Phir farmaya jante ho banday jab yeh kar lein to un ka haq Allah Ta'ala ke zimma kya hai? Yeh hai ke woh unhein azaab na kare. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh hadith barwayat Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) marwi hai.

Musalmano! Tabaqati asabiyat se bacho. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ) se farmata hai ke logon mein elaan kar do ke main Allah ke khazanon ka maalik nahin, na mujhe un mein kisi tarah ka ikhtiyar hai, na main yeh kehta hoon ke main ghaib ka janne wala hoon, Rabb ne jo cheezein khaas apne ilm mein rakhi hain mujhe un mein se kuch bhi maloom nahin, haan jin cheezon se khud Allah ne mujhe muttala kar de un par mujhe ittila ho jati hai, mera yeh bhi dawa nahin ke main koi farishta hoon, main toh insaan hoon, Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe jo sharaf diya hai yani meri taraf jo wahi nazil farmayi hai main usi ka amal paira hoon, is se ek balisht idhar udhar nahin hatta. Kya haq ke tabe-daar jo basarat wale hain aur haq se mehroom jo andhe hain barabar ho sakte hain? Kya tum itna gaur bhi nahin karte? Aur aayat mein hai ke kya woh shakhs jo jaanta hai ke jo kuch teri taraf tere Rabb ki janib se utra hai haq hai us shakhs jaisa ho sakta hai jo nabina hai? Nasihat toh sirf wahi hasil karte hain jo aqalmand hain. Ae Nabi (ﷺ) aap Quran ke zariye inhe raah-e-raast par layein jo Rabb ke samne khade hone ka khauf dil mein rakhte hain, hisab ka khatka rakhte hain, jaante hain ke Rabb ke samne pesh hona hai us din us ke siwa aur koi un ka qareebi ya sifarishi na hoga, woh agar azab karna chahe toh koi shafa'at nahin kar sakta. Yeh tera darana is liye hai ke shayad woh taqi ban jayein, Haakim-e-Haqiqi se dar kar nekiyan karein aur Qayamat ke azabon se chhootein aur jannat ke mustahiq ban jayein. Phir farmata hai yeh musalman ghurbaa jo subh-o-sham apne Parwardigar ka naam japte hain khabardar inhe haqeer na samajhna, inhe apne paas se na hatana balkay inhi ko apni sohbat mein rakh kar inhi ke saath baith uth. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wastabir nafsaka ma'allazina yad'una rabbahum bil-ghadati wal-ashiyyi yuriduna wajhahu wala ta'du aynaka anhum) (18. Al-Kahf: 28) yani inhi ke saath reh jo subh-o-sham apne Parwardigar ko pukarte hain usi ki raza-mandi ki talab karte hain, khabardar un ki taraf se aankhein na pherna ke duniya ki zindagi ki aasayish talab karne lago, us ka kaha na karna jis ke dil ko hum ne apni yaad se ghafil kar diya hai aur us ne apni khwahish ki pairwi ki hai aur us ka har kaam had se guzra hua hai, balkay un ka saath de jo subh-o-sham Allah ki ibadat karte hain aur usi se duayein maangte hain. Ba'az buzurg farmate hain murad is se farz namazein hain aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa qala rabbukumud'uni astajib lakum innallazina yastakbiruna an ibadati sayadkhuluna jahannama dakhireen) (40. Al-Ghafir: 60).

Ghafir: 60) Tumhare Rab ka elaan hai ke mujh se duayein karo main qubool karunga. In itaat-on aur ibadat-on se unka irada Allah Kareem ke deedar ka hai, mehez khuloos-o-ikhlas wali unki niyatein hain, unka koi hisab tujh par nahin na tera koi hisab un par. Janab-e-Nuh (A.S) se jab unki qoum ke shurfa ne kaha tha ke hum tujhe kaise maan lein tere manne wale toh aksar ghareeb maskeen log hain toh aap ne yahi jawab diya ke unke aamaal ka mujhe kya ilm hai unka hisab toh mere Rab par hai lekin tumhein itna bhi shaoor nahin. Phir bhi tum ne in ghareeb maskeen logon ko apni majlis mein na baithne diya. Un se zara bhi berukhi ki toh yaad rakhna tumhara shumar bhi zalimon mein ho jayega. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Quraish ke bade log Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas gaye us waqt aap ki majlis-e-mubarak mein Hazrat Suhaib (R.A), Hazrat Bilal (R.A), Hazrat Khabbab (R.A), Hazrat Ammar (R.A) the, inhe dekh kar yeh log kehne lage dekho toh hamein chhod kar kin ke sath baithe hain? Toh aayat (Wa anzir bihi se bish-shakireen tak) utri. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke in logon aur in jaise auron ko Huzoor (ﷺ) ki majlis mein dekh kar mushrik sardaron ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke kya yahi log reh gaye hain ke Allah ne hum sab mein se chun chun kar inhi par ehsan kiya? Yeh kaise ho sakta hai ke yeh pe dar pe sahara log bhi hum amiron raeeson ke barabar baithein. Dekhiye Hazrat agar aap inhe apni majlis se nikal dein toh woh aap ki majlis mein baith sakte hain. Is par aayat (WALA TATRUDIL-LAZEENA YAD'OONA RABBAHUM BIL-GHADATI WAL-ASHIYYI YUREEDOONA WAJHAH) (6. Al-An'am: 52) shakireen tak utri. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Quraish ke in moazzizeen logon mein se do ke naam yeh hain Aqra bin Habis Taimi, Uyaynah bin Hisn Fazari. Is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke tanhai mein mil kar unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ko samjhaya ke in ghulam aur gire pade be-haisiyat logon ke sath hamein baithte hue sharm maloom hoti hai, aap ki majlis mein Arab ka wafd aaya karte hain woh hamein in ke sath dekh kar hamein bhi zaleel khayal karenge toh aap kam se kam itna hi kijiye ke jab hum aayein tab khaas majlis ho aur in jaise gire pade log is mein shamil na kiye jayein, haan jab hum na hon toh aap ko ikhtiyar hai. Jab yeh baat tay ho gayi aur aap ne bhi is ka iqrar kar liya toh unhon ne kaha hamara yeh muahida tehreer mein aa jana chahiye. Aap ne kagaz mangwaya aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko likhne ke liye bulwaya, musalmanon ka yeh ghareeb tabqa ek kone mein baitha hua tha isi waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) utre aur yeh aayat nazil hui. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne kagaz phenk diya aur hamein apne paas bula liya aur hum ne phir se Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko apne halqe mein le liya, lekin yeh hadees ghareeb hai, aayat Makki hai aur Aqra aur Uyaynah hijrat ke bahut sare zamane ke baad Islam mein aaye hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) bhi the, hum log sab se pehle khidmat-e-Nabwi mein jate aur aap ke gird-o-pesh baithte taake poori tarah aur shuru se aakhir tak aap ki hadeesein sunen.

Quraish ke bade logon par yeh baat garan guzarti thi is ke bar-khilaf yeh aayat utri (Mustadrak Hakim). Phir farmata hai isi tarah hum ek dusre ko parakh lete hain aur ek se ek ka imtehan le lete hain ke yeh umra in ghuraba se mutaliq apni raye zahir kar dein ke kya yahi log hain jin par Allah ne ehsan kiya aur hum sab mein se Allah ko yahi log pasand aaye? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sab se pehle tasleem karne wale yahi bechare be-maya ghareeb ghuraba log thay, mard, aurat, laundi, ghulam waghera, bade bade aur zi-waqat logon mein se toh us waqt yunhi koi akka-dukka aa gaya tha. Yahi log darasal Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ke muti aur farman-bardar hote rahe. Qaum-e-Nuh ne kaha tha (Wa ma nara-ka ittaba-aka illa-llazina hum araazilu-na badi-yar-rayi) (Surah Hud: 27) yani hum toh dekhte hain ke teri tabedari razeel aur be-waqoof logon ne hi ki hai. Shah-e-Room Heraclius ne jab Abu Sufyan se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki babat yeh daryaft kiya ke shareef logon ne is ki pairwi ikhtiyar ki hai? Ya zaeef logon ne? Toh Abu Sufyan ne jawab diya tha ke zaeef logon ne, badshah ne is se yeh natija nikala ke fi-waqai tamam nabiyon ka awwal pairu yahi tabqa hota hai. Yeh hadith dusri sanad hai marfoo'an bhi marwi hai aur aisi hi aksar hadeesain aayat (وَرَحْمَتِيْ وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ) (Surah Al-A'raf: 156) ki tafseer mein aayengi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Aisi hi ahadees mein se ek yeh bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) se poocha jante ho Allah ka haq bandon par kya hai? Woh yeh hai ke woh sab usi ki ibadat karein aur us ke sath kisi ko shareek na karein. Phir farmaya jante ho banday jab yeh kar lein to un ka haq Allah Ta'ala ke zimma kya hai? Yeh hai ke woh unhein azaab na kare. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh hadith barwayat Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) marwi hai.

Musalmano! Tabaqati asabiyat se bacho. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ) se farmata hai ke logon mein elaan kar do ke main Allah ke khazanon ka maalik nahin, na mujhe un mein kisi tarah ka ikhtiyar hai, na main yeh kehta hoon ke main ghaib ka janne wala hoon, Rabb ne jo cheezein khaas apne ilm mein rakhi hain mujhe un mein se kuch bhi maloom nahin, haan jin cheezon se khud Allah ne mujhe muttala kar de un par mujhe ittila ho jati hai, mera yeh bhi dawa nahin ke main koi farishta hoon, main toh insaan hoon, Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe jo sharaf diya hai yani meri taraf jo wahi nazil farmayi hai main usi ka amal paira hoon, is se ek balisht idhar udhar nahin hatta. Kya haq ke tabe-daar jo basarat wale hain aur haq se mehroom jo andhe hain barabar ho sakte hain? Kya tum itna gaur bhi nahin karte? Aur aayat mein hai ke kya woh shakhs jo jaanta hai ke jo kuch teri taraf tere Rabb ki janib se utra hai haq hai us shakhs jaisa ho sakta hai jo nabina hai? Nasihat toh sirf wahi hasil karte hain jo aqalmand hain. Ae Nabi (ﷺ) aap Quran ke zariye inhe raah-e-raast par layein jo Rabb ke samne khade hone ka khauf dil mein rakhte hain, hisab ka khatka rakhte hain, jaante hain ke Rabb ke samne pesh hona hai us din us ke siwa aur koi un ka qareebi ya sifarishi na hoga, woh agar azab karna chahe toh koi shafa'at nahin kar sakta. Yeh tera darana is liye hai ke shayad woh taqi ban jayein, Haakim-e-Haqiqi se dar kar nekiyan karein aur Qayamat ke azabon se chhootein aur jannat ke mustahiq ban jayein. Phir farmata hai yeh musalman ghurbaa jo subh-o-sham apne Parwardigar ka naam japte hain khabardar inhe haqeer na samajhna, inhe apne paas se na hatana balkay inhi ko apni sohbat mein rakh kar inhi ke saath baith uth. Jaise aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wastabir nafsaka ma'allazina yad'una rabbahum bil-ghadati wal-ashiyyi yuriduna wajhahu wala ta'du aynaka anhum) (18. Al-Kahf: 28) yani inhi ke saath reh jo subh-o-sham apne Parwardigar ko pukarte hain usi ki raza-mandi ki talab karte hain, khabardar un ki taraf se aankhein na pherna ke duniya ki zindagi ki aasayish talab karne lago, us ka kaha na karna jis ke dil ko hum ne apni yaad se ghafil kar diya hai aur us ne apni khwahish ki pairwi ki hai aur us ka har kaam had se guzra hua hai, balkay un ka saath de jo subh-o-sham Allah ki ibadat karte hain aur usi se duayein maangte hain. Ba'az buzurg farmate hain murad is se farz namazein hain aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa qala rabbukumud'uni astajib lakum innallazina yastakbiruna an ibadati sayadkhuluna jahannama dakhireen) (40. Al-Ghafir: 60).

Ghafir: 60) Tumhare Rab ka elaan hai ke mujh se duayein karo main qubool karunga. In itaat-on aur ibadat-on se unka irada Allah Kareem ke deedar ka hai, mehez khuloos-o-ikhlas wali unki niyatein hain, unka koi hisab tujh par nahin na tera koi hisab un par. Janab-e-Nuh (A.S) se jab unki qoum ke shurfa ne kaha tha ke hum tujhe kaise maan lein tere manne wale toh aksar ghareeb maskeen log hain toh aap ne yahi jawab diya ke unke aamaal ka mujhe kya ilm hai unka hisab toh mere Rab par hai lekin tumhein itna bhi shaoor nahin. Phir bhi tum ne in ghareeb maskeen logon ko apni majlis mein na baithne diya. Un se zara bhi berukhi ki toh yaad rakhna tumhara shumar bhi zalimon mein ho jayega. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Quraish ke bade log Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas gaye us waqt aap ki majlis-e-mubarak mein Hazrat Suhaib (R.A), Hazrat Bilal (R.A), Hazrat Khabbab (R.A), Hazrat Ammar (R.A) the, inhe dekh kar yeh log kehne lage dekho toh hamein chhod kar kin ke sath baithe hain? Toh aayat (Wa anzir bihi se bish-shakireen tak) utri. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ke in logon aur in jaise auron ko Huzoor (ﷺ) ki majlis mein dekh kar mushrik sardaron ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke kya yahi log reh gaye hain ke Allah ne hum sab mein se chun chun kar inhi par ehsan kiya? Yeh kaise ho sakta hai ke yeh pe dar pe sahara log bhi hum amiron raeeson ke barabar baithein. Dekhiye Hazrat agar aap inhe apni majlis se nikal dein toh woh aap ki majlis mein baith sakte hain. Is par aayat (WALA TATRUDIL-LAZEENA YAD'OONA RABBAHUM BIL-GHADATI WAL-ASHIYYI YUREEDOONA WAJHAH) (6. Al-An'am: 52) shakireen tak utri. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Quraish ke in moazzizeen logon mein se do ke naam yeh hain Aqra bin Habis Taimi, Uyaynah bin Hisn Fazari. Is riwayat mein yeh bhi hai ke tanhai mein mil kar unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ko samjhaya ke in ghulam aur gire pade be-haisiyat logon ke sath hamein baithte hue sharm maloom hoti hai, aap ki majlis mein Arab ka wafd aaya karte hain woh hamein in ke sath dekh kar hamein bhi zaleel khayal karenge toh aap kam se kam itna hi kijiye ke jab hum aayein tab khaas majlis ho aur in jaise gire pade log is mein shamil na kiye jayein, haan jab hum na hon toh aap ko ikhtiyar hai. Jab yeh baat tay ho gayi aur aap ne bhi is ka iqrar kar liya toh unhon ne kaha hamara yeh muahida tehreer mein aa jana chahiye. Aap ne kagaz mangwaya aur Hazrat Ali (R.A) ko likhne ke liye bulwaya, musalmanon ka yeh ghareeb tabqa ek kone mein baitha hua tha isi waqt Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) utre aur yeh aayat nazil hui. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne kagaz phenk diya aur hamein apne paas bula liya aur hum ne phir se Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ko apne halqe mein le liya, lekin yeh hadees ghareeb hai, aayat Makki hai aur Aqra aur Uyaynah hijrat ke bahut sare zamane ke baad Islam mein aaye hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) bhi the, hum log sab se pehle khidmat-e-Nabwi mein jate aur aap ke gird-o-pesh baithte taake poori tarah aur shuru se aakhir tak aap ki hadeesein sunen.

Quraish ke bade logon par yeh baat garan guzarti thi is ke bar-khilaf yeh aayat utri (Mustadrak Hakim). Phir farmata hai isi tarah hum ek dusre ko parakh lete hain aur ek se ek ka imtehan le lete hain ke yeh umra in ghuraba se mutaliq apni raye zahir kar dein ke kya yahi log hain jin par Allah ne ehsan kiya aur hum sab mein se Allah ko yahi log pasand aaye? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko sab se pehle tasleem karne wale yahi bechare be-maya ghareeb ghuraba log thay, mard, aurat, laundi, ghulam waghera, bade bade aur zi-waqat logon mein se toh us waqt yunhi koi akka-dukka aa gaya tha. Yahi log darasal Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam / A.S) ke muti aur farman-bardar hote rahe. Qaum-e-Nuh ne kaha tha (Wa ma nara-ka ittaba-aka illa-llazina hum araazilu-na badi-yar-rayi) (Surah Hud: 27) yani hum toh dekhte hain ke teri tabedari razeel aur be-waqoof logon ne hi ki hai. Shah-e-Room Heraclius ne jab Abu Sufyan se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki babat yeh daryaft kiya ke shareef logon ne is ki pairwi ikhtiyar ki hai? Ya zaeef logon ne? Toh Abu Sufyan ne jawab diya tha ke zaeef logon ne, badshah ne is se yeh natija nikala ke fi-waqai tamam nabiyon ka awwal pairu yahi tabqa hota hai. Al-gharaz mushrikeen-e-Makkah in imandar-on ka mazaq udate aur unhein satate thay, jahan tak bas chalta unhein sazayein dete aur kehte ke yeh namumkin hai ke bhalai inhein toh nazar aa jaye aur hum yunhi reh jayein? Quran mein un ka qaul yeh bhi hai ke aayat (Lau kana khairam-ma sabaquna ilaih) (Surah Al-Ahqaf: 11) agar yeh koi achi cheez hoti toh yeh log hum se aage na badh sakte. Aur aayat mein hai jab un ke samne hamari saaf aur wazeh aayatein tilawat ki jati hain toh yeh kuffar imandaron se kehte hain ke batao toh martabe mein, izzat mein, hasab-nasab mein kaun shareef hai? Is ke jawab mein Rabb ne farmaya aayat (Wa kam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu asasan wa riya) (Surah Maryam: 74) yani in se pehle hum ne bohat si bastiyan tabah kar di hain jo ba-aitbar-e-saman-o-asbab ke aur ba-aitbar-e-numood-o-riya ke in se bohat hi aage badhi hui thin. Chunancha yahan bhi un ke aise hi qaul ke jawab mein farmaya gaya ke shukar-guzaron ko Allah khoob janta hai jo apne aqwal-o-af'aal aur qawi iradon ko durust rakhte hain. Allah Ta'ala unhein salamatiyon ki rahein dikhata hai aur andheron se nikal kar noor ki taraf lata hai aur sahih raah ki rehnumai karta hai, jaise farman hai aayat (Wallazina jahadu fina la-nahdiyannahum subulana wa innallaha la-ma'al muhsineen) (Surah Al-Ankabut: 69).

Al-Ankabut: 69) Jo log hamari farmanbardari ki koshish karte hain hum unhein apni sahih rah par laga dete hain, Allah Ta'ala nek karon ka sath deta hai. Sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala tumhari suraton aur rangon ko nahin dekhta balkeh niyaton aur a'maal ko dekhta hai. Ikrimah farmate hain Rabi'ah ke dono bete Utbah aur Shaibah aur Adi ka beta Mut'im aur Naufal ka beta Harith aur Amr ka beta Qurtah aur Ibn-e-Abd-e-Manaf ke qabile ke kafir sab ke sab jama ho kar Abu Talib ke paas gaye aur kehne lage dekh aap ke bhatije agar hamari ek darkhwast qabool kar lein to hamare dilon mein un ki azmat-o-izzat hogi aur phir un ki majlis mein bhi aamad-o-raft shuru kar denge aur ho sakta hai ke un ki sachai samajh mein aa jaye aur hum bhi maan lein. Abu Talib ne qoum ke baron ka yeh paigham Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki khidmat mein pahunchaya. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) bhi us waqt us majlis mein the, farmane lage ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) aisa karne mein kya harj hai? Allah Azzawajal ne Wa-anzir se bil-shakireen tak ayatein utarein. Yeh ghuraba jinhein yeh log faiz-e-sohbat se mehroom karna chahte the yeh the Bilal, Ammar, Salim, Subaih, Ibn-e-Mas'ud, Miqdad, Mas'ud, Waqid, Amr Zul-Shamalin, Yazid aur inhi jaise aur hazrat (R.A) ajma'een. Inhi dono jamaton ke bare mein ayat (وَكَذٰلِكَ فَتَنَّا بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لِّيَقُوْلُوْٓا اَهٰٓؤُلَاۗءِ مَنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنْۢ بَيْنِنَا ۭ اَلَيْسَ اللّٰهُ بِاَعْلَمَ بالشّٰكِرِيْنَ) (Al-An'am: 53) bhi nazil hui. Hazrat Umar in ayaton ko sun kar uzr-o-ma'zarat karne lage, is par ayat (وَاِذَا جَاۗءَكَ الَّذِيْنَ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَقُلْ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمْ كَتَبَ رَبُّكُمْ عَلٰي نَفْسِهِ الرَّحْمَةَ ۙ اَنَّهٗ مَنْ عَمِلَ مِنْكُمْ سُوْۗءًۢا بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ وَاَصْلَحَ ۙ فَاَنَّهٗ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ) (Al-An'am: 54) nazil hui. Aakhri ayat mein hukum hota hai ke iman wale jab tere paas aa kar salam karein to un ke salam ka jawab do, un ka ehtram karo aur unhein Allah ki wasee rahmat ki khabar do ke Allah Ta'ala ne apne fazl-o-karam se apne nafs par rahmat ko wajib kar liya hai. Ba'az salaf se manqool hai ke gunah har shakhs jahalat se hi karta hai. Ikrimah farmate hain dunya sari jahalat hai. Gharz jo bhi koi burai kare phir us se hat jaye aur poora irada kar le ke aaindah kabhi aisi harkat nahin karega aur aage ke liye apne a'mal ki islah bhi kar le to woh yaqeen mane ke Ghafoor-o-Rahim Allah use bakhshega bhi aur us par meherbani bhi karega. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne jab makhlooq ki qaza-o-qadr muqarrar ki to apni kitab mein likha jo us ke paas Arsh ke oopar hai ke meri rahmat mere ghazab par ghalib hai.

Ibn-e-Marduyah mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke jis waqt Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ke faislay kar de ga apne Arsh ke neeche se ek kitab nikale ga jis mein yeh tahrir hai ke mera raham-o-karam mere ghussay aur ghazab se zyada barha hua hai aur main sab se zyada rahmat karne wala hoon. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ek baar mutthiyan bhar kar apni makhlooq ko jahannam mein se nikale ga jinhon ne koi bhalai nahin ki, un ki peshaniyon par likha hua hoga ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ke azaad karda hain. Hazrat Salman Farsi (R.A) farmate hain ke Taurat mein hum likha dekhte hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne zameen-o-aasman ko paida kiya aur apni rahmat ke sau hissay kiye, phir sari makhlooq mein un mein se ek hissa rakha aur nannaway (99) hissay apne paas baqi rakhay. Isi ek hissa-e-rahmat ka yeh zuhoor hai ke makhlooq bhi ek dusre par meherbani karti hai aur tawazo se pesh aati hai aur aapas ke talluqat qaim hain, oontni, gaye, bakri, parind, machli waghera janwar apne bachon ki parwarish mein takleefain jhelte hain aur un par pyar-o-mohabbat karte hain. Roz-e-Qayamat mein is hissay ko kaamil karne ke baad is mein nannaway (99) hissay mila liye jayenge. Fi-alwaqai Rabb ki rahmat aur us ka fazl bahut hi wasee aur kushada hai. Yeh hadith dusri sanad hai marfoo'an bhi marwi hai aur aisi hi aksar hadeesain aayat (وَرَحْمَتِيْ وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ) (Surah Al-A'raf: 156) ki tafseer mein aayengi Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Aisi hi ahadees mein se ek yeh bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (R.A) se poocha jante ho Allah ka haq bandon par kya hai? Woh yeh hai ke woh sab usi ki ibadat karein aur us ke sath kisi ko shareek na karein. Phir farmaya jante ho banday jab yeh kar lein to un ka haq Allah Ta'ala ke zimma kya hai? Yeh hai ke woh unhein azaab na kare. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein yeh hadith barwayat Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A) marwi hai.

Nek-o-bad ki wazahat ke baad? Ya'ni jis tarah hum ne is se pehle hidayat ki baatein aur bhalai ki rahein wazeh kar dein, neki-badi khol khol kar bayan kar di, isi tarah hum har us cheez ka tafseeli bayan karte hain jis ki tumhein zaroorat pesh aane wali hai. Is mein alawa aur fawaid ke ek faida yeh bhi hai ke mujrimon ka rasta nekon par ayan ho jaye. Ek aur qirat ke aitbar se yeh matlab hai taake tu gunahgaron ka tareeqa-e-wardat logon ke samne khol de. Phir hukum hota hai ke ae Nabi (ﷺ) logon mein elan kar do ke mere paas Ilahi daleel hai, main apne Rab ki di hui sachi shariat par qaim hoon. Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se mere paas wahi aati hai, afsos ke tum is haq ko jhutla rahe ho, tum agarcheh azabon ki jaldi macha rahe ho lekin azab ka lana mere ikhtiyar ki cheez nahin. Yeh sab kuch Allah ke hukum ke matahat hai. Is ki maslahat wahi janta hai, agar chahe der se laye, agar chahe to jaldi laye, woh haq bayan farmane wala aur apne bandon ke darmiyan behtareen faisle karne wala hai. Suno agar mera hi hukum chalta, mere hi ikhtiyar mein sawab-o-azab hota, mere bas mein baqa aur fana hoti to main jo chahta ho jaya karta aur main to abhi apne aur tumhare darmiyan faisla kar leta aur tum par woh azab baras padte jin se main tumhein dara raha hoon. Baat yeh hai ke mere bas mein koi baat nahin, ikhtiyar wala Allah Ta'ala akela hi hai, woh zalimon ko bakhoobi janta hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ne ek baar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah! Uhud se zyada sakhti ka to aap par koi din na aaya hoga? Aap ne farmaya: Ayesha! Kya poochti ho ke mujhe is qoum ne kya kya izayein pahunchayin? Sab se zyada bhari din mujh par Aqaba ka din tha jabke main Abd-e-Yalil bin Abd-e-Kulal ke paas pahuncha aur main ne us se aarzoo ki ke woh mera sath de magar us ne meri baat na mani. Wallah! Main sakht ghamgeen ho kar wahan se chala, mujhe nahin maloom tha ke main kidhar ja raha hoon. Qarn-e-Sa'alib mein aa kar mere hawas theek hue to main ne dekha ke upar se ek badal ne mujhe dhak liya hai. Sar utha kar dekhta hoon to Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) mujhe awaz de kar farma rahe hain: Allah Ta'ala ne teri qoum ki baatein sunin aur jo jawab unhon ne tujhe diya woh bhi suna. Ab pahadon ke darogha farishte ko us ne bheja hai, aap jo chahein unhein hukum dijiye yeh baja layenge. Isi waqt is farishte ne mujhe pukara, salam kiya aur kaha: Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki qoum ki baatein sunin aur mujhe aap ke paas bheja hai ke un ke bare mein jo irshad aap farmayein main baja laoon. Agar aap hukum dein to Makkah Sharif ke in dono pahadon ko jo junoob-o-shumal mein hain main ikatthe kar doon aur in tamam ko in dono ke darmiyan pees doon.

Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein jawab diya ke nahin main yeh nahin chahta balkeh mujhe toh umeed hai ke kya ajab un ki nasl mein aage ja kar hi kuch aise log hon jo Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki ibadat karein aur us ke sath kisi ko sharik na karein, han yahan yeh baat khayal mein rahe ke koi is shuba mein na pade ke Quran ki is ayat mein toh hai ke agar mere bas mein azab hote toh abhi hi faisla kar diya jata aur hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne bas mein kar diye phir bhi aap ne un ke liye takheer talab ki. Is shuba ka jawab yeh hai ke ayat se itna maloom hota hai ke jab woh azab talab karte us waqt agar aap ke bas mein hota toh usi waqt un par azab aa jata aur hadith mein yeh nahin ke us waqt unhon ne koi azab manga tha. Hadith mein toh sirf itna hai ke paharon ke farishte ne aap ko yeh batlaya ke bahukm-e-Ilahi main yeh kar sakta hoon sirf aap ki zaban-e-mubarak ke hilne ka muntazir hoon lekin Rahmatul-lil-Alameen ko raham aa gaya aur narmi barti, pas ayat-o-hadith mein koi muariza nahin. Wallahu A'lam. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ghaib ki kunjiyan paanch hain jinhein Allah Ta'ala ke siwa koi nahin janta phir aap ne ayat (Innallaha indahu ilmus-sa'ati wa yunazzilul-ghaitha wa ya'lamu ma fil-arhami wa ma tadri nafsun maza taksibu ghada wa ma tadri nafsun bi-ayyi ardin tamutu innallaha Alimun Khabir) (Surah Luqman: 34) parhi, yani qayamat ka ilm, barish ka ilm, pet ke bachay ka ilm, kal ke kaam ka ilm, maut ki jagah ka ilm. Is hadith mein jis mein Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ka basurat-e-insan aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se iman, islam, ehsan ki tafseel puchna bhi marwi hai yeh bhi hai ke jab qayamat ke sahih waqt ka sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya yeh un paanch cheezon mein se hai jin ka ilm Allah Ta'ala ke siwa kisi aur ko nahin. Phir aap ne ayat (Innallaha indahu ilmus-sa'ati wa yunazzilul-ghaitha wa ya'lamu ma fil-arhami wa ma tadri nafsun maza taksibu ghada wa ma tadri nafsun bi-ayyi ardin tamutu innallaha Alimun Khabir) (Surah Luqman: 34) tilawat farmayi. Phir farmata hai us ka ilm tamam maujudat ko ihata kiye hue hai. Barri bahri koi cheez us ke ilm se bahar nahin. Asman-o-zameen ka ek zarra us par posheeda nahin. Sarsari ka kya hi achha sher hai. Fala yahfa alaihil-zarra ma yatara lin-nawaziri au tawara yani kisi ko kuch dikhayi de na de Rab par kuch bhi posheeda nahin, woh sab ki harkat se bhi waqif hai, jamadat ka hilna julna yahan tak ke pattay ka jhadna bhi us ke wasee ilm se bahar nahin. Phir bhala jinat aur insan ka kaunsa ilm us par makhfi rah sakta hai? Jaise farman-e-aali shan hai ayat (Ya'lamu kha'inal-a'yuni wa ma tukhfis-sudur) (Surah Ghafir: 19) aankhon ki khayanat aur dilon ke posheeda bhed bhi us par ayan hain.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke khushki tari ka koi darakht aisa nahin jis par Allah ki taraf se koi farishta muqarrar na ho jo us ke jhar jaane wale patton ko bhi likh le, phir farmata hai zameen ke andheron ke daanon ka bhi us Allah ko ilm hai. Hazrat Amr bin Aas R.A farmate hain, teesri zameen ke oopar aur chauthi ke neeche itne jinn baste hain ke agar woh is zameen par aajayein to un ki wajah se koi roshni nazar na pare, zameen ke har kone par Allah ki mohron mein se ek mohar aur har mohar par ek farishta muqarrar hai aur har din Allah ki taraf se hai us ke paas ek aur farishte ke zariye se hukm pahunchta hai ke tere paas jo hai us ki bakhoobi hifazat kar. Hazrat Abdullah bin Haris farmate hain ke zameen ke har ek darakht waghera par farishte muqarrar hain jo un ki khushki tari waghera ki babat Allah ki janab mein arz kar dete hain. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se marvi hai Allah Ta'ala ne Noon yani dawaat ko paida kiya aur takhtiyan banayin aur is mein duniya ke tamam hone wale amoor likhe. Kul makhlooq ki roziyan, halal haram neki badi sab kuch likh diya hai phir yahi aayat parhi.

Ya'ni jis tarah hum ne is se pehle hidayat ki baatein aur bhalai ki rahein wazeh kar dein, neki-badi khol khol kar bayan kar di, isi tarah hum har us cheez ka tafseeli bayan karte hain jis ki tumhein zaroorat pesh aane wali hai. Is mein alawa aur fawaid ke ek faida yeh bhi hai ke mujrimon ka rasta nekon par ayan ho jaye. Ek aur qirat ke aitbar se yeh matlab hai taake tu gunahgaron ka tareeqa-e-wardat logon ke samne khol de. Phir hukum hota hai ke ae Nabi (ﷺ) logon mein elan kar do ke mere paas Ilahi daleel hai, main apne Rab ki di hui sachi shariat par qaim hoon. Yeh sab kuch Allah ke hukum ke matahat hai. Is ki maslahat wahi janta hai, agar chahe der se laye, agar chahe to jaldi laye, woh haq bayan farmane wala aur apne bandon ke darmiyan behtareen faisle karne wala hai. Suno agar mera hi hukum chalta, mere hi ikhtiyar mein sawab-o-azab hota, mere bas mein baqa aur fana hoti to main jo chahta ho jaya karta aur main to abhi apne aur tumhare darmiyan faisla kar leta aur tum par woh azab baras padte jin se main tumhein dara raha hoon. Baat yeh hai ke mere bas mein koi baat nahin, ikhtiyar wala Allah Ta'ala akela hi hai, woh zalimon ko bakhoobi janta hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ne ek baar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah! Uhud se zyada sakhti ka to aap par koi din na aaya hoga? Aap ne farmaya: Ayesha! Kya poochti ho ke mujhe is qoum ne kya kya izayein pahunchayin? Sab se zyada bhari din mujh par Aqaba ka din tha jabke main Abd-e-Yalil bin Abd-e-Kulal ke paas pahuncha aur main ne us se aarzoo ki ke woh mera sath de magar us ne meri baat na mani. Wallah! Main sakht ghamgeen ho kar wahan se chala, mujhe nahin maloom tha ke main kidhar ja raha hoon. Qarn-e-Sa'alib mein aa kar mere hawas theek hue to main ne dekha ke upar se ek badal ne mujhe dhak liya hai. Sar utha kar dekhta hoon to Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) mujhe awaz de kar farma rahe hain: Allah Ta'ala ne teri qoum ki baatein sunin aur jo jawab unhon ne tujhe diya woh bhi suna. Agar aap hukum dein to Makkah Sharif ke in dono pahadon ko jo junoob-o-shumal mein hain main ikatthe kar doon aur in tamam ko in dono ke darmiyan pees doon.

Phir farmata hai us ka ilm tamam maujudat ko ihata kiye hue hai. Barri bahri koi cheez us ke ilm se bahar nahin. Asman-o-zameen ka ek zarra us par posheeda nahin. Sarsari ka kya hi achha sher hai. Fala yahfa alaihil-zarra ma yatara lin-nawaziri au tawara yani kisi ko kuch dikhayi de na de Rab par kuch bhi posheeda nahin, woh sab ki harkat se bhi waqif hai, jamadat ka hilna julna yahan tak ke pattay ka jhadna bhi us ke wasee ilm se bahar nahin. Phir bhala jinat aur insan ka kaunsa ilm us par makhfi rah sakta hai? Jaise farman-e-aali shan hai ayat (Ya'lamu kha'inal-a'yuni wa ma tukhfis-sudur) (Surah Ghafir: 19) aankhon ki khayanat aur dilon ke posheeda bhed bhi us par ayan hain.

Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain ke khushki tari ka koi darakht aisa nahin jis par Allah ki taraf se koi farishta muqarrar na ho jo us ke jhar jaane wale patton ko bhi likh le, phir farmata hai zameen ke andheron ke daanon ka bhi us Allah ko ilm hai. Hazrat Amr bin Aas R.A farmate hain, teesri zameen ke oopar aur chauthi ke neeche itne jinn baste hain ke agar woh is zameen par aajayein to un ki wajah se koi roshni nazar na pare, zameen ke har kone par Allah ki mohron mein se ek mohar aur har mohar par ek farishta muqarrar hai aur har din Allah ki taraf se hai us ke paas ek aur farishte ke zariye se hukm pahunchta hai ke tere paas jo hai us ki bakhoobi hifazat kar. Hazrat Abdullah bin Haris farmate hain ke zameen ke har ek darakht waghera par farishte muqarrar hain jo un ki khushki tari waghera ki babat Allah ki janab mein arz kar dete hain. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A se marvi hai Allah Ta'ala ne Noon yani dawaat ko paida kiya aur takhtiyan banayin aur is mein duniya ke tamam hone wale amoor likhe. Kul makhlooq ki roziyan, halal haram neki badi sab kuch likh diya hai phir yahi aayat parhi.

Nek-o-bad ki wazahat ke baad? Ya'ni jis tarah hum ne is se pehle hidayat ki baatein aur bhalai ki rahein wazeh kar dein, neki-badi khol khol kar bayan kar di, isi tarah hum har us cheez ka tafseeli bayan karte hain jis ki tumhein zaroorat pesh aane wali hai. Is mein alawa aur fawaid ke ek faida yeh bhi hai ke mujrimon ka rasta nekon par ayan ho jaye. Ek aur qirat ke aitbar se yeh matlab hai taake tu gunahgaron ka tareeqa-e-wardat logon ke samne khol de. Phir hukum hota hai ke ae Nabi (ﷺ) logon mein elan kar do ke mere paas Ilahi daleel hai, main apne Rab ki di hui sachi shariat par qaim hoon. Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se mere paas wahi aati hai, afsos ke tum is haq ko jhutla rahe ho, tum agarcheh azabon ki jaldi macha rahe ho lekin azab ka lana mere ikhtiyar ki cheez nahin. Yeh sab kuch Allah ke hukum ke matahat hai. Is ki maslahat wahi janta hai, agar chahe der se laye, agar chahe to jaldi laye, woh haq bayan farmane wala aur apne bandon ke darmiyan behtareen faisle karne wala hai. Suno agar mera hi hukum chalta, mere hi ikhtiyar mein sawab-o-azab hota, mere bas mein baqa aur fana hoti to main jo chahta ho jaya karta aur main to abhi apne aur tumhare darmiyan faisla kar leta aur tum par woh azab baras padte jin se main tumhein dara raha hoon. Baat yeh hai ke mere bas mein koi baat nahin, ikhtiyar wala Allah Ta'ala akela hi hai, woh zalimon ko bakhoobi janta hai. Bukhari-o-Muslim ki ek hadith mein hai ke Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa (R.A) ne ek baar Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah! Uhud se zyada sakhti ka to aap par koi din na aaya hoga? Aap ne farmaya: Ayesha! Kya poochti ho ke mujhe is qoum ne kya kya izayein pahunchayin? Sab se zyada bhari din mujh par Aqaba ka din tha jabke main Abd-e-Yalil bin Abd-e-Kulal ke paas pahuncha aur main ne us se aarzoo ki ke woh mera sath de magar us ne meri baat na mani. Wallah! Main sakht ghamgeen ho kar wahan se chala, mujhe nahin maloom tha ke main kidhar ja raha hoon. Qarn-e-Sa'alib mein aa kar mere hawas theek hue to main ne dekha ke upar se ek badal ne mujhe dhak liya hai. Sar utha kar dekhta hoon to Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) mujhe awaz de kar farma rahe hain: Allah Ta'ala ne teri qoum ki baatein sunin aur jo jawab unhon ne tujhe diya woh bhi suna. Ab pahadon ke darogha farishte ko us ne bheja hai, aap jo chahein unhein hukum dijiye yeh baja layenge. Isi waqt is farishte ne mujhe pukara, salam kiya aur kaha: Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki qoum ki baatein sunin aur mujhe aap ke paas bheja hai ke un ke bare mein jo irshad aap farmayein main baja laoon. Agar aap hukum dein to Makkah Sharif ke in dono pahadon ko jo junoob-o-shumal mein hain main ikatthe kar doon aur in tamam ko in dono ke darmiyan pees doon.

Anhazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne unhein jawab diya ke nahin main yeh nahin chahta balkeh mujhe toh umeed hai ke kya ajab un ki nasl mein aage ja kar hi kuch aise log hon jo Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki ibadat karein aur us ke sath kisi ko sharik na karein, han yahan yeh baat khayal mein rahe ke koi is shuba mein na pade ke Quran ki is ayat mein toh hai ke agar mere bas mein azab hote toh abhi hi faisla kar diya jata aur hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne bas mein kar diye phir bhi aap ne un ke liye takheer talab ki. Is shuba ka jawab yeh hai ke ayat se itna maloom hota hai ke jab woh azab talab karte us waqt agar aap ke bas mein hota toh usi waqt un par azab aa jata aur hadith mein yeh nahin ke us waqt unhon ne koi azab manga tha. Hadith mein toh sirf itna hai ke paharon ke farishte ne aap ko yeh batlaya ke bahukm-e-Ilahi main yeh kar sakta hoon sirf aap ki zaban-e-mubarak ke hilne ka muntazir hoon lekin Rahmatul-lil-Alameen ko raham aa gaya aur narmi barti, pas ayat-o-hadith mein koi muariza nahin. Wallahu A'lam. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ghaib ki kunjiyan paanch hain jinhein Allah Ta'ala ke siwa koi nahin janta phir aap ne ayat (Innallaha indahu ilmus-sa'ati wa yunazzilul-ghaitha wa ya'lamu ma fil-arhami wa ma tadri nafsun maza taksibu ghada wa ma tadri nafsun bi-ayyi ardin tamutu innallaha Alimun Khabir) (Surah Luqman: 34) parhi, yani qayamat ka ilm, barish ka ilm, pet ke bachay ka ilm, kal ke kaam ka ilm, maut ki jagah ka ilm. Is hadith mein jis mein Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ka basurat-e-insan aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se iman, islam, ehsan ki tafseel puchna bhi marwi hai yeh bhi hai ke jab qayamat ke sahih waqt ka sawal hua toh aap ne farmaya yeh un paanch cheezon mein se hai jin ka ilm Allah Ta'ala ke siwa kisi aur ko nahin. Kul makhlooq ki roziyan, halal haram neki badi sab kuch likh diya hai phir yahi aayat parhi.

Neend maut ki choti behan, Wafaat-e-Sughra yani choti maut ka bayan ho raha hai. Is se murad neend hai, jaise is aayat mein hai: Aayat (Iza qaalallahu ya 'Isa inni mutawaffika wa rafi'uka ilayya wa mutahhiruka minallazina kafaru wa ja'ilullazina-ttaba'uka fawqallazina kafarru ila yawmil qiyamah, summa ilayya marji'ukum fa-ahkumu bainakum fima kuntum fihi takhtalifun) (Surah Al-Imran: 55). Yani jabke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke ae Isa! Main tujhe faut karne wala hoon (yani tujh par neend dalne wala hoon) aur apni taraf chadha lene wala hoon. Aur jaise is aayat mein hai: Aayat (Allahu yatawaffal-anfusa hina mautiha wallati lam tamut fi manamiha, fayumsikul-lati qada 'alaihal-mawta wa yursilul-ukhra ila ajalim musamma, inna fi zalika la-ayatil-liqawmiy yatafakkarun) (Surah Az-Zumar: 42). Yani Allah Ta'ala nafsun ko un ki maut ke waqt maar dalta hai aur jin ki maut nahin aayi unhein neend ke waqt faut kar leta hai (yani sula deta hai). Maut wale nafs ko toh apne paas rok leta hai aur dusre ko muqarrara waqt pura karne ke liye phir bhej deta hai. Is aayat mein dono wafaat bayan kar di hain, Wafaat-e-Kubra aur Wafaat-e-Sughra. Aur jis aayat ki is waqt tafsir ho rahi hai us mein bhi dono wafaaton ka zikr hai, Wafaat-e-Sughra yani neend ka pehle, phir Wafaat-e-Kubra yani haqiqi maut ka. Beech ka jumla: Aayat (Wa ya'lamu ma jarahtum bin-nahari summa yab'athukum fihi liyuqda ajalum musamma) (Surah Al-An'am: 60) jumla-e-mu'tariza hai jis se Allah ke wasi' ilm ki dalalat ho rahi hai ke woh din raat ke kisi waqt apni makhluq ki kisi halat se be-ilm nahin, un ki harkat-o-sakanat sab jaanta hai. Jaise farman hai: Aayat (Sawa-um minkum man asarral-qawla wa man jahara bihi wa man huwa mustakhfim bil-laili wa saribum bin-nahar) (Surah Ar-Ra'd: 10). Yani chupa khula, raat ka din ka, sab baaton ka use ilm hai. Aur aayat mein hai: (Wa mir-rahmatihi ja'ala lakumul-laila wan-nahara litaskunu fihi wa litabtaghu min fadlihi wa la'allakum tashkurun) (Surah Al-Qasas: 73). Yani yeh bhi Rabb ki rahmat hai ke us ne tumhare sukoon ka waqt raat ko banaya aur din ko talash-e-ma'ash ka waqt banaya. Aur aayat mein irshad hai: Aayat (Wa ja'alnal-laila libasa) (Surah An-Naba: 10). Raat ko hum ne libas aur din ko sabab-e-ma'ash banaya. Yahan farmaya raat ko woh tumhein sula deta hai aur dinon ko jo tum karte ho us se woh aagah hai, phir din mein tumhein utha bitha deta hai.

Ek ma'ani yeh bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke woh neend mein yani khwab mein tumhein utha khada karta hai lekin awwal ma'ani hi awla hain, Ibn-e-Marduyah ki ek marfoo' riwayat mein hai ke har insaan ke sath ek farishta muqarrar hai jo sone ke waqt uski rooh ko le jata hai phir agar qabz karne ka hukum hota hai toh woh us rooh ko nahin lautata warna bahukum-e-Ilahi lauta deta hai, yahi ma'ani is aayat ke jumle aayat (وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ يَتَوَفّٰىكُمْ بالَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُمْ بالنَّهَارِ) (6. Al-An'am: 60) ka hai taake is tarah umr ka poora waqt guzre aur jo ajal-e-muqarrar hai woh poori ho, Qayamat ke din sab ka lautna Allah hi ki taraf hai phir woh har ek ko uske a'maal ka badla dega nek-on ko nek aur bad-on ko bura, wahi zaat hai jo har cheez par ghalib-o-qadir hai uski jalalat, azmat, izzat ke samne har koi past hai badai uski hai aur sab uske samne aajiz-o-maskeen hain woh apne muhafiz farishton ko bhejta hai jo insaan ki dekh bhaal rakhte hain jaise farman-e-aalishan hai aayat (لَهٗ مُعَقِّبٰتٌ مِّنْۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهٖ يَحْفَظُوْنَهٗ مِنْ اَمْرِ اللّٰهِ) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 11) pas yeh farishte toh woh hain jo insaan ki jismani hifazat rakhte hain aur dayen bayen aage peeche se use bahukum-e-Ilahi balaon se bachate rehte hain, dusri qisam ke woh farishte hain jo uske a'maal ki dekh bhaal karte hain aur unki nigahbani karte rehte hain jaise farmaya aayat (وَاِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحٰفِظِيْنَ) (82. Al-Infitar: 10) in hi farishton ka zikr aayat (اِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيٰنِ عَنِ الْيَمِيْنِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيْدٌ) (50. Qaf: 17) mein hai phir farmaya yahan tak ke tum mein se kisi ki maut ka waqt aa jata hai toh sakraat ke aalam mein uske paas hamare woh farishte aate hain jo isi kaam par muqarrar hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Malakul Maut ke bahut se madadgar farishte hain jo rooh ko jism se nikalte hain aur halqoom tak jab rooh aa jati hai phir Malakul Maut use qabz kar lete hain. Iska mufassal bayan aayat (Yusabbitullahu) mein aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Phir farmaya woh koi kami nahin karte yani rooh ki hifazat mein kotahi nahin karte. Use poori hifazat ke sath ya toh Illiyeen mein nek roohon se mila dete hain ya Sijjeen mein buri roohon mein daal dete hain. Phir woh sab apne sache Maula ki taraf bula liye jayenge.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke marne wale ki rooh ko nikalne ke liye farishte aate hain aur agar woh nek hai toh us se kehte hain ae mutma'in rooh jo paak jism mein thi toh nihayat achhaiyon aur bhalaiyon se chal toh rahat-o-aaram ki khushkhabri sun toh us Rabb ki taraf chal jo tujh par kabhi khafa na hoga, woh use sunte hi nikalti hai aur jab tak woh nikal na chuke tab tak yahi mubarak sada use sunayi jaati hai phir use aasmanon par le jaate hain us ke liye darwaze khol diye jaate hain aur farishte us ki aao-bhagat karte hain marhaba kehte hue hathon-hath lete hain aur jo maut ke farishton ne kaha tha wahi khushkhabri yeh bhi sunate hain yahan tak ke isi tarah nihayat tapak aur garm-joshi se farishton ke istiqbal ke sath yeh nek rooh us aasman tak pahunchti hai jis mein Allah Ta'ala hai, (Allah Ta'ala hamari maut bhi nek par kare) aur jab koi bura aadmi hota hai toh maut ke farishte us se kehte hain ke ae khabeeth rooh jo gande jism mein thi toh buri ban kar chal garm kholte hue pani aur sari-bhasi ghiza aur tarah tarah ke azabon ki taraf chal, phir woh us rooh ko nikalte hain aur yahi kehte rehte hain phir use aasman ki taraf chadhate hain darwaza kholna chahte hain, aasman ke farishte puchte hain kaun hai? Yeh us ka naam batate hain toh woh kehte hain is khabeeth nafs ke liye marhaba nahin, yeh tha bhi naapak jism mein toh burayi ke sath laut ja, tere liye aasmanon ke darwaze nahin khulte, chunancha use zameen ki taraf phenk diya jaata hai, phir qabr par layi jaati hai, phir qabr mein un dono roohon se sawal-jawab hote hain jaise pehli hadeesein guzar chukin. Phir Allah ki taraf lautaye jaate hain is se matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke farishte lautaye jaate hain. Is se matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke farishte lautaye jaate hain ya yeh ke makhlooq lautayi jaati hai yani Qayamat ke din, phir Janab-e-Bari in mein adl-o-insaf karega aur ahkaam jaari farmayega, jaise farmaya aayat (Qul innal awwaleena wal aakhireen) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 49) yani keh de ke awwal aakhir wale sab Qayamat ke din jama honge aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa hasharna hum falam nughadir minhum ahada) hum sab ko jama karenge aur kisi ko bhi baqi na chhodenge yahan bhi farmaya ke apne sache Maula ki taraf sab ko lautna hai. Jo bahut jaldi hisab lene wala hai. Is se zyada jaldi hisab mein koi nahin kar sakta.

Yahan farmaya raat ko woh tumhein sula deta hai aur dinon ko jo tum karte ho us se woh aagah hai, phir din mein tumhein utha bitha deta hai.

Ek ma'ani yeh bhi bayan kiye gaye hain ke woh neend mein yani khwab mein tumhein utha khada karta hai lekin awwal ma'ani hi awla hain, Ibn-e-Marduyah ki ek marfoo' riwayat mein hai ke har insaan ke sath ek farishta muqarrar hai jo sone ke waqt uski rooh ko le jata hai phir agar qabz karne ka hukum hota hai toh woh us rooh ko nahin lautata warna bahukum-e-Ilahi lauta deta hai, yahi ma'ani is aayat ke jumle aayat (وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ يَتَوَفّٰىكُمْ بالَّيْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا جَرَحْتُمْ بالنَّهَارِ) (6. Al-An'am: 60) ka hai taake is tarah umr ka poora waqt guzre aur jo ajal-e-muqarrar hai woh poori ho, Qayamat ke din sab ka lautna Allah hi ki taraf hai phir woh har ek ko uske a'maal ka badla dega nek-on ko nek aur bad-on ko bura, wahi zaat hai jo har cheez par ghalib-o-qadir hai uski jalalat, azmat, izzat ke samne har koi past hai badai uski hai aur sab uske samne aajiz-o-maskeen hain woh apne muhafiz farishton ko bhejta hai jo insaan ki dekh bhaal rakhte hain jaise farman-e-aalishan hai aayat (لَهٗ مُعَقِّبٰتٌ مِّنْۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهٖ يَحْفَظُوْنَهٗ مِنْ اَمْرِ اللّٰهِ) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 11) pas yeh farishte toh woh hain jo insaan ki jismani hifazat rakhte hain aur dayen bayen aage peeche se use bahukum-e-Ilahi balaon se bachate rehte hain, dusri qisam ke woh farishte hain jo uske a'maal ki dekh bhaal karte hain aur unki nigahbani karte rehte hain jaise farmaya aayat (وَاِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحٰفِظِيْنَ) (82. Al-Infitar: 10) in hi farishton ka zikr aayat (اِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيٰنِ عَنِ الْيَمِيْنِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيْدٌ) (50. Qaf: 17) mein hai phir farmaya yahan tak ke tum mein se kisi ki maut ka waqt aa jata hai toh sakraat ke aalam mein uske paas hamare woh farishte aate hain jo isi kaam par muqarrar hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain Malakul Maut ke bahut se madadgar farishte hain jo rooh ko jism se nikalte hain aur halqoom tak jab rooh aa jati hai phir Malakul Maut use qabz kar lete hain. Iska mufassal bayan aayat (Yusabbitullahu) mein aayega Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Phir farmaya woh koi kami nahin karte yani rooh ki hifazat mein kotahi nahin karte. Use poori hifazat ke sath ya toh Illiyeen mein nek roohon se mila dete hain ya Sijjeen mein buri roohon mein daal dete hain. Phir woh sab apne sache Maula ki taraf bula liye jayenge.

Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke marne wale ki rooh ko nikalne ke liye farishte aate hain aur agar woh nek hai toh us se kehte hain ae mutma'in rooh jo paak jism mein thi toh nihayat achhaiyon aur bhalaiyon se chal toh rahat-o-aaram ki khushkhabri sun toh us Rabb ki taraf chal jo tujh par kabhi khafa na hoga, woh use sunte hi nikalti hai aur jab tak woh nikal na chuke tab tak yahi mubarak sada use sunayi jaati hai phir use aasmanon par le jaate hain us ke liye darwaze khol diye jaate hain aur farishte us ki aao-bhagat karte hain marhaba kehte hue hathon-hath lete hain aur jo maut ke farishton ne kaha tha wahi khushkhabri yeh bhi sunate hain yahan tak ke isi tarah nihayat tapak aur garm-joshi se farishton ke istiqbal ke sath yeh nek rooh us aasman tak pahunchti hai jis mein Allah Ta'ala hai, (Allah Ta'ala hamari maut bhi nek par kare) aur jab koi bura aadmi hota hai toh maut ke farishte us se kehte hain ke ae khabeeth rooh jo gande jism mein thi toh buri ban kar chal garm kholte hue pani aur sari-bhasi ghiza aur tarah tarah ke azabon ki taraf chal, phir woh us rooh ko nikalte hain aur yahi kehte rehte hain phir use aasman ki taraf chadhate hain darwaza kholna chahte hain, aasman ke farishte puchte hain kaun hai? Yeh us ka naam batate hain toh woh kehte hain is khabeeth nafs ke liye marhaba nahin, yeh tha bhi naapak jism mein toh burayi ke sath laut ja, tere liye aasmanon ke darwaze nahin khulte, chunancha use zameen ki taraf phenk diya jaata hai, phir qabr par layi jaati hai, phir qabr mein un dono roohon se sawal-jawab hote hain jaise pehli hadeesein guzar chukin. Phir Allah ki taraf lautaye jaate hain is se matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke farishte lautaye jaate hain. Is se matlab yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke farishte lautaye jaate hain ya yeh ke makhlooq lautayi jaati hai yani Qayamat ke din, phir Janab-e-Bari in mein adl-o-insaf karega aur ahkaam jaari farmayega, jaise farmaya aayat (Qul innal awwaleena wal aakhireen) (Surah Al-Waqi'ah: 49) yani keh de ke awwal aakhir wale sab Qayamat ke din jama honge aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa hasharna hum falam nughadir minhum ahada) hum sab ko jama karenge aur kisi ko bhi baqi na chhodenge yahan bhi farmaya ke apne sache Maula ki taraf sab ko lautna hai. Jo bahut jaldi hisab lene wala hai. Is se zyada jaldi hisab mein koi nahin kar sakta.

Neend maut ki choti behan, Wafaat-e-Sughra yani choti maut ka bayan ho raha hai. Is se murad neend hai, jaise is aayat mein hai: Aayat (Iza qaalallahu ya 'Isa inni mutawaffika wa rafi'uka ilayya wa mutahhiruka minallazina kafaru wa ja'ilullazina-ttaba'uka fawqallazina kafarru ila yawmil qiyamah, summa ilayya marji'ukum fa-ahkumu bainakum fima kuntum fihi takhtalifun) (Surah Al-Imran: 55). Yani jabke Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke ae Isa! Main tujhe faut karne wala hoon (yani tujh par neend dalne wala hoon) aur apni taraf chadha lene wala hoon. Aur jaise is aayat mein hai: Aayat (Allahu yatawaffal-anfusa hina mautiha wallati lam tamut fi manamiha, fayumsikul-lati qada 'alaihal-mawta wa yursilul-ukhra ila ajalim musamma, inna fi zalika la-ayatil-liqawmiy yatafakkarun) (Surah Az-Zumar: 42). Yani Allah Ta'ala nafsun ko un ki maut ke waqt maar dalta hai aur jin ki maut nahin aayi unhein neend ke waqt faut kar leta hai (yani sula deta hai). Maut wale nafs ko toh apne paas rok leta hai aur dusre ko muqarrara waqt pura karne ke liye phir bhej deta hai. Is aayat mein dono wafaat bayan kar di hain, Wafaat-e-Kubra aur Wafaat-e-Sughra. Aur jis aayat ki is waqt tafsir ho rahi hai us mein bhi dono wafaaton ka zikr hai, Wafaat-e-Sughra yani neend ka pehle, phir Wafaat-e-Kubra yani haqiqi maut ka. Beech ka jumla: Aayat (Wa ya'lamu ma jarahtum bin-nahari summa yab'athukum fihi liyuqda ajalum musamma) (Surah Al-An'am: 60) jumla-e-mu'tariza hai jis se Allah ke wasi' ilm ki dalalat ho rahi hai ke woh din raat ke kisi waqt apni makhluq ki kisi halat se be-ilm nahin, un ki harkat-o-sakanat sab jaanta hai. Jaise farman hai: Aayat (Sawa-um minkum man asarral-qawla wa man jahara bihi wa man huwa mustakhfim bil-laili wa saribum bin-nahar) (Surah Ar-Ra'd: 10). Yani chupa khula, raat ka din ka, sab baaton ka use ilm hai. Aur aayat mein hai: (Wa mir-rahmatihi ja'ala lakumul-laila wan-nahara litaskunu fihi wa litabtaghu min fadlihi wa la'allakum tashkurun) (Surah Al-Qasas: 73). Yani yeh bhi Rabb ki rahmat hai ke us ne tumhare sukoon ka waqt raat ko banaya aur din ko talash-e-ma'ash ka waqt banaya. Aur aayat mein irshad hai: Aayat (Wa ja'alnal-laila libasa) (Surah An-Naba: 10). Raat ko hum ne libas aur din ko sabab-e-ma'ash banaya. Yahan farmaya raat ko woh tumhein sula deta hai aur dinon ko jo tum karte ho us se woh aagah hai, phir din mein tumhein utha bitha deta hai.

Ahsan faramosh na bano. Allah Ta'ala apna ahsan bayan farmata hai ke jab tum khushki ke bayabanon aur laq-o-daq sunsan jangalon mein raah bhatke hue qadam qadam par khauf-o-khatar mein mubtala hote ho aur jab tum kashtiyon mein baithe hue toofan ke waqt samundar ke talatum mein mayus-o-aajiz ho jate ho. Us waqt apne devtaon aur buton ko chhod kar sirf Allah Ta'ala hi ko pukarte ho. Yehi mazmoon Quran-e-Kareem ki aayat (وَاِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فِي الْبَحْرِ ضَلَّ مَنْ تَدْعُوْنَ اِلَّآ اِيَّاهُ) (17. Al-Isra: 67) mein aur aayat (ھُوَ الَّذِيْ يُسَيِّرُكُمْ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ) (10. Yunus: 22) mein aur aayat (اَمَّنْ يَّهْدِيْكُمْ فِيْ ظُلُمٰتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَنْ يُّرْسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهٖ ۭ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ ۭ تَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ) (27. An-Naml: 63) mein bhi bayan hua hai. Tadarru'an wa khufyatan ke ma'ani jahran aur sirran yani buland aawaz aur past aawaz ke hain. Al-gharaz us waqt sirf Allah ko hi pukarte hain aur wada karte hain ke agar tu hamein is waqt se nijat dega to hum hamesha tere shukr guzar rahenge. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai bawajood is ahd-o-paiman ke idhar hum ne inhe tangi aur museebat se chhoda aur udhar yeh azaad hote hi hamare sath shirk karne lage aur apne jhoote maboodon ko phir pukarne lage, phir farmata hai kya tum nahin jante ke jis Allah ne tumhe us waqt aafat mein dala tha woh ab bhi qadir hai ke tum par koi aur azaab upar se ya neeche se le aaye jaise ke Surah Subhan mein aayat (رَبُّكُمُ الَّذِيْ يُزْجِيْ لَكُمُ الْفُلْكَ فِي الْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ ۭ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِـيْمًا) (17. Al-Isra: 66) tak bayan farmaya. Yani tumhara Parwardigar woh hai jo darya mein tumhare liye kashtiyan chalata hai taake tum uska fazl hasil karo aur woh tum par bahut hi meharban hai. Lekin jab tumhe darya mein koi museebat pahunchti hai to jin ki tum ibadat karte rehte the woh sab tumhare khayal se nikal jate hain aur sirf Allah hi ki taraf lau lag jati hai, phir jab woh tumhe khushki par pahuncha deta hai to tum us se munh pher lete ho fi-alwaq'e insaan bada hi nashukra hai kya tum us se be-khauf ho ke woh tumhe khushki mein hi dhansa de ya tum par aandhi ka azaab bhej de phir tum kisi ko bhi apna karsaz na pao. Kya tum is baat se bhi nidar ho ke woh tumhe phir dobara darya mein le jaye aur tum par tundo-tez hawa bhej de aur tumhe tumhare kufr ke ba'is gharq kar de to phir kisi ko na pao jo hamara peecha kar sake. Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain upar neeche ke azaab mushrikon ke liye hain, Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain is aayat mein isi ummat ko daraya gaya tha lekin phir Allah Ta'ala ne maafi de di. Hum yahan is aayat se talluq rakhne wali hadeesain aur aasar bayan karte hain mulahiza hon.

Allah Ta'ala par hamara bharosa hai aur us se hum madad chahte hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai 'Yalbisakum' ke ma'ani 'Yakhlitukum' ke hain, yeh lafz 'Iltibas' se ma'akhuz hai. 'Shiya'an' ke ma'ani 'Firaqan' ke hain. Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain ke jab yeh aayat utri ke Allah qadir hai ke tumhare upar se azab nazil farmaye to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dua ki ke ya Allah! Main tere pur-azmat-o-jalal chehre ki panah mein aata hoon aur jab yeh suna ke neeche se azab le aaye to bhi aap (ﷺ) ne yeh dua ki. Phir yeh sun kar ke ya woh tum mein ikhtilaf daal de aur tumhein ek dusre se takleef pahunche to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh bahut zyada halka hai. Ibn Marduyah ki is hadith ke aakhir mein Hazrat Jabir (R.A) ka yeh farman bhi marwi hai ke agar is aapas ki nachaqi se bhi panah mangte to panah mil jati. Musnad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) se jab is aayat ke bare mein sawal kiya gaya to aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh to hone wala hi hai, ab tak yeh hua nahin. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise 'Ghareeb' batate hain. Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) se marwi hai ke hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke sath aa rahe the, aap (ﷺ) Masjid-e-Bani Mu'awiyah mein gaye aur do rakat namaz ada ki, hum ne bhi aap (ﷺ) ke sath padhi, phir aap (ﷺ) ne lambi munajat ki aur farmaya: Main ne apne Rab se teen cheezein talab keen, ek to yeh ke meri tamam ummat ko duboye nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe yeh cheez ata farmayi. Phir main ne dua ki ke meri aam ummat ko qahat-sali se Allah Ta'ala halak na kare, Allah Ta'ala ne meri yeh dua bhi qabool farmayi. Phir main ne dua ki ke in mein aapas mein phoot na pade, meri yeh dua qabool na hui. Sahih Muslim waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain hamare paas Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) Bani Mu'awiyah ke mohalle mein aaye aur mujh se daryaft farmaya ke jante ho tumhari is masjid mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne namaz kis jagah padhi? Main ne masjid ke ek kone ko dikha kar kaha yahan, phir pucha jante ho yahan teen duayein Huzoor (ﷺ) ne kya kya keen?

Main ne kaha ek toh yeh ke aap ki ummat par koi ghair muslim taqat is tarah ghalib na aa jaye ke un ko pees dale, dusre yeh ke un par aam qahat-e-sali aisi na aaye ke yeh sab tabah ho jayen. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne aap ki yeh dono duayen qabool farmayin. Phir teesri dua yeh ki ke in mein aapas mein ladaiyan na hon lekin yeh dua qabool na hui. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya tum ne sach kaha, yaad rakho Qayamat tak yeh aapas ki ladaiyan chalti rahengi. Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Banu Muawiyah ke mohallay mein gaye aur wahan aath rakat namaz ada ki, badi lambi rakat padhin, phir meri taraf tawajjah farma kar farmaya main ne apne Rab se teen cheezein mangin, Allah Pak ne do toh deen aur ek na di. Main ne sawal kiya ke meri ummat par un ke dushman is tarah na chha jayen ke unhein barbad kar dein aur un sab ko dubo ya na jaye, Allah ne in dono baton se mujhe aman diya, phir main ne aapas mein ladaiyan na hone ki dua ki lekin is se mujhe mana kar diya. Ibn Majah aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain main Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaya toh mujhe maloom hua ke aap tashreef le gaye, ab daryaft karta karta Huzoor jahan thay wahin pahuncha, dekha toh aap namaz padh rahe hain, main bhi aap ke peeche namaz mein khada ho gaya. Aap ne badi lambi namaz padhi, jab farigh huye toh main ne kaha Huzoor badi lambi namaz thi, phir aap ne apni teenon duaon ka zikr kiya. Nasai waghera mein Hazrat Anas se marwi hai ke ek safar mein Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne subah ki namaz ki aath rakat padhin aur Hazrat Anas ke sawal par apni duaon ka zikr kiya, is mein aam qahat-e-sali ka zikr hai. Nasai waghera mein hai ke Huzoor ne ek martaba sari raat namaz mein guzar di, subah ke waqt salam phera toh Hazrat Khabbab bin Arath (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne jo Badri sahabi hain, poocha ke aisi taweel namaz mein toh main ne aap ko kabhi nahin dekha, aap ne is ke jawab mein wahi farmaya jo oopar mazkoor hua, is mein ek dua yeh hai ke agli ummaton par jo aam azab aaye woh meri ummat par aam taur par na ayen.

Tafsir Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne namaz padhi jis ke ruku sujud pooray thay aur namaz halki thi, phir sawal-o-jawab wohi hain jo oopar bayan huay. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain: Mere liye zameen lapet di gayi yahan tak ke main ne mashriqain-o-maghribain dekh liye, jahan jahan tak yeh zameen mere liye lapet di gayi thi wahan wahan tak meri ummat ki badshahat pohanchay gi. Mujhe dono khazanay diye gaye hain, safaid aur surkh. Main ne apne Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal se sawal kiya ke meri ummat ko aam qahat-e-sali se halak na kar aur un par koi un ke siwa aisa dushman musallat na kar jo unhein aam tor par halak kar de yahan tak ke yeh khud aapas mein ek dusron ko halak karne lagen aur ek dusron ko qatl karne lagen aur ek dusron ko qaid karne lagen. Aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Main apni ummat par kisi cheez se nahin darta bajuz gumrah karne walay imamon ke. Phir jab meri ummat mein talwar rakh di jaye gi to Qayamat tak un mein se uthai na jaye gi.

Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke jab aap logon mein namaz parhtay to namaz halki hoti, ruku-o-sujud pooray hotay. Ek roz aap bohat der tak baithay rahay yahan tak ke hum ne ek dusre ko isharay se samjha diya ke shayad aap par wahi utar rahi hai, khamoshi se baithay raho. Jab aap farigh huay to baaz logon ne kaha: Huzoor! Aaj to is qadar zyada der tak aap ke baithay rehne se hum ne yeh khayal kiya tha aur aapas mein ek dusre ko isharay se yeh samjhaya tha. Aap ne farmaya: Nahin, yeh baat to na thi, balkay main ne yeh namaz bari raghbat-o-yaksooi se ada ki thi. Main ne is mein teen cheezein Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala se talab ki thin jin mein se do to Allah Ta'ala ne de dein aur ek nahin di. Main ne Allah Ta'ala se sawal kiya ke woh tumhein woh azab na kare jo tum se pehli qomon ko kiye hain, Allah Ta'ala ne ise poora kiya. Main ne phir kaha ke Ya Allah! Meri ummat par koi aisa dushman chha na jaye jo un ka safaya kar de, to Allah Ta'ala ne meri yeh murad bhi poori kar di. Phir main ne dua ki ke Allah Ta'ala tum mein phoot na dalay ke ek dusre ko eza pohanchayen, magar Allah Ta'ala ne yeh dua qabool na farmayi. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai: Main ne Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala se chaar duayen keen to teen poori huin aur ek rad ho gayi.

Chauthi dua is mein yeh hai ke meri ummat gumrahi par jama na ho jaye aur hadith mein hai do cheezein Allah ne dein do na dein, aasman se pathron ka sab par barsana mauqoof kar diya gaya, zameen ke pani ke toofan se sab ka gharq ho jana mauqoof kar diya gaya lekin qatl aur aapas ki ladai mauqoof nahin ki gayi (Ibn Marduyah). Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain jab yeh aayat utri toh Aan-Hazrat ﷺ wuzu kar ke uth kharay hue aur Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke meri ummat par na toh in ke oopar se azaab utaar na neeche se inhein azaab chakha aur na in mein tafriqa daal kar ek dusre ki museebat pahuncha, isi waqt Hazrat Jibraeel A.S utray aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki ummat ko is se panah de di ke in ke oopar se ya in ke neeche se in par aam azaab utara jaye (Ibn Marduyah). Ibn Abi Ka'ab se marwi hai ke do cheezein is ummat se hat gayin aur door reh gayin oopar ka azaab yani pathrao aur neeche ka azaab yani zameen ka dhansao hat gaya aur aapas ki phoot aur ek ka ek ko eizayein pahunchana reh gaya, aap farmate hain ke is aayat mein chaar cheezon ka zikr hai jin mein se do toh Huzoor ﷺ ki wafat ke pachis saal baad hi shuru ho gayin yani phoot aur aapas ki dushmani. Do baqi reh gayin woh bhi zaroor hi aanay wali hain yani rajam aur khasf aasman se sangbari aur zameen mein dhansaya jana (Ahmad). Hazrat Hasan is aayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain gunah se log bachay hue thay azaab rukay hue thay jab gunah shuru hue azaab utar paray. Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood R.A ba-aawaz buland majlis mein ya mimbar par farmate thay logo tum par aayat (Qul huwal-qadiru 'ala ay-yab'atha 'alaikum 'azaban min fawqikum aw min tahti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiya'an wa yudhiqa ba'dakum ba'sa ba'din) (Surah Al-An'am: 65) utar chuki hai agar aasmani azaab aa jaye ek bhi baqi na bachay agar tumhein woh zameen mein dhansa de toh tum sab halak ho jao aur tum mein se ek bhi na bachay lekin tum par aapas ki phoot ka teesra azaab aa chuka hai, Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke oopar ka azaab buray imam aur bad badshah hain neeche ka azaab bad-batin ghulam aur baddiyanat naukar chaakar hain yeh qaul bhi go sahih ho sakta hai lekin pehla qaul hi zyada zahir aur qawi hai, is ki shahadat mein aayat (A-amintum man fis-sama-i ay-yakhsifa bikumul-arda fa-idha hiya tamoor) (Surah Al-Mulk: 16) pesh ho sakti hai, ek hadith mein hai meri ummat mein sangbari aur zameen mein dhans jana aur surat badal jana hoga, is qisam ki bohat si hadeesein hain jo qayamat ke qurb ki alamaton ke bayan mein is ke mauqa par ja-ba-ja aayengi. Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Aapas ki phoot se murad firqa bandi hai, khwahishon ko peshwa banana hai, ek hadith mein hai yeh ummat tehattar firqon mein bat jayegi sab jahannami honge siwaye ek ke, ek dusre ki takleef ka maza chakhay is se murad saza aur qatl hai, dekh le ke hum kis tarah apni aayatein wazahat ke sath bayan farma rahe hain. Taake log ghaur-o-tadabbur karein sochein samjhein.

Is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Logo! Mere baad kafir ban kar na laut jana ke ek dusron ki gardanon par talwarein chalane lago. Is par logon ne kaha: Huzoor! Kya hum Allah ki wahdaniyat aur aap ki risalat ko maante hue aisa kar sakte hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Haan, haan! Yehi hoga. Kisi ne kaha: Aisa nahin ho sakta ke hum musalman rehte hue musalmanon hi ko qatl karein. Is par aayat ka aakhri hissa aur us ke baad ki aayat (Wa kazzaba bihi) ilakh, utri. (Ibn Abi Hatim aur Ibn Jarir)

Ahsan faramosh na bano. Allah Ta'ala apna ahsan bayan farmata hai ke jab tum khushki ke bayabanon aur laq-o-daq sunsan jangalon mein raah bhatke hue qadam qadam par khauf-o-khatar mein mubtala hote ho aur jab tum kashtiyon mein baithe hue toofan ke waqt samundar ke talatum mein mayus-o-aajiz ho jate ho. Us waqt apne devtaon aur buton ko chhod kar sirf Allah Ta'ala hi ko pukarte ho. Yehi mazmoon Quran-e-Kareem ki aayat (وَاِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فِي الْبَحْرِ ضَلَّ مَنْ تَدْعُوْنَ اِلَّآ اِيَّاهُ) (17. Al-Isra: 67) mein aur aayat (ھُوَ الَّذِيْ يُسَيِّرُكُمْ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ) (10. Yunus: 22) mein aur aayat (اَمَّنْ يَّهْدِيْكُمْ فِيْ ظُلُمٰتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَنْ يُّرْسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهٖ ۭ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ ۭ تَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ) (27. An-Naml: 63) mein bhi bayan hua hai. Tadarru'an wa khufyatan ke ma'ani jahran aur sirran yani buland aawaz aur past aawaz ke hain. Al-gharaz us waqt sirf Allah ko hi pukarte hain aur wada karte hain ke agar tu hamein is waqt se nijat dega to hum hamesha tere shukr guzar rahenge. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai bawajood is ahd-o-paiman ke idhar hum ne inhe tangi aur museebat se chhoda aur udhar yeh azaad hote hi hamare sath shirk karne lage aur apne jhoote maboodon ko phir pukarne lage, phir farmata hai kya tum nahin jante ke jis Allah ne tumhe us waqt aafat mein dala tha woh ab bhi qadir hai ke tum par koi aur azaab upar se ya neeche se le aaye jaise ke Surah Subhan mein aayat (رَبُّكُمُ الَّذِيْ يُزْجِيْ لَكُمُ الْفُلْكَ فِي الْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ ۭ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِـيْمًا) (17. Al-Isra: 66) tak bayan farmaya. Yani tumhara Parwardigar woh hai jo darya mein tumhare liye kashtiyan chalata hai taake tum uska fazl hasil karo aur woh tum par bahut hi meharban hai. Lekin jab tumhe darya mein koi museebat pahunchti hai to jin ki tum ibadat karte rehte the woh sab tumhare khayal se nikal jate hain aur sirf Allah hi ki taraf lau lag jati hai, phir jab woh tumhe khushki par pahuncha deta hai to tum us se munh pher lete ho fi-alwaq'e insaan bada hi nashukra hai kya tum us se be-khauf ho ke woh tumhe khushki mein hi dhansa de ya tum par aandhi ka azaab bhej de phir tum kisi ko bhi apna karsaz na pao. Kya tum is baat se bhi nidar ho ke woh tumhe phir dobara darya mein le jaye aur tum par tundo-tez hawa bhej de aur tumhe tumhare kufr ke ba'is gharq kar de to phir kisi ko na pao jo hamara peecha kar sake. Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain upar neeche ke azaab mushrikon ke liye hain, Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain is aayat mein isi ummat ko daraya gaya tha lekin phir Allah Ta'ala ne maafi de di. Hum yahan is aayat se talluq rakhne wali hadeesain aur aasar bayan karte hain mulahiza hon.

Allah Ta'ala par hamara bharosa hai aur us se hum madad chahte hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai 'Yalbisakum' ke ma'ani 'Yakhlitukum' ke hain, yeh lafz 'Iltibas' se ma'akhuz hai. 'Shiya'an' ke ma'ani 'Firaqan' ke hain. Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain ke jab yeh aayat utri ke Allah qadir hai ke tumhare upar se azab nazil farmaye to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dua ki ke ya Allah! Main tere pur-azmat-o-jalal chehre ki panah mein aata hoon aur jab yeh suna ke neeche se azab le aaye to bhi aap (ﷺ) ne yeh dua ki. Phir yeh sun kar ke ya woh tum mein ikhtilaf daal de aur tumhein ek dusre se takleef pahunche to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh bahut zyada halka hai. Ibn Marduyah ki is hadith ke aakhir mein Hazrat Jabir (R.A) ka yeh farman bhi marwi hai ke agar is aapas ki nachaqi se bhi panah mangte to panah mil jati. Musnad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) se jab is aayat ke bare mein sawal kiya gaya to aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh to hone wala hi hai, ab tak yeh hua nahin. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise 'Ghareeb' batate hain. Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) se marwi hai ke hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke sath aa rahe the, aap (ﷺ) Masjid-e-Bani Mu'awiyah mein gaye aur do rakat namaz ada ki, hum ne bhi aap (ﷺ) ke sath padhi, phir aap (ﷺ) ne lambi munajat ki aur farmaya: Main ne apne Rab se teen cheezein talab keen, ek to yeh ke meri tamam ummat ko duboye nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe yeh cheez ata farmayi. Phir main ne dua ki ke meri aam ummat ko qahat-sali se Allah Ta'ala halak na kare, Allah Ta'ala ne meri yeh dua bhi qabool farmayi. Phir main ne dua ki ke in mein aapas mein phoot na pade, meri yeh dua qabool na hui. Sahih Muslim waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain hamare paas Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) Bani Mu'awiyah ke mohalle mein aaye aur mujh se daryaft farmaya ke jante ho tumhari is masjid mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne namaz kis jagah padhi? Main ne masjid ke ek kone ko dikha kar kaha yahan, phir pucha jante ho yahan teen duayein Huzoor (ﷺ) ne kya kya keen?

Main ne kaha ek toh yeh ke aap ki ummat par koi ghair muslim taqat is tarah ghalib na aa jaye ke un ko pees dale, dusre yeh ke un par aam qahat-e-sali aisi na aaye ke yeh sab tabah ho jayen. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne aap ki yeh dono duayen qabool farmayin. Phir teesri dua yeh ki ke in mein aapas mein ladaiyan na hon lekin yeh dua qabool na hui.
