Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ood R.A ba-aawaz buland majlis mein ya mimbar par farmate thay logo tum par aayat (Qul huwal-qadiru 'ala ay-yab'atha 'alaikum 'azaban min fawqikum aw min tahti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiya'an wa yudhiqa ba'dakum ba'sa ba'din) (Surah Al-An'am: 65) utar chuki hai agar aasmani azaab aa jaye ek bhi baqi na bachay agar tumhein woh zameen mein dhansa de toh tum sab halak ho jao aur tum mein se ek bhi na bachay lekin tum par aapas ki phoot ka teesra azaab aa chuka hai, Ibn Abbas se marwi hai ke oopar ka azaab buray imam aur bad badshah hain neeche ka azaab bad-batin ghulam aur baddiyanat naukar chaakar hain yeh qaul bhi go sahih ho sakta hai lekin pehla qaul hi zyada zahir aur qawi hai, is ki shahadat mein aayat (A-amintum man fis-sama-i ay-yakhsifa bikumul-arda fa-idha hiya tamoor) (Surah Al-Mulk: 16) pesh ho sakti hai, ek hadith mein hai meri ummat mein sangbari aur zameen mein dhans jana aur surat badal jana hoga, is qisam ki bohat si hadeesein hain jo qayamat ke qurb ki alamaton ke bayan mein is ke mauqa par ja-ba-ja aayengi. Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Aapas ki phoot se murad firqa bandi hai, khwahishon ko peshwa banana hai, ek hadith mein hai yeh ummat tehattar firqon mein bat jayegi sab jahannami honge siwaye ek ke, ek dusre ki takleef ka maza chakhay is se murad saza aur qatl hai, dekh le ke hum kis tarah apni aayatein wazahat ke sath bayan farma rahe hain. Taake log ghaur-o-tadabbur karein sochein samjhein.

Is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Logo! Mere baad kafir ban kar na laut jana ke ek dusron ki gardanon par talwarein chalane lago. Is par logon ne kaha: Huzoor! Kya hum Allah ki wahdaniyat aur aap ki risalat ko maante hue aisa kar sakte hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Haan, haan! Yehi hoga. Kisi ne kaha: Aisa nahin ho sakta ke hum musalman rehte hue musalmanon hi ko qatl karein. Is par aayat ka aakhri hissa aur us ke baad ki aayat (Wa kazzaba bihi) ilakh, utri. (Ibn Abi Hatim aur Ibn Jarir)

Ahsan faramosh na bano. Allah Ta'ala apna ahsan bayan farmata hai ke jab tum khushki ke bayabanon aur laq-o-daq sunsan jangalon mein raah bhatke hue qadam qadam par khauf-o-khatar mein mubtala hote ho aur jab tum kashtiyon mein baithe hue toofan ke waqt samundar ke talatum mein mayus-o-aajiz ho jate ho. Us waqt apne devtaon aur buton ko chhod kar sirf Allah Ta'ala hi ko pukarte ho. Yehi mazmoon Quran-e-Kareem ki aayat (وَاِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فِي الْبَحْرِ ضَلَّ مَنْ تَدْعُوْنَ اِلَّآ اِيَّاهُ) (17. Al-Isra: 67) mein aur aayat (ھُوَ الَّذِيْ يُسَيِّرُكُمْ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ) (10. Yunus: 22) mein aur aayat (اَمَّنْ يَّهْدِيْكُمْ فِيْ ظُلُمٰتِ الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ وَمَنْ يُّرْسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ رَحْمَتِهٖ ۭ ءَاِلٰهٌ مَّعَ اللّٰهِ ۭ تَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ) (27. An-Naml: 63) mein bhi bayan hua hai. Tadarru'an wa khufyatan ke ma'ani jahran aur sirran yani buland aawaz aur past aawaz ke hain. Al-gharaz us waqt sirf Allah ko hi pukarte hain aur wada karte hain ke agar tu hamein is waqt se nijat dega to hum hamesha tere shukr guzar rahenge. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai bawajood is ahd-o-paiman ke idhar hum ne inhe tangi aur museebat se chhoda aur udhar yeh azaad hote hi hamare sath shirk karne lage aur apne jhoote maboodon ko phir pukarne lage, phir farmata hai kya tum nahin jante ke jis Allah ne tumhe us waqt aafat mein dala tha woh ab bhi qadir hai ke tum par koi aur azaab upar se ya neeche se le aaye jaise ke Surah Subhan mein aayat (رَبُّكُمُ الَّذِيْ يُزْجِيْ لَكُمُ الْفُلْكَ فِي الْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ ۭ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِـيْمًا) (17. Al-Isra: 66) tak bayan farmaya. Yani tumhara Parwardigar woh hai jo darya mein tumhare liye kashtiyan chalata hai taake tum uska fazl hasil karo aur woh tum par bahut hi meharban hai. Lekin jab tumhe darya mein koi museebat pahunchti hai to jin ki tum ibadat karte rehte the woh sab tumhare khayal se nikal jate hain aur sirf Allah hi ki taraf lau lag jati hai, phir jab woh tumhe khushki par pahuncha deta hai to tum us se munh pher lete ho fi-alwaq'e insaan bada hi nashukra hai kya tum us se be-khauf ho ke woh tumhe khushki mein hi dhansa de ya tum par aandhi ka azaab bhej de phir tum kisi ko bhi apna karsaz na pao. Kya tum is baat se bhi nidar ho ke woh tumhe phir dobara darya mein le jaye aur tum par tundo-tez hawa bhej de aur tumhe tumhare kufr ke ba'is gharq kar de to phir kisi ko na pao jo hamara peecha kar sake. Hazrat Hasan R.H farmate hain upar neeche ke azaab mushrikon ke liye hain, Hazrat Mujahid R.H farmate hain is aayat mein isi ummat ko daraya gaya tha lekin phir Allah Ta'ala ne maafi de di. Hum yahan is aayat se talluq rakhne wali hadeesain aur aasar bayan karte hain mulahiza hon.

Allah Ta'ala par hamara bharosa hai aur us se hum madad chahte hain. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai 'Yalbisakum' ke ma'ani 'Yakhlitukum' ke hain, yeh lafz 'Iltibas' se ma'akhuz hai. 'Shiya'an' ke ma'ani 'Firaqan' ke hain. Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain ke jab yeh aayat utri ke Allah qadir hai ke tumhare upar se azab nazil farmaye to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dua ki ke ya Allah! Main tere pur-azmat-o-jalal chehre ki panah mein aata hoon aur jab yeh suna ke neeche se azab le aaye to bhi aap (ﷺ) ne yeh dua ki. Phir yeh sun kar ke ya woh tum mein ikhtilaf daal de aur tumhein ek dusre se takleef pahunche to Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh bahut zyada halka hai. Ibn Marduyah ki is hadith ke aakhir mein Hazrat Jabir (R.A) ka yeh farman bhi marwi hai ke agar is aapas ki nachaqi se bhi panah mangte to panah mil jati. Musnad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) se jab is aayat ke bare mein sawal kiya gaya to aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya yeh to hone wala hi hai, ab tak yeh hua nahin. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein bhi hai aur Imam Tirmidhi ise 'Ghareeb' batate hain. Musnad Ahmad mein Hazrat Sa'ad bin Abi Waqqas (R.A) se marwi hai ke hum Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke sath aa rahe the, aap (ﷺ) Masjid-e-Bani Mu'awiyah mein gaye aur do rakat namaz ada ki, hum ne bhi aap (ﷺ) ke sath padhi, phir aap (ﷺ) ne lambi munajat ki aur farmaya: Main ne apne Rab se teen cheezein talab keen, ek to yeh ke meri tamam ummat ko duboye nahin, Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe yeh cheez ata farmayi. Phir main ne dua ki ke meri aam ummat ko qahat-sali se Allah Ta'ala halak na kare, Allah Ta'ala ne meri yeh dua bhi qabool farmayi. Phir main ne dua ki ke in mein aapas mein phoot na pade, meri yeh dua qabool na hui. Sahih Muslim waghera mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Abdullah bin Abdullah (R.A) farmate hain hamare paas Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) Bani Mu'awiyah ke mohalle mein aaye aur mujh se daryaft farmaya ke jante ho tumhari is masjid mein Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne namaz kis jagah padhi? Main ne masjid ke ek kone ko dikha kar kaha yahan, phir pucha jante ho yahan teen duayein Huzoor (ﷺ) ne kya kya keen?

Main ne kaha ek toh yeh ke aap ki ummat par koi ghair muslim taqat is tarah ghalib na aa jaye ke un ko pees dale, dusre yeh ke un par aam qahat-e-sali aisi na aaye ke yeh sab tabah ho jayen. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ne aap ki yeh dono duayen qabool farmayin. Phir teesri dua yeh ki ke in mein aapas mein ladaiyan na hon lekin yeh dua qabool na hui. Yeh sun kar Hazrat Abdullah ne farmaya tum ne sach kaha, yaad rakho Qayamat tak yeh aapas ki ladaiyan chalti rahengi. Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Banu Muawiyah ke mohallay mein gaye aur wahan aath rakat namaz ada ki, badi lambi rakat padhin, phir meri taraf tawajjah farma kar farmaya main ne apne Rab se teen cheezein mangin, Allah Pak ne do toh deen aur ek na di. Main ne sawal kiya ke meri ummat par un ke dushman is tarah na chha jayen ke unhein barbad kar dein aur un sab ko dubo ya na jaye, Allah ne in dono baton se mujhe aman diya, phir main ne aapas mein ladaiyan na hone ki dua ki lekin is se mujhe mana kar diya. Ibn Majah aur Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Hazrat Mu'az bin Jabal (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain main Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaya toh mujhe maloom hua ke aap tashreef le gaye, ab daryaft karta karta Huzoor jahan thay wahin pahuncha, dekha toh aap namaz padh rahe hain, main bhi aap ke peeche namaz mein khada ho gaya. Aap ne badi lambi namaz padhi, jab farigh huye toh main ne kaha Huzoor badi lambi namaz thi, phir aap ne apni teenon duaon ka zikr kiya. Nasai waghera mein Hazrat Anas se marwi hai ke ek safar mein Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne subah ki namaz ki aath rakat padhin aur Hazrat Anas ke sawal par apni duaon ka zikr kiya, is mein aam qahat-e-sali ka zikr hai. Nasai waghera mein hai ke Huzoor ne ek martaba sari raat namaz mein guzar di, subah ke waqt salam phera toh Hazrat Khabbab bin Arath (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) ne jo Badri sahabi hain, poocha ke aisi taweel namaz mein toh main ne aap ko kabhi nahin dekha, aap ne is ke jawab mein wahi farmaya jo oopar mazkoor hua, is mein ek dua yeh hai ke agli ummaton par jo aam azab aaye woh meri ummat par aam taur par na ayen.

Tafsir Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne namaz padhi jis ke ruku sujud pooray thay aur namaz halki thi, phir sawal-o-jawab wohi hain jo oopar bayan huay. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmatay hain: Mere liye zameen lapet di gayi yahan tak ke main ne mashriqain-o-maghribain dekh liye, jahan jahan tak yeh zameen mere liye lapet di gayi thi wahan wahan tak meri ummat ki badshahat pohanchay gi. Mujhe dono khazanay diye gaye hain, safaid aur surkh. Main ne apne Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal se sawal kiya ke meri ummat ko aam qahat-e-sali se halak na kar aur un par koi un ke siwa aisa dushman musallat na kar jo unhein aam tor par halak kar de yahan tak ke yeh khud aapas mein ek dusron ko halak karne lagen aur ek dusron ko qatl karne lagen aur ek dusron ko qaid karne lagen. Aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Main apni ummat par kisi cheez se nahin darta bajuz gumrah karne walay imamon ke. Phir jab meri ummat mein talwar rakh di jaye gi to Qayamat tak un mein se uthai na jaye gi.

Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke jab aap logon mein namaz parhtay to namaz halki hoti, ruku-o-sujud pooray hotay. Ek roz aap bohat der tak baithay rahay yahan tak ke hum ne ek dusre ko isharay se samjha diya ke shayad aap par wahi utar rahi hai, khamoshi se baithay raho. Jab aap farigh huay to baaz logon ne kaha: Huzoor! Aaj to is qadar zyada der tak aap ke baithay rehne se hum ne yeh khayal kiya tha aur aapas mein ek dusre ko isharay se yeh samjhaya tha. Aap ne farmaya: Nahin, yeh baat to na thi, balkay main ne yeh namaz bari raghbat-o-yaksooi se ada ki thi. Main ne is mein teen cheezein Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala se talab ki thin jin mein se do to Allah Ta'ala ne de dein aur ek nahin di. Main ne Allah Ta'ala se sawal kiya ke woh tumhein woh azab na kare jo tum se pehli qomon ko kiye hain, Allah Ta'ala ne ise poora kiya. Main ne phir kaha ke Ya Allah! Meri ummat par koi aisa dushman chha na jaye jo un ka safaya kar de, to Allah Ta'ala ne meri yeh murad bhi poori kar di. Phir main ne dua ki ke Allah Ta'ala tum mein phoot na dalay ke ek dusre ko eza pohanchayen, magar Allah Ta'ala ne yeh dua qabool na farmayi. Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai: Main ne Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala se chaar duayen keen to teen poori huin aur ek rad ho gayi.

Chauthi dua is mein yeh hai ke meri ummat gumrahi par jama na ho jaye aur hadith mein hai do cheezein Allah ne dein do na dein, aasman se pathron ka sab par barsana mauqoof kar diya gaya, zameen ke pani ke toofan se sab ka gharq ho jana mauqoof kar diya gaya lekin qatl aur aapas ki ladai mauqoof nahin ki gayi (Ibn Marduyah). Ibn Abbas R.A farmate hain jab yeh aayat utri toh Aan-Hazrat ﷺ wuzu kar ke uth kharay hue aur Allah Ta'ala se dua ki ke meri ummat par na toh in ke oopar se azaab utaar na neeche se inhein azaab chakha aur na in mein tafriqa daal kar ek dusre ki museebat pahuncha, isi waqt Hazrat Jibraeel A.S utray aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki ummat ko is se panah de di ke in ke oopar se ya in ke neeche se in par aam azaab utara jaye (Ibn Marduyah). Ibn Abi Ka'ab se marwi hai ke do cheezein is ummat se hat gayin aur door reh gayin oopar ka azaab yani pathrao aur neeche ka azaab yani zameen ka dhansao hat gaya aur aapas ki phoot aur ek ka ek ko eizayein pahunchana reh gaya, aap farmate hain ke is aayat mein chaar cheezon ka zikr hai jin mein se do toh Huzoor ﷺ ki wafat ke pachis saal baad hi shuru ho gayin yani phoot aur aapas ki dushmani. Do baqi reh gayin woh bhi zaroor hi aanay wali hain yani rajam aur khasf aasman se sangbari aur zameen mein dhansaya jana (Ahmad). Hazrat Hasan is aayat ki tafsir mein farmate hain gunah se log bachay hue thay azaab rukay hue thay jab gunah shuru hue azaab utar paray. Insha'Allah Ta'ala. Aapas ki phoot se murad firqa bandi hai, khwahishon ko peshwa banana hai, ek hadith mein hai yeh ummat tehattar firqon mein bat jayegi sab jahannami honge siwaye ek ke, ek dusre ki takleef ka maza chakhay is se murad saza aur qatl hai, dekh le ke hum kis tarah apni aayatein wazahat ke sath bayan farma rahe hain. Taake log ghaur-o-tadabbur karein sochein samjhein.

Is aayat ke nazil hone ke baad Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Logo! Mere baad kafir ban kar na laut jana ke ek dusron ki gardanon par talwarein chalane lago. Is par logon ne kaha: Huzoor! Kya hum Allah ki wahdaniyat aur aap ki risalat ko maante hue aisa kar sakte hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Haan, haan! Yehi hoga. Kisi ne kaha: Aisa nahin ho sakta ke hum musalman rehte hue musalmanon hi ko qatl karein. Is par aayat ka aakhri hissa aur us ke baad ki aayat (Wa kazzaba bihi) ilakh, utri. (Ibn Abi Hatim aur Ibn Jarir)

Ghalat taweelein karne walon se na milo. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke jis Quran ko aur jis hidayat-o-bayan ko tu Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se laya hai aur jise teri qoum Quraish jhutla rahi hai haqeeqatan woh sarasar haq hai, balkay is ke siwa aur koi haq hai hi nahin. In se keh dijiye main na to tumhara muhafiz hoon na tum par wakeel hoon, jaise aur aayat mein hai keh de ke yeh tumhare Rab ki taraf se haq hai jo chahe imaan laye aur jo chahe na mane, yani mujh par sirf tableegh karna farz hai, tumhare zimme sunna aur manna hai. Manne wale duniya aur aakhirat mein neki payenge aur na manne wale dono jahan mein badnaseeb rahenge. Har khabar ki haqeeqat hai woh zaroor waqay hone wali hai is ka waqt muqarrar hai, tumhein anqareeb haqeeqat-e-haal maloom ho jayegi, waqay ka inkishaf ho jayega aur jaan loge. Phir farmaya jab tu unhein dekhe jo meri aayaton ko jhutlate hain aur un ka mazaq udate hain to tu un se munh pher le aur jab tak woh apni shaitaniyat se baaz na aa jayen to un ke sath na utho na baitho. Is aayat mein go farman Hazrat-e-Risalat Ma'ab (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hai lekin hukm aam hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ummat ke har shakhs par haram hai ke woh aisi majlis mein ya aise logon ke sath baithe jo Allah ki aayaton ki takzeeb karte hon, un ke ma'ani ulat pulat karte hon aur un ki beja taweelein karte hon. Agar bilfarz koi shakhs bhoole se un mein baith bhi jaye to yaad aane ke baad aise zalimon ke paas baithna mamnoo hai. Hadees-e-Shareef mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne meri ummat ko khata aur bhool se darguzar farma liya hai aur un kamon se bhi jo un se zabardasti majboor kar ke karaye jayen. Is aayat ke isi hukm ki taraf ishara is aayat mein hai aayat (Wa qad nazzala alaikum fil kitabi an iza sami'tum aayatillahi yukfaru biha wa yustahza'u biha fala taq'udu ma'ahum hatta yakhoodu fi hadeesin ghairihi) (Surah An-Nisa: 140). Yani tum par is kitab mein yeh farman nazil ho chuka hai ke jab Allah ki aayaton ke sath kufr aur mazaq hota hua suno to aise logon ke sath na baitho aur agar tum ne aisa kiya to tum bhi is soorat mein un jaise hi ho jao ge, han jab woh aur baton mein mashghool hon to khair. Matlab yeh hai ke agar tum un ke sath baithe aur un ki baton ko bardasht kar liya to tum bhi un ki tarah hi ho. Phir farman hai ke jo log un se doori karen, un ke sath shareek na hon, un ki aisi majlison se alag rahen woh bari-uz-zimma hain, un par un ka koi gunah nahin, un par is badkirdari ka koi bojh un ke sar nahin. Deegar mufassireen kehte hain ke is ke yeh ma'ani hain ke agarche un ke sath baithen lekin jabke un ke kaam mein aur un ke khayal mein un ki shirkat nahin to yeh beganah hain, lekin yeh hazrat yeh bhi kehte hain ke yeh hukm Surah Nisa Madani ki aayat (Innaka iza misluhum) (Surah An-Nisa: 140) se mansookh hai.

In mufassireen ki is tafsir ke mutabiq aayat ke aakhri jumle ke yeh ma'ani honge ke hum ne tumhein un se alag rehne ka hukum is liye diya hai ke unhein ibrat hasil ho aur ho sakta hai ke woh apne gunah se baaz aajayein aur aisa na karein.

Har khabar ki haqeeqat hai woh zaroor waqay hone wali hai is ka waqt muqarrar hai, tumhein anqareeb haqeeqat-e-haal maloom ho jayegi, waqay ka inkishaf ho jayega aur jaan loge. Phir farmaya jab tu unhein dekhe jo meri aayaton ko jhutlate hain aur un ka mazaq udate hain to tu un se munh pher le aur jab tak woh apni shaitaniyat se baaz na aa jayen to un ke sath na utho na baitho. Is aayat mein go farman Hazrat-e-Risalat Ma'ab (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hai lekin hukm aam hai. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ummat ke har shakhs par haram hai ke woh aisi majlis mein ya aise logon ke sath baithe jo Allah ki aayaton ki takzeeb karte hon, un ke ma'ani ulat pulat karte hon aur un ki beja taweelein karte hon. Agar bilfarz koi shakhs bhoole se un mein baith bhi jaye to yaad aane ke baad aise zalimon ke paas baithna mamnoo hai. Hadees-e-Shareef mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne meri ummat ko khata aur bhool se darguzar farma liya hai aur un kamon se bhi jo un se zabardasti majboor kar ke karaye jayen. Is aayat ke isi hukm ki taraf ishara is aayat mein hai aayat (Wa qad nazzala alaikum fil kitabi an iza sami'tum aayatillahi yukfaru biha wa yustahza'u biha fala taq'udu ma'ahum hatta yakhoodu fi hadeesin ghairihi) (Surah An-Nisa: 140). Yani tum par is kitab mein yeh farman nazil ho chuka hai ke jab Allah ki aayaton ke sath kufr aur mazaq hota hua suno to aise logon ke sath na baitho aur agar tum ne aisa kiya to tum bhi is soorat mein un jaise hi ho jao ge, han jab woh aur baton mein mashghool hon to khair. Matlab yeh hai ke agar tum un ke sath baithe aur un ki baton ko bardasht kar liya to tum bhi un ki tarah hi ho. Phir farman hai ke jo log un se doori karen, un ke sath shareek na hon, un ki aisi majlison se alag rahen woh bari-uz-zimma hain, un par un ka koi gunah nahin, un par is badkirdari ka koi bojh un ke sar nahin. Deegar mufassireen kehte hain ke is ke yeh ma'ani hain ke agarche un ke sath baithen lekin jabke un ke kaam mein aur un ke khayal mein un ki shirkat nahin to yeh beganah hain, lekin yeh hazrat yeh bhi kehte hain ke yeh hukm Surah Nisa Madani ki aayat (Innaka iza misluhum) (Surah An-Nisa: 140) se mansookh hai.

In mufassireen ki is tafsir ke mutabiq aayat ke aakhri jumle ke yeh ma'ani honge ke hum ne tumhein un se alag rehne ka hukum is liye diya hai ke unhein ibrat hasil ho aur ho sakta hai ke woh apne gunah se baaz aajayein aur aisa na karein.

Ghalat taweelein karne walon se na milo. Allah Ta'ala farmata hai ke jis Quran ko aur jis hidayat-o-bayan ko tu Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se laya hai aur jise teri qoum Quraish jhutla rahi hai haqeeqatan woh sarasar haq hai, balkay is ke siwa aur koi haq hai hi nahin. In se keh dijiye main na to tumhara muhafiz hoon na tum par wakeel hoon, jaise aur aayat mein hai keh de ke yeh tumhare Rab ki taraf se haq hai jo chahe imaan laye aur jo chahe na mane, yani mujh par sirf tableegh karna farz hai, tumhare zimme sunna aur manna hai. Ya'ni be-deeno se munh pher lo, unka anjam nihayat bura hai. Is Quran ko parh kar suna kar logon ko hoshiyar kar do Allah ki narazgi se aur uske azabon se unhein dara do taake koi shakhs apni bad-a'maliyon ki wajah se halak na ho, pakra na jaye, ruswa na kiya jaye, apne matloob se mehroom na reh jaye. Jaise farman hai, ayat (Kullu nafsin bima kasabat raheenah) (Surah Al-Muddaththir: 38), har shakhs apne a'mal ka garwi hua hai magar dahne hath wale. Yaad rakho kisi ka koi wali aur sifarishi nahin, jaise irshad farmaya, ayat (Min qabli ay-ya'tiya yawmul-la bai'un feehi wala khullatuw-wala shafa'ah, wal-kafiroona humuz-zalimoon) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 254), is se pehle ke woh din aa jaye jis mein na khareedo-farokht hai, na dosti aur mohabbat, sifarish aur shafa'at. Kafir poore zalim hain. Agar yeh log Qayamat ke din tamam duniya ki cheezein fidiye ya badle mein de dena chahein to bhi un se na fidiya liya jaye ga na badla. Kisi cheez ke badle woh azabon se nijat nahin pa sakte. Jaise farman hai, ayat (Innal-lazina kafaroo wa matoo wahum kuffarun falan yuqbala min ahadihim mil-ul-ardi zahabanw-walawiftada bihi, ula'ika lahum 'azabun aleemunw-wama lahum min nasireen) (Surah Al-Imran: 91), jo log kufr par jiye aur kufr par hi mare, yeh agar zameen bhar kar sona bhi dein to namumkin hai ke qabool kiya jaye aur unhein chhora jaye. Pas farma diya gaya ke yahi woh log hain jo apni bad-a'maliyon ki wajah se ruswa kar diye gaye, unhein garam kholta hua pani peene ko mile ga aur unhein sakht alamnak azab hoga kyunke yeh kafir thay.

Islam ke siwa sab raston ki manzil Jahannam hai. Mushrikon ne musalmanon se kaha tha ke hamare deen mein aajao aur Islam chhod do. Is par yeh aayat utri ke kya hum bhi tumhari tarah be-jaan-o-be-nafa-o-nuqsan maboodon ko poojne lagein? Aur jis kufr se hat gaye hain kya phir laut kar usi par aajayein? Aur tum jaise hi hojayein? Bhala yeh kaise ho sakta hai? Ab toh hamari aankhein khul gayin, sahih raah mil gayi, ab ise kaise chhod dein? Agar hum aisa karlein toh hamari misaal us shakhs jaisi hogi jo logon ke sath seedhe raste par ja raha tha magar rasta gum hogaya. Shaitan ne use pareshan kardiya aur idhar udhar bhatkane laga. Uske sath jo raste par the woh use pukarne lage ke hamare sath mil ja, hum sahih raste par ja rahe hain. Yehi misaal us shakhs ki hai jo Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jaan aur pehchan ke baad mushrikon ka sath de. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi pukarne wale hain aur Islam hi seedha aur sahih rasta hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh misaal Allah Ta'ala ne maboodan-e-batil ki taraf bulane walon ki bayan farmayi hai aur unki bhi jo Allah ki taraf bulate hain. Ek shakhs rasta bhoolta hai, wahin uske kaan mein aawaz aati hai ke ae falan idhar aa, seedhi raah yehi hai, lekin uske sathi jis ghalat raste par lag gaye hain woh use thapakte hain aur kehte hain yehi rasta sahih hai, isi par chala chal. Ab agar yeh sache shakhs ko manega toh raah-e-rast lag jayega warna bhatakta phirega. Allah ke siwa dusron ki ibadat karne wale is umeed mein hote hain ke hum bhi kuch hain lekin marne ke baad unhein maloom hojata hai ke woh kuch na the, us waqt bahut nadim hote hain aur siwaye halakat ke koi cheez unhein dikhayi nahi deti. Yani jis tarah kisi jang mein gum-shuda insan ko jinnaat uska naam le kar aawazein de kar use aur ghalat raston par daal dete hain jahan woh mara mara phirta hai aur bil-aakhir halak aur tabah hojata hai, isi tarah jhoote maboodon ka pujari bhi barbad hojata hai. Hidayat ke baad gumrah hone wale ki yehi misaal hai. Jis raah ki taraf Shaitan use bula rahe hain woh toh tabahi aur barbadi ki raah hai aur jis raah ki taraf Allah bula raha hai aur uske nek bande jis raah ko sujha rahe hain woh hidayat hai. Go woh apne sathiyon ke majmay mein se na nikle aur unhein hi raah-e-rast par samajhta rahe aur woh sathi bhi apne tayin hidayat-yafta kehte rahein. Lekin yeh qaul aayat ke lafzon se mutabiq nahi kyunke aayat mein maujood hai ke woh use hidayat ki taraf bulate hain, phir yeh kaise ho sakta hai ke woh zalalat ho?

Hairan par zabar haal hone ki wajah se hai, sahih matlab yahi hai ke us ke saathi jo hidayat par hain ab use ghalat raah par dekhte hain to us ki khair khwahi ke liye pukar pukar kar kehte hain ke hamare paas aa ja seedha rasta yahi hai lekin yeh badnaseeb un ki baat par aitimaad nahin karta balkay tawajjah tak nahin karta, sach to yeh hai ke hidayat Allah ke qabze mein hai, woh jise raah dikhaye use koi gumrah nahin kar sakta, chunancha khud Quran mein hai ke tu chahe un ki hidayat par hirs kare lekin jise Allah bhatka de use wahi raah par la sakta hai, aison ka koi madadgar nahin. Hum sab ko yahi hukum kiya gaya hai ke hum khuloos se sari ibadatein mahaz usi Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ke liye karein aur yeh bhi hukum hai ke namazein qaim rakhein aur har haal mein us se darte rahein, Qayamat ke din usi ke samne hashr kiya jayega, sab wahin jama kiye jayenge. Usi ne aasman-o-zameen ko adl ke sath paida kiya hai, wahi maalik aur mudabbir hai, Qayamat ke din farmayega ho ja to ho jayega, ek lamha bhi der na lagegi. Yaum ka zabar ya to wa-ittaqo par atf hone ki wajah se hai yani us din se daro jis din Allah farmayega ho aur ho jayega aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yaum ka zabar Khalaqas-Samawati wal-Ardi par atf hone ki bina par ho to goya ibtida-e-paidaish ko bayan farma kar phir dobara paidaish ko bayan farmaya, yahi zyada munasib hai. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke fe'l muzmar ho yani Uzkur aur is wajah se yaum par zabar aaya ho, is ke baad ke dono jumle mahalan majroor hain, pas yeh dono jumle bhi mahalan majroor hain. In mein pehli sifat yeh hai ke Allah ka qaul haq hai, Rabb ke farman sab ke sab sach hain, tamam mulk ka wahi akela maalik hai, sab cheezein usi ki malkiyat hain. Yaum-e-yanfukhu mein yaum mumkin hai ke Yaum-e-yaqulu ka badal ho aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Wa Lahul-Mulku ka zarf ho jaise aur aayat mein hai: (Limanil-Mulkul-Yaum) (Surah Ghafir: 16) aaj kis ka mulk hai? Sirf Allah akele Ghalib ka aur jaise is aayat mein irshad hua hai: (Al-Mulku Yauma-izinil-Haqqu lir-Rahman, wa kana yauman alal-kafirina asira) (Surah Al-Furqan: 26) yani mulk aaj sirf Rahman ka hai aur aaj ka din kuffar par bahut sakht hai aur bhi is tarah ki aur is mazmoon ki bahut si aayatein hain. Baaz kehte hain soor jama hai soorat ki jaise soorah shehar panah ko kehte hain aur woh jama hai soorat ki lekin sahih yeh hai ke murad soor se qarn hai jise Hazrat Israfil (A.S) phoonkenge, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke Hazrat Israfil (A.S) soor ko apne munh mein liye hue apni peshani jhukaye hue hukum-e-Ilahi ke muntazir hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek sahabi ke sawal par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya soor ek narsinghe jaisa hai jo phoonka jayega, Tabrani ki mutawalat mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish ke baad soor ko paida kiya aur use Hazrat Israfil (A.S) ko diya, woh use liye hue hain aur Arsh ki taraf nigah jamaye hue hain ke kab hukum ho aur main use phoonk doon.

Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmate hain main ne daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Soor kya hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ek narsingha hai. Main ne kaha woh kaisa hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya bahut hi bada hai, wallah us ke daire ki chaudai aasman o zameen ke barabar hai. Is mein se teen nafe phoonke jayenge, pehla ghabrahat ka, doosra behoshi ka, teesra Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke samne khade hone ka. Awwal awwal Janab-e-Bari Hazrat Israfeel A.S ko Soor phoonkne ka hukum de ga, woh phoonk denge jis se aasman o zameen ki tamam makhlooq ghabra uthe gi magar jise Allah chahe. Yeh Soor bahukum-e-Rabb der tak barabar phoonka jaye ga, isi taraf ishara is aayat mein hai: "Wa ma yanzuru ha'ula'i illa saihatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaq" (38:15), yani inhe sirf buland zor-dar cheekh ka intezar hai. Pahar is Soor se misl badalon ke chalne phirne lagenge, phir ret ret ho jayenge. Zameen mein bhunchal aa jaye ga aur woh is tarah thar-tharane lage gi jaise koi kashti darya ke beech zabardast toofan mein maujon se idhar udhar ho rahi ho aur ghote kha rahi ho. Misl us handi ke jo arsh mein latki hui hai jise hawain hila jula rahi hain, isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai: "Yauma tarjufur-rajifah" (79:6) al-aayat, is din zameen junbish mein aa jaye gi aur bahut hi hilne lage gi, is ke peeche hi peeche lagne wali aa jaye gi. Dil dhadakne lagenge aur kaleje ulatne lagenge, log idhar udhar girne lagenge, maain apne doodh peete bachon ko bhool jayengi, hamila aurton ke hamal gir jayenge, bachche boodhe ho jayenge. Shayateen mare ghabrahat aur pareshani ke bhagte bhagte zameen ke kinaron par aa jayenge, yahan se farishte inhe maar maar kar hatayenge. Log pareshan-haal hawas-bakhta honge, koi jaye panah nazar na aaye gi, Amr-e-Ilahi se bachao na ho sake ga. Ek doosre ko aawazein denge lekin sab apni apni museebat mein pade hue honge ke nagahan zameen phatni shuru hogi, kahin idhar se phati kahin udhar se phati, ab to abtar halat ho jaye gi, kaleja kapkapane lage ga, dil ulat jaye ga aur itna sadma aur gham hoga jis ka andaza nahin ho sakta. Jo aasman ki taraf nazar uthayenge to dekhenge ke ghul raha hai aur woh bhi phat raha hai, sitare jhad rahe hain, sooraj chand benoor ho gaya hai. Haan murdon ko is ka kuch ilm na hoga. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne sawal kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Quran ki aayat mein jo farmaya gaya hai: "Fafazi'a man fis-samawati wa man fil-ardi illa man sha' Allah" (27:87), yani zameen o aasman ke sab log ghabra uthenge lekin jinhein Allah chahe is se murad kaun log hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh shaheed log hain ke woh Allah ke haan zinda hain, roziyan paate hain aur sab zinda log ghabrahat mein honge lekin Allah Ta'ala inhe pareshani se mehfooz rakhe ga. Yeh to azaab hai jo woh apni badtareen makhlooq par bheje ga, isi ka bayan aayat: (Ya ayyuhan-nasut-taqu Rabbakumullazi khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin wa khalaqa minha zaujaha wa bassa minhuma rijalan kaseeran wa nisa'a) (4:1).

An-Nisa (1) mein hai yani ae logo apne Rab se daro, yaad rakho Qayamat ka zalzala bahut badi cheez hai. Jis din tum ise dekh lo ge har ek doodh pilane wali apne doodh peete bache se ghafil ho jaye gi, har hamal wali ka hamal gir jaye ga, toh dekha jaye ga ke sab log behosh honge halankeh woh nasha piye hue nahin, balkeh Allah ke sakht azabon ne unhein bad-hawas kar rakha hai. Yehi halat rahe gi jab tak Allah chahe, bahut der tak yehi ghabrahat ka alam rahe ga. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ko behoshi ke nafh-e ka hukum de ga, is nafh-e ke phonkte hi zameen-o-aasman ki tamam makhlooq behosh ho jaye gi magar jise Allah chahe aur achanak sab ke sab mar jayenge. Hazrat Malak-ul-Maut A.S Allah Ta'ala ke huzoor mein hazir ho kar arz karenge ke ae Bari Ta'ala zameen-o-aasman ki tamam makhlooq mar gayi magar jise Tu ne chaha. Allah Ta'ala bawajood ilm ke sawal kare ga ke yeh batao ab baqi kaun kaun hai? Woh jawab denge Tu baqi hai, Tu Hayy-o-Qayyum hai, Tujh par kabhi fana nahin aur Arsh ke uthane wale farishte aur Jibraeel-o-Mikaeel. Is waqt Arsh ko zaban mile gi aur woh kahe ga ae Parwardigar kya Jibraeel woh Mikaeel bhi marenge? Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga main ne apne Arsh se neeche walon par sab par maut likh di hai, chunancha yeh dono bhi faut ho jayenge. Phir Malak-ul-Maut A.S Rabb-e-Jabbar-o-Qahhar ke paas aayenge aur khabar denge ke Jibraeel-o-Mikaeel bhi inteqal kar gaye. Janab-e-Allah ilm ke bawajood phir daryaft farmaye ga ke ab baqi kaun hai? Malak-ul-Maut A.S jawab denge ke baqi ek Tu hai, aisi baqa wala jis par fana hai hi nahin aur tere Arsh ke uthane wale. Allah farmaye ga Arsh ke uthane wale bhi mar jayenge, is waqt woh bhi mar jayenge. Phir Allah ke hukum se Hazrat Israfeel A.S se Soor ko Arsh le le ga, Malak-ul-Maut A.S hazir ho kar arz karenge ke ya Allah Arsh ke uthane wale farishte bhi mar gaye. Allah Ta'ala daryaft farmaye ga halankeh woh khoob janta hai ke ab baqi kaun raha? Malak-ul-Maut A.S jawab denge ke ek Tu jis par maut hai hi nahin aur ek tera ghulam main. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmaye ga tu bhi meri makhlooq mein se ek makhlooq hai, tujhe main ne ek kaam ke liye paida kiya tha jise tu kar chuka, ab tu bhi mar ja, chunancha woh bhi mar jayenge. Ab Allah Ta'ala akela baqi reh jaye ga jo ghalba wala, yaganat wala, be-maan baap aur be-aulad ke hai. Jis tarah makhlooq ke paida karne se pehle woh yakta aur akela tha. Phir aasmanon aur zameeno ko woh is tarah lapet le ga jaise daftari kaghaz ko lapetta hai, phir unhein teen martaba ulat-palat kare ga aur farmaye ga main Jabbar hoon, main kibriyai wala hoon. Phir teen martaba farmaye ga aaj mulk ka malik kaun hai? Koi na hoga jo jawab de, toh khud hi jawab de ga Allah-ul-Wahid-ul-Qahhar. Quran mein hai us din aasman-o-zameen badal diye jayenge.

Allah Ta'ala unhein phaila de ga aur khench de ga jis tarah chamra khencha jata hai kahin koi oonch neech baqi na rahe gi, phir ek Ilahi aawaz ke sath hi sari makhlooq is tabdeel shuda zameen mein aajaye gi andar wale andar aur oopar wale oopar phir Allah Ta'ala apne Arsh-e-tale se is par barish barsaye ga phir aasman ko hukum hoga aur woh chalees din tak meenh barsaye ga yahan tak ke pani un ke oopar barah hath charh jaye ga, phir jismon ko hukum hoga ke woh ugein aur woh is tarah ugane lagen ge jaise sabziyan aur tarkariyan aur woh pooray pooray kamil jism jaise thay waise hi hojayen ge phir hukum farmaye ga ke mere Arsh ke uthane wale farishtay jee uthein chunancha woh zinda hojayen ge phir Israfeel ko hukum hoga ke Soor le kar munh se laga lein. Phir farman hoga ke Jibraeel-o-Mikaeel zinda hojayen yeh dono bhi uthein ge, phir Allah Ta'ala roohon ko bulaye ga mominon ko noorani arwah aur kuffar ki zulmati roohein aayengi unhein le kar Allah Ta'ala Soor mein daal de ga, phir Israfeel ko hukum hoga ke ab Soor phoonk do chunancha Ba'as ka Soor phoonka jaye ga jis se arwah is tarah niklein gi jaise shehad ki makkhiyan. Tamam khala un se bhar jaye ga phir Rabb-e-Aalam ka irshad hoga ke mujhe apni izzat-o-jalal ki qasam hai har rooh apne apne jism mein chali jaye, chunancha sab roohein apne apne jismon mein nathnon ke rastay chali jayengi aur jis tarah zehar rag-o-paye mein asar kar jata hai rooh roohein roohein mein dor jaye gi, phir zameen phat jaye gi aur log apni qabron se nikal kharay honge, sab se pehle mere oopar se zameen shaq hogi, log nikal kar dortay huay apne Rabb ki taraf chal dein ge, us waqt kafir kahenge ke aaj ka din bara bhari hai, sab nangay pairon nangay badan be-khatna honge ek maidan mein ba-qadr sattar saal ke kharay rahen ge, na un ki taraf nigah uthai jaye gi na un ke darmiyan faislay kiye jayen ge, log be-tarah girya-o-zari mein mubtala honge yahan tak ke aansoo khatam hojayen ge aur khoon aankhon se nikalne lagay ga, paseena is qadar aaye ga ke munh tak ya thodiyon tak is mein doobay huay honge, aapas mein kahenge aao kisi se kahein ke woh hamari shafa'at kare, hamaray Parwardigar se arz kare ke woh aaye aur hamaray faislay kare to kahenge ke is ke laiq hamaray baap Hazrat Adam (A.S) se behtar kaun hoga? Jinhein Allah ne apne hath se paida kiya, apni rooh un mein phonki aur aamnay samnay un se batein kein. Chunancha sab mil kar aap ke paas jayen ge aur sifarish talab karenge lekin Hazrat Adam (A.S) saaf inkar kar jayen ge aur farmayen ge mujh mein itni qabiliyat nahin phir woh isi tarah ek ek Nabi ke paas jayen ge aur sab inkar kar dein ge. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmatay hain phir sab ke sab mere paas aayen ge, mein Arsh ke aagay jaunga aur sajday mein gir parunga, Allah Ta'ala mere paas farishta bhejega woh mera bazu tham kar mujhe sajday se uthaye ga.

Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga, "Aye Muhammad (ﷺ), main jawab doon ga ke haan aye mere Rab." Allah Azza-wa-Jal ba-wujood-e-alim-e-kul hone ke mujh se daryaft farmaye ga ke, "Kya baat hai?" Main kahoon ga, "Ya Allah! Tu ne mujh se shifa'at ki qabooliyat ka wada farmaya hai apni makhlooq ke bare mein, meri shifa'at ko qabool farma aur un ke faislon ke liye tashreef le aa." Rabb-ul-Aalameen farmaye ga, "Main ne teri sifarish qabool ki aur main aa kar tum mein faisle kiye deta hoon." Main laut kar logon ke sath thehar jaoon ga ke nagahan aasmanon se ek bahut bada dhamaka sunai de ga jis se log khaufzada ho jayenge. Itne mein aasman ke farishte utarne shuru honge jin ki tadaad kul insanon aur sare jinnon ke barabar hogi. Jab woh zameen ke qareeb pahunchenge to un ke noor se zameen jagmaga uthe gi, woh safein baandh kar khade ho jayenge. Hum sab un se daryaft karenge ke, "Kya tum mein hamara Rab aaya hai?" Woh jawab denge, "Nahin." Phir us tadaad se bhi zyada tadaad mein aur farishte aayenge. Aakhir hamara Rab Azza-wa-Jal abr ke saye mein nuzool farmaye ga aur farishte bhi us ke sath honge. Us ka Arsh us din aath farishte uthaye hue honge. Is waqt Arsh ke uthane wale chaar farishte hain, un ke qadam aakhri neeche wali zameen ki teh mein hain, zameen-o-aasman un ke nisf jism ke muqable mein hain, un ke kandhon par Arsh-e-Ilahi hai. Un ki zabanen har waqt Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ki pakeezgi ke bayan mein tar hain. Un ki tasbeeh yeh hai: "Subhan-a-Zil Arshi wal Jabroot, Subhan-a-Zil Mulki wal Malakoot, Subhan-al-Hayy-il-lazi la yamoot, Subhan-al-lazi yumeet-ul-khala'iqi wa la yamoot, Subboohun Quddusun Quddusun Quddusun, Subhan-a-Rabbinal A'la, Rabb-ul-Mala'ikati war-Rooh, Subhan-a-Rabbinal A'la-il-lazi yumeet-ul-khala'iqi wa la yamoot." Phir Allah jis jagah chahe ga apni Kursi zameen par rakhe ga aur buland aawaz se farmaye ga, "Aye jino aur insano! Main ne tumhein jis din se paida kiya tha us din se aaj tak main khamosh raha, tumhari baatein sunta raha, tumhare aamal dekhta raha. Suno! Tumhare aamal-name mere samne padhe jayenge, jo is mein bhalai paye woh Allah ki hamd kare aur jo is mein aur kuch paye woh apni jaan ko malamat kare." Phir ba-hukm-e-Ilahi jahannam mein se ek dehakti hui gardan nikle gi. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga, "Aye Adam ki aulad! Kya main ne tum se ahd nahin liya tha ke shaitan ki pooja na karna, woh tumhara khula dushman hai? Aur sirf meri hi ibadat karte rehna, yahi seedhi raah hai. Shaitan ne to bahut si makhlooq ko gumrah kar diya hai, kya tumhein aql nahin? Yeh hai woh jahannam jis ka tum wada diye jate the aur jise tum jhutlate rahe, aye gunahgaro!"

Aaj tum nek bandon se alag ho jao, is farman ke sath hi bad log nekon se alag ho jayenge. Tamam ummatein ghutnon ke bal gir padengi jaise Quran-e-Kareem mein hai ke tu har ummat ko ghutnon ke bal gire hue dekhega. Har ummat apne nam-e-aamal ki taraf bulai jayegi, phir Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq mein faisle karega. Pehle janwaron mein faisle honge yahan tak ke be-seeng wali bakri ka badla seeng wali bakri se liya jayega, jab kisi ka kisi ke zimme koi dawa baqi na rahega to Allah Ta'ala unhein farmayega tum sab mitti ho jao, is farman ke sath hi tamam janwar mitti ban jayenge, us waqt kafir bhi yahi aarzoo karenge ke kaash hum bhi mitti ho jate. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne bandon ke faisle shuru karega, sab se pehle qatl-o-khoon ka faisla hoga, Allah Ta'ala apni rah ke shaheedon ko bhi bulayega, un ke hathon se qatl shuda log apna sar uthaye hue hazir honge, ragon se khoon beh raha hoga, kahenge ke Bari Ta'ala daryaft farma ke is ne mujhe kyun qatl kiya? Pas bawajood ilm ke Allah Azza-o-Jal mujahideen se puchega ke tum ne inhe kyun qatl kiya? Woh jawab denge is liye ke teri baat buland ho aur teri izzat ho. Allah Aali farmayega tum sache ho, usi waqt un ka chehra noorani ho jayega, suraj ki tarah chamakne lagega aur farishte unhein apne jhurmat mein le kar jannat ki taraf chalenge. Phir baqi ke aur tamam qatil-o-maqtool isi tarah pesh honge aur jo nafs zulm se qatl kiya gaya hai us ka badla zalim qatil se dilwaya jayega, isi tarah har mazloom ko zalim se badla dilwaya jayega yahan tak ke jo shakhs doodh mein pani mila kar bechta tha use farmaya jayega ke apne doodh se pani juda kar de. In faislon ke baad ek munadi ba-awaz-e-buland nida karega jise sab sunenge, har aabid apne mabood ke peeche ho le aur Allah ke siwa jis ne kisi aur ki ibadat ki hai woh jahannam mein chal de, suno agar yeh sache mabood hote to jahannam mein warid na hote, yeh sab to jahannam mein hi hamesha rahenge. Ab sirf ba-iman log baqi rahenge, in mein munafiqeen bhi shamil honge. Allah Ta'ala un ke paas jis hai'at mein chahe tashreef layega aur un se farmayega ke sab apne maboodon ke peeche chale gaye, tum bhi jis ki ibadat karte the us ke paas chale jao. Yeh jawab denge ke Wallah hamara to koi mabood nahin bajuz Ilah-ul-Aalameen ke, hum ne kisi aur ki ibadat nahin ki. Ab un ke liye pindli khol di jayegi aur Allah Ta'ala apni azmat ki tajalliyan un par dalega jis se yeh Allah Ta'ala ko pehchan lenge aur sajde mein gir padenge lekin munafiq sajda nahin kar sakenge, yeh oondhe aur ulte ho jayenge aur apni kamar ke bal gir padenge, un ki peeth seedhi kar di jayegi, mud nahin sakenge.

Phir Allah Ta'ala mominon ko sajde se uthne ka hukum de ga aur Jahannam par Pul-e-Sirat rakhi jaye gi jo talwar jaisi tez dhaar wali hogi aur jagah jagah aankre aur kaante honge, bari phislni aur khatarnak hogi. Imaan-dar toh is par se itni si der mein guzar jayenge jitni der mein koi aankh band kar ke khol de, jis tarah bijli guzar jati hai aur jaise hawa tezi se chalti hai, ya jaise tez-rau ghore ya oont hote hain ya khoob bhagne wale aadmi hote hain. Baaz sahih-o-salim guzar jayenge, baaz zakhmi ho kar paar utar jayenge, baaz kat kar Jahannam mein gir jayenge. Jitne log jab Jannat ke paas pahunchenge toh kahenge kaun hamare Rab se hamari sifarish kare ki hum Jannat mein chale jayen? Dusre log jawab denge is ke haqdar tumhare baap Hazrat Adam A.S se zyada aur kaun honge? Jinhein Rab-e-Zul-Kareem ne apne haath se paida kiya aur apni rooh un mein phonki aur aamne-saamne baatein keen. Pas sab log aap ke paas aayenge aur aap se sifarish karani chahenge lekin apna gunah yaad kar ke jawab denge ki main is laiq nahin hoon, tum Nuh A.S ke paas jao woh Allah ke pehle Rasool hain. Log Hazrat Nuh A.S ke paas aa kar un se yeh darkhwast karenge lekin woh bhi apne gunah ko yaad kar ke yahi farmayenge aur kahenge ki tum sab Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke paas jao woh Khalilullah hain. Log aap ke paas aayenge aur yahi kahenge, aap bhi apne gunah ko yaad kar ke yahi jawab denge aur Hazrat Musa A.S ke paas jaane ki hidayat karenge ki Allah ne unhein sargoshiyan karte hue nazdeek kiya tha, woh Kalimullah hain, un par Taurat nazil farmayi gayi thi. Log aap ke paas aayenge aur aap se talab-e-sifarish karenge, aap bhi apne gunah ka zikr karenge aur Roohullah aur Kalimatullah Hazrat Isa Ibn-e-Maryam A.S ke paas bhejenge lekin Hazrat Isa A.S farmayenge main is qabil nahin, tum Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ke paas jao. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain pas sab log mere paas aayenge, main Allah ke saamne teen shafa'atein karunga. Main jaunga, Jannat ke paas pahunch kar darwaze ka kunda pakar kar khatkhatauga, mujhe marhaba kaha jaye ga aur khush-aamdeed kaha jaye ga. Main Jannat mein ja kar apne Rab ko dekh kar sajde mein gir padunga aur woh woh hamd-o-sana Janab-e-Bari ki bayan karunga jo kisi ne na ki ho. Phir Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga, "Aye Muhammad ﷺ! Apna sar uthao, shafa'at karo qabool ki jaye gi, mango mile ga." Main sar uthaunga, Allah Ta'ala toh dilon ke bhed bhi jaanta hai taham woh daryaft farmaye ga ki kya kehna chahte ho? Main kahunga, "Aye Allah! Tu ne meri shafa'at ke qabool farmane ka wada kiya hai." Chunancha Allah Ta'ala meri shafa'at un jannatiyon ke bare mein qabool farmaye ga aur unhein Jannat ke dakhle ki ijazat ho jaye gi.

Wallah jaise tum apne ghar se apne baal bachon se aagah ho is se bohat zyada yeh jannati apni jagah aur apni biwiyon se waqif honge. Har ek apne apne thikane pahunch jayega. Sattar sattar hoorein aur do do auratein milengi, yeh dono auratein apni ki hui nekiyon ke sabab pur-fazilat chehron ki malik hongi. Jitni der mein se ek ke paas jayega jo yaqoot ke bala-khane mein sone ke jadao takht par sattar reshmi hullay pehne hue hogi, is ka jism is qadar noorani hoga ke ek taraf agar jannati apna hath rakhe to dusri taraf se nazar aaye ga. Is ki safai ki wajah se is ki pindli ka guda gosht post mein nazar aa raha hoga. Is ka dil is ka aaina hoga, na yeh is se bas kare na woh is se uktaye. Jab kabhi is ke paas jayega bakira payega, na yeh thake na ise takleef ho, na koi makrooh cheez ho. Yeh apni isi mashghooli mein, mazay mein aur lutf-o-rahat mein Allah jaane kitni muddat guzar de ga jo ek aawaz aayegi ke maana na tumhara dil is se bharta hai na un ka dil tum se bhare ga. Lekin Allah ne tumhare liye aur biwiyan bhi rakhi hui hain.

Ab yeh auron ke paas jayega jis ke paas jayega besakhta zaban se yahi niklega Allah ki qasam ki saazi jannat mein tum se behtar koi cheez nahin mujhe toh jannat ki tamam cheezon se zyada tum se mohabbat hai, haan jinhein un ki bad-amliyon aur gunahon ne tabah kar rakha hai woh jahannam mein jayenge apne apne aamaal ke mutabiq aag mein jalenge, baaz qadmon tak baaz aadhi pindli tak baaz ghutne tak baaz aadhe badan tak baaz gardan tak, sirf chehra baqi reh jayega kyunke surat ka bigadna Allah ne aag par haram kar diya hai, Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) Allah Ta'ala se apni ummat ke gunahgar dozakhiyon ki shafa'at karenge Allah Ta'ala farmayega jao jinhein pehchano unhein nikal lao, phir yeh log jahannam se azaad honge yahan tak ke un mein se koi baqi na rahega phir toh shafa'at ki aam ijazat mil jayegi kul ambiya aur shuhada shafa'at karenge, Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hoga ke jis ke dil mein ek dinar barabar bhi iman pao use nikal lao, pas yeh log bhi azaad honge aur un mein se bhi koi baqi na rahega, phir farmayega unhein bhi nikal lao jis ke dil mein do sulus dinar ke barabar iman ho, phir farmayega ek sulus walon ko bhi, phir irshad hoga chauthai dinar ke barabar walon ko bhi, phir farmayega ek qirat ke barabar walon ko bhi, phir irshad hoga unhein bhi jahannam se nikal lao jin ke dil mein rai ke daane ke barabar iman ho, pas yeh sab bhi nikal aayenge aur un mein se ek shakhs bhi baqi na bachega, balkay jahannam mein ek shakhs bhi aisa na reh jaye ga jis ne khuloos ke sath koi neki bhi Allah ki farmanbardari ke mat-hat ki ho, jitne shafi honge sab sifarish kar lenge yahan tak ke Iblees ko bhi umeed bandh jayegi aur woh bhi gardan utha utha kar dekhega ke shayad koi meri bhi shafa'at kare kyunke woh Allah ki rahmat ka josh dekh raha hoga is ke baad Allah Ta'ala Arham-ur-Rahimeen farmayega ke ab toh sirf main hi baqi reh gaya aur main toh sab se zyada raham-o-karam karne wala hoon, pas apna hath daal kar khud Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala jahannam mein se logon ko nikale ga jin ki tadaad siwaye is ke aur koi nahin janta woh jalte jhulaste hue koyle ki tarah ho gaye honge, unhein Nahar-e-Haiwan mein dala jayega jahan woh is tarah ugengen jis tarah dana ugta hai jo kisi darya ke kinare boya gaya ho ke us ka dhoop ka rukh toh sabz rehta hai aur saaye ka rukh zard rehta hai un ki gardanon par tahrir hoga ke yeh Rahman ke azaad karda hain, is tahrir se unhein dusre jannati pehchan lenge. Ek muddat tak toh yunhi rahenge phir Allah Ta'ala se dua karenge ke Aye Allah yeh huroof bhi mit jayen Allah Azza-o-Jal yeh bhi mita dega yeh hadith aur aage bhi hai aur bahut hi ghareeb hai aur is ke baaz hisson ke shawahid mutafarriq ahadith mein milte hain, is ke baaz alfaaz munkar hain.

Ismail bin Rafi Qazi Ahl-e-Madina is riwayat ke sath munfarid hain, in ko ba'az muhaddiseen ne toh siqah kaha hai aur ba'az ne za'eef kaha hai aur in ki hadith ki nisbat kayi ek muhaddiseen ne munkar hone ki sarahat ki hai, jaise Imam Ahmad, Imam Abu Hatim, Imam Amr bin Ali, ba'az ne in ke bare mein farmaya hai ke yeh matrook hain, Imam Ibn-e-Adi farmate hain in ki sab ahadees mein nazar hai magar in ki hadeesein za'eef ahadees mein likhne ke qabil hain, main ne is hadith ki sanadon mein jo ikhtilaf kayi wajooh se hai use alaihida ek juz mein bayan kar diya hai is mein shak nahin ke is ka bayan bahut hi ghareeb hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke bahut si ahadees ko mila kar ek hadith bana li hai isi wajah se ise munkar kaha gaya hai, main ne apne ustad Hafiz Abu Al-Hajjaj Mizzi se suna hai ke unhon ne Imam Waleed bin Muslim ki ek kitab dekhi hai jis mein in baton ke jo is hadith mein hain shawahid bayan kiye hain, Wallahu A'lam.

Islam ke siwa sab raston ki manzil Jahannam hai. Mushrikon ne musalmanon se kaha tha ke hamare deen mein aajao aur Islam chhod do. Is par yeh aayat utri ke kya hum bhi tumhari tarah be-jaan-o-be-nafa-o-nuqsan maboodon ko poojne lagein? Aur jis kufr se hat gaye hain kya phir laut kar usi par aajayein? Aur tum jaise hi hojayein? Bhala yeh kaise ho sakta hai? Ab toh hamari aankhein khul gayin, sahih raah mil gayi, ab ise kaise chhod dein? Agar hum aisa karlein toh hamari misaal us shakhs jaisi hogi jo logon ke sath seedhe raste par ja raha tha magar rasta gum hogaya. Shaitan ne use pareshan kardiya aur idhar udhar bhatkane laga. Uske sath jo raste par the woh use pukarne lage ke hamare sath mil ja, hum sahih raste par ja rahe hain. Yehi misaal us shakhs ki hai jo Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jaan aur pehchan ke baad mushrikon ka sath de. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi pukarne wale hain aur Islam hi seedha aur sahih rasta hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh misaal Allah Ta'ala ne maboodan-e-batil ki taraf bulane walon ki bayan farmayi hai aur unki bhi jo Allah ki taraf bulate hain. Ek shakhs rasta bhoolta hai, wahin uske kaan mein aawaz aati hai ke ae falan idhar aa, seedhi raah yehi hai, lekin uske sathi jis ghalat raste par lag gaye hain woh use thapakte hain aur kehte hain yehi rasta sahih hai, isi par chala chal. Ab agar yeh sache shakhs ko manega toh raah-e-rast lag jayega warna bhatakta phirega. Allah ke siwa dusron ki ibadat karne wale is umeed mein hote hain ke hum bhi kuch hain lekin marne ke baad unhein maloom hojata hai ke woh kuch na the, us waqt bahut nadim hote hain aur siwaye halakat ke koi cheez unhein dikhayi nahi deti. Yani jis tarah kisi jang mein gum-shuda insan ko jinnaat uska naam le kar aawazein de kar use aur ghalat raston par daal dete hain jahan woh mara mara phirta hai aur bil-aakhir halak aur tabah hojata hai, isi tarah jhoote maboodon ka pujari bhi barbad hojata hai. Hidayat ke baad gumrah hone wale ki yehi misaal hai. Jis raah ki taraf Shaitan use bula rahe hain woh toh tabahi aur barbadi ki raah hai aur jis raah ki taraf Allah bula raha hai aur uske nek bande jis raah ko sujha rahe hain woh hidayat hai. Go woh apne sathiyon ke majmay mein se na nikle aur unhein hi raah-e-rast par samajhta rahe aur woh sathi bhi apne tayin hidayat-yafta kehte rahein. Lekin yeh qaul aayat ke lafzon se mutabiq nahi kyunke aayat mein maujood hai ke woh use hidayat ki taraf bulate hain, phir yeh kaise ho sakta hai ke woh zalalat ho?

Hairan par zabar haal hone ki wajah se hai, sahih matlab yahi hai ke us ke saathi jo hidayat par hain ab use ghalat raah par dekhte hain to us ki khair khwahi ke liye pukar pukar kar kehte hain ke hamare paas aa ja seedha rasta yahi hai lekin yeh badnaseeb un ki baat par aitimaad nahin karta balkay tawajjah tak nahin karta, sach to yeh hai ke hidayat Allah ke qabze mein hai, woh jise raah dikhaye use koi gumrah nahin kar sakta, chunancha khud Quran mein hai ke tu chahe un ki hidayat par hirs kare lekin jise Allah bhatka de use wahi raah par la sakta hai, aison ka koi madadgar nahin. Hum sab ko yahi hukum kiya gaya hai ke hum khuloos se sari ibadatein mahaz usi Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ke liye karein aur yeh bhi hukum hai ke namazein qaim rakhein aur har haal mein us se darte rahein, Qayamat ke din usi ke samne hashr kiya jayega, sab wahin jama kiye jayenge. Usi ne aasman-o-zameen ko adl ke sath paida kiya hai, wahi maalik aur mudabbir hai, Qayamat ke din farmayega ho ja to ho jayega, ek lamha bhi der na lagegi. Yaum ka zabar ya to wa-ittaqo par atf hone ki wajah se hai yani us din se daro jis din Allah farmayega ho aur ho jayega aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yaum ka zabar Khalaqas-Samawati wal-Ardi par atf hone ki bina par ho to goya ibtida-e-paidaish ko bayan farma kar phir dobara paidaish ko bayan farmaya, yahi zyada munasib hai. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke fe'l muzmar ho yani Uzkur aur is wajah se yaum par zabar aaya ho, is ke baad ke dono jumle mahalan majroor hain, pas yeh dono jumle bhi mahalan majroor hain. In mein pehli sifat yeh hai ke Allah ka qaul haq hai, Rabb ke farman sab ke sab sach hain, tamam mulk ka wahi akela maalik hai, sab cheezein usi ki malkiyat hain. Yaum-e-yanfukhu mein yaum mumkin hai ke Yaum-e-yaqulu ka badal ho aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Wa Lahul-Mulku ka zarf ho jaise aur aayat mein hai: (Limanil-Mulkul-Yaum) (Surah Ghafir: 16) aaj kis ka mulk hai? Sirf Allah akele Ghalib ka aur jaise is aayat mein irshad hua hai: (Al-Mulku Yauma-izinil-Haqqu lir-Rahman, wa kana yauman alal-kafirina asira) (Surah Al-Furqan: 26) yani mulk aaj sirf Rahman ka hai aur aaj ka din kuffar par bahut sakht hai aur bhi is tarah ki aur is mazmoon ki bahut si aayatein hain. Baaz kehte hain soor jama hai soorat ki jaise soorah shehar panah ko kehte hain aur woh jama hai soorat ki lekin sahih yeh hai ke murad soor se qarn hai jise Hazrat Israfil (A.S) phoonkenge, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke Hazrat Israfil (A.S) soor ko apne munh mein liye hue apni peshani jhukaye hue hukum-e-Ilahi ke muntazir hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek sahabi ke sawal par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya soor ek narsinghe jaisa hai jo phoonka jayega, Tabrani ki mutawalat mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish ke baad soor ko paida kiya aur use Hazrat Israfil (A.S) ko diya, woh use liye hue hain aur Arsh ki taraf nigah jamaye hue hain ke kab hukum ho aur main use phoonk doon.

Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmate hain main ne daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Soor kya hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ek narsingha hai. Main ne kaha woh kaisa hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya bahut hi bada hai, wallah us ke daire ki chaudai aasman o zameen ke barabar hai. Is mein se teen nafe phoonke jayenge, pehla ghabrahat ka, doosra behoshi ka, teesra Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke samne khade hone ka. Awwal awwal Janab-e-Bari Hazrat Israfeel A.S ko Soor phoonkne ka hukum de ga, woh phoonk denge jis se aasman o zameen ki tamam makhlooq ghabra uthe gi magar jise Allah chahe. Yeh Soor bahukum-e-Rabb der tak barabar phoonka jaye ga, isi taraf ishara is aayat mein hai: "Wa ma yanzuru ha'ula'i illa saihatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaq" (38:15), yani inhe sirf buland zor-dar cheekh ka intezar hai. Pahar is Soor se misl badalon ke chalne phirne lagenge, phir ret ret ho jayenge. Zameen mein bhunchal aa jaye ga aur woh is tarah thar-tharane lage gi jaise koi kashti darya ke beech zabardast toofan mein maujon se idhar udhar ho rahi ho aur ghote kha rahi ho. Misl us handi ke jo arsh mein latki hui hai jise hawain hila jula rahi hain, isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai: "Yauma tarjufur-rajifah" (79:6) al-aayat, is din zameen junbish mein aa jaye gi aur bahut hi hilne lage gi, is ke peeche hi peeche lagne wali aa jaye gi. Dil dhadakne lagenge aur kaleje ulatne lagenge, log idhar udhar girne lagenge, maain apne doodh peete bachon ko bhool jayengi, hamila aurton ke hamal gir jayenge, bachche boodhe ho jayenge. Shayateen mare ghabrahat aur pareshani ke bhagte bhagte zameen ke kinaron par aa jayenge, yahan se farishte inhe maar maar kar hatayenge. Log pareshan-haal hawas-bakhta honge, koi jaye panah nazar na aaye gi, Amr-e-Ilahi se bachao na ho sake ga. Ek doosre ko aawazein denge lekin sab apni apni museebat mein pade hue honge ke nagahan zameen phatni shuru hogi, kahin idhar se phati kahin udhar se phati, ab to abtar halat ho jaye gi, kaleja kapkapane lage ga, dil ulat jaye ga aur itna sadma aur gham hoga jis ka andaza nahin ho sakta. Jo aasman ki taraf nazar uthayenge to dekhenge ke ghul raha hai aur woh bhi phat raha hai, sitare jhad rahe hain, sooraj chand benoor ho gaya hai. Haan murdon ko is ka kuch ilm na hoga. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne sawal kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Quran ki aayat mein jo farmaya gaya hai: "Fafazi'a man fis-samawati wa man fil-ardi illa man sha' Allah" (27:87), yani zameen o aasman ke sab log ghabra uthenge lekin jinhein Allah chahe is se murad kaun log hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh shaheed log hain ke woh Allah ke haan zinda hain, roziyan paate hain aur sab zinda log ghabrahat mein honge lekin Allah Ta'ala inhe pareshani se mehfooz rakhe ga. Yeh to azaab hai jo woh apni badtareen makhlooq par bheje ga, isi ka bayan aayat: (Ya ayyuhan-nasut-taqu Rabbakumullazi khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin wa khalaqa minha zaujaha wa bassa minhuma rijalan kaseeran wa nisa'a) (4:1).

An-Nisa (1) mein hai yani ae logo apne Rab se daro, yaad rakho Qayamat ka zalzala bahut badi cheez hai. Jis din tum ise dekh lo ge har ek doodh pilane wali apne doodh peete bache se ghafil ho jaye gi, har hamal wali ka hamal gir jaye ga, toh dekha jaye ga ke sab log behosh honge halankeh woh nasha piye hue nahin, balkeh Allah ke sakht azabon ne unhein bad-hawas kar rakha hai. Yehi halat rahe gi jab tak Allah chahe, bahut der tak yehi ghabrahat ka alam rahe ga. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ko behoshi ke nafh-e ka hukum de ga, is nafh-e ke phonkte hi zameen-o-aasman ki tamam makhlooq behosh ho jaye gi magar jise Allah chahe aur achanak sab ke sab mar jayenge. Hazrat Malak-ul-Maut A.S Allah Ta'ala ke huzoor mein hazir ho kar arz karenge ke ae Bari Ta'ala zameen-o-aasman ki tamam makhlooq mar gayi magar jise Tu ne chaha. Allah Ta'ala bawajood ilm ke sawal kare ga ke yeh batao ab baqi kaun kaun hai? Woh jawab denge Tu baqi hai, Tu Hayy-o-Qayyum hai, Tujh par kabhi fana nahin aur Arsh ke uthane wale farishte aur Jibraeel-o-Mikaeel. Is waqt Arsh ko zaban mile gi aur woh kahe ga ae Parwardigar kya Jibraeel woh Mikaeel bhi marenge? Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga main ne apne Arsh se neeche walon par sab par maut likh di hai, chunancha yeh dono bhi faut ho jayenge. Phir Malak-ul-Maut A.S Rabb-e-Jabbar-o-Qahhar ke paas aayenge aur khabar denge ke Jibraeel-o-Mikaeel bhi inteqal kar gaye. Janab-e-Allah ilm ke bawajood phir daryaft farmaye ga ke ab baqi kaun hai? Malak-ul-Maut A.S jawab denge ke baqi ek Tu hai, aisi baqa wala jis par fana hai hi nahin aur tere Arsh ke uthane wale. Allah farmaye ga Arsh ke uthane wale bhi mar jayenge, is waqt woh bhi mar jayenge. Phir Allah ke hukum se Hazrat Israfeel A.S se Soor ko Arsh le le ga, Malak-ul-Maut A.S hazir ho kar arz karenge ke ya Allah Arsh ke uthane wale farishte bhi mar gaye. Allah Ta'ala daryaft farmaye ga halankeh woh khoob janta hai ke ab baqi kaun raha? Malak-ul-Maut A.S jawab denge ke ek Tu jis par maut hai hi nahin aur ek tera ghulam main. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmaye ga tu bhi meri makhlooq mein se ek makhlooq hai, tujhe main ne ek kaam ke liye paida kiya tha jise tu kar chuka, ab tu bhi mar ja, chunancha woh bhi mar jayenge. Ab Allah Ta'ala akela baqi reh jaye ga jo ghalba wala, yaganat wala, be-maan baap aur be-aulad ke hai. Jis tarah makhlooq ke paida karne se pehle woh yakta aur akela tha. Phir aasmanon aur zameeno ko woh is tarah lapet le ga jaise daftari kaghaz ko lapetta hai, phir unhein teen martaba ulat-palat kare ga aur farmaye ga main Jabbar hoon, main kibriyai wala hoon. Phir teen martaba farmaye ga aaj mulk ka malik kaun hai? Koi na hoga jo jawab de, toh khud hi jawab de ga Allah-ul-Wahid-ul-Qahhar. Quran mein hai us din aasman-o-zameen badal diye jayenge.

Allah Ta'ala unhein phaila de ga aur khench de ga jis tarah chamra khencha jata hai kahin koi oonch neech baqi na rahe gi, phir ek Ilahi aawaz ke sath hi sari makhlooq is tabdeel shuda zameen mein aajaye gi andar wale andar aur oopar wale oopar phir Allah Ta'ala apne Arsh-e-tale se is par barish barsaye ga phir aasman ko hukum hoga aur woh chalees din tak meenh barsaye ga yahan tak ke pani un ke oopar barah hath charh jaye ga, phir jismon ko hukum hoga ke woh ugein aur woh is tarah ugane lagen ge jaise sabziyan aur tarkariyan aur woh pooray pooray kamil jism jaise thay waise hi hojayen ge phir hukum farmaye ga ke mere Arsh ke uthane wale farishtay jee uthein chunancha woh zinda hojayen ge phir Israfeel ko hukum hoga ke Soor le kar munh se laga lein. Phir farman hoga ke Jibraeel-o-Mikaeel zinda hojayen yeh dono bhi uthein ge, phir Allah Ta'ala roohon ko bulaye ga mominon ko noorani arwah aur kuffar ki zulmati roohein aayengi unhein le kar Allah Ta'ala Soor mein daal de ga, phir Israfeel ko hukum hoga ke ab Soor phoonk do chunancha Ba'as ka Soor phoonka jaye ga jis se arwah is tarah niklein gi jaise shehad ki makkhiyan. Tamam khala un se bhar jaye ga phir Rabb-e-Aalam ka irshad hoga ke mujhe apni izzat-o-jalal ki qasam hai har rooh apne apne jism mein chali jaye, chunancha sab roohein apne apne jismon mein nathnon ke rastay chali jayengi aur jis tarah zehar rag-o-paye mein asar kar jata hai rooh roohein roohein mein dor jaye gi, phir zameen phat jaye gi aur log apni qabron se nikal kharay honge, sab se pehle mere oopar se zameen shaq hogi, log nikal kar dortay huay apne Rabb ki taraf chal dein ge, us waqt kafir kahenge ke aaj ka din bara bhari hai, sab nangay pairon nangay badan be-khatna honge ek maidan mein ba-qadr sattar saal ke kharay rahen ge, na un ki taraf nigah uthai jaye gi na un ke darmiyan faislay kiye jayen ge, log be-tarah girya-o-zari mein mubtala honge yahan tak ke aansoo khatam hojayen ge aur khoon aankhon se nikalne lagay ga, paseena is qadar aaye ga ke munh tak ya thodiyon tak is mein doobay huay honge, aapas mein kahenge aao kisi se kahein ke woh hamari shafa'at kare, hamaray Parwardigar se arz kare ke woh aaye aur hamaray faislay kare to kahenge ke is ke laiq hamaray baap Hazrat Adam (A.S) se behtar kaun hoga? Jinhein Allah ne apne hath se paida kiya, apni rooh un mein phonki aur aamnay samnay un se batein kein. Chunancha sab mil kar aap ke paas jayen ge aur sifarish talab karenge lekin Hazrat Adam (A.S) saaf inkar kar jayen ge aur farmayen ge mujh mein itni qabiliyat nahin phir woh isi tarah ek ek Nabi ke paas jayen ge aur sab inkar kar dein ge. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmatay hain phir sab ke sab mere paas aayen ge, mein Arsh ke aagay jaunga aur sajday mein gir parunga, Allah Ta'ala mere paas farishta bhejega woh mera bazu tham kar mujhe sajday se uthaye ga.

Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga, "Aye Muhammad (ﷺ), main jawab doon ga ke haan aye mere Rab." Allah Azza-wa-Jal ba-wujood-e-alim-e-kul hone ke mujh se daryaft farmaye ga ke, "Kya baat hai?" Main kahoon ga, "Ya Allah! Tu ne mujh se shifa'at ki qabooliyat ka wada farmaya hai apni makhlooq ke bare mein, meri shifa'at ko qabool farma aur un ke faislon ke liye tashreef le aa." Rabb-ul-Aalameen farmaye ga, "Main ne teri sifarish qabool ki aur main aa kar tum mein faisle kiye deta hoon." Main laut kar logon ke sath thehar jaoon ga ke nagahan aasmanon se ek bahut bada dhamaka sunai de ga jis se log khaufzada ho jayenge. Itne mein aasman ke farishte utarne shuru honge jin ki tadaad kul insanon aur sare jinnon ke barabar hogi. Jab woh zameen ke qareeb pahunchenge to un ke noor se zameen jagmaga uthe gi, woh safein baandh kar khade ho jayenge. Hum sab un se daryaft karenge ke, "Kya tum mein hamara Rab aaya hai?" Woh jawab denge, "Nahin." Phir us tadaad se bhi zyada tadaad mein aur farishte aayenge. Aakhir hamara Rab Azza-wa-Jal abr ke saye mein nuzool farmaye ga aur farishte bhi us ke sath honge. Us ka Arsh us din aath farishte uthaye hue honge. Is waqt Arsh ke uthane wale chaar farishte hain, un ke qadam aakhri neeche wali zameen ki teh mein hain, zameen-o-aasman un ke nisf jism ke muqable mein hain, un ke kandhon par Arsh-e-Ilahi hai. Un ki zabanen har waqt Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ki pakeezgi ke bayan mein tar hain. Un ki tasbeeh yeh hai: "Subhan-a-Zil Arshi wal Jabroot, Subhan-a-Zil Mulki wal Malakoot, Subhan-al-Hayy-il-lazi la yamoot, Subhan-al-lazi yumeet-ul-khala'iqi wa la yamoot, Subboohun Quddusun Quddusun Quddusun, Subhan-a-Rabbinal A'la, Rabb-ul-Mala'ikati war-Rooh, Subhan-a-Rabbinal A'la-il-lazi yumeet-ul-khala'iqi wa la yamoot." Phir Allah jis jagah chahe ga apni Kursi zameen par rakhe ga aur buland aawaz se farmaye ga, "Aye jino aur insano! Main ne tumhein jis din se paida kiya tha us din se aaj tak main khamosh raha, tumhari baatein sunta raha, tumhare aamal dekhta raha. Suno! Tumhare aamal-name mere samne padhe jayenge, jo is mein bhalai paye woh Allah ki hamd kare aur jo is mein aur kuch paye woh apni jaan ko malamat kare." Phir ba-hukm-e-Ilahi jahannam mein se ek dehakti hui gardan nikle gi. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga, "Aye Adam ki aulad! Kya main ne tum se ahd nahin liya tha ke shaitan ki pooja na karna, woh tumhara khula dushman hai? Aur sirf meri hi ibadat karte rehna, yahi seedhi raah hai. Shaitan ne to bahut si makhlooq ko gumrah kar diya hai, kya tumhein aql nahin? Yeh hai woh jahannam jis ka tum wada diye jate the aur jise tum jhutlate rahe, aye gunahgaro!"

Aaj tum nek bandon se alag ho jao, is farman ke sath hi bad log nekon se alag ho jayenge. Tamam ummatein ghutnon ke bal gir padengi jaise Quran-e-Kareem mein hai ke tu har ummat ko ghutnon ke bal gire hue dekhega. Har ummat apne nam-e-aamal ki taraf bulai jayegi, phir Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq mein faisle karega. Pehle janwaron mein faisle honge yahan tak ke be-seeng wali bakri ka badla seeng wali bakri se liya jayega, jab kisi ka kisi ke zimme koi dawa baqi na rahega to Allah Ta'ala unhein farmayega tum sab mitti ho jao, is farman ke sath hi tamam janwar mitti ban jayenge, us waqt kafir bhi yahi aarzoo karenge ke kaash hum bhi mitti ho jate. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne bandon ke faisle shuru karega, sab se pehle qatl-o-khoon ka faisla hoga, Allah Ta'ala apni rah ke shaheedon ko bhi bulayega, un ke hathon se qatl shuda log apna sar uthaye hue hazir honge, ragon se khoon beh raha hoga, kahenge ke Bari Ta'ala daryaft farma ke is ne mujhe kyun qatl kiya? Pas bawajood ilm ke Allah Azza-o-Jal mujahideen se puchega ke tum ne inhe kyun qatl kiya? Woh jawab denge is liye ke teri baat buland ho aur teri izzat ho. Allah Aali farmayega tum sache ho, usi waqt un ka chehra noorani ho jayega, suraj ki tarah chamakne lagega aur farishte unhein apne jhurmat mein le kar jannat ki taraf chalenge. Phir baqi ke aur tamam qatil-o-maqtool isi tarah pesh honge aur jo nafs zulm se qatl kiya gaya hai us ka badla zalim qatil se dilwaya jayega, isi tarah har mazloom ko zalim se badla dilwaya jayega yahan tak ke jo shakhs doodh mein pani mila kar bechta tha use farmaya jayega ke apne doodh se pani juda kar de. In faislon ke baad ek munadi ba-awaz-e-buland nida karega jise sab sunenge, har aabid apne mabood ke peeche ho le aur Allah ke siwa jis ne kisi aur ki ibadat ki hai woh jahannam mein chal de, suno agar yeh sache mabood hote to jahannam mein warid na hote, yeh sab to jahannam mein hi hamesha rahenge. Ab sirf ba-iman log baqi rahenge, in mein munafiqeen bhi shamil honge. Allah Ta'ala un ke paas jis hai'at mein chahe tashreef layega aur un se farmayega ke sab apne maboodon ke peeche chale gaye, tum bhi jis ki ibadat karte the us ke paas chale jao. Yeh jawab denge ke Wallah hamara to koi mabood nahin bajuz Ilah-ul-Aalameen ke, hum ne kisi aur ki ibadat nahin ki. Ab un ke liye pindli khol di jayegi aur Allah Ta'ala apni azmat ki tajalliyan un par dalega jis se yeh Allah Ta'ala ko pehchan lenge aur sajde mein gir padenge lekin munafiq sajda nahin kar sakenge, yeh oondhe aur ulte ho jayenge aur apni kamar ke bal gir padenge, un ki peeth seedhi kar di jayegi, mud nahin sakenge.

Phir Allah Ta'ala mominon ko sajde se uthne ka hukum de ga aur Jahannam par Pul-e-Sirat rakhi jaye gi jo talwar jaisi tez dhaar wali hogi aur jagah jagah aankre aur kaante honge, bari phislni aur khatarnak hogi. Imaan-dar toh is par se itni si der mein guzar jayenge jitni der mein koi aankh band kar ke khol de, jis tarah bijli guzar jati hai aur jaise hawa tezi se chalti hai, ya jaise tez-rau ghore ya oont hote hain ya khoob bhagne wale aadmi hote hain. Baaz sahih-o-salim guzar jayenge, baaz zakhmi ho kar paar utar jayenge, baaz kat kar Jahannam mein gir jayenge. Jitne log jab Jannat ke paas pahunchenge toh kahenge kaun hamare Rab se hamari sifarish kare ki hum Jannat mein chale jayen? Dusre log jawab denge is ke haqdar tumhare baap Hazrat Adam A.S se zyada aur kaun honge? Jinhein Rab-e-Zul-Kareem ne apne haath se paida kiya aur apni rooh un mein phonki aur aamne-saamne baatein keen. Pas sab log aap ke paas aayenge aur aap se sifarish karani chahenge lekin apna gunah yaad kar ke jawab denge ki main is laiq nahin hoon, tum Nuh A.S ke paas jao woh Allah ke pehle Rasool hain. Log Hazrat Nuh A.S ke paas aa kar un se yeh darkhwast karenge lekin woh bhi apne gunah ko yaad kar ke yahi farmayenge aur kahenge ki tum sab Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke paas jao woh Khalilullah hain. Log aap ke paas aayenge aur yahi kahenge, aap bhi apne gunah ko yaad kar ke yahi jawab denge aur Hazrat Musa A.S ke paas jaane ki hidayat karenge ki Allah ne unhein sargoshiyan karte hue nazdeek kiya tha, woh Kalimullah hain, un par Taurat nazil farmayi gayi thi. Log aap ke paas aayenge aur aap se talab-e-sifarish karenge, aap bhi apne gunah ka zikr karenge aur Roohullah aur Kalimatullah Hazrat Isa Ibn-e-Maryam A.S ke paas bhejenge lekin Hazrat Isa A.S farmayenge main is qabil nahin, tum Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ke paas jao. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain pas sab log mere paas aayenge, main Allah ke saamne teen shafa'atein karunga. Main jaunga, Jannat ke paas pahunch kar darwaze ka kunda pakar kar khatkhatauga, mujhe marhaba kaha jaye ga aur khush-aamdeed kaha jaye ga. Main Jannat mein ja kar apne Rab ko dekh kar sajde mein gir padunga aur woh woh hamd-o-sana Janab-e-Bari ki bayan karunga jo kisi ne na ki ho. Phir Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga, "Aye Muhammad ﷺ! Apna sar uthao, shafa'at karo qabool ki jaye gi, mango mile ga." Main sar uthaunga, Allah Ta'ala toh dilon ke bhed bhi jaanta hai taham woh daryaft farmaye ga ki kya kehna chahte ho? Main kahunga, "Aye Allah! Tu ne meri shafa'at ke qabool farmane ka wada kiya hai." Chunancha Allah Ta'ala meri shafa'at un jannatiyon ke bare mein qabool farmaye ga aur unhein Jannat ke dakhle ki ijazat ho jaye gi.

Wallah jaise tum apne ghar se apne baal bachon se aagah ho is se bohat zyada yeh jannati apni jagah aur apni biwiyon se waqif honge. Har ek apne apne thikane pahunch jayega. Sattar sattar hoorein aur do do auratein milengi, yeh dono auratein apni ki hui nekiyon ke sabab pur-fazilat chehron ki malik hongi. Jitni der mein se ek ke paas jayega jo yaqoot ke bala-khane mein sone ke jadao takht par sattar reshmi hullay pehne hue hogi, is ka jism is qadar noorani hoga ke ek taraf agar jannati apna hath rakhe to dusri taraf se nazar aaye ga. Is ki safai ki wajah se is ki pindli ka guda gosht post mein nazar aa raha hoga. Is ka dil is ka aaina hoga, na yeh is se bas kare na woh is se uktaye. Jab kabhi is ke paas jayega bakira payega, na yeh thake na ise takleef ho, na koi makrooh cheez ho. Yeh apni isi mashghooli mein, mazay mein aur lutf-o-rahat mein Allah jaane kitni muddat guzar de ga jo ek aawaz aayegi ke maana na tumhara dil is se bharta hai na un ka dil tum se bhare ga. Lekin Allah ne tumhare liye aur biwiyan bhi rakhi hui hain.

Ab yeh auron ke paas jayega jis ke paas jayega besakhta zaban se yahi niklega Allah ki qasam ki saazi jannat mein tum se behtar koi cheez nahin mujhe toh jannat ki tamam cheezon se zyada tum se mohabbat hai, haan jinhein un ki bad-amliyon aur gunahon ne tabah kar rakha hai woh jahannam mein jayenge apne apne aamaal ke mutabiq aag mein jalenge, baaz qadmon tak baaz aadhi pindli tak baaz ghutne tak baaz aadhe badan tak baaz gardan tak, sirf chehra baqi reh jayega kyunke surat ka bigadna Allah ne aag par haram kar diya hai, Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) Allah Ta'ala se apni ummat ke gunahgar dozakhiyon ki shafa'at karenge Allah Ta'ala farmayega jao jinhein pehchano unhein nikal lao, phir yeh log jahannam se azaad honge yahan tak ke un mein se koi baqi na rahega phir toh shafa'at ki aam ijazat mil jayegi kul ambiya aur shuhada shafa'at karenge, Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hoga ke jis ke dil mein ek dinar barabar bhi iman pao use nikal lao, pas yeh log bhi azaad honge aur un mein se bhi koi baqi na rahega, phir farmayega unhein bhi nikal lao jis ke dil mein do sulus dinar ke barabar iman ho, phir farmayega ek sulus walon ko bhi, phir irshad hoga chauthai dinar ke barabar walon ko bhi, phir farmayega ek qirat ke barabar walon ko bhi, phir irshad hoga unhein bhi jahannam se nikal lao jin ke dil mein rai ke daane ke barabar iman ho, pas yeh sab bhi nikal aayenge aur un mein se ek shakhs bhi baqi na bachega, balkay jahannam mein ek shakhs bhi aisa na reh jaye ga jis ne khuloos ke sath koi neki bhi Allah ki farmanbardari ke mat-hat ki ho, jitne shafi honge sab sifarish kar lenge yahan tak ke Iblees ko bhi umeed bandh jayegi aur woh bhi gardan utha utha kar dekhega ke shayad koi meri bhi shafa'at kare kyunke woh Allah ki rahmat ka josh dekh raha hoga is ke baad Allah Ta'ala Arham-ur-Rahimeen farmayega ke ab toh sirf main hi baqi reh gaya aur main toh sab se zyada raham-o-karam karne wala hoon, pas apna hath daal kar khud Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala jahannam mein se logon ko nikale ga jin ki tadaad siwaye is ke aur koi nahin janta woh jalte jhulaste hue koyle ki tarah ho gaye honge, unhein Nahar-e-Haiwan mein dala jayega jahan woh is tarah ugengen jis tarah dana ugta hai jo kisi darya ke kinare boya gaya ho ke us ka dhoop ka rukh toh sabz rehta hai aur saaye ka rukh zard rehta hai un ki gardanon par tahrir hoga ke yeh Rahman ke azaad karda hain, is tahrir se unhein dusre jannati pehchan lenge. Ek muddat tak toh yunhi rahenge phir Allah Ta'ala se dua karenge ke Aye Allah yeh huroof bhi mit jayen Allah Azza-o-Jal yeh bhi mita dega yeh hadith aur aage bhi hai aur bahut hi ghareeb hai aur is ke baaz hisson ke shawahid mutafarriq ahadith mein milte hain, is ke baaz alfaaz munkar hain.

Ismail bin Rafi Qazi Ahl-e-Madina is riwayat ke sath munfarid hain, in ko ba'az muhaddiseen ne toh siqah kaha hai aur ba'az ne za'eef kaha hai aur in ki hadith ki nisbat kayi ek muhaddiseen ne munkar hone ki sarahat ki hai, jaise Imam Ahmad, Imam Abu Hatim, Imam Amr bin Ali, ba'az ne in ke bare mein farmaya hai ke yeh matrook hain, Imam Ibn-e-Adi farmate hain in ki sab ahadees mein nazar hai magar in ki hadeesein za'eef ahadees mein likhne ke qabil hain, main ne is hadith ki sanadon mein jo ikhtilaf kayi wajooh se hai use alaihida ek juz mein bayan kar diya hai is mein shak nahin ke is ka bayan bahut hi ghareeb hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke bahut si ahadees ko mila kar ek hadith bana li hai isi wajah se ise munkar kaha gaya hai, main ne apne ustad Hafiz Abu Al-Hajjaj Mizzi se suna hai ke unhon ne Imam Waleed bin Muslim ki ek kitab dekhi hai jis mein in baton ke jo is hadith mein hain shawahid bayan kiye hain, Wallahu A'lam.

Islam ke siwa sab raston ki manzil Jahannam hai. Mushrikon ne musalmanon se kaha tha ke hamare deen mein aajao aur Islam chhod do. Is par yeh aayat utri ke kya hum bhi tumhari tarah be-jaan-o-be-nafa-o-nuqsan maboodon ko poojne lagein? Aur jis kufr se hat gaye hain kya phir laut kar usi par aajayein? Aur tum jaise hi hojayein? Bhala yeh kaise ho sakta hai? Ab toh hamari aankhein khul gayin, sahih raah mil gayi, ab ise kaise chhod dein? Agar hum aisa karlein toh hamari misaal us shakhs jaisi hogi jo logon ke sath seedhe raste par ja raha tha magar rasta gum hogaya. Shaitan ne use pareshan kardiya aur idhar udhar bhatkane laga. Uske sath jo raste par the woh use pukarne lage ke hamare sath mil ja, hum sahih raste par ja rahe hain. Yehi misaal us shakhs ki hai jo Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko jaan aur pehchan ke baad mushrikon ka sath de. Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hi pukarne wale hain aur Islam hi seedha aur sahih rasta hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain yeh misaal Allah Ta'ala ne maboodan-e-batil ki taraf bulane walon ki bayan farmayi hai aur unki bhi jo Allah ki taraf bulate hain. Ek shakhs rasta bhoolta hai, wahin uske kaan mein aawaz aati hai ke ae falan idhar aa, seedhi raah yehi hai, lekin uske sathi jis ghalat raste par lag gaye hain woh use thapakte hain aur kehte hain yehi rasta sahih hai, isi par chala chal. Ab agar yeh sache shakhs ko manega toh raah-e-rast lag jayega warna bhatakta phirega. Allah ke siwa dusron ki ibadat karne wale is umeed mein hote hain ke hum bhi kuch hain lekin marne ke baad unhein maloom hojata hai ke woh kuch na the, us waqt bahut nadim hote hain aur siwaye halakat ke koi cheez unhein dikhayi nahi deti. Yani jis tarah kisi jang mein gum-shuda insan ko jinnaat uska naam le kar aawazein de kar use aur ghalat raston par daal dete hain jahan woh mara mara phirta hai aur bil-aakhir halak aur tabah hojata hai, isi tarah jhoote maboodon ka pujari bhi barbad hojata hai. Hidayat ke baad gumrah hone wale ki yehi misaal hai. Jis raah ki taraf Shaitan use bula rahe hain woh toh tabahi aur barbadi ki raah hai aur jis raah ki taraf Allah bula raha hai aur uske nek bande jis raah ko sujha rahe hain woh hidayat hai. Go woh apne sathiyon ke majmay mein se na nikle aur unhein hi raah-e-rast par samajhta rahe aur woh sathi bhi apne tayin hidayat-yafta kehte rahein. Lekin yeh qaul aayat ke lafzon se mutabiq nahi kyunke aayat mein maujood hai ke woh use hidayat ki taraf bulate hain, phir yeh kaise ho sakta hai ke woh zalalat ho?

Hairan par zabar haal hone ki wajah se hai, sahih matlab yahi hai ke us ke saathi jo hidayat par hain ab use ghalat raah par dekhte hain to us ki khair khwahi ke liye pukar pukar kar kehte hain ke hamare paas aa ja seedha rasta yahi hai lekin yeh badnaseeb un ki baat par aitimaad nahin karta balkay tawajjah tak nahin karta, sach to yeh hai ke hidayat Allah ke qabze mein hai, woh jise raah dikhaye use koi gumrah nahin kar sakta, chunancha khud Quran mein hai ke tu chahe un ki hidayat par hirs kare lekin jise Allah bhatka de use wahi raah par la sakta hai, aison ka koi madadgar nahin. Hum sab ko yahi hukum kiya gaya hai ke hum khuloos se sari ibadatein mahaz usi Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ke liye karein aur yeh bhi hukum hai ke namazein qaim rakhein aur har haal mein us se darte rahein, Qayamat ke din usi ke samne hashr kiya jayega, sab wahin jama kiye jayenge. Usi ne aasman-o-zameen ko adl ke sath paida kiya hai, wahi maalik aur mudabbir hai, Qayamat ke din farmayega ho ja to ho jayega, ek lamha bhi der na lagegi. Yaum ka zabar ya to wa-ittaqo par atf hone ki wajah se hai yani us din se daro jis din Allah farmayega ho aur ho jayega aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke yaum ka zabar Khalaqas-Samawati wal-Ardi par atf hone ki bina par ho to goya ibtida-e-paidaish ko bayan farma kar phir dobara paidaish ko bayan farmaya, yahi zyada munasib hai. Yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke fe'l muzmar ho yani Uzkur aur is wajah se yaum par zabar aaya ho, is ke baad ke dono jumle mahalan majroor hain, pas yeh dono jumle bhi mahalan majroor hain. In mein pehli sifat yeh hai ke Allah ka qaul haq hai, Rabb ke farman sab ke sab sach hain, tamam mulk ka wahi akela maalik hai, sab cheezein usi ki malkiyat hain. Yaum-e-yanfukhu mein yaum mumkin hai ke Yaum-e-yaqulu ka badal ho aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Wa Lahul-Mulku ka zarf ho jaise aur aayat mein hai: (Limanil-Mulkul-Yaum) (Surah Ghafir: 16) aaj kis ka mulk hai? Sirf Allah akele Ghalib ka aur jaise is aayat mein irshad hua hai: (Al-Mulku Yauma-izinil-Haqqu lir-Rahman, wa kana yauman alal-kafirina asira) (Surah Al-Furqan: 26) yani mulk aaj sirf Rahman ka hai aur aaj ka din kuffar par bahut sakht hai aur bhi is tarah ki aur is mazmoon ki bahut si aayatein hain. Baaz kehte hain soor jama hai soorat ki jaise soorah shehar panah ko kehte hain aur woh jama hai soorat ki lekin sahih yeh hai ke murad soor se qarn hai jise Hazrat Israfil (A.S) phoonkenge, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) bhi isi ko pasand farmate hain. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka irshad hai ke Hazrat Israfil (A.S) soor ko apne munh mein liye hue apni peshani jhukaye hue hukum-e-Ilahi ke muntazir hain.
