Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke ek sahabi ke sawal par Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya soor ek narsinghe jaisa hai jo phoonka jayega, Tabrani ki mutawalat mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ne aasman-o-zameen ki paidaish ke baad soor ko paida kiya aur use Hazrat Israfil (A.S) ko diya, woh use liye hue hain aur Arsh ki taraf nigah jamaye hue hain ke kab hukum ho aur main use phoonk doon.

Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A farmate hain main ne daryaft kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Soor kya hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ek narsingha hai. Main ne kaha woh kaisa hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya bahut hi bada hai, wallah us ke daire ki chaudai aasman o zameen ke barabar hai. Is mein se teen nafe phoonke jayenge, pehla ghabrahat ka, doosra behoshi ka, teesra Rabb-ul-Aalameen ke samne khade hone ka. Awwal awwal Janab-e-Bari Hazrat Israfeel A.S ko Soor phoonkne ka hukum de ga, woh phoonk denge jis se aasman o zameen ki tamam makhlooq ghabra uthe gi magar jise Allah chahe. Yeh Soor bahukum-e-Rabb der tak barabar phoonka jaye ga, isi taraf ishara is aayat mein hai: "Wa ma yanzuru ha'ula'i illa saihatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaq" (38:15), yani inhe sirf buland zor-dar cheekh ka intezar hai. Pahar is Soor se misl badalon ke chalne phirne lagenge, phir ret ret ho jayenge. Zameen mein bhunchal aa jaye ga aur woh is tarah thar-tharane lage gi jaise koi kashti darya ke beech zabardast toofan mein maujon se idhar udhar ho rahi ho aur ghote kha rahi ho. Misl us handi ke jo arsh mein latki hui hai jise hawain hila jula rahi hain, isi ka bayan is aayat mein hai: "Yauma tarjufur-rajifah" (79:6) al-aayat, is din zameen junbish mein aa jaye gi aur bahut hi hilne lage gi, is ke peeche hi peeche lagne wali aa jaye gi. Dil dhadakne lagenge aur kaleje ulatne lagenge, log idhar udhar girne lagenge, maain apne doodh peete bachon ko bhool jayengi, hamila aurton ke hamal gir jayenge, bachche boodhe ho jayenge. Shayateen mare ghabrahat aur pareshani ke bhagte bhagte zameen ke kinaron par aa jayenge, yahan se farishte inhe maar maar kar hatayenge. Log pareshan-haal hawas-bakhta honge, koi jaye panah nazar na aaye gi, Amr-e-Ilahi se bachao na ho sake ga. Ek doosre ko aawazein denge lekin sab apni apni museebat mein pade hue honge ke nagahan zameen phatni shuru hogi, kahin idhar se phati kahin udhar se phati, ab to abtar halat ho jaye gi, kaleja kapkapane lage ga, dil ulat jaye ga aur itna sadma aur gham hoga jis ka andaza nahin ho sakta. Jo aasman ki taraf nazar uthayenge to dekhenge ke ghul raha hai aur woh bhi phat raha hai, sitare jhad rahe hain, sooraj chand benoor ho gaya hai. Haan murdon ko is ka kuch ilm na hoga. Hazrat Abu Huraira R.A ne sawal kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) Quran ki aayat mein jo farmaya gaya hai: "Fafazi'a man fis-samawati wa man fil-ardi illa man sha' Allah" (27:87), yani zameen o aasman ke sab log ghabra uthenge lekin jinhein Allah chahe is se murad kaun log hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya yeh shaheed log hain ke woh Allah ke haan zinda hain, roziyan paate hain aur sab zinda log ghabrahat mein honge lekin Allah Ta'ala inhe pareshani se mehfooz rakhe ga. Yeh to azaab hai jo woh apni badtareen makhlooq par bheje ga, isi ka bayan aayat: (Ya ayyuhan-nasut-taqu Rabbakumullazi khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin wa khalaqa minha zaujaha wa bassa minhuma rijalan kaseeran wa nisa'a) (4:1).

An-Nisa (1) mein hai yani ae logo apne Rab se daro, yaad rakho Qayamat ka zalzala bahut badi cheez hai. Jis din tum ise dekh lo ge har ek doodh pilane wali apne doodh peete bache se ghafil ho jaye gi, har hamal wali ka hamal gir jaye ga, toh dekha jaye ga ke sab log behosh honge halankeh woh nasha piye hue nahin, balkeh Allah ke sakht azabon ne unhein bad-hawas kar rakha hai. Yehi halat rahe gi jab tak Allah chahe, bahut der tak yehi ghabrahat ka alam rahe ga. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala Hazrat Jibraeel A.S ko behoshi ke nafh-e ka hukum de ga, is nafh-e ke phonkte hi zameen-o-aasman ki tamam makhlooq behosh ho jaye gi magar jise Allah chahe aur achanak sab ke sab mar jayenge. Hazrat Malak-ul-Maut A.S Allah Ta'ala ke huzoor mein hazir ho kar arz karenge ke ae Bari Ta'ala zameen-o-aasman ki tamam makhlooq mar gayi magar jise Tu ne chaha. Allah Ta'ala bawajood ilm ke sawal kare ga ke yeh batao ab baqi kaun kaun hai? Woh jawab denge Tu baqi hai, Tu Hayy-o-Qayyum hai, Tujh par kabhi fana nahin aur Arsh ke uthane wale farishte aur Jibraeel-o-Mikaeel. Is waqt Arsh ko zaban mile gi aur woh kahe ga ae Parwardigar kya Jibraeel woh Mikaeel bhi marenge? Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga main ne apne Arsh se neeche walon par sab par maut likh di hai, chunancha yeh dono bhi faut ho jayenge. Phir Malak-ul-Maut A.S Rabb-e-Jabbar-o-Qahhar ke paas aayenge aur khabar denge ke Jibraeel-o-Mikaeel bhi inteqal kar gaye. Janab-e-Allah ilm ke bawajood phir daryaft farmaye ga ke ab baqi kaun hai? Malak-ul-Maut A.S jawab denge ke baqi ek Tu hai, aisi baqa wala jis par fana hai hi nahin aur tere Arsh ke uthane wale. Allah farmaye ga Arsh ke uthane wale bhi mar jayenge, is waqt woh bhi mar jayenge. Phir Allah ke hukum se Hazrat Israfeel A.S se Soor ko Arsh le le ga, Malak-ul-Maut A.S hazir ho kar arz karenge ke ya Allah Arsh ke uthane wale farishte bhi mar gaye. Allah Ta'ala daryaft farmaye ga halankeh woh khoob janta hai ke ab baqi kaun raha? Malak-ul-Maut A.S jawab denge ke ek Tu jis par maut hai hi nahin aur ek tera ghulam main. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala farmaye ga tu bhi meri makhlooq mein se ek makhlooq hai, tujhe main ne ek kaam ke liye paida kiya tha jise tu kar chuka, ab tu bhi mar ja, chunancha woh bhi mar jayenge. Ab Allah Ta'ala akela baqi reh jaye ga jo ghalba wala, yaganat wala, be-maan baap aur be-aulad ke hai. Jis tarah makhlooq ke paida karne se pehle woh yakta aur akela tha. Phir aasmanon aur zameeno ko woh is tarah lapet le ga jaise daftari kaghaz ko lapetta hai, phir unhein teen martaba ulat-palat kare ga aur farmaye ga main Jabbar hoon, main kibriyai wala hoon. Phir teen martaba farmaye ga aaj mulk ka malik kaun hai? Koi na hoga jo jawab de, toh khud hi jawab de ga Allah-ul-Wahid-ul-Qahhar. Quran mein hai us din aasman-o-zameen badal diye jayenge.

Allah Ta'ala unhein phaila de ga aur khench de ga jis tarah chamra khencha jata hai kahin koi oonch neech baqi na rahe gi, phir ek Ilahi aawaz ke sath hi sari makhlooq is tabdeel shuda zameen mein aajaye gi andar wale andar aur oopar wale oopar phir Allah Ta'ala apne Arsh-e-tale se is par barish barsaye ga phir aasman ko hukum hoga aur woh chalees din tak meenh barsaye ga yahan tak ke pani un ke oopar barah hath charh jaye ga, phir jismon ko hukum hoga ke woh ugein aur woh is tarah ugane lagen ge jaise sabziyan aur tarkariyan aur woh pooray pooray kamil jism jaise thay waise hi hojayen ge phir hukum farmaye ga ke mere Arsh ke uthane wale farishtay jee uthein chunancha woh zinda hojayen ge phir Israfeel ko hukum hoga ke Soor le kar munh se laga lein. Phir farman hoga ke Jibraeel-o-Mikaeel zinda hojayen yeh dono bhi uthein ge, phir Allah Ta'ala roohon ko bulaye ga mominon ko noorani arwah aur kuffar ki zulmati roohein aayengi unhein le kar Allah Ta'ala Soor mein daal de ga, phir Israfeel ko hukum hoga ke ab Soor phoonk do chunancha Ba'as ka Soor phoonka jaye ga jis se arwah is tarah niklein gi jaise shehad ki makkhiyan. Tamam khala un se bhar jaye ga phir Rabb-e-Aalam ka irshad hoga ke mujhe apni izzat-o-jalal ki qasam hai har rooh apne apne jism mein chali jaye, chunancha sab roohein apne apne jismon mein nathnon ke rastay chali jayengi aur jis tarah zehar rag-o-paye mein asar kar jata hai rooh roohein roohein mein dor jaye gi, phir zameen phat jaye gi aur log apni qabron se nikal kharay honge, sab se pehle mere oopar se zameen shaq hogi, log nikal kar dortay huay apne Rabb ki taraf chal dein ge, us waqt kafir kahenge ke aaj ka din bara bhari hai, sab nangay pairon nangay badan be-khatna honge ek maidan mein ba-qadr sattar saal ke kharay rahen ge, na un ki taraf nigah uthai jaye gi na un ke darmiyan faislay kiye jayen ge, log be-tarah girya-o-zari mein mubtala honge yahan tak ke aansoo khatam hojayen ge aur khoon aankhon se nikalne lagay ga, paseena is qadar aaye ga ke munh tak ya thodiyon tak is mein doobay huay honge, aapas mein kahenge aao kisi se kahein ke woh hamari shafa'at kare, hamaray Parwardigar se arz kare ke woh aaye aur hamaray faislay kare to kahenge ke is ke laiq hamaray baap Hazrat Adam (A.S) se behtar kaun hoga? Jinhein Allah ne apne hath se paida kiya, apni rooh un mein phonki aur aamnay samnay un se batein kein. Chunancha sab mil kar aap ke paas jayen ge aur sifarish talab karenge lekin Hazrat Adam (A.S) saaf inkar kar jayen ge aur farmayen ge mujh mein itni qabiliyat nahin phir woh isi tarah ek ek Nabi ke paas jayen ge aur sab inkar kar dein ge. Huzoor (ﷺ) farmatay hain phir sab ke sab mere paas aayen ge, mein Arsh ke aagay jaunga aur sajday mein gir parunga, Allah Ta'ala mere paas farishta bhejega woh mera bazu tham kar mujhe sajday se uthaye ga.

Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga, "Aye Muhammad (ﷺ), main jawab doon ga ke haan aye mere Rab." Allah Azza-wa-Jal ba-wujood-e-alim-e-kul hone ke mujh se daryaft farmaye ga ke, "Kya baat hai?" Main kahoon ga, "Ya Allah! Tu ne mujh se shifa'at ki qabooliyat ka wada farmaya hai apni makhlooq ke bare mein, meri shifa'at ko qabool farma aur un ke faislon ke liye tashreef le aa." Rabb-ul-Aalameen farmaye ga, "Main ne teri sifarish qabool ki aur main aa kar tum mein faisle kiye deta hoon." Main laut kar logon ke sath thehar jaoon ga ke nagahan aasmanon se ek bahut bada dhamaka sunai de ga jis se log khaufzada ho jayenge. Itne mein aasman ke farishte utarne shuru honge jin ki tadaad kul insanon aur sare jinnon ke barabar hogi. Jab woh zameen ke qareeb pahunchenge to un ke noor se zameen jagmaga uthe gi, woh safein baandh kar khade ho jayenge. Hum sab un se daryaft karenge ke, "Kya tum mein hamara Rab aaya hai?" Woh jawab denge, "Nahin." Phir us tadaad se bhi zyada tadaad mein aur farishte aayenge. Aakhir hamara Rab Azza-wa-Jal abr ke saye mein nuzool farmaye ga aur farishte bhi us ke sath honge. Us ka Arsh us din aath farishte uthaye hue honge. Is waqt Arsh ke uthane wale chaar farishte hain, un ke qadam aakhri neeche wali zameen ki teh mein hain, zameen-o-aasman un ke nisf jism ke muqable mein hain, un ke kandhon par Arsh-e-Ilahi hai. Un ki zabanen har waqt Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ki pakeezgi ke bayan mein tar hain. Un ki tasbeeh yeh hai: "Subhan-a-Zil Arshi wal Jabroot, Subhan-a-Zil Mulki wal Malakoot, Subhan-al-Hayy-il-lazi la yamoot, Subhan-al-lazi yumeet-ul-khala'iqi wa la yamoot, Subboohun Quddusun Quddusun Quddusun, Subhan-a-Rabbinal A'la, Rabb-ul-Mala'ikati war-Rooh, Subhan-a-Rabbinal A'la-il-lazi yumeet-ul-khala'iqi wa la yamoot." Phir Allah jis jagah chahe ga apni Kursi zameen par rakhe ga aur buland aawaz se farmaye ga, "Aye jino aur insano! Main ne tumhein jis din se paida kiya tha us din se aaj tak main khamosh raha, tumhari baatein sunta raha, tumhare aamal dekhta raha. Suno! Tumhare aamal-name mere samne padhe jayenge, jo is mein bhalai paye woh Allah ki hamd kare aur jo is mein aur kuch paye woh apni jaan ko malamat kare." Phir ba-hukm-e-Ilahi jahannam mein se ek dehakti hui gardan nikle gi. Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga, "Aye Adam ki aulad! Kya main ne tum se ahd nahin liya tha ke shaitan ki pooja na karna, woh tumhara khula dushman hai? Aur sirf meri hi ibadat karte rehna, yahi seedhi raah hai. Shaitan ne to bahut si makhlooq ko gumrah kar diya hai, kya tumhein aql nahin? Yeh hai woh jahannam jis ka tum wada diye jate the aur jise tum jhutlate rahe, aye gunahgaro!"

Aaj tum nek bandon se alag ho jao, is farman ke sath hi bad log nekon se alag ho jayenge. Tamam ummatein ghutnon ke bal gir padengi jaise Quran-e-Kareem mein hai ke tu har ummat ko ghutnon ke bal gire hue dekhega. Har ummat apne nam-e-aamal ki taraf bulai jayegi, phir Allah Ta'ala apni makhlooq mein faisle karega. Pehle janwaron mein faisle honge yahan tak ke be-seeng wali bakri ka badla seeng wali bakri se liya jayega, jab kisi ka kisi ke zimme koi dawa baqi na rahega to Allah Ta'ala unhein farmayega tum sab mitti ho jao, is farman ke sath hi tamam janwar mitti ban jayenge, us waqt kafir bhi yahi aarzoo karenge ke kaash hum bhi mitti ho jate. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala apne bandon ke faisle shuru karega, sab se pehle qatl-o-khoon ka faisla hoga, Allah Ta'ala apni rah ke shaheedon ko bhi bulayega, un ke hathon se qatl shuda log apna sar uthaye hue hazir honge, ragon se khoon beh raha hoga, kahenge ke Bari Ta'ala daryaft farma ke is ne mujhe kyun qatl kiya? Pas bawajood ilm ke Allah Azza-o-Jal mujahideen se puchega ke tum ne inhe kyun qatl kiya? Woh jawab denge is liye ke teri baat buland ho aur teri izzat ho. Allah Aali farmayega tum sache ho, usi waqt un ka chehra noorani ho jayega, suraj ki tarah chamakne lagega aur farishte unhein apne jhurmat mein le kar jannat ki taraf chalenge. Phir baqi ke aur tamam qatil-o-maqtool isi tarah pesh honge aur jo nafs zulm se qatl kiya gaya hai us ka badla zalim qatil se dilwaya jayega, isi tarah har mazloom ko zalim se badla dilwaya jayega yahan tak ke jo shakhs doodh mein pani mila kar bechta tha use farmaya jayega ke apne doodh se pani juda kar de. In faislon ke baad ek munadi ba-awaz-e-buland nida karega jise sab sunenge, har aabid apne mabood ke peeche ho le aur Allah ke siwa jis ne kisi aur ki ibadat ki hai woh jahannam mein chal de, suno agar yeh sache mabood hote to jahannam mein warid na hote, yeh sab to jahannam mein hi hamesha rahenge. Ab sirf ba-iman log baqi rahenge, in mein munafiqeen bhi shamil honge. Allah Ta'ala un ke paas jis hai'at mein chahe tashreef layega aur un se farmayega ke sab apne maboodon ke peeche chale gaye, tum bhi jis ki ibadat karte the us ke paas chale jao. Yeh jawab denge ke Wallah hamara to koi mabood nahin bajuz Ilah-ul-Aalameen ke, hum ne kisi aur ki ibadat nahin ki. Ab un ke liye pindli khol di jayegi aur Allah Ta'ala apni azmat ki tajalliyan un par dalega jis se yeh Allah Ta'ala ko pehchan lenge aur sajde mein gir padenge lekin munafiq sajda nahin kar sakenge, yeh oondhe aur ulte ho jayenge aur apni kamar ke bal gir padenge, un ki peeth seedhi kar di jayegi, mud nahin sakenge.

Phir Allah Ta'ala mominon ko sajde se uthne ka hukum de ga aur Jahannam par Pul-e-Sirat rakhi jaye gi jo talwar jaisi tez dhaar wali hogi aur jagah jagah aankre aur kaante honge, bari phislni aur khatarnak hogi. Imaan-dar toh is par se itni si der mein guzar jayenge jitni der mein koi aankh band kar ke khol de, jis tarah bijli guzar jati hai aur jaise hawa tezi se chalti hai, ya jaise tez-rau ghore ya oont hote hain ya khoob bhagne wale aadmi hote hain. Baaz sahih-o-salim guzar jayenge, baaz zakhmi ho kar paar utar jayenge, baaz kat kar Jahannam mein gir jayenge. Jitne log jab Jannat ke paas pahunchenge toh kahenge kaun hamare Rab se hamari sifarish kare ki hum Jannat mein chale jayen? Dusre log jawab denge is ke haqdar tumhare baap Hazrat Adam A.S se zyada aur kaun honge? Jinhein Rab-e-Zul-Kareem ne apne haath se paida kiya aur apni rooh un mein phonki aur aamne-saamne baatein keen. Pas sab log aap ke paas aayenge aur aap se sifarish karani chahenge lekin apna gunah yaad kar ke jawab denge ki main is laiq nahin hoon, tum Nuh A.S ke paas jao woh Allah ke pehle Rasool hain. Log Hazrat Nuh A.S ke paas aa kar un se yeh darkhwast karenge lekin woh bhi apne gunah ko yaad kar ke yahi farmayenge aur kahenge ki tum sab Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke paas jao woh Khalilullah hain. Log aap ke paas aayenge aur yahi kahenge, aap bhi apne gunah ko yaad kar ke yahi jawab denge aur Hazrat Musa A.S ke paas jaane ki hidayat karenge ki Allah ne unhein sargoshiyan karte hue nazdeek kiya tha, woh Kalimullah hain, un par Taurat nazil farmayi gayi thi. Log aap ke paas aayenge aur aap se talab-e-sifarish karenge, aap bhi apne gunah ka zikr karenge aur Roohullah aur Kalimatullah Hazrat Isa Ibn-e-Maryam A.S ke paas bhejenge lekin Hazrat Isa A.S farmayenge main is qabil nahin, tum Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ ke paas jao. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain pas sab log mere paas aayenge, main Allah ke saamne teen shafa'atein karunga. Main jaunga, Jannat ke paas pahunch kar darwaze ka kunda pakar kar khatkhatauga, mujhe marhaba kaha jaye ga aur khush-aamdeed kaha jaye ga. Main Jannat mein ja kar apne Rab ko dekh kar sajde mein gir padunga aur woh woh hamd-o-sana Janab-e-Bari ki bayan karunga jo kisi ne na ki ho. Phir Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga, "Aye Muhammad ﷺ! Apna sar uthao, shafa'at karo qabool ki jaye gi, mango mile ga." Main sar uthaunga, Allah Ta'ala toh dilon ke bhed bhi jaanta hai taham woh daryaft farmaye ga ki kya kehna chahte ho? Main kahunga, "Aye Allah! Tu ne meri shafa'at ke qabool farmane ka wada kiya hai." Chunancha Allah Ta'ala meri shafa'at un jannatiyon ke bare mein qabool farmaye ga aur unhein Jannat ke dakhle ki ijazat ho jaye gi.

Wallah jaise tum apne ghar se apne baal bachon se aagah ho is se bohat zyada yeh jannati apni jagah aur apni biwiyon se waqif honge. Har ek apne apne thikane pahunch jayega. Sattar sattar hoorein aur do do auratein milengi, yeh dono auratein apni ki hui nekiyon ke sabab pur-fazilat chehron ki malik hongi. Jitni der mein se ek ke paas jayega jo yaqoot ke bala-khane mein sone ke jadao takht par sattar reshmi hullay pehne hue hogi, is ka jism is qadar noorani hoga ke ek taraf agar jannati apna hath rakhe to dusri taraf se nazar aaye ga. Is ki safai ki wajah se is ki pindli ka guda gosht post mein nazar aa raha hoga. Is ka dil is ka aaina hoga, na yeh is se bas kare na woh is se uktaye. Jab kabhi is ke paas jayega bakira payega, na yeh thake na ise takleef ho, na koi makrooh cheez ho. Yeh apni isi mashghooli mein, mazay mein aur lutf-o-rahat mein Allah jaane kitni muddat guzar de ga jo ek aawaz aayegi ke maana na tumhara dil is se bharta hai na un ka dil tum se bhare ga. Lekin Allah ne tumhare liye aur biwiyan bhi rakhi hui hain.

Ab yeh auron ke paas jayega jis ke paas jayega besakhta zaban se yahi niklega Allah ki qasam ki saazi jannat mein tum se behtar koi cheez nahin mujhe toh jannat ki tamam cheezon se zyada tum se mohabbat hai, haan jinhein un ki bad-amliyon aur gunahon ne tabah kar rakha hai woh jahannam mein jayenge apne apne aamaal ke mutabiq aag mein jalenge, baaz qadmon tak baaz aadhi pindli tak baaz ghutne tak baaz aadhe badan tak baaz gardan tak, sirf chehra baqi reh jayega kyunke surat ka bigadna Allah ne aag par haram kar diya hai, Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) Allah Ta'ala se apni ummat ke gunahgar dozakhiyon ki shafa'at karenge Allah Ta'ala farmayega jao jinhein pehchano unhein nikal lao, phir yeh log jahannam se azaad honge yahan tak ke un mein se koi baqi na rahega phir toh shafa'at ki aam ijazat mil jayegi kul ambiya aur shuhada shafa'at karenge, Janab-e-Bari ka irshad hoga ke jis ke dil mein ek dinar barabar bhi iman pao use nikal lao, pas yeh log bhi azaad honge aur un mein se bhi koi baqi na rahega, phir farmayega unhein bhi nikal lao jis ke dil mein do sulus dinar ke barabar iman ho, phir farmayega ek sulus walon ko bhi, phir irshad hoga chauthai dinar ke barabar walon ko bhi, phir farmayega ek qirat ke barabar walon ko bhi, phir irshad hoga unhein bhi jahannam se nikal lao jin ke dil mein rai ke daane ke barabar iman ho, pas yeh sab bhi nikal aayenge aur un mein se ek shakhs bhi baqi na bachega, balkay jahannam mein ek shakhs bhi aisa na reh jaye ga jis ne khuloos ke sath koi neki bhi Allah ki farmanbardari ke mat-hat ki ho, jitne shafi honge sab sifarish kar lenge yahan tak ke Iblees ko bhi umeed bandh jayegi aur woh bhi gardan utha utha kar dekhega ke shayad koi meri bhi shafa'at kare kyunke woh Allah ki rahmat ka josh dekh raha hoga is ke baad Allah Ta'ala Arham-ur-Rahimeen farmayega ke ab toh sirf main hi baqi reh gaya aur main toh sab se zyada raham-o-karam karne wala hoon, pas apna hath daal kar khud Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala jahannam mein se logon ko nikale ga jin ki tadaad siwaye is ke aur koi nahin janta woh jalte jhulaste hue koyle ki tarah ho gaye honge, unhein Nahar-e-Haiwan mein dala jayega jahan woh is tarah ugengen jis tarah dana ugta hai jo kisi darya ke kinare boya gaya ho ke us ka dhoop ka rukh toh sabz rehta hai aur saaye ka rukh zard rehta hai un ki gardanon par tahrir hoga ke yeh Rahman ke azaad karda hain, is tahrir se unhein dusre jannati pehchan lenge. Ek muddat tak toh yunhi rahenge phir Allah Ta'ala se dua karenge ke Aye Allah yeh huroof bhi mit jayen Allah Azza-o-Jal yeh bhi mita dega yeh hadith aur aage bhi hai aur bahut hi ghareeb hai aur is ke baaz hisson ke shawahid mutafarriq ahadith mein milte hain, is ke baaz alfaaz munkar hain.

Ismail bin Rafi Qazi Ahl-e-Madina is riwayat ke sath munfarid hain, in ko ba'az muhaddiseen ne toh siqah kaha hai aur ba'az ne za'eef kaha hai aur in ki hadith ki nisbat kayi ek muhaddiseen ne munkar hone ki sarahat ki hai, jaise Imam Ahmad, Imam Abu Hatim, Imam Amr bin Ali, ba'az ne in ke bare mein farmaya hai ke yeh matrook hain, Imam Ibn-e-Adi farmate hain in ki sab ahadees mein nazar hai magar in ki hadeesein za'eef ahadees mein likhne ke qabil hain, main ne is hadith ki sanadon mein jo ikhtilaf kayi wajooh se hai use alaihida ek juz mein bayan kar diya hai is mein shak nahin ke is ka bayan bahut hi ghareeb hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke bahut si ahadees ko mila kar ek hadith bana li hai isi wajah se ise munkar kaha gaya hai, main ne apne ustad Hafiz Abu Al-Hajjaj Mizzi se suna hai ke unhon ne Imam Waleed bin Muslim ki ek kitab dekhi hai jis mein in baton ke jo is hadith mein hain shawahid bayan kiye hain, Wallahu A'lam.

Ibrahim A.S aur Azar mein mukalma. Hazrat Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihimas Salam) ke walid ka naam Azar na tha balkay Tarikh tha. Azar se murad but hai. Aap ki walida ka naam Masla tha, aap ki biwi sahiba ka naam Sarah tha. Hazrat Ismail A.S ki walida ka naam Hajra tha, yeh Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki surriya thin. Ulama-e-nasab mein se auron ka bhi qaul hai ke aap ke walid ka naam Tarikh tha. Mujahid aur Suddi farmate hain Azar us but ka naam tha jis ke pujari aur khadim Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke walid thay, ho sakta hai ke us but ke naam ki wajah se unhein bhi isi naam se yaad kiya jata ho aur yahi naam mashhoor ho gaya ho. Wallahu A'lam. Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain ke Azar ka lafz un mein bator-e-aib-giri ke istemal kiya jata tha, is ke ma'ni terhay aadmi ke hain. Lekin is kalam ki sanad nahin, na Imam sahab ne ise kisi se naqal kiya hai. Sulaiman ka qaul hai ke is ke ma'ni terhay-pan ke hain aur yahi sab se sakht lafz hai jo Khalilullah ki zaban se nikla. Ibn-e-Jarir ka farman hai ke theek baat yahi hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke walid ka naam Azar tha aur yeh jo aam tarikh-dan kehte hain ke un ka naam Tarikh tha, is ka jawab yeh hai ke mumkin hai dono naam hon ya ek to naam ho aur dusra laqab ho. Baat to yeh theek aur nihayat qawi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Azar aur Azur dono qiratein hain. Pichli qira'at yani ra ke zabar ke sath to jamhoor ki hai. Pesh wali qira'at mein nida ki wajah se pesh hai aur zabar wali qira'at la-abiyah se badal hone ki hai aur mumkin hai ke atf-e-bayan ho aur yahi zyada mushabah hai. Yeh lafz alamiyat aur ajamiyat ki bina par ghair-munsarif hai, baaz log ise sifat batlate hain, is bina par bhi yeh ghair-munsarif rahe ga jaise Ahmar aur Aswad. Baaz ise attakhizu ka ma'mool maan kar mansoob kehte hain. Goya Hazrat Ibrahim A.S yun farmate ke hum log Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath thay, jab hum Madina Sharif se bahar nikal gaye to hum ne dekha ke ek oont sawar bahut tezi se apne oont ko daudata hua aa raha hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tumhari taraf hi aa raha hai. Us ne pahunch kar salam kiya, hum ne jawab diya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un se poocha kahan se aa rahe ho? Us ne kaha apne ghar se, apne baal-bachon mein se, apne kunbay qabeelay mein se. Daryaft farmaya kya irada hai? Kaise nikle ho? Jawab diya Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki justuju mein. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya phir to tum apne maqsad mein kamyab ho gaye, main hi Allah ka Rasool hoon. Us ne khush ho kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe samjhaiye ke imaan kya hai?

Aap ne farmaya yeh keh do ke Allah ek hai aur Muhammad (ﷺ) Allah ke Rasool hain aur namazon ko qaim rakhe aur zakat ada karta rahe aur Ramzan ke rozay rakhe aur Baitullah ka Hajj kare. Us ne kaha mujhe sab baatein manzoor hain main sab iqrar karta hoon, itne mein un ke oont ka paon ek soorakh mein gir para aur oont ek dam se jhatka le kar jhuk gaya aur woh oopar se gire aur sar ke bal gire aur usi waqt rooh parwaz kar gayi. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un ke girte hi farmaya ke dekho inhe sambhalo. Usi waqt Hazrat Ammar bin Yasir (R.A) aur Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman (R.A) apne oonton se kood pare aur unhein utha liya, dekha to rooh jism se alaihda ho chuki hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) se kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh to faut ho gaye, aap ne munh pher liya. Phir zara si der mein farmane lage tum ne mujhe munh modte hue dekha hoga, is ki wajah yeh thi ke main ne dekha do farishtay aaye thay aur marhoom ke munh mein jannat ke phool de rahe thay, is se main ne jaan liya ke bhookay faut hue hain. Suno yeh unhi logon mein se hain jin ki babat Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala irshad farmata hai ke jo log iman laye aur apne iman ko zulm se na milaya un ke liye aman-o-aman hai aur woh rah-yafta hain. Achha apne pyare bhai ko dafan karo, chunancha hum unhein pani ke paas utha le gaye, ghusal diya, khushbu mali aur qabr ki taraf janaza le kar chale. An-Hazrat (ﷺ) qabr ke kinare baith gaye aur farmane lage baghli qabr banao seedhi na banao, baghli qabr hamare liye hai aur seedhi hamare siwa auron ke liye hai. Logo yeh woh shakhs hai jis ne amal bahut hi kam kiya aur sawab zyada paya. Yeh ek Aarabi thay unhon ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) us silsile ki qasam jis ne aap ko haq ke sath bheja hai, main apne ghar se, apne bal bachon se, apne maal se, apne kunbay qabeelay se is liye aur sirf is liye alag hua hoon ke aap ki hidayat ko qabool karoon, aap ki sunnaton par amal karoon, aap ki hadeesein loon. Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main ghaas phoos khata hua aap tak pahuncha hoon, aap mujhe Islam sikhaiye. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne sikhaya us ne qabool kiya, hum sab un ke ird-gird bheer lagaye kharay thay itne mein jungli chuhay ke bil mein un ke oont ka paon par gaya, yeh gir pare aur gardan toot gayi. Aap ne farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne mujhe haq ke sath mab'oos farmaya, yeh sach much fi-al-waqai apne ghar se, apne ahl-o-ayal se aur apne maal-o-maweshi se sirf meri tabedari ki dhun mein nikla tha aur woh is baat mein bhi sachay thay ke woh mere paas nahin pahunchay yahan tak ke un ka khana sirf sabz pattay aur ghaas reh gaya tha. Tum ne aise log bhi sunay honge jo amal kam karte hain aur sawab bahut patay hain. Yeh buzurg inhi mein se thay.

Tum ne suna hoga ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai jo imaan layein aur zulm na karein woh aman-o-hidayat wale hain, yeh unhi mein se thay (R.A). Phir farmaya Ibrahim (A.S) ko yeh daleelein hum ne sikhayin jin se woh apni qoum par ghalib aa gaye, jaise unhon ne ek Allah ke parastar ka aman aur us ki hidayat bayan farmayi aur khud Allah ki taraf se is baat ki tasdeeq ki gayi. Aayat (نَرْفَعُ دَرَجٰتٍ مَّنْ نَّشَاۗءُ ۭاِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيْمٌ عَلِيْمٌ) (Surah Al-An'am: 83) ki yahi ek qira'at hai, izafat ke sath aur be-izafat dono tarah parha gaya hai jaise Surah Yusuf mein hai aur ma'ani dono qira'aton ke qareeb qareeb barabar hain. Tere Rab ke aqwal rahmat wale aur us ke kaam bhi hikmat wale hain. Woh sahih raste walon ko aur gumrahon ko bakhoobi jaanta hai jaise farman hai jin par tere ki thandak main ne apne seene mein mehsoos ki phir toh tamam cheezein mere samne khul gayin aur main ne use pehchan liya. Wal-yakoon ka waw za'ida hai, jaise wal-tastabeen mein aur kaha gaya hai ke woh apni jagah par hai yani is liye ke woh aalim aur yaqeen wale ho jayein. Raat ke andhere mein Khalil-ullah sitare ko dekh kar farmate hain ke yeh mera Rab hai, jab woh ghuroob ho jata hai toh aap samajh lete hain ke yeh Parwardigar nahin kyunke Rab dawam wala hota hai, woh zawal aur inqilab se pak hota hai. Phir jab chand charhta hai toh yahi farmate hain, jab woh bhi ghuroob ho jata hai toh us se bhi yaksooi kar lete hain. Phir suraj ke tuloo hone par use sab se bada pa kar sab se zyada roshan dekh kar yahi kehte hain, jab woh bhi dhal jata hai toh Allah ke siwa tamam maboodon se bezar ho jate hain. Aur pukar uthte hain ke main toh apni ibadat ke liye Allah ki zaat ko makhsoos karta hoon jis ne ibtida mein baghair kisi namune ke aasmanon aur zameenon ko paida kiya hai, main shirk se hat kar tawheed ki taraf laut-ta hoon aur main mushrikon mein shamil rehna nahin chahta. Mufassireen in aayaton ki babat do khayal zahir karte hain; ek toh yeh ke yeh bator-e-nazar aur ghour-o-fikr ke tha, dusre yeh ke yeh sab bator-e-munazra ke tha. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se dusri baat hi marwi hai, Ibn Jareer (R.H) mein bhi isi ko pasand kiya gaya hai, is ki daleel mein aap ka yeh qaul late hain ke agar mujhe mera Rab hidayat na karta toh main gumrahon mein ho jata.

Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq (R.H) ne ek lamba qissa naqal kiya hai jis mein hai ke Namrud bin Canaan badshah se yeh kaha gaya tha ke ek bacha paida hone wala hai jiske hathon tera takht-e-taraaj hoga to usne hukum de diya tha ke is saal meri mamlikat mein jitne bache paida hon sab qatl kardiye jayen. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki walida ne jab yeh suna to kuch waqt qabl shehar ke bahar ek ghaar mein chali gayin, wahin Hazrat Khalilullah paida hue, to jab aap is ghaar se bahar nikle tab aap ne yeh sab farmaya tha jiska zikr in aayaton mein hai. Bilkul sahi baat yeh hai ke yeh guftagu Allah ke Khalil Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki munazirana thi, apni qoum ki baatil parasti ka ahwal Allah ko samjha rahe the. Awwal to aap ne apne walid ki khata zahir ki ke woh zameen ke un buton ki puja karte the jinhein unhon ne farishton waghera ki shakal par bana liya tha aur jinhein woh safarishi samajh rahe the. Yeh log bazam-e-khud apne aap ko is qabil nahin jante the ke barah-e-rast Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat karein. Is liye bator-e-waseele ke farishton ko pujte the ke woh Allah Ta'ala se unke bare mein keh sun kar unki rozi waghera barhwa dein aur unki hajatein puri kara dein. Phir jin aasmani cheezon ko yeh pujte the un mein unki khata bayan ki. Yeh sitara parast bhi the, saaton sitaron ko jo chalne phirne wale hain, pujte the; chand, utarid, zuhra, suraj, mirrikh, mushtari, zuhal. Unke nazdeek sab se zyada roshan suraj hai, phir chand, phir zuhra. Pas aap ne adna se shuru kiya aur aala tak le gaye. Pehle to zuhra ki nisbat farmaya ke woh puja ke qabil nahin kyunke yeh dusre ke qabu mein hain. Yeh muqarrara jaal se chalta hai, muqarrara jagah par chalta hai, dayen bayen zara bhi khisak nahin sakta. To jabke woh khud beshumar cheezon mein se ek cheez hai. Is mein roshni bhi Allah ki di hui hai, yeh mashriq se nikalta hai phir chalta phirta rehta hai aur doob jata hai, phir dusri raat isi tarah zahir hota hai to aisi cheez mabood hone ki salahiyat kya rakhti hai? Phir is se zyada roshan cheez yani chand ko dekhte hain aur usko bhi ibadat ke qabil na hona zahir farma kar phir suraj ko liya aur uski majboori aur uski ghulami aur maskeeni ka izhar kiya aur kaha ke logo main tumhare in shurka se, inki ibadat se, inki aqeedat se, inki mohabbat se door hoon. Suno agar yeh sache mabood hain aur kuch qudrat rakhte hain to in sab ko mila lo aur jo tum sab se ho sake mere khilaf kar lo.

Main toh us Allah ka aabid hoon jo in masnooaat ka saani, jo in makhlooqaat ka khaliq hai, jo har cheez ka maalik, Rabb aur saccha mabood hai. Jaise Qurani irshad hai ke tumhara Rabb sirf wahi hai jisne chhay din mein aasman-o-zameen ko paida kiya, phir Arsh par mustawi ho gaya. Raat ko din se, din ko raat se dhanpta hai, ek dusre ke barabar peeche ja aa raha hai. Suraj, chand aur taare sab uske farman ke tehat hain. Khalq-o-Amr usi ki malkiyat mein hain. Woh Rabb-ul-Aalameen hai, badi barkaton wala hai. Yeh toh bilkul namumkin sa maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ke yeh sab farman bator-e-waqia ke hon aur haqeeqat mein aap Allah ko pehchante hi na hon. Halankeh Allah Ta'ala farmata hai, aayat: (Wa laqad aatayna Ibrahima rushdahu min qablu wa kunna bihi alimeen) (21. Al-Anbiya: 51). Yani humne pehle se Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko seedha rasta de diya tha aur hum us se khoob waqif thay jabkeh usne apne baap se aur apni qoum se farmaya yeh soortein kya hain jin ki tum parastish aur mujawarat kar rahe ho? Aur aayat mein hai, aayat: (Inna Ibrahima kana ummatan qanitan lillahi hanifan wa lam yaku minal mushrikeen) (16. An-Nahl: 120). Ibrahim (A.S) toh bade khuloos wale Allah ke sacche farmanbardar thay, woh mushrikon mein se na thay. Allah ki naimaton ke shukr guzar thay. Allah ne unhein pasand farma liya tha aur Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki hidayat di thi, duniya ki bhalaaiyan di thin aur aakhirat mein bhi unhein saleh logon mein mila diya tha. Ab hum teri taraf wahi kar rahe hain ke Ibrahim (A.S) Hanif ke deen ka tabe-dar reh, woh mushrik na tha. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke har baccha fitrat par paida hota hai. Sahih Muslim ki Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "Maine apne bandon ko muwahid paida kiya hai." Kitabullah mein hai, aayat: (Fitratallahi allati fataran-nasa alaiha la tabdeela likhalqillahi zalikad deenul qayyimu wa lakinna aksaran-nasi la ya'lamoon) (30. Ar-Rum: 30). Allah Ta'ala ne logon ko Fitrat-e-Allah par paida kiya hai, Allah ki khalq ki tabdeeli nahin. Aur aayat mein hai, tere Rabb ne Adam (A.S) ki peeth se unki aulad nikal kar unhein unki jaanon par gawah kiya ke kya main tumhara sab ka Rabb nahin hoon? Sab ne iqrar kiya ke haan beshak tu hamara Rabb hai. Pas yahi Fitrat-e-Allah hai, jaise ke iska suboot anqareeb aayega Insha'Allah. Pas jabkeh tamam makhlooq ki paidaish Deen-e-Islam par, Allah ki sacchi tauheed par hai, toh Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) jin ki tauheed aur Allah parasti ka sana khwan khud Kalam-e-Rehman hai, unki nisbat kaun keh sakta hai ke aap Allah Jalla Shanuhu se aagah na thay aur kabhi taare ko aur kabhi chand suraj ko apna Allah samajh rahe thay? Nahin, nahin! Aap ki fitrat salim thi, aap ki aql sahih thi, aap Allah ke sacche deen par aur khalis tauheed par thay. Aap ka yeh tamam kalam bahaisiyat-e-munazra tha aur iski zabardast daleel iske baad ki aayat hai.

Ibrahim A.S aur Azar mein mukalma. Hazrat Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihimas Salam) ke walid ka naam Azar na tha balkay Tarikh tha. Azar se murad but hai. Aap ki walida ka naam Masla tha, aap ki biwi sahiba ka naam Sarah tha. Hazrat Ismail A.S ki walida ka naam Hajra tha, yeh Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki surriya thin. Ulama-e-nasab mein se auron ka bhi qaul hai ke aap ke walid ka naam Tarikh tha. Mujahid aur Suddi farmate hain Azar us but ka naam tha jis ke pujari aur khadim Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke walid thay, ho sakta hai ke us but ke naam ki wajah se unhein bhi isi naam se yaad kiya jata ho aur yahi naam mashhoor ho gaya ho. Wallahu A'lam. Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain ke Azar ka lafz un mein bator-e-aib-giri ke istemal kiya jata tha, is ke ma'ni terhay aadmi ke hain. Lekin is kalam ki sanad nahin, na Imam sahab ne ise kisi se naqal kiya hai. Sulaiman ka qaul hai ke is ke ma'ni terhay-pan ke hain aur yahi sab se sakht lafz hai jo Khalilullah ki zaban se nikla. Ibn-e-Jarir ka farman hai ke theek baat yahi hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke walid ka naam Azar tha aur yeh jo aam tarikh-dan kehte hain ke un ka naam Tarikh tha, is ka jawab yeh hai ke mumkin hai dono naam hon ya ek to naam ho aur dusra laqab ho. Baat to yeh theek aur nihayat qawi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Azar aur Azur dono qiratein hain. Pichli qira'at yani ra ke zabar ke sath to jamhoor ki hai. Pesh wali qira'at mein nida ki wajah se pesh hai aur zabar wali qira'at la-abiyah se badal hone ki hai aur mumkin hai ke atf-e-bayan ho aur yahi zyada mushabah hai. Yeh lafz alamiyat aur ajamiyat ki bina par ghair-munsarif hai, baaz log ise sifat batlate hain, is bina par bhi yeh ghair-munsarif rahe ga jaise Ahmar aur Aswad. Baaz ise attakhizu ka ma'mool maan kar mansoob kehte hain. Goya Hazrat Ibrahim A.S yun farmate ke hum log Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath thay, jab hum Madina Sharif se bahar nikal gaye to hum ne dekha ke ek oont sawar bahut tezi se apne oont ko daudata hua aa raha hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tumhari taraf hi aa raha hai. Us ne pahunch kar salam kiya, hum ne jawab diya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un se poocha kahan se aa rahe ho? Us ne kaha apne ghar se, apne baal-bachon mein se, apne kunbay qabeelay mein se. Daryaft farmaya kya irada hai? Kaise nikle ho? Jawab diya Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki justuju mein. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya phir to tum apne maqsad mein kamyab ho gaye, main hi Allah ka Rasool hoon. Us ne khush ho kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe samjhaiye ke imaan kya hai?

Aap ne farmaya yeh keh do ke Allah ek hai aur Muhammad (ﷺ) Allah ke Rasool hain aur namazon ko qaim rakhe aur zakat ada karta rahe aur Ramzan ke rozay rakhe aur Baitullah ka Hajj kare. Us ne kaha mujhe sab baatein manzoor hain main sab iqrar karta hoon, itne mein un ke oont ka paon ek soorakh mein gir para aur oont ek dam se jhatka le kar jhuk gaya aur woh oopar se gire aur sar ke bal gire aur usi waqt rooh parwaz kar gayi. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un ke girte hi farmaya ke dekho inhe sambhalo. Usi waqt Hazrat Ammar bin Yasir (R.A) aur Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman (R.A) apne oonton se kood pare aur unhein utha liya, dekha to rooh jism se alaihda ho chuki hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) se kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh to faut ho gaye, aap ne munh pher liya. Phir zara si der mein farmane lage tum ne mujhe munh modte hue dekha hoga, is ki wajah yeh thi ke main ne dekha do farishtay aaye thay aur marhoom ke munh mein jannat ke phool de rahe thay, is se main ne jaan liya ke bhookay faut hue hain. Suno yeh unhi logon mein se hain jin ki babat Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala irshad farmata hai ke jo log iman laye aur apne iman ko zulm se na milaya un ke liye aman-o-aman hai aur woh rah-yafta hain. Achha apne pyare bhai ko dafan karo, chunancha hum unhein pani ke paas utha le gaye, ghusal diya, khushbu mali aur qabr ki taraf janaza le kar chale. An-Hazrat (ﷺ) qabr ke kinare baith gaye aur farmane lage baghli qabr banao seedhi na banao, baghli qabr hamare liye hai aur seedhi hamare siwa auron ke liye hai. Logo yeh woh shakhs hai jis ne amal bahut hi kam kiya aur sawab zyada paya. Yeh ek Aarabi thay unhon ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) us silsile ki qasam jis ne aap ko haq ke sath bheja hai, main apne ghar se, apne bal bachon se, apne maal se, apne kunbay qabeelay se is liye aur sirf is liye alag hua hoon ke aap ki hidayat ko qabool karoon, aap ki sunnaton par amal karoon, aap ki hadeesein loon. Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main ghaas phoos khata hua aap tak pahuncha hoon, aap mujhe Islam sikhaiye. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne sikhaya us ne qabool kiya, hum sab un ke ird-gird bheer lagaye kharay thay itne mein jungli chuhay ke bil mein un ke oont ka paon par gaya, yeh gir pare aur gardan toot gayi. Aap ne farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne mujhe haq ke sath mab'oos farmaya, yeh sach much fi-al-waqai apne ghar se, apne ahl-o-ayal se aur apne maal-o-maweshi se sirf meri tabedari ki dhun mein nikla tha aur woh is baat mein bhi sachay thay ke woh mere paas nahin pahunchay yahan tak ke un ka khana sirf sabz pattay aur ghaas reh gaya tha. Tum ne aise log bhi sunay honge jo amal kam karte hain aur sawab bahut patay hain. Yeh buzurg inhi mein se thay.

Tum ne suna hoga ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai jo imaan layein aur zulm na karein woh aman-o-hidayat wale hain, yeh unhi mein se thay (R.A). Phir farmaya Ibrahim (A.S) ko yeh daleelein hum ne sikhayin jin se woh apni qoum par ghalib aa gaye, jaise unhon ne ek Allah ke parastar ka aman aur us ki hidayat bayan farmayi aur khud Allah ki taraf se is baat ki tasdeeq ki gayi. Aayat (نَرْفَعُ دَرَجٰتٍ مَّنْ نَّشَاۗءُ ۭاِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيْمٌ عَلِيْمٌ) (Surah Al-An'am: 83) ki yahi ek qira'at hai, izafat ke sath aur be-izafat dono tarah parha gaya hai jaise Surah Yusuf mein hai aur ma'ani dono qira'aton ke qareeb qareeb barabar hain. Tere Rab ke aqwal rahmat wale aur us ke kaam bhi hikmat wale hain. Woh sahih raste walon ko aur gumrahon ko bakhoobi jaanta hai jaise farman hai jin par tere ki thandak main ne apne seene mein mehsoos ki phir toh tamam cheezein mere samne khul gayin aur main ne use pehchan liya. Wal-yakoon ka waw za'ida hai, jaise wal-tastabeen mein aur kaha gaya hai ke woh apni jagah par hai yani is liye ke woh aalim aur yaqeen wale ho jayein. Raat ke andhere mein Khalil-ullah sitare ko dekh kar farmate hain ke yeh mera Rab hai, jab woh ghuroob ho jata hai toh aap samajh lete hain ke yeh Parwardigar nahin kyunke Rab dawam wala hota hai, woh zawal aur inqilab se pak hota hai. Phir jab chand charhta hai toh yahi farmate hain, jab woh bhi ghuroob ho jata hai toh us se bhi yaksooi kar lete hain. Phir suraj ke tuloo hone par use sab se bada pa kar sab se zyada roshan dekh kar yahi kehte hain, jab woh bhi dhal jata hai toh Allah ke siwa tamam maboodon se bezar ho jate hain. Aur pukar uthte hain ke main toh apni ibadat ke liye Allah ki zaat ko makhsoos karta hoon jis ne ibtida mein baghair kisi namune ke aasmanon aur zameenon ko paida kiya hai, main shirk se hat kar tawheed ki taraf laut-ta hoon aur main mushrikon mein shamil rehna nahin chahta. Mufassireen in aayaton ki babat do khayal zahir karte hain; ek toh yeh ke yeh bator-e-nazar aur ghour-o-fikr ke tha, dusre yeh ke yeh sab bator-e-munazra ke tha. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se dusri baat hi marwi hai, Ibn Jareer (R.H) mein bhi isi ko pasand kiya gaya hai, is ki daleel mein aap ka yeh qaul late hain ke agar mujhe mera Rab hidayat na karta toh main gumrahon mein ho jata.

Pesh wali qira'at mein nida ki wajah se pesh hai aur zabar wali qira'at la-abiyah se badal hone ki hai aur mumkin hai ke atf-e-bayan ho aur yahi zyada mushabah hai. Yeh lafz alamiyat aur ajamiyat ki bina par ghair-munsarif hai, baaz log ise sifat batlate hain, is bina par bhi yeh ghair-munsarif rahe ga jaise Ahmar aur Aswad. Baaz ise attakhizu ka ma'mool maan kar mansoob kehte hain. Goya Hazrat Ibrahim A.S yun farmate ke hum log Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath thay, jab hum Madina Sharif se bahar nikal gaye to hum ne dekha ke ek oont sawar bahut tezi se apne oont ko daudata hua aa raha hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tumhari taraf hi aa raha hai. Us ne pahunch kar salam kiya, hum ne jawab diya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un se poocha kahan se aa rahe ho? Us ne kaha apne ghar se, apne baal-bachon mein se, apne kunbay qabeelay mein se. Daryaft farmaya kya irada hai? Kaise nikle ho? Jawab diya Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki justuju mein. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya phir to tum apne maqsad mein kamyab ho gaye, main hi Allah ka Rasool hoon. Us ne khush ho kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe samjhaiye ke imaan kya hai?

Aap ne farmaya yeh keh do ke Allah ek hai aur Muhammad (ﷺ) Allah ke Rasool hain aur namazon ko qaim rakhe aur zakat ada karta rahe aur Ramzan ke rozay rakhe aur Baitullah ka Hajj kare. Us ne kaha mujhe sab baatein manzoor hain main sab iqrar karta hoon, itne mein un ke oont ka paon ek soorakh mein gir para aur oont ek dam se jhatka le kar jhuk gaya aur woh oopar se gire aur sar ke bal gire aur usi waqt rooh parwaz kar gayi. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un ke girte hi farmaya ke dekho inhe sambhalo. Usi waqt Hazrat Ammar bin Yasir (R.A) aur Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman (R.A) apne oonton se kood pare aur unhein utha liya, dekha to rooh jism se alaihda ho chuki hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) se kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh to faut ho gaye, aap ne munh pher liya. Phir zara si der mein farmane lage tum ne mujhe munh modte hue dekha hoga, is ki wajah yeh thi ke main ne dekha do farishtay aaye thay aur marhoom ke munh mein jannat ke phool de rahe thay, is se main ne jaan liya ke bhookay faut hue hain. Suno yeh unhi logon mein se hain jin ki babat Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala irshad farmata hai ke jo log iman laye aur apne iman ko zulm se na milaya un ke liye aman-o-aman hai aur woh rah-yafta hain. Achha apne pyare bhai ko dafan karo, chunancha hum unhein pani ke paas utha le gaye, ghusal diya, khushbu mali aur qabr ki taraf janaza le kar chale. An-Hazrat (ﷺ) qabr ke kinare baith gaye aur farmane lage baghli qabr banao seedhi na banao, baghli qabr hamare liye hai aur seedhi hamare siwa auron ke liye hai. Logo yeh woh shakhs hai jis ne amal bahut hi kam kiya aur sawab zyada paya. Yeh ek Aarabi thay unhon ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) us silsile ki qasam jis ne aap ko haq ke sath bheja hai, main apne ghar se, apne bal bachon se, apne maal se, apne kunbay qabeelay se is liye aur sirf is liye alag hua hoon ke aap ki hidayat ko qabool karoon, aap ki sunnaton par amal karoon, aap ki hadeesein loon. Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main ghaas phoos khata hua aap tak pahuncha hoon, aap mujhe Islam sikhaiye. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne sikhaya us ne qabool kiya, hum sab un ke ird-gird bheer lagaye kharay thay itne mein jungli chuhay ke bil mein un ke oont ka paon par gaya, yeh gir pare aur gardan toot gayi. Aap ne farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne mujhe haq ke sath mab'oos farmaya, yeh sach much fi-al-waqai apne ghar se, apne ahl-o-ayal se aur apne maal-o-maweshi se sirf meri tabedari ki dhun mein nikla tha aur woh is baat mein bhi sachay thay ke woh mere paas nahin pahunchay yahan tak ke un ka khana sirf sabz pattay aur ghaas reh gaya tha. Tum ne aise log bhi sunay honge jo amal kam karte hain aur sawab bahut patay hain. Yeh buzurg inhi mein se thay.

Tum ne suna hoga ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai jo imaan layein aur zulm na karein woh aman-o-hidayat wale hain, yeh unhi mein se thay (R.A). Phir farmaya Ibrahim (A.S) ko yeh daleelein hum ne sikhayin jin se woh apni qoum par ghalib aa gaye, jaise unhon ne ek Allah ke parastar ka aman aur us ki hidayat bayan farmayi aur khud Allah ki taraf se is baat ki tasdeeq ki gayi. Aayat (نَرْفَعُ دَرَجٰتٍ مَّنْ نَّشَاۗءُ ۭاِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيْمٌ عَلِيْمٌ) (Surah Al-An'am: 83) ki yahi ek qira'at hai, izafat ke sath aur be-izafat dono tarah parha gaya hai jaise Surah Yusuf mein hai aur ma'ani dono qira'aton ke qareeb qareeb barabar hain. Tere Rab ke aqwal rahmat wale aur us ke kaam bhi hikmat wale hain. Woh sahih raste walon ko aur gumrahon ko bakhoobi jaanta hai jaise farman hai jin par tere ki thandak main ne apne seene mein mehsoos ki phir toh tamam cheezein mere samne khul gayin aur main ne use pehchan liya. Wal-yakoon ka waw za'ida hai, jaise wal-tastabeen mein aur kaha gaya hai ke woh apni jagah par hai yani is liye ke woh aalim aur yaqeen wale ho jayein. Raat ke andhere mein Khalil-ullah sitare ko dekh kar farmate hain ke yeh mera Rab hai, jab woh ghuroob ho jata hai toh aap samajh lete hain ke yeh Parwardigar nahin kyunke Rab dawam wala hota hai, woh zawal aur inqilab se pak hota hai. Phir jab chand charhta hai toh yahi farmate hain, jab woh bhi ghuroob ho jata hai toh us se bhi yaksooi kar lete hain. Phir suraj ke tuloo hone par use sab se bada pa kar sab se zyada roshan dekh kar yahi kehte hain, jab woh bhi dhal jata hai toh Allah ke siwa tamam maboodon se bezar ho jate hain. Aur pukar uthte hain ke main toh apni ibadat ke liye Allah ki zaat ko makhsoos karta hoon jis ne ibtida mein baghair kisi namune ke aasmanon aur zameenon ko paida kiya hai, main shirk se hat kar tawheed ki taraf laut-ta hoon aur main mushrikon mein shamil rehna nahin chahta. Mufassireen in aayaton ki babat do khayal zahir karte hain; ek toh yeh ke yeh bator-e-nazar aur ghour-o-fikr ke tha, dusre yeh ke yeh sab bator-e-munazra ke tha. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se dusri baat hi marwi hai, Ibn Jareer (R.H) mein bhi isi ko pasand kiya gaya hai, is ki daleel mein aap ka yeh qaul late hain ke agar mujhe mera Rab hidayat na karta toh main gumrahon mein ho jata.

Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq (R.H) ne ek lamba qissa naqal kiya hai jis mein hai ke Namrud bin Canaan badshah se yeh kaha gaya tha ke ek bacha paida hone wala hai jiske hathon tera takht-e-taraaj hoga to usne hukum de diya tha ke is saal meri mamlikat mein jitne bache paida hon sab qatl kardiye jayen. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki walida ne jab yeh suna to kuch waqt qabl shehar ke bahar ek ghaar mein chali gayin, wahin Hazrat Khalilullah paida hue, to jab aap is ghaar se bahar nikle tab aap ne yeh sab farmaya tha jiska zikr in aayaton mein hai. Bilkul sahi baat yeh hai ke yeh guftagu Allah ke Khalil Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki munazirana thi, apni qoum ki baatil parasti ka ahwal Allah ko samjha rahe the. Awwal to aap ne apne walid ki khata zahir ki ke woh zameen ke un buton ki puja karte the jinhein unhon ne farishton waghera ki shakal par bana liya tha aur jinhein woh safarishi samajh rahe the. Yeh log bazam-e-khud apne aap ko is qabil nahin jante the ke barah-e-rast Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat karein. Is liye bator-e-waseele ke farishton ko pujte the ke woh Allah Ta'ala se unke bare mein keh sun kar unki rozi waghera barhwa dein aur unki hajatein puri kara dein. Phir jin aasmani cheezon ko yeh pujte the un mein unki khata bayan ki. Yeh sitara parast bhi the, saaton sitaron ko jo chalne phirne wale hain, pujte the; chand, utarid, zuhra, suraj, mirrikh, mushtari, zuhal. Unke nazdeek sab se zyada roshan suraj hai, phir chand, phir zuhra. Pas aap ne adna se shuru kiya aur aala tak le gaye. Pehle to zuhra ki nisbat farmaya ke woh puja ke qabil nahin kyunke yeh dusre ke qabu mein hain. Yeh muqarrara jaal se chalta hai, muqarrara jagah par chalta hai, dayen bayen zara bhi khisak nahin sakta. To jabke woh khud beshumar cheezon mein se ek cheez hai. Is mein roshni bhi Allah ki di hui hai, yeh mashriq se nikalta hai phir chalta phirta rehta hai aur doob jata hai, phir dusri raat isi tarah zahir hota hai to aisi cheez mabood hone ki salahiyat kya rakhti hai? Phir is se zyada roshan cheez yani chand ko dekhte hain aur usko bhi ibadat ke qabil na hona zahir farma kar phir suraj ko liya aur uski majboori aur uski ghulami aur maskeeni ka izhar kiya aur kaha ke logo main tumhare in shurka se, inki ibadat se, inki aqeedat se, inki mohabbat se door hoon. Suno agar yeh sache mabood hain aur kuch qudrat rakhte hain to in sab ko mila lo aur jo tum sab se ho sake mere khilaf kar lo.

Main toh us Allah ka aabid hoon jo in masnooaat ka saani, jo in makhlooqaat ka khaliq hai, jo har cheez ka maalik, Rabb aur saccha mabood hai. Jaise Qurani irshad hai ke tumhara Rabb sirf wahi hai jisne chhay din mein aasman-o-zameen ko paida kiya, phir Arsh par mustawi ho gaya. Raat ko din se, din ko raat se dhanpta hai, ek dusre ke barabar peeche ja aa raha hai. Suraj, chand aur taare sab uske farman ke tehat hain. Khalq-o-Amr usi ki malkiyat mein hain. Woh Rabb-ul-Aalameen hai, badi barkaton wala hai. Yeh toh bilkul namumkin sa maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ke yeh sab farman bator-e-waqia ke hon aur haqeeqat mein aap Allah ko pehchante hi na hon. Halankeh Allah Ta'ala farmata hai, aayat: (Wa laqad aatayna Ibrahima rushdahu min qablu wa kunna bihi alimeen) (21. Al-Anbiya: 51). Yani humne pehle se Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko seedha rasta de diya tha aur hum us se khoob waqif thay jabkeh usne apne baap se aur apni qoum se farmaya yeh soortein kya hain jin ki tum parastish aur mujawarat kar rahe ho? Aur aayat mein hai, aayat: (Inna Ibrahima kana ummatan qanitan lillahi hanifan wa lam yaku minal mushrikeen) (16. An-Nahl: 120). Ibrahim (A.S) toh bade khuloos wale Allah ke sacche farmanbardar thay, woh mushrikon mein se na thay. Allah ki naimaton ke shukr guzar thay. Allah ne unhein pasand farma liya tha aur Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki hidayat di thi, duniya ki bhalaaiyan di thin aur aakhirat mein bhi unhein saleh logon mein mila diya tha. Ab hum teri taraf wahi kar rahe hain ke Ibrahim (A.S) Hanif ke deen ka tabe-dar reh, woh mushrik na tha. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke har baccha fitrat par paida hota hai. Sahih Muslim ki Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "Maine apne bandon ko muwahid paida kiya hai." Kitabullah mein hai, aayat: (Fitratallahi allati fataran-nasa alaiha la tabdeela likhalqillahi zalikad deenul qayyimu wa lakinna aksaran-nasi la ya'lamoon) (30. Ar-Rum: 30). Allah Ta'ala ne logon ko Fitrat-e-Allah par paida kiya hai, Allah ki khalq ki tabdeeli nahin. Aur aayat mein hai, tere Rabb ne Adam (A.S) ki peeth se unki aulad nikal kar unhein unki jaanon par gawah kiya ke kya main tumhara sab ka Rabb nahin hoon? Sab ne iqrar kiya ke haan beshak tu hamara Rabb hai. Pas yahi Fitrat-e-Allah hai, jaise ke iska suboot anqareeb aayega Insha'Allah. Pas jabkeh tamam makhlooq ki paidaish Deen-e-Islam par, Allah ki sacchi tauheed par hai, toh Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) jin ki tauheed aur Allah parasti ka sana khwan khud Kalam-e-Rehman hai, unki nisbat kaun keh sakta hai ke aap Allah Jalla Shanuhu se aagah na thay aur kabhi taare ko aur kabhi chand suraj ko apna Allah samajh rahe thay? Nahin, nahin! Aap ki fitrat salim thi, aap ki aql sahih thi, aap Allah ke sacche deen par aur khalis tauheed par thay. Aap ka yeh tamam kalam bahaisiyat-e-munazra tha aur iski zabardast daleel iske baad ki aayat hai.

Ibrahim A.S aur Azar mein mukalma. Hazrat Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihimas Salam) ke walid ka naam Azar na tha balkay Tarikh tha. Azar se murad but hai. Aap ki walida ka naam Masla tha, aap ki biwi sahiba ka naam Sarah tha. Hazrat Ismail A.S ki walida ka naam Hajra tha, yeh Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki surriya thin. Ulama-e-nasab mein se auron ka bhi qaul hai ke aap ke walid ka naam Tarikh tha. Mujahid aur Suddi farmate hain Azar us but ka naam tha jis ke pujari aur khadim Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke walid thay, ho sakta hai ke us but ke naam ki wajah se unhein bhi isi naam se yaad kiya jata ho aur yahi naam mashhoor ho gaya ho. Wallahu A'lam. Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain ke Azar ka lafz un mein bator-e-aib-giri ke istemal kiya jata tha, is ke ma'ni terhay aadmi ke hain. Lekin is kalam ki sanad nahin, na Imam sahab ne ise kisi se naqal kiya hai. Sulaiman ka qaul hai ke is ke ma'ni terhay-pan ke hain aur yahi sab se sakht lafz hai jo Khalilullah ki zaban se nikla. Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq (R.H) ne ek lamba qissa naqal kiya hai jis mein hai ke Namrud bin Canaan badshah se yeh kaha gaya tha ke ek bacha paida hone wala hai jiske hathon tera takht-e-taraaj hoga to usne hukum de diya tha ke is saal meri mamlikat mein jitne bache paida hon sab qatl kardiye jayen. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki walida ne jab yeh suna to kuch waqt qabl shehar ke bahar ek ghaar mein chali gayin, wahin Hazrat Khalilullah paida hue, to jab aap is ghaar se bahar nikle tab aap ne yeh sab farmaya tha jiska zikr in aayaton mein hai. Bilkul sahi baat yeh hai ke yeh guftagu Allah ke Khalil Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki munazirana thi, apni qoum ki baatil parasti ka ahwal Allah ko samjha rahe the. Awwal to aap ne apne walid ki khata zahir ki ke woh zameen ke un buton ki puja karte the jinhein unhon ne farishton waghera ki shakal par bana liya tha aur jinhein woh safarishi samajh rahe the. Yeh log bazam-e-khud apne aap ko is qabil nahin jante the ke barah-e-rast Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat karein. Is liye bator-e-waseele ke farishton ko pujte the ke woh Allah Ta'ala se unke bare mein keh sun kar unki rozi waghera barhwa dein aur unki hajatein puri kara dein. Phir jin aasmani cheezon ko yeh pujte the un mein unki khata bayan ki. Yeh sitara parast bhi the, saaton sitaron ko jo chalne phirne wale hain, pujte the; chand, utarid, zuhra, suraj, mirrikh, mushtari, zuhal. Unke nazdeek sab se zyada roshan suraj hai, phir chand, phir zuhra. Pas aap ne adna se shuru kiya aur aala tak le gaye. Pehle to zuhra ki nisbat farmaya ke woh puja ke qabil nahin kyunke yeh dusre ke qabu mein hain. Yeh muqarrara jaal se chalta hai, muqarrara jagah par chalta hai, dayen bayen zara bhi khisak nahin sakta. To jabke woh khud beshumar cheezon mein se ek cheez hai. Is mein roshni bhi Allah ki di hui hai, yeh mashriq se nikalta hai phir chalta phirta rehta hai aur doob jata hai, phir dusri raat isi tarah zahir hota hai to aisi cheez mabood hone ki salahiyat kya rakhti hai? Phir is se zyada roshan cheez yani chand ko dekhte hain aur usko bhi ibadat ke qabil na hona zahir farma kar phir suraj ko liya aur uski majboori aur uski ghulami aur maskeeni ka izhar kiya aur kaha ke logo main tumhare in shurka se, inki ibadat se, inki aqeedat se, inki mohabbat se door hoon. Suno agar yeh sache mabood hain aur kuch qudrat rakhte hain to in sab ko mila lo aur jo tum sab se ho sake mere khilaf kar lo.

Main toh us Allah ka aabid hoon jo in masnooaat ka saani, jo in makhlooqaat ka khaliq hai, jo har cheez ka maalik, Rabb aur saccha mabood hai. Jaise Qurani irshad hai ke tumhara Rabb sirf wahi hai jisne chhay din mein aasman-o-zameen ko paida kiya, phir Arsh par mustawi ho gaya. Raat ko din se, din ko raat se dhanpta hai, ek dusre ke barabar peeche ja aa raha hai. Suraj, chand aur taare sab uske farman ke tehat hain. Khalq-o-Amr usi ki malkiyat mein hain. Woh Rabb-ul-Aalameen hai, badi barkaton wala hai. Yeh toh bilkul namumkin sa maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ke yeh sab farman bator-e-waqia ke hon aur haqeeqat mein aap Allah ko pehchante hi na hon. Halankeh Allah Ta'ala farmata hai, aayat: (Wa laqad aatayna Ibrahima rushdahu min qablu wa kunna bihi alimeen) (21. Al-Anbiya: 51). Yani humne pehle se Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko seedha rasta de diya tha aur hum us se khoob waqif thay jabkeh usne apne baap se aur apni qoum se farmaya yeh soortein kya hain jin ki tum parastish aur mujawarat kar rahe ho? Aur aayat mein hai, aayat: (Inna Ibrahima kana ummatan qanitan lillahi hanifan wa lam yaku minal mushrikeen) (16. An-Nahl: 120). Ibrahim (A.S) toh bade khuloos wale Allah ke sacche farmanbardar thay, woh mushrikon mein se na thay. Allah ki naimaton ke shukr guzar thay. Allah ne unhein pasand farma liya tha aur Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki hidayat di thi, duniya ki bhalaaiyan di thin aur aakhirat mein bhi unhein saleh logon mein mila diya tha. Ab hum teri taraf wahi kar rahe hain ke Ibrahim (A.S) Hanif ke deen ka tabe-dar reh, woh mushrik na tha. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke har baccha fitrat par paida hota hai. Sahih Muslim ki Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "Maine apne bandon ko muwahid paida kiya hai." Kitabullah mein hai, aayat: (Fitratallahi allati fataran-nasa alaiha la tabdeela likhalqillahi zalikad deenul qayyimu wa lakinna aksaran-nasi la ya'lamoon) (30. Ar-Rum: 30). Allah Ta'ala ne logon ko Fitrat-e-Allah par paida kiya hai, Allah ki khalq ki tabdeeli nahin. Aur aayat mein hai, tere Rabb ne Adam (A.S) ki peeth se unki aulad nikal kar unhein unki jaanon par gawah kiya ke kya main tumhara sab ka Rabb nahin hoon? Sab ne iqrar kiya ke haan beshak tu hamara Rabb hai. Pas yahi Fitrat-e-Allah hai, jaise ke iska suboot anqareeb aayega Insha'Allah. Pas jabkeh tamam makhlooq ki paidaish Deen-e-Islam par, Allah ki sacchi tauheed par hai, toh Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) jin ki tauheed aur Allah parasti ka sana khwan khud Kalam-e-Rehman hai, unki nisbat kaun keh sakta hai ke aap Allah Jalla Shanuhu se aagah na thay aur kabhi taare ko aur kabhi chand suraj ko apna Allah samajh rahe thay? Nahin, nahin! Aap ki fitrat salim thi, aap ki aql sahih thi, aap Allah ke sacche deen par aur khalis tauheed par thay. Aap ka yeh tamam kalam bahaisiyat-e-munazra tha aur iski zabardast daleel iske baad ki aayat hai.

Ibrahim A.S aur Azar mein mukalma. Hazrat Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihimas Salam) ke walid ka naam Azar na tha balkay Tarikh tha. Azar se murad but hai. Aap ki walida ka naam Masla tha, aap ki biwi sahiba ka naam Sarah tha. Hazrat Ismail A.S ki walida ka naam Hajra tha, yeh Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki surriya thin. Ulama-e-nasab mein se auron ka bhi qaul hai ke aap ke walid ka naam Tarikh tha. Mujahid aur Suddi farmate hain Azar us but ka naam tha jis ke pujari aur khadim Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke walid thay, ho sakta hai ke us but ke naam ki wajah se unhein bhi isi naam se yaad kiya jata ho aur yahi naam mashhoor ho gaya ho. Wallahu A'lam. Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain ke Azar ka lafz un mein bator-e-aib-giri ke istemal kiya jata tha, is ke ma'ni terhay aadmi ke hain. Lekin is kalam ki sanad nahin, na Imam sahab ne ise kisi se naqal kiya hai. Sulaiman ka qaul hai ke is ke ma'ni terhay-pan ke hain aur yahi sab se sakht lafz hai jo Khalilullah ki zaban se nikla. Ibn-e-Jarir ka farman hai ke theek baat yahi hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke walid ka naam Azar tha aur yeh jo aam tarikh-dan kehte hain ke un ka naam Tarikh tha, is ka jawab yeh hai ke mumkin hai dono naam hon ya ek to naam ho aur dusra laqab ho. Baat to yeh theek aur nihayat qawi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Azar aur Azur dono qiratein hain. Pichli qira'at yani ra ke zabar ke sath to jamhoor ki hai. Pesh wali qira'at mein nida ki wajah se pesh hai aur zabar wali qira'at la-abiyah se badal hone ki hai aur mumkin hai ke atf-e-bayan ho aur yahi zyada mushabah hai. Yeh lafz alamiyat aur ajamiyat ki bina par ghair-munsarif hai, baaz log ise sifat batlate hain, is bina par bhi yeh ghair-munsarif rahe ga jaise Ahmar aur Aswad. Baaz ise attakhizu ka ma'mool maan kar mansoob kehte hain. Goya Hazrat Ibrahim A.S yun farmate ke hum log Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath thay, jab hum Madina Sharif se bahar nikal gaye to hum ne dekha ke ek oont sawar bahut tezi se apne oont ko daudata hua aa raha hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tumhari taraf hi aa raha hai. Us ne pahunch kar salam kiya, hum ne jawab diya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un se poocha kahan se aa rahe ho? Us ne kaha apne ghar se, apne baal-bachon mein se, apne kunbay qabeelay mein se. Daryaft farmaya kya irada hai? Kaise nikle ho? Jawab diya Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki justuju mein. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya phir to tum apne maqsad mein kamyab ho gaye, main hi Allah ka Rasool hoon. Us ne khush ho kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe samjhaiye ke imaan kya hai?

Aap ne farmaya yeh keh do ke Allah ek hai aur Muhammad (ﷺ) Allah ke Rasool hain aur namazon ko qaim rakhe aur zakat ada karta rahe aur Ramzan ke rozay rakhe aur Baitullah ka Hajj kare. Us ne kaha mujhe sab baatein manzoor hain main sab iqrar karta hoon, itne mein un ke oont ka paon ek soorakh mein gir para aur oont ek dam se jhatka le kar jhuk gaya aur woh oopar se gire aur sar ke bal gire aur usi waqt rooh parwaz kar gayi. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un ke girte hi farmaya ke dekho inhe sambhalo. Usi waqt Hazrat Ammar bin Yasir (R.A) aur Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman (R.A) apne oonton se kood pare aur unhein utha liya, dekha to rooh jism se alaihda ho chuki hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) se kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh to faut ho gaye, aap ne munh pher liya. Phir zara si der mein farmane lage tum ne mujhe munh modte hue dekha hoga, is ki wajah yeh thi ke main ne dekha do farishtay aaye thay aur marhoom ke munh mein jannat ke phool de rahe thay, is se main ne jaan liya ke bhookay faut hue hain. Suno yeh unhi logon mein se hain jin ki babat Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala irshad farmata hai ke jo log iman laye aur apne iman ko zulm se na milaya un ke liye aman-o-aman hai aur woh rah-yafta hain. Achha apne pyare bhai ko dafan karo, chunancha hum unhein pani ke paas utha le gaye, ghusal diya, khushbu mali aur qabr ki taraf janaza le kar chale. An-Hazrat (ﷺ) qabr ke kinare baith gaye aur farmane lage baghli qabr banao seedhi na banao, baghli qabr hamare liye hai aur seedhi hamare siwa auron ke liye hai. Logo yeh woh shakhs hai jis ne amal bahut hi kam kiya aur sawab zyada paya. Yeh ek Aarabi thay unhon ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) us silsile ki qasam jis ne aap ko haq ke sath bheja hai, main apne ghar se, apne bal bachon se, apne maal se, apne kunbay qabeelay se is liye aur sirf is liye alag hua hoon ke aap ki hidayat ko qabool karoon, aap ki sunnaton par amal karoon, aap ki hadeesein loon. Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main ghaas phoos khata hua aap tak pahuncha hoon, aap mujhe Islam sikhaiye. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne sikhaya us ne qabool kiya, hum sab un ke ird-gird bheer lagaye kharay thay itne mein jungli chuhay ke bil mein un ke oont ka paon par gaya, yeh gir pare aur gardan toot gayi. Aap ne farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne mujhe haq ke sath mab'oos farmaya, yeh sach much fi-al-waqai apne ghar se, apne ahl-o-ayal se aur apne maal-o-maweshi se sirf meri tabedari ki dhun mein nikla tha aur woh is baat mein bhi sachay thay ke woh mere paas nahin pahunchay yahan tak ke un ka khana sirf sabz pattay aur ghaas reh gaya tha. Tum ne aise log bhi sunay honge jo amal kam karte hain aur sawab bahut patay hain. Yeh buzurg inhi mein se thay.

Tum ne suna hoga ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai jo imaan layein aur zulm na karein woh aman-o-hidayat wale hain, yeh unhi mein se thay (R.A). Phir farmaya Ibrahim (A.S) ko yeh daleelein hum ne sikhayin jin se woh apni qoum par ghalib aa gaye, jaise unhon ne ek Allah ke parastar ka aman aur us ki hidayat bayan farmayi aur khud Allah ki taraf se is baat ki tasdeeq ki gayi. Aayat (نَرْفَعُ دَرَجٰتٍ مَّنْ نَّشَاۗءُ ۭاِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيْمٌ عَلِيْمٌ) (Surah Al-An'am: 83) ki yahi ek qira'at hai, izafat ke sath aur be-izafat dono tarah parha gaya hai jaise Surah Yusuf mein hai aur ma'ani dono qira'aton ke qareeb qareeb barabar hain. Tere Rab ke aqwal rahmat wale aur us ke kaam bhi hikmat wale hain. Woh sahih raste walon ko aur gumrahon ko bakhoobi jaanta hai jaise farman hai jin par tere ki thandak main ne apne seene mein mehsoos ki phir toh tamam cheezein mere samne khul gayin aur main ne use pehchan liya. Wal-yakoon ka waw za'ida hai, jaise wal-tastabeen mein aur kaha gaya hai ke woh apni jagah par hai yani is liye ke woh aalim aur yaqeen wale ho jayein. Raat ke andhere mein Khalil-ullah sitare ko dekh kar farmate hain ke yeh mera Rab hai, jab woh ghuroob ho jata hai toh aap samajh lete hain ke yeh Parwardigar nahin kyunke Rab dawam wala hota hai, woh zawal aur inqilab se pak hota hai. Phir jab chand charhta hai toh yahi farmate hain, jab woh bhi ghuroob ho jata hai toh us se bhi yaksooi kar lete hain. Phir suraj ke tuloo hone par use sab se bada pa kar sab se zyada roshan dekh kar yahi kehte hain, jab woh bhi dhal jata hai toh Allah ke siwa tamam maboodon se bezar ho jate hain. Aur pukar uthte hain ke main toh apni ibadat ke liye Allah ki zaat ko makhsoos karta hoon jis ne ibtida mein baghair kisi namune ke aasmanon aur zameenon ko paida kiya hai, main shirk se hat kar tawheed ki taraf laut-ta hoon aur main mushrikon mein shamil rehna nahin chahta.
