Lekin is kalam ki sanad nahin, na Imam sahab ne ise kisi se naqal kiya hai. Sulaiman ka qaul hai ke is ke ma'ni terhay-pan ke hain aur yahi sab se sakht lafz hai jo Khalilullah ki zaban se nikla. Ibn-e-Jarir ka farman hai ke theek baat yahi hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ke walid ka naam Azar tha aur yeh jo aam tarikh-dan kehte hain ke un ka naam Tarikh tha, is ka jawab yeh hai ke mumkin hai dono naam hon ya ek to naam ho aur dusra laqab ho. Baat to yeh theek aur nihayat qawi hai, Wallahu A'lam. Azar aur Azur dono qiratein hain. Pichli qira'at yani ra ke zabar ke sath to jamhoor ki hai. Pesh wali qira'at mein nida ki wajah se pesh hai aur zabar wali qira'at la-abiyah se badal hone ki hai aur mumkin hai ke atf-e-bayan ho aur yahi zyada mushabah hai. Yeh lafz alamiyat aur ajamiyat ki bina par ghair-munsarif hai, baaz log ise sifat batlate hain, is bina par bhi yeh ghair-munsarif rahe ga jaise Ahmar aur Aswad. Baaz ise attakhizu ka ma'mool maan kar mansoob kehte hain. Goya Hazrat Ibrahim A.S yun farmate ke hum log Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke sath thay, jab hum Madina Sharif se bahar nikal gaye to hum ne dekha ke ek oont sawar bahut tezi se apne oont ko daudata hua aa raha hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya tumhari taraf hi aa raha hai. Us ne pahunch kar salam kiya, hum ne jawab diya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un se poocha kahan se aa rahe ho? Us ne kaha apne ghar se, apne baal-bachon mein se, apne kunbay qabeelay mein se. Daryaft farmaya kya irada hai? Kaise nikle ho? Jawab diya Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki justuju mein. Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya phir to tum apne maqsad mein kamyab ho gaye, main hi Allah ka Rasool hoon. Us ne khush ho kar kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mujhe samjhaiye ke imaan kya hai?

Aap ne farmaya yeh keh do ke Allah ek hai aur Muhammad (ﷺ) Allah ke Rasool hain aur namazon ko qaim rakhe aur zakat ada karta rahe aur Ramzan ke rozay rakhe aur Baitullah ka Hajj kare. Us ne kaha mujhe sab baatein manzoor hain main sab iqrar karta hoon, itne mein un ke oont ka paon ek soorakh mein gir para aur oont ek dam se jhatka le kar jhuk gaya aur woh oopar se gire aur sar ke bal gire aur usi waqt rooh parwaz kar gayi. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne un ke girte hi farmaya ke dekho inhe sambhalo. Usi waqt Hazrat Ammar bin Yasir (R.A) aur Hazrat Huzaifa bin Yaman (R.A) apne oonton se kood pare aur unhein utha liya, dekha to rooh jism se alaihda ho chuki hai. Huzoor (ﷺ) se kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) yeh to faut ho gaye, aap ne munh pher liya. Phir zara si der mein farmane lage tum ne mujhe munh modte hue dekha hoga, is ki wajah yeh thi ke main ne dekha do farishtay aaye thay aur marhoom ke munh mein jannat ke phool de rahe thay, is se main ne jaan liya ke bhookay faut hue hain. Suno yeh unhi logon mein se hain jin ki babat Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala irshad farmata hai ke jo log iman laye aur apne iman ko zulm se na milaya un ke liye aman-o-aman hai aur woh rah-yafta hain. Achha apne pyare bhai ko dafan karo, chunancha hum unhein pani ke paas utha le gaye, ghusal diya, khushbu mali aur qabr ki taraf janaza le kar chale. An-Hazrat (ﷺ) qabr ke kinare baith gaye aur farmane lage baghli qabr banao seedhi na banao, baghli qabr hamare liye hai aur seedhi hamare siwa auron ke liye hai. Logo yeh woh shakhs hai jis ne amal bahut hi kam kiya aur sawab zyada paya. Yeh ek Aarabi thay unhon ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) us silsile ki qasam jis ne aap ko haq ke sath bheja hai, main apne ghar se, apne bal bachon se, apne maal se, apne kunbay qabeelay se is liye aur sirf is liye alag hua hoon ke aap ki hidayat ko qabool karoon, aap ki sunnaton par amal karoon, aap ki hadeesein loon. Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) main ghaas phoos khata hua aap tak pahuncha hoon, aap mujhe Islam sikhaiye. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne sikhaya us ne qabool kiya, hum sab un ke ird-gird bheer lagaye kharay thay itne mein jungli chuhay ke bil mein un ke oont ka paon par gaya, yeh gir pare aur gardan toot gayi. Aap ne farmaya us Allah ki qasam jis ne mujhe haq ke sath mab'oos farmaya, yeh sach much fi-al-waqai apne ghar se, apne ahl-o-ayal se aur apne maal-o-maweshi se sirf meri tabedari ki dhun mein nikla tha aur woh is baat mein bhi sachay thay ke woh mere paas nahin pahunchay yahan tak ke un ka khana sirf sabz pattay aur ghaas reh gaya tha. Tum ne aise log bhi sunay honge jo amal kam karte hain aur sawab bahut patay hain. Yeh buzurg inhi mein se thay.

Tum ne suna hoga ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai jo imaan layein aur zulm na karein woh aman-o-hidayat wale hain, yeh unhi mein se thay (R.A). Phir farmaya Ibrahim (A.S) ko yeh daleelein hum ne sikhayin jin se woh apni qoum par ghalib aa gaye, jaise unhon ne ek Allah ke parastar ka aman aur us ki hidayat bayan farmayi aur khud Allah ki taraf se is baat ki tasdeeq ki gayi. Aayat (نَرْفَعُ دَرَجٰتٍ مَّنْ نَّشَاۗءُ ۭاِنَّ رَبَّكَ حَكِيْمٌ عَلِيْمٌ) (Surah Al-An'am: 83) ki yahi ek qira'at hai, izafat ke sath aur be-izafat dono tarah parha gaya hai jaise Surah Yusuf mein hai aur ma'ani dono qira'aton ke qareeb qareeb barabar hain. Tere Rab ke aqwal rahmat wale aur us ke kaam bhi hikmat wale hain. Woh sahih raste walon ko aur gumrahon ko bakhoobi jaanta hai jaise farman hai jin par tere ki thandak main ne apne seene mein mehsoos ki phir toh tamam cheezein mere samne khul gayin aur main ne use pehchan liya. Wal-yakoon ka waw za'ida hai, jaise wal-tastabeen mein aur kaha gaya hai ke woh apni jagah par hai yani is liye ke woh aalim aur yaqeen wale ho jayein. Raat ke andhere mein Khalil-ullah sitare ko dekh kar farmate hain ke yeh mera Rab hai, jab woh ghuroob ho jata hai toh aap samajh lete hain ke yeh Parwardigar nahin kyunke Rab dawam wala hota hai, woh zawal aur inqilab se pak hota hai. Phir jab chand charhta hai toh yahi farmate hain, jab woh bhi ghuroob ho jata hai toh us se bhi yaksooi kar lete hain. Phir suraj ke tuloo hone par use sab se bada pa kar sab se zyada roshan dekh kar yahi kehte hain, jab woh bhi dhal jata hai toh Allah ke siwa tamam maboodon se bezar ho jate hain. Aur pukar uthte hain ke main toh apni ibadat ke liye Allah ki zaat ko makhsoos karta hoon jis ne ibtida mein baghair kisi namune ke aasmanon aur zameenon ko paida kiya hai, main shirk se hat kar tawheed ki taraf laut-ta hoon aur main mushrikon mein shamil rehna nahin chahta. Mufassireen in aayaton ki babat do khayal zahir karte hain; ek toh yeh ke yeh bator-e-nazar aur ghour-o-fikr ke tha, dusre yeh ke yeh sab bator-e-munazra ke tha. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se dusri baat hi marwi hai, Ibn Jareer (R.H) mein bhi isi ko pasand kiya gaya hai, is ki daleel mein aap ka yeh qaul late hain ke agar mujhe mera Rab hidayat na karta toh main gumrahon mein ho jata.

Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq (R.H) ne ek lamba qissa naqal kiya hai jis mein hai ke Namrud bin Canaan badshah se yeh kaha gaya tha ke ek bacha paida hone wala hai jiske hathon tera takht-e-taraaj hoga to usne hukum de diya tha ke is saal meri mamlikat mein jitne bache paida hon sab qatl kardiye jayen. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki walida ne jab yeh suna to kuch waqt qabl shehar ke bahar ek ghaar mein chali gayin, wahin Hazrat Khalilullah paida hue, to jab aap is ghaar se bahar nikle tab aap ne yeh sab farmaya tha jiska zikr in aayaton mein hai. Bilkul sahi baat yeh hai ke yeh guftagu Allah ke Khalil Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ki munazirana thi, apni qoum ki baatil parasti ka ahwal Allah ko samjha rahe the. Awwal to aap ne apne walid ki khata zahir ki ke woh zameen ke un buton ki puja karte the jinhein unhon ne farishton waghera ki shakal par bana liya tha aur jinhein woh safarishi samajh rahe the. Yeh log bazam-e-khud apne aap ko is qabil nahin jante the ke barah-e-rast Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat karein. Is liye bator-e-waseele ke farishton ko pujte the ke woh Allah Ta'ala se unke bare mein keh sun kar unki rozi waghera barhwa dein aur unki hajatein puri kara dein. Phir jin aasmani cheezon ko yeh pujte the un mein unki khata bayan ki. Yeh sitara parast bhi the, saaton sitaron ko jo chalne phirne wale hain, pujte the; chand, utarid, zuhra, suraj, mirrikh, mushtari, zuhal. Unke nazdeek sab se zyada roshan suraj hai, phir chand, phir zuhra. Pas aap ne adna se shuru kiya aur aala tak le gaye. Pehle to zuhra ki nisbat farmaya ke woh puja ke qabil nahin kyunke yeh dusre ke qabu mein hain. Yeh muqarrara jaal se chalta hai, muqarrara jagah par chalta hai, dayen bayen zara bhi khisak nahin sakta. To jabke woh khud beshumar cheezon mein se ek cheez hai. Is mein roshni bhi Allah ki di hui hai, yeh mashriq se nikalta hai phir chalta phirta rehta hai aur doob jata hai, phir dusri raat isi tarah zahir hota hai to aisi cheez mabood hone ki salahiyat kya rakhti hai? Phir is se zyada roshan cheez yani chand ko dekhte hain aur usko bhi ibadat ke qabil na hona zahir farma kar phir suraj ko liya aur uski majboori aur uski ghulami aur maskeeni ka izhar kiya aur kaha ke logo main tumhare in shurka se, inki ibadat se, inki aqeedat se, inki mohabbat se door hoon. Suno agar yeh sache mabood hain aur kuch qudrat rakhte hain to in sab ko mila lo aur jo tum sab se ho sake mere khilaf kar lo.

Main toh us Allah ka aabid hoon jo in masnooaat ka saani, jo in makhlooqaat ka khaliq hai, jo har cheez ka maalik, Rabb aur saccha mabood hai. Jaise Qurani irshad hai ke tumhara Rabb sirf wahi hai jisne chhay din mein aasman-o-zameen ko paida kiya, phir Arsh par mustawi ho gaya. Raat ko din se, din ko raat se dhanpta hai, ek dusre ke barabar peeche ja aa raha hai. Suraj, chand aur taare sab uske farman ke tehat hain. Khalq-o-Amr usi ki malkiyat mein hain. Woh Rabb-ul-Aalameen hai, badi barkaton wala hai. Yeh toh bilkul namumkin sa maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (Alaihis Salam) ke yeh sab farman bator-e-waqia ke hon aur haqeeqat mein aap Allah ko pehchante hi na hon. Halankeh Allah Ta'ala farmata hai, aayat: (Wa laqad aatayna Ibrahima rushdahu min qablu wa kunna bihi alimeen) (21. Al-Anbiya: 51). Yani humne pehle se Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ko seedha rasta de diya tha aur hum us se khoob waqif thay jabkeh usne apne baap se aur apni qoum se farmaya yeh soortein kya hain jin ki tum parastish aur mujawarat kar rahe ho? Aur aayat mein hai, aayat: (Inna Ibrahima kana ummatan qanitan lillahi hanifan wa lam yaku minal mushrikeen) (16. An-Nahl: 120). Ibrahim (A.S) toh bade khuloos wale Allah ke sacche farmanbardar thay, woh mushrikon mein se na thay. Allah ki naimaton ke shukr guzar thay. Allah ne unhein pasand farma liya tha aur Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki hidayat di thi, duniya ki bhalaaiyan di thin aur aakhirat mein bhi unhein saleh logon mein mila diya tha. Ab hum teri taraf wahi kar rahe hain ke Ibrahim (A.S) Hanif ke deen ka tabe-dar reh, woh mushrik na tha. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai, Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke har baccha fitrat par paida hota hai. Sahih Muslim ki Hadith-e-Qudsi mein hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: "Maine apne bandon ko muwahid paida kiya hai." Kitabullah mein hai, aayat: (Fitratallahi allati fataran-nasa alaiha la tabdeela likhalqillahi zalikad deenul qayyimu wa lakinna aksaran-nasi la ya'lamoon) (30. Ar-Rum: 30). Allah Ta'ala ne logon ko Fitrat-e-Allah par paida kiya hai, Allah ki khalq ki tabdeeli nahin. Aur aayat mein hai, tere Rabb ne Adam (A.S) ki peeth se unki aulad nikal kar unhein unki jaanon par gawah kiya ke kya main tumhara sab ka Rabb nahin hoon? Sab ne iqrar kiya ke haan beshak tu hamara Rabb hai. Pas yahi Fitrat-e-Allah hai, jaise ke iska suboot anqareeb aayega Insha'Allah. Pas jabkeh tamam makhlooq ki paidaish Deen-e-Islam par, Allah ki sacchi tauheed par hai, toh Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) jin ki tauheed aur Allah parasti ka sana khwan khud Kalam-e-Rehman hai, unki nisbat kaun keh sakta hai ke aap Allah Jalla Shanuhu se aagah na thay aur kabhi taare ko aur kabhi chand suraj ko apna Allah samajh rahe thay? Nahin, nahin! Aap ki fitrat salim thi, aap ki aql sahih thi, aap Allah ke sacche deen par aur khalis tauheed par thay. Aap ka yeh tamam kalam bahaisiyat-e-munazra tha aur iski zabardast daleel iske baad ki aayat hai.

Mushrikeen ka tauheed se faraar. Ibrahim A.S ki sachi tauheed ke dalail sun kar phir bhi mushrikeen aap se behas jaari rakhte hain toh aap un se farmate hain ta'ajjub hai ke tum mujh se Allah Jalla Jalaluhu ke baare mein jhagda kar rahe ho? Halankeh woh yakta aur la-shareek hai us ne mujhe raah dikha di hai aur daleel ata farmayi hai main yaqeenan jaanta hoon ke tumhare yeh sab mabood mehez bebas aur be-taqat hain, main na toh tumhari fazool aur baatil baaton mein aaunga na tumhari dhamkiyan sachi jaanunga, jao tum se aur tumhare baatil maboodon se jo ho sake kar lo. Hargiz hargiz kami na karo balkeh jaldi kar guzro agar tumhare aur un ke qabze mein mera koi nuqsan hai toh jao pahuncha do. Mere Rab ki mansha baghair kuch bhi nahin ho sakta zarar nafa sab usi ki taraf se hai tamam cheezein usi ke ilm mein hain us par choti se choti cheez bhi posheeda nahin. Afsos itni daleelein sun kar bhi tumhare dil naseehat hasil nahin karte. Huzoor Hud A.S ne bhi apni qoum ke samne yahi daleel pesh ki thi. Quran mein majood hai ke un ki qoum ne un se kaha ae Hud tum koi daleel toh laye nahin ho aur sirf tumhare qaul se hum apne maboodon se dast-bardar nahin ho sakte na hum tujh par imaan layenge. Hamara apna khayal toh yeh hai ke hamare maboodon ne tujhe kuch kar diya hai. Aap ne jawab diya ke main Allah ko gawah karta hoon aur tum bhi gawah raho ke tum jin ko bhi Allah ka shareek thehra rahe ho, main sab se bezar hoon. Jao tum sab mil kar jo kuch makr mere sath karna chahte ho woh kar lo aur mujhe mohlat bhi na do, main ne toh us Rab par tawakkul kar liya hai jo tumhara mera sab ka palanhaar hai. Tamam jaandaron ki peshaniyan usi ke haath mein hain. Samjho aur socho toh sahi ke main tumhare in baatil maboodon se kyun daraunga? Jabkeh tum us akele Allah Wahdahu La-Shareek se nahin darte aur khullam khulla us ki zaat ke sath dusron ko shareek thehra rahe ho. Tum hi batlao ke hum tum mein se aman ka zyada haqdar kaun hai? Daleel mein aala kaun hai? Yeh aayat misl aayat (Am lahum shuraka'u falyatu bi-shurakaihim in kanu sadiqeen) (Surah Al-Qalam: 41) aur aayat (In hiya illa asma'un sammaitumuha antum wa aba'ukum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultan) (Surah An-Najm: 23) ke hai matlab yeh hai ke us ka banda jo khair-o-shar, ka nafa-o-zarar ka maalik hai aman wala hoga ya us ka banda jo mehez bebas aur be-qudrat hai Qayamat ke din ke azabon se aman mein rahega phir Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala farmata hai ke jo log sirf Allah hi ki ibadat karein aur khuloos ke sath deendari karein Rab ke sath kisi ko shareek na karein aman-o-aman aur raah-e-raast wale yahi log hain jab yeh aayat utri toh Sahaba R.A zulm ka lafz sun kar chaunk uthe aur kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hum mein se aisa kaun hai jis ne koi gunah hi na kiya ho? Is par aayat (Innash shirka la-zulmun azeem) (Surah Luqman: 13) nazil hui.

(Luqman: 13) nazil hui yani yahan murad zulm se shirk hai (Bukhari Sharif) aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ke is sawal par farmaya kya tum ne Allah ke nek bande ka yeh qaul nahin suna ke ae mere pyare bache Allah ke sath kisi ko sharik na karna shirk bada bhari zulm hai. Pas murad yahan zulm se shirk hai aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh bhi farmaya ke tum jo samajh rahe ho woh maqsad nahin aur hadith mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka khud zulm ki tafsir ba-shirk se karna marwi hai. Bohat se sahabiyon se bohat si sanadon ke sath bohat si kitabon mein yeh hadith marwi hai. Ek riwayat mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke mujh se kaha gaya ke tu un hi logon mein se hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Zazan aur Jarir (R.A) se marwi hai ke ae baap kya aap Azar but ko mabood maante hain? Lekin yeh door ki baat hai khilaf-e-lughat hai kyunke harf-e-istifham ke baad wala apne se pehle wale mein aamil nahin hota is liye ke us ke liye ibtida-e-kalam ka haq hai, arabi ka yeh to mashhoor qaida hai, al-gharaz Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) apne baap ko wa'z suna rahe hain aur unhein but-parasti se rok rahe hain lekin woh baaz na aaye. Aap farmate hain ke yeh to nihayat buri baat hai ke tum ek but ke samne iltija aur aajizi karo. Jo Allah Ta'ala ka haq hai yaqeenan is maslak ke log sab ke sab behke hue aur rah bhatke hue hain aur ayat mein hai ke Siddiq Nabi Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) ne apne walid se farmaya aba aap in ki parastish kyun karte hain jo na sunen na dekhen na kuch faida pahunchayen, aba main aap ko woh khari baat sunata hoon jo ab tak aap ke ilm mein nahin aayi thi, aap meri baat maan lijiye main aap ko sahi rah ki rehnumai karunga, aba shaitan ki ibadat se hat jaiye, woh to Rahman ka nafarman hai, aba mujhe to dar lagta hai ke kahin aisa na ho aap par Allah ka koi azab aa jaye aur aap shaitan ke rafiq-e-kar ban jayen. Baap ne jawab diya ke Ibrahim kya tu mere maboodon se naraz hai? Sun agar tu is se baaz na aaya to main tujhe sangsar kar doonga, pas ab tu mujh se alag ho ja.

Aap ne farmaya achha mera salam lo main toh ab bhi apne Parwardigar se tumhari maafi ki darkhwast karunga woh mujh par bahut meharban hai, main tum sab ko aur tumhare in maboodon ko jo Allah ke siwa hain chhodta hoon apne Rabb ki ibadat mein mashghool hota hoon namumkin hai ke main us ki ibadat bhi karoon aur phir benaseeb aur khali hath rahoon chunancha hasb-e-wada Khalilullah apne walid ki zindagi tak istighfar karte rahe lekin jabke marte hue bhi woh shirk se baaz na aaye toh aap ne istighfar band kar diya aur bezar ho gaye, chunancha Quran-e-Kareem mein hai Hazrat Ibrahim ka apne baap ke liye istighfar karna ek wade ki bina par tha jab aap par yeh khul gaya ke woh dushman-e-Allah hai toh aap us se bezar aur bari ho gaye, Ibrahim bade hi Allah se darne wale narm dil haleem-ul-tab'a thay, hadith-e-sahih mein hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) Qayamat ke din apne baap Aazar se mulaqat karenge Aazar aap ko dekh kar kahega beta aaj main teri kisi baat ki mukhalifat na karunga, aap Allah Ta'ala se dua karenge ke Aye Allah tu ne mujh se wada kiya hai ke Qayamat ke din tu mujhe ruswa na karega is se zyada ruswai kya hogi ke mera baap rahmat se door kar diya jaye, aap se farmaya jayega ke tum apne peeche ki taraf dekho, dekhenge ke ek bajoo keechad mein lathda khada hai us ke paon pakde jayenge aur aag mein daal diya jayega, makhlooq ko dekh kar Khaliq ki wahdaniyat samajh mein aa jaye is liye hum ne Ibrahim ko aasman-o-zameen ki makhlooq dikha di jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (Awalama yanzuru fi malakutis samawati wal ardi wa ma khalaqallahu min shai'in wa an 'asa an yakuna qad iqtaraba ajaluhum) (Surah Al-A'raf: 185) aur jagah hai ayat (Afalam yarau ila ma baina aidihim wa ma khalfahum minas samai wal ardi in nasha nakhsif bihimul arda au nusqit 'alaihim kisafan minas samai) (Surah Saba: 9) yani logon ko aasman-o-zameen ki makhlooq par ibrat ki nazrein dalni chahiyein unhein apne aage peeche aasman-o-zameen ko dekhna chahiye agar hum chahein toh unhein zameen mein dhansa dein agar chahein aasman ka tukda un par gira dein raghbat-o-rujoo wale bandon ke liye is mein nishaniyan hain. Mujahid wagaira se manqool hai ke aasman Hazrat Ibrahim ke samne khol diye gaye Arsh tak aap ki nazrein pahunchin. Hijab utha diye gaye aur aap ne sab kuch dekha, bandon ko gunahon mein dekh kar un ke liye bad-dua karne lage toh Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya tujh se zyada main un par Raheem hoon bahut mumkin hai ke yeh tauba kar lein aur bad-aamaliyon se hat jayein. Pas yeh dikhlana mauqoof kar diya gaya mumkin hai yeh kashf ke taur par ho aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke is se murad maloom karana aur haqaiq se muta'arif kara dena ho.

Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Tirmidhi ki ek hadith mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khwab ka zikr hai ke mere paas mera Rab bahut achi surat mein aaya aur mujh se daryaft farmaya ke unchi jamaat ke farishtay is waqt kis baaray mein guftagu kar rahe hain? Main ne apni la-ilmi zahir ki toh Allah Ta'ala ne apni hatheli meri dono bazuo'n ke darmiyan rakh di yahan tak ke us ki puriyon Rab ki baat sadiq aa gayi hai un ke paas chaahay tum tamam nishaniyan le aao phir bhi unhein iman naseeb nahin hoga yahan tak ke woh apni aankhon se azab dekh lein. Pas Rab ki hikmat aur us ke ilm mein koi shuba nahin.

Mushrikeen ka tauheed se faraar. Ibrahim A.S ki sachi tauheed ke dalail sun kar phir bhi mushrikeen aap se behas jaari rakhte hain toh aap un se farmate hain ta'ajjub hai ke tum mujh se Allah Jalla Jalaluhu ke baare mein jhagda kar rahe ho? Halankeh woh yakta aur la-shareek hai us ne mujhe raah dikha di hai aur daleel ata farmayi hai main yaqeenan jaanta hoon ke tumhare yeh sab mabood mehez bebas aur be-taqat hain, main na toh tumhari fazool aur baatil baaton mein aaunga na tumhari dhamkiyan sachi jaanunga, jao tum se aur tumhare baatil maboodon se jo ho sake kar lo. Hargiz hargiz kami na karo balkeh jaldi kar guzro agar tumhare aur un ke qabze mein mera koi nuqsan hai toh jao pahuncha do. Mere Rab ki mansha baghair kuch bhi nahin ho sakta zarar nafa sab usi ki taraf se hai tamam cheezein usi ke ilm mein hain us par choti se choti cheez bhi posheeda nahin. Afsos itni daleelein sun kar bhi tumhare dil naseehat hasil nahin karte. Huzoor Hud A.S ne bhi apni qoum ke samne yahi daleel pesh ki thi. Quran mein majood hai ke un ki qoum ne un se kaha ae Hud tum koi daleel toh laye nahin ho aur sirf tumhare qaul se hum apne maboodon se dast-bardar nahin ho sakte na hum tujh par imaan layenge. Hamara apna khayal toh yeh hai ke hamare maboodon ne tujhe kuch kar diya hai. Aap ne jawab diya ke main Allah ko gawah karta hoon aur tum bhi gawah raho ke tum jin ko bhi Allah ka shareek thehra rahe ho, main sab se bezar hoon. Jao tum sab mil kar jo kuch makr mere sath karna chahte ho woh kar lo aur mujhe mohlat bhi na do, main ne toh us Rab par tawakkul kar liya hai jo tumhara mera sab ka palanhaar hai. Tamam jaandaron ki peshaniyan usi ke haath mein hain. Samjho aur socho toh sahi ke main tumhare in baatil maboodon se kyun daraunga? Jabkeh tum us akele Allah Wahdahu La-Shareek se nahin darte aur khullam khulla us ki zaat ke sath dusron ko shareek thehra rahe ho. Tum hi batlao ke hum tum mein se aman ka zyada haqdar kaun hai? Daleel mein aala kaun hai? Yeh aayat misl aayat (Am lahum shuraka'u falyatu bi-shurakaihim in kanu sadiqeen) (Surah Al-Qalam: 41) aur aayat (In hiya illa asma'un sammaitumuha antum wa aba'ukum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultan) (Surah An-Najm: 23) ke hai matlab yeh hai ke us ka banda jo khair-o-shar, ka nafa-o-zarar ka maalik hai aman wala hoga ya us ka banda jo mehez bebas aur be-qudrat hai Qayamat ke din ke azabon se aman mein rahega phir Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala farmata hai ke jo log sirf Allah hi ki ibadat karein aur khuloos ke sath deendari karein Rab ke sath kisi ko shareek na karein aman-o-aman aur raah-e-raast wale yahi log hain jab yeh aayat utri toh Sahaba R.A zulm ka lafz sun kar chaunk uthe aur kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hum mein se aisa kaun hai jis ne koi gunah hi na kiya ho? Is par aayat (Innash shirka la-zulmun azeem) (Surah Luqman: 13) nazil hui.

(Luqman: 13) nazil hui yani yahan murad zulm se shirk hai (Bukhari Sharif) aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ke is sawal par farmaya kya tum ne Allah ke nek bande ka yeh qaul nahin suna ke ae mere pyare bache Allah ke sath kisi ko sharik na karna shirk bada bhari zulm hai. Pas murad yahan zulm se shirk hai aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh bhi farmaya ke tum jo samajh rahe ho woh maqsad nahin aur hadith mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka khud zulm ki tafsir ba-shirk se karna marwi hai. Bohat se sahabiyon se bohat si sanadon ke sath bohat si kitabon mein yeh hadith marwi hai. Ek riwayat mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke mujh se kaha gaya ke tu un hi logon mein se hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Zazan aur Jarir (R.A) se marwi hai ke ae baap kya aap Azar but ko mabood maante hain? Lekin yeh door ki baat hai khilaf-e-lughat hai kyunke harf-e-istifham ke baad wala apne se pehle wale mein aamil nahin hota is liye ke us ke liye ibtida-e-kalam ka haq hai, arabi ka yeh to mashhoor qaida hai, al-gharaz Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) apne baap ko wa'z suna rahe hain aur unhein but-parasti se rok rahe hain lekin woh baaz na aaye. Aap farmate hain ke yeh to nihayat buri baat hai ke tum ek but ke samne iltija aur aajizi karo. Jo Allah Ta'ala ka haq hai yaqeenan is maslak ke log sab ke sab behke hue aur rah bhatke hue hain aur ayat mein hai ke Siddiq Nabi Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) ne apne walid se farmaya aba aap in ki parastish kyun karte hain jo na sunen na dekhen na kuch faida pahunchayen, aba main aap ko woh khari baat sunata hoon jo ab tak aap ke ilm mein nahin aayi thi, aap meri baat maan lijiye main aap ko sahi rah ki rehnumai karunga, aba shaitan ki ibadat se hat jaiye, woh to Rahman ka nafarman hai, aba mujhe to dar lagta hai ke kahin aisa na ho aap par Allah ka koi azab aa jaye aur aap shaitan ke rafiq-e-kar ban jayen. Baap ne jawab diya ke Ibrahim kya tu mere maboodon se naraz hai? Sun agar tu is se baaz na aaya to main tujhe sangsar kar doonga, pas ab tu mujh se alag ho ja.

Aap ne farmaya achha mera salam lo main toh ab bhi apne Parwardigar se tumhari maafi ki darkhwast karunga woh mujh par bahut meharban hai, main tum sab ko aur tumhare in maboodon ko jo Allah ke siwa hain chhodta hoon apne Rabb ki ibadat mein mashghool hota hoon namumkin hai ke main us ki ibadat bhi karoon aur phir benaseeb aur khali hath rahoon chunancha hasb-e-wada Khalilullah apne walid ki zindagi tak istighfar karte rahe lekin jabke marte hue bhi woh shirk se baaz na aaye toh aap ne istighfar band kar diya aur bezar ho gaye, chunancha Quran-e-Kareem mein hai Hazrat Ibrahim ka apne baap ke liye istighfar karna ek wade ki bina par tha jab aap par yeh khul gaya ke woh dushman-e-Allah hai toh aap us se bezar aur bari ho gaye, Ibrahim bade hi Allah se darne wale narm dil haleem-ul-tab'a thay, hadith-e-sahih mein hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) Qayamat ke din apne baap Aazar se mulaqat karenge Aazar aap ko dekh kar kahega beta aaj main teri kisi baat ki mukhalifat na karunga, aap Allah Ta'ala se dua karenge ke Aye Allah tu ne mujh se wada kiya hai ke Qayamat ke din tu mujhe ruswa na karega is se zyada ruswai kya hogi ke mera baap rahmat se door kar diya jaye, aap se farmaya jayega ke tum apne peeche ki taraf dekho, dekhenge ke ek bajoo keechad mein lathda khada hai us ke paon pakde jayenge aur aag mein daal diya jayega, makhlooq ko dekh kar Khaliq ki wahdaniyat samajh mein aa jaye is liye hum ne Ibrahim ko aasman-o-zameen ki makhlooq dikha di jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (Awalama yanzuru fi malakutis samawati wal ardi wa ma khalaqallahu min shai'in wa an 'asa an yakuna qad iqtaraba ajaluhum) (Surah Al-A'raf: 185) aur jagah hai ayat (Afalam yarau ila ma baina aidihim wa ma khalfahum minas samai wal ardi in nasha nakhsif bihimul arda au nusqit 'alaihim kisafan minas samai) (Surah Saba: 9) yani logon ko aasman-o-zameen ki makhlooq par ibrat ki nazrein dalni chahiyein unhein apne aage peeche aasman-o-zameen ko dekhna chahiye agar hum chahein toh unhein zameen mein dhansa dein agar chahein aasman ka tukda un par gira dein raghbat-o-rujoo wale bandon ke liye is mein nishaniyan hain. Mujahid wagaira se manqool hai ke aasman Hazrat Ibrahim ke samne khol diye gaye Arsh tak aap ki nazrein pahunchin. Yeh aayat misl aayat (Am lahum shuraka'u falyatu bi-shurakaihim in kanu sadiqeen) (Surah Al-Qalam: 41) aur aayat (In hiya illa asma'un sammaitumuha antum wa aba'ukum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultan) (Surah An-Najm: 23) ke hai matlab yeh hai ke us ka banda jo khair-o-shar, ka nafa-o-zarar ka maalik hai aman wala hoga ya us ka banda jo mehez bebas aur be-qudrat hai Qayamat ke din ke azabon se aman mein rahega phir Janab-e-Bari Ta'ala farmata hai ke jo log sirf Allah hi ki ibadat karein aur khuloos ke sath deendari karein Rab ke sath kisi ko shareek na karein aman-o-aman aur raah-e-raast wale yahi log hain jab yeh aayat utri toh Sahaba R.A zulm ka lafz sun kar chaunk uthe aur kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hum mein se aisa kaun hai jis ne koi gunah hi na kiya ho? Is par aayat (Innash shirka la-zulmun azeem) (Surah Luqman: 13) nazil hui.

(Luqman: 13) nazil hui yani yahan murad zulm se shirk hai (Bukhari Sharif) aur riwayat mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne un ke is sawal par farmaya kya tum ne Allah ke nek bande ka yeh qaul nahin suna ke ae mere pyare bache Allah ke sath kisi ko sharik na karna shirk bada bhari zulm hai. Pas murad yahan zulm se shirk hai aur riwayat mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh bhi farmaya ke tum jo samajh rahe ho woh maqsad nahin aur hadith mein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka khud zulm ki tafsir ba-shirk se karna marwi hai. Bohat se sahabiyon se bohat si sanadon ke sath bohat si kitabon mein yeh hadith marwi hai. Ek riwayat mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke mujh se kaha gaya ke tu un hi logon mein se hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein Zazan aur Jarir (R.A) se marwi hai ke ae baap kya aap Azar but ko mabood maante hain? Lekin yeh door ki baat hai khilaf-e-lughat hai kyunke harf-e-istifham ke baad wala apne se pehle wale mein aamil nahin hota is liye ke us ke liye ibtida-e-kalam ka haq hai, arabi ka yeh to mashhoor qaida hai, al-gharaz Hazrat Ibrahim Khalilullah (A.S) apne baap ko wa'z suna rahe hain aur unhein but-parasti se rok rahe hain lekin woh baaz na aaye. Aap farmate hain ke yeh to nihayat buri baat hai ke tum ek but ke samne iltija aur aajizi karo. Jo Allah Ta'ala ka haq hai yaqeenan is maslak ke log sab ke sab behke hue aur rah bhatke hue hain aur ayat mein hai ke Siddiq Nabi Ibrahim Khalil (A.S) ne apne walid se farmaya aba aap in ki parastish kyun karte hain jo na sunen na dekhen na kuch faida pahunchayen, aba main aap ko woh khari baat sunata hoon jo ab tak aap ke ilm mein nahin aayi thi, aap meri baat maan lijiye main aap ko sahi rah ki rehnumai karunga, aba shaitan ki ibadat se hat jaiye, woh to Rahman ka nafarman hai, aba mujhe to dar lagta hai ke kahin aisa na ho aap par Allah ka koi azab aa jaye aur aap shaitan ke rafiq-e-kar ban jayen. Baap ne jawab diya ke Ibrahim kya tu mere maboodon se naraz hai? Sun agar tu is se baaz na aaya to main tujhe sangsar kar doonga, pas ab tu mujh se alag ho ja.

Aap ne farmaya achha mera salam lo main toh ab bhi apne Parwardigar se tumhari maafi ki darkhwast karunga woh mujh par bahut meharban hai, main tum sab ko aur tumhare in maboodon ko jo Allah ke siwa hain chhodta hoon apne Rabb ki ibadat mein mashghool hota hoon namumkin hai ke main us ki ibadat bhi karoon aur phir benaseeb aur khali hath rahoon chunancha hasb-e-wada Khalilullah apne walid ki zindagi tak istighfar karte rahe lekin jabke marte hue bhi woh shirk se baaz na aaye toh aap ne istighfar band kar diya aur bezar ho gaye, chunancha Quran-e-Kareem mein hai Hazrat Ibrahim ka apne baap ke liye istighfar karna ek wade ki bina par tha jab aap par yeh khul gaya ke woh dushman-e-Allah hai toh aap us se bezar aur bari ho gaye, Ibrahim bade hi Allah se darne wale narm dil haleem-ul-tab'a thay, hadith-e-sahih mein hai ke Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) Qayamat ke din apne baap Aazar se mulaqat karenge Aazar aap ko dekh kar kahega beta aaj main teri kisi baat ki mukhalifat na karunga, aap Allah Ta'ala se dua karenge ke Aye Allah tu ne mujh se wada kiya hai ke Qayamat ke din tu mujhe ruswa na karega is se zyada ruswai kya hogi ke mera baap rahmat se door kar diya jaye, aap se farmaya jayega ke tum apne peeche ki taraf dekho, dekhenge ke ek bajoo keechad mein lathda khada hai us ke paon pakde jayenge aur aag mein daal diya jayega, makhlooq ko dekh kar Khaliq ki wahdaniyat samajh mein aa jaye is liye hum ne Ibrahim ko aasman-o-zameen ki makhlooq dikha di jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (Awalama yanzuru fi malakutis samawati wal ardi wa ma khalaqallahu min shai'in wa an 'asa an yakuna qad iqtaraba ajaluhum) (Surah Al-A'raf: 185) aur jagah hai ayat (Afalam yarau ila ma baina aidihim wa ma khalfahum minas samai wal ardi in nasha nakhsif bihimul arda au nusqit 'alaihim kisafan minas samai) (Surah Saba: 9) yani logon ko aasman-o-zameen ki makhlooq par ibrat ki nazrein dalni chahiyein unhein apne aage peeche aasman-o-zameen ko dekhna chahiye agar hum chahein toh unhein zameen mein dhansa dein agar chahein aasman ka tukda un par gira dein raghbat-o-rujoo wale bandon ke liye is mein nishaniyan hain. Mujahid wagaira se manqool hai ke aasman Hazrat Ibrahim ke samne khol diye gaye Arsh tak aap ki nazrein pahunchin. Hijab utha diye gaye aur aap ne sab kuch dekha, bandon ko gunahon mein dekh kar un ke liye bad-dua karne lage toh Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya tujh se zyada main un par Raheem hoon bahut mumkin hai ke yeh tauba kar lein aur bad-aamaliyon se hat jayein. Pas yeh dikhlana mauqoof kar diya gaya mumkin hai yeh kashf ke taur par ho aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke is se murad maloom karana aur haqaiq se muta'arif kara dena ho.

Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad aur Tirmidhi ki ek hadith mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khwab ka zikr hai ke mere paas mera Rab bahut achi surat mein aaya aur mujh se daryaft farmaya ke unchi jamaat ke farishtay is waqt kis baaray mein guftagu kar rahe hain? Main ne apni la-ilmi zahir ki toh Allah Ta'ala ne apni hatheli meri dono bazuo'n ke darmiyan rakh di yahan tak ke us ki puriyon Rab ki baat sadiq aa gayi hai un ke paas chaahay tum tamam nishaniyan le aao phir bhi unhein iman naseeb nahin hoga yahan tak ke woh apni aankhon se azab dekh lein. Pas Rab ki hikmat aur us ke ilm mein koi shuba nahin.

Khalil-ur-Rahman ko basharat-e-aulad. Allah Ta'ala apna ehsan bayan farma raha hai ke Khalil-ur-Rahman ko us ne un ke burhapay ke waqt beta ata farmaya jin ka naam Ishaq (A.S) hai. Us waqt aap bhi aulad se mayoos ho chuke thay aur aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Sarah (R.A) bhi mayoos ho chuki thin. Jo farishtay basharat sunanay aatay hain woh Qaum-e-Loot ki halakat ke liye ja rahay thay. Un se basharat sun kar mai sahiba sakht muta'ajib ho kar kehti hain main burhiya khosat ho chuki, mere khawand umar se utar chukay, hamaray yahan bacha hona ta'ajub ki baat hai. Farishton ne jawab diya Allah ki qudrat mein aisay ta'ajubat aam hotay hain. Ae Nabi ke gharanay walo tum par Rabb ki rahmatain aur barkatain nazil hon, Allah bari tareefon wala aur bari buzurgi wala hai. Itna hi nahin ke tumharay yahan bacha hoga balkay woh Nabi-zada khud bhi Nabi hoga aur us se tumhari nasl phailey gi aur baqi rahay gi. Quran ki aur ayat mein basharat ke alfaaz mein "Nabiyan" ka lafz bhi hai. Phir lutf yeh hai ke aulad ki aulad bhi tum dekh lo ge, Ishaq (A.S) ke ghar Yaqub (A.S) paida hon ge aur tumhain khushi par khushi hogi aur phir potay ka naam Yaqub rakhna jo "Aqab" se mushtaq hai, khushkhabri hai is amr ki ke yeh nasl jaari rahay gi. Fi-al-waqai Khalilullah (A.S) is basharat ke qabil bhi thay, qaum ko chora, un se munh mora, shehar ko chora, hijrat ki. Allah ne duniya mein bhi inaam diye, itni nasl phailai jo aaj tak duniya mein abad hai. Farman-e-Ilahi hai ke jab Ibrahim (A.S) ne apni qaum ko aur un ke maboodon ko chora to hum ne unhain Ishaq (A.S) o Yaqub (A.S) bakhsha aur dono ko Nabi banaya. Yahan farmaya un sab ko hum ne hidayat di thi aur un ki bhi nek aulad duniya mein baqi rahi. Toofan-e-Nooh mein kuffar sab gharq ho gaye phir Hazrat Nooh (A.S) ki nasl phaili, ambiya unhi ki nasl mein se hotay rahay. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke baad to nabuwwat unhi ke gharanay mein rahi jaise farman hai ayat: (Waja'alna fi zurriyatihi an-nubuwwata wal-kitaba wa ataynahu ajrahu fid-dunya) (29. Al-Ankabut: 27) hum ne un hi ki aulad mein nabuwwat aur kitab rakhi. Aur ayat mein hai: (Walaqad arsalna Noohan wa Ibrahima wa ja'alna fi zurriyatihima an-nubuwwata wal-kitaba faminhum muhtadin wa kathirum minhum fasiqoon) (57. Al-Hadid: 26) yani hum ne Nooh (A.S) aur Ibrahim (A.S) ko Rasool bana kar phir un hi dono ki aulad mein nabuwwat aur kitab kar di. Aur ayat mein hai yeh hain jin par inaam-e-Ilahi hua. Nabiyon mein se Adam (A.S) ki aulad mein se aur jinhein hum ne Nooh (A.S) ke sath kashti mein le liya tha aur Ibrahim (A.S) aur Israel (A.S) ki aulad mein se aur jinhein hum ne hidayat ki thi aur pasand kar liya tha, un par jab Rahman ki aayatein parhi jati thin to rotay girgiratay sajday mein gir partay thay. Phir farmaya hum ne is ki aulad mein se Dawood (A.S) o Sulaiman (A.S) ko hidayat ki, is mein agar zameer ka marja' Nooh (A.S) ko kiya jaye to theek hai is liye ke zameer se pehlay sab se qareeb naam yahi hai.

Imam Ibn-e-Jarir R.H isi ko pasand farmate hain aur hai bhi yeh bilkul zahir jis mein koi ishkal nahin. Haan ise Hazrat Ibrahim A.S ki taraf lautana bhi hai toh achha, isliye ke kalam unhi ke bare mein hai, qissa unhi ka bayan ho raha hai. Lekin baad ke namon mein se Lut A.S ka naam aulad-e-Adam mein hona zara mushkil hai, isliye ke Hazrat Lut A.S, Khalilullah A.S ki aulad mein nahin, balkay unke walid ka naam Maran hai, woh Azar ke ladke thay toh woh aap ke bhatije hue. Haan iska jawab yeh ho sakta hai ke ba-aitbar-e-ghalbay ke unhein bhi aulad mein shamil kar liya gaya, jaise ke aayat (اَمْ كُنْتُمْ شُهَدَاۗءَ اِذْ حَضَرَ يَعْقُوْبَ الْمَوْتُ ۙ اِذْ قَالَ لِبَنِيْهِ مَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِيْ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 133) mein Hazrat Ismail A.S ko, jo aulad-e-Yaqoob A.S ke chacha thay, baapon mein shumar kar liya gaya hai. Haan yeh bhi khayal rahe ke Hazrat Isa A.S ko aulad-e-Ibrahim A.S ya aulad-e-Nooh A.S mein ginna is bina par hai ke ladkiyon ki aulad yani nawasay bhi aulad mein dakhil hain, kyunke Hazrat Isa A.S bin-baap ke paida hue thay. Riwayat mein hai Hajjaj ne Hazrat Yahya bin Ya'mar ke paas aadmi bheja ke mujhe maloom hua hai ke tu Hasan R.A aur Hussain R.A ko Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ki aulad mein ginta hai aur kehta hai ke yeh Quran se sabit hai, lekin main toh pooray Quran mein kisi jagah yeh nahin pata. Aap ne jawab diya kya tu ne Surah An'am mein aayat (وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهٖ دَاوٗدَ وَسُلَيْمٰنَ وَاَيُّوْبَ وَيُوْسُفَ وَمُوْسٰي وَهٰرُوْنَ ۭوَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ) (Surah Al-An'am: 84) nahin padha? Usne kaha haan yeh toh padha hai. Kaha phir dekho is mein Hazrat Isa A.S ka naam hai aur unka koi baap tha hi nahin, toh maloom hua ke ladki ki aulad bhi aulad hi hai. Hajjaj ne kaha beshak aap sachay hain. Isi liye masla hai ke jab koi shakhs apni zurriyat ke liye wasiyat kare ya waqf kare ya hiba kare toh ladkiyon ki aulad bhi is mein dakhil hai. Haan agar usne apne ladkon ko diya hai ya un par waqf kiya hai toh uske apne sulbi ladke aur ladkon ke ladke is mein shamil honge. Iski daleel Arabi shayar ka yeh sher suniye: Banuna banu abna'ina wa banatuna banu hunna abna'ur-rijali al-ajanib. Yani hamare ladkon ke ladke toh hamare ladke hain aur hamari ladkiyon ke ladke ajnabiyon ke ladke hain. Aur log kehte hain ke ladkiyon ke ladke bhi in mein dakhil hain kyunke Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hazrat Hasan bin Ali R.A ki nisbat farmaya: "Mera yeh ladka Sayyid hai aur Insha'Allah iski wajah se musalmanon ki do badi jamaton mein Allah Ta'ala sulah kara dega." Pas nawasay ko apna ladka kehne se ladkiyon ki aulad ka bhi apni aulad mein dakhil hona sabit hua aur log kehte hain ke yeh majaz hai. Iske baad farmaya unke baap-daday, unki auladein, unke bhai, al-gharaz usool-o-furoo aur ahl-e-tabqa ka zikr aa gaya ke hidayat aur pasandidagi in sab ko ghere hue hai, yeh Allah ki sachi aur seedhi raah par laga diye gaye hain.

Yeh jo kuch unhein hasil hua yeh Allah ki meherbani us ki taufiq aur us ki hidayat se hai. Phir shirk ka kamil burai logon ke zehan mein aajaye is liye farmaya ke agar bilfarz nabiyon ka yeh giroh bhi shirk kar baithe to un ki bhi tamam tar nekiyan zaya hojayengi jaise irshad hai ayat (Walaqad uhiya ilaika wa ilalladhina min qablika la'in ashrakta layahbattanna 'amaluka walatakunanna minal-khasirin) (Surah Az-Zumar: 65). Tujh par aur tujh se pehle ke ek ek nabi par yeh wahi bhej di gayi ke agar tu ne shirk kiya to tere a'mal akarat hojayenge. Yeh yaad rahe ke yeh shart hai aur shart ka waqay hona hi zaroori nahin jaise farman hai ayat (Qul in kana lir-Rahmani waladun fa'ana awwalul-'abidin) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 81). Ya'ni agar Allah ki aulad ho to main to sab se pehle manne wala ban jaunga aur jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (Law aradna an nattakhidha lahwan lattakhadhnahu min ladunna in kunna fa'ilin) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 17). Ya'ni agar khel tamasha banana hi chahte ho to apne paas se hi bana lete aur farman hai ayat (Law aradallahu an yattakhidha waladan lastafa mimma yakhluqu ma yasha'u subhanahu) (Surah Az-Zumar: 4). Agar Allah Ta'ala aulad ka hi irada karta to apni makhluq mein se jise chahta chun leta lekin woh is se pak hai aur woh yakta aur ghalib hai. Phir farmaya bandon par rahmat nazil farmane ke liye hum ne unhein kitab hikmat aur nabuwat ata farmayi. Pas agar yeh log ya'ni ahl-e-Makkah is ke sath ya'ni nabuwat ke sath ya kitab-o-hikmat-o-nabuwat ke sath kufr karein, yeh agar in ne'maton ka inkar karein khwah Quraish hon khwah ahl-e-kitab hon khwah koi aur arabi ya ajami hon to koi harj nahin. Hum ne ek qoum aisi bhi tayyar kar rakhi hai jo is ke sath kabhi kufr na karegi. Ya'ni muhajireen, ansar aur un ki tabedari karne wale un ke baad aane wale. Yeh log na kisi amr ka inkar karenge na tahrif ya radd-o-badal karenge balkeh iman-e-kamil le aayenge, har har harf ko manenge, muhkam mutashabeh sab ka iqrar karenge, sab par aqida rakhenge. Allah Ta'ala hamein bhi apne fazl-o-karam se in hi ba-iman logon mein kar de. Phir apne paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab kar ke farmata hai jin ambiya-e-kiram (Alaihimas Salam) ka zikr hua aur jo mujmal taur par un ke baron chhoton aur lawahiqeen mein se mazkoor hue yahi sab ahl-e-hidayat hain to apne nabi-e-akhir-uz-zaman hi ki iqtida aur itteba' karo aur jab yeh hukm nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hai to zahir hai ke aap ki ummat bator-e-aula is mein dakhil hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is ayat ki tafsir mein hadith laye hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se aap ke shagird-e-rashid Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne sawal kiya ke kya Surah Sad mein sajda hai? Aap ne farmaya haan hai phir aap ne yeh ayat tilawat farmayi aur farmaya An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un ki tabedari ka hukm hua hai.

Phir farmata hai ke ae Nabi! In mein elaan kar do ke yeh main toh Quran pahunchane ka koi muawza ya badla ya ujrat tum se nahin chahta. Yeh toh sirf duniya ke liye nasihat hai ke woh andhe-pan ko chhod kar aankhon ka noor hasil kar lein aur burai se kat kar bhalai pa lein aur kufr se nikal kar imaan mein aa jayen.

Haan yeh bhi khayal rahe ke Hazrat Isa A.S ko aulad-e-Ibrahim A.S ya aulad-e-Nooh A.S mein ginna is bina par hai ke ladkiyon ki aulad yani nawasay bhi aulad mein dakhil hain, kyunke Hazrat Isa A.S bin-baap ke paida hue thay. Riwayat mein hai Hajjaj ne Hazrat Yahya bin Ya'mar ke paas aadmi bheja ke mujhe maloom hua hai ke tu Hasan R.A aur Hussain R.A ko Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ki aulad mein ginta hai aur kehta hai ke yeh Quran se sabit hai, lekin main toh pooray Quran mein kisi jagah yeh nahin pata. Aap ne jawab diya kya tu ne Surah An'am mein aayat (وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهٖ دَاوٗدَ وَسُلَيْمٰنَ وَاَيُّوْبَ وَيُوْسُفَ وَمُوْسٰي وَهٰرُوْنَ ۭوَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ) (Surah Al-An'am: 84) nahin padha? Usne kaha haan yeh toh padha hai. Kaha phir dekho is mein Hazrat Isa A.S ka naam hai aur unka koi baap tha hi nahin, toh maloom hua ke ladki ki aulad bhi aulad hi hai. Hajjaj ne kaha beshak aap sachay hain. Isi liye masla hai ke jab koi shakhs apni zurriyat ke liye wasiyat kare ya waqf kare ya hiba kare toh ladkiyon ki aulad bhi is mein dakhil hai. Haan agar usne apne ladkon ko diya hai ya un par waqf kiya hai toh uske apne sulbi ladke aur ladkon ke ladke is mein shamil honge. Iski daleel Arabi shayar ka yeh sher suniye: Banuna banu abna'ina wa banatuna banu hunna abna'ur-rijali al-ajanib. Yani hamare ladkon ke ladke toh hamare ladke hain aur hamari ladkiyon ke ladke ajnabiyon ke ladke hain. Aur log kehte hain ke ladkiyon ke ladke bhi in mein dakhil hain kyunke Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hazrat Hasan bin Ali R.A ki nisbat farmaya: "Mera yeh ladka Sayyid hai aur Insha'Allah iski wajah se musalmanon ki do badi jamaton mein Allah Ta'ala sulah kara dega." Pas nawasay ko apna ladka kehne se ladkiyon ki aulad ka bhi apni aulad mein dakhil hona sabit hua aur log kehte hain ke yeh majaz hai. Iske baad farmaya unke baap-daday, unki auladein, unke bhai, al-gharaz usool-o-furoo aur ahl-e-tabqa ka zikr aa gaya ke hidayat aur pasandidagi in sab ko ghere hue hai, yeh Allah ki sachi aur seedhi raah par laga diye gaye hain.

Yeh jo kuch unhein hasil hua yeh Allah ki meherbani us ki taufiq aur us ki hidayat se hai. Phir shirk ka kamil burai logon ke zehan mein aajaye is liye farmaya ke agar bilfarz nabiyon ka yeh giroh bhi shirk kar baithe to un ki bhi tamam tar nekiyan zaya hojayengi jaise irshad hai ayat (Walaqad uhiya ilaika wa ilalladhina min qablika la'in ashrakta layahbattanna 'amaluka walatakunanna minal-khasirin) (Surah Az-Zumar: 65). Tujh par aur tujh se pehle ke ek ek nabi par yeh wahi bhej di gayi ke agar tu ne shirk kiya to tere a'mal akarat hojayenge. Yeh yaad rahe ke yeh shart hai aur shart ka waqay hona hi zaroori nahin jaise farman hai ayat (Qul in kana lir-Rahmani waladun fa'ana awwalul-'abidin) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 81). Ya'ni agar Allah ki aulad ho to main to sab se pehle manne wala ban jaunga aur jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (Law aradna an nattakhidha lahwan lattakhadhnahu min ladunna in kunna fa'ilin) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 17). Ya'ni agar khel tamasha banana hi chahte ho to apne paas se hi bana lete aur farman hai ayat (Law aradallahu an yattakhidha waladan lastafa mimma yakhluqu ma yasha'u subhanahu) (Surah Az-Zumar: 4). Agar Allah Ta'ala aulad ka hi irada karta to apni makhluq mein se jise chahta chun leta lekin woh is se pak hai aur woh yakta aur ghalib hai. Phir farmaya bandon par rahmat nazil farmane ke liye hum ne unhein kitab hikmat aur nabuwat ata farmayi. Pas agar yeh log ya'ni ahl-e-Makkah is ke sath ya'ni nabuwat ke sath ya kitab-o-hikmat-o-nabuwat ke sath kufr karein, yeh agar in ne'maton ka inkar karein khwah Quraish hon khwah ahl-e-kitab hon khwah koi aur arabi ya ajami hon to koi harj nahin. Hum ne ek qoum aisi bhi tayyar kar rakhi hai jo is ke sath kabhi kufr na karegi. Ya'ni muhajireen, ansar aur un ki tabedari karne wale un ke baad aane wale. Yeh log na kisi amr ka inkar karenge na tahrif ya radd-o-badal karenge balkeh iman-e-kamil le aayenge, har har harf ko manenge, muhkam mutashabeh sab ka iqrar karenge, sab par aqida rakhenge. Allah Ta'ala hamein bhi apne fazl-o-karam se in hi ba-iman logon mein kar de. Phir apne paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab kar ke farmata hai jin ambiya-e-kiram (Alaihimas Salam) ka zikr hua aur jo mujmal taur par un ke baron chhoton aur lawahiqeen mein se mazkoor hue yahi sab ahl-e-hidayat hain to apne nabi-e-akhir-uz-zaman hi ki iqtida aur itteba' karo aur jab yeh hukm nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hai to zahir hai ke aap ki ummat bator-e-aula is mein dakhil hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is ayat ki tafsir mein hadith laye hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se aap ke shagird-e-rashid Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne sawal kiya ke kya Surah Sad mein sajda hai? Phir farmata hai ke ae Nabi! In mein elaan kar do ke yeh main toh Quran pahunchane ka koi muawza ya badla ya ujrat tum se nahin chahta. Yeh toh sirf duniya ke liye nasihat hai ke woh andhe-pan ko chhod kar aankhon ka noor hasil kar lein aur burai se kat kar bhalai pa lein aur kufr se nikal kar imaan mein aa jayen.

Haan yeh bhi khayal rahe ke Hazrat Isa A.S ko aulad-e-Ibrahim A.S ya aulad-e-Nooh A.S mein ginna is bina par hai ke ladkiyon ki aulad yani nawasay bhi aulad mein dakhil hain, kyunke Hazrat Isa A.S bin-baap ke paida hue thay. Riwayat mein hai Hajjaj ne Hazrat Yahya bin Ya'mar ke paas aadmi bheja ke mujhe maloom hua hai ke tu Hasan R.A aur Hussain R.A ko Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ki aulad mein ginta hai aur kehta hai ke yeh Quran se sabit hai, lekin main toh pooray Quran mein kisi jagah yeh nahin pata. Aap ne jawab diya kya tu ne Surah An'am mein aayat (وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهٖ دَاوٗدَ وَسُلَيْمٰنَ وَاَيُّوْبَ وَيُوْسُفَ وَمُوْسٰي وَهٰرُوْنَ ۭوَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ) (Surah Al-An'am: 84) nahin padha? Usne kaha haan yeh toh padha hai. Kaha phir dekho is mein Hazrat Isa A.S ka naam hai aur unka koi baap tha hi nahin, toh maloom hua ke ladki ki aulad bhi aulad hi hai. Hajjaj ne kaha beshak aap sachay hain. Isi liye masla hai ke jab koi shakhs apni zurriyat ke liye wasiyat kare ya waqf kare ya hiba kare toh ladkiyon ki aulad bhi is mein dakhil hai. Haan agar usne apne ladkon ko diya hai ya un par waqf kiya hai toh uske apne sulbi ladke aur ladkon ke ladke is mein shamil honge. Iski daleel Arabi shayar ka yeh sher suniye: Banuna banu abna'ina wa banatuna banu hunna abna'ur-rijali al-ajanib. Yani hamare ladkon ke ladke toh hamare ladke hain aur hamari ladkiyon ke ladke ajnabiyon ke ladke hain. Aur log kehte hain ke ladkiyon ke ladke bhi in mein dakhil hain kyunke Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hazrat Hasan bin Ali R.A ki nisbat farmaya: "Mera yeh ladka Sayyid hai aur Insha'Allah iski wajah se musalmanon ki do badi jamaton mein Allah Ta'ala sulah kara dega." Pas nawasay ko apna ladka kehne se ladkiyon ki aulad ka bhi apni aulad mein dakhil hona sabit hua aur log kehte hain ke yeh majaz hai. Iske baad farmaya unke baap-daday, unki auladein, unke bhai, al-gharaz usool-o-furoo aur ahl-e-tabqa ka zikr aa gaya ke hidayat aur pasandidagi in sab ko ghere hue hai, yeh Allah ki sachi aur seedhi raah par laga diye gaye hain.

Yeh jo kuch unhein hasil hua yeh Allah ki meherbani us ki taufiq aur us ki hidayat se hai. Phir shirk ka kamil burai logon ke zehan mein aajaye is liye farmaya ke agar bilfarz nabiyon ka yeh giroh bhi shirk kar baithe to un ki bhi tamam tar nekiyan zaya hojayengi jaise irshad hai ayat (Walaqad uhiya ilaika wa ilalladhina min qablika la'in ashrakta layahbattanna 'amaluka walatakunanna minal-khasirin) (Surah Az-Zumar: 65). Tujh par aur tujh se pehle ke ek ek nabi par yeh wahi bhej di gayi ke agar tu ne shirk kiya to tere a'mal akarat hojayenge. Yeh yaad rahe ke yeh shart hai aur shart ka waqay hona hi zaroori nahin jaise farman hai ayat (Qul in kana lir-Rahmani waladun fa'ana awwalul-'abidin) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 81). Ya'ni agar Allah ki aulad ho to main to sab se pehle manne wala ban jaunga aur jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (Law aradna an nattakhidha lahwan lattakhadhnahu min ladunna in kunna fa'ilin) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 17). Ya'ni agar khel tamasha banana hi chahte ho to apne paas se hi bana lete aur farman hai ayat (Law aradallahu an yattakhidha waladan lastafa mimma yakhluqu ma yasha'u subhanahu) (Surah Az-Zumar: 4). Agar Allah Ta'ala aulad ka hi irada karta to apni makhluq mein se jise chahta chun leta lekin woh is se pak hai aur woh yakta aur ghalib hai. Phir farmaya bandon par rahmat nazil farmane ke liye hum ne unhein kitab hikmat aur nabuwat ata farmayi. Pas agar yeh log ya'ni ahl-e-Makkah is ke sath ya'ni nabuwat ke sath ya kitab-o-hikmat-o-nabuwat ke sath kufr karein, yeh agar in ne'maton ka inkar karein khwah Quraish hon khwah ahl-e-kitab hon khwah koi aur arabi ya ajami hon to koi harj nahin. Hum ne ek qoum aisi bhi tayyar kar rakhi hai jo is ke sath kabhi kufr na karegi. Ya'ni muhajireen, ansar aur un ki tabedari karne wale un ke baad aane wale. Yeh log na kisi amr ka inkar karenge na tahrif ya radd-o-badal karenge balkeh iman-e-kamil le aayenge, har har harf ko manenge, muhkam mutashabeh sab ka iqrar karenge, sab par aqida rakhenge. Allah Ta'ala hamein bhi apne fazl-o-karam se in hi ba-iman logon mein kar de. Phir apne paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab kar ke farmata hai jin ambiya-e-kiram (Alaihimas Salam) ka zikr hua aur jo mujmal taur par un ke baron chhoton aur lawahiqeen mein se mazkoor hue yahi sab ahl-e-hidayat hain to apne nabi-e-akhir-uz-zaman hi ki iqtida aur itteba' karo aur jab yeh hukm nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hai to zahir hai ke aap ki ummat bator-e-aula is mein dakhil hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is ayat ki tafsir mein hadith laye hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se aap ke shagird-e-rashid Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne sawal kiya ke kya Surah Sad mein sajda hai? Phir farmata hai ke ae Nabi! In mein elaan kar do ke yeh main toh Quran pahunchane ka koi muawza ya badla ya ujrat tum se nahin chahta. Yeh toh sirf duniya ke liye nasihat hai ke woh andhe-pan ko chhod kar aankhon ka noor hasil kar lein aur burai se kat kar bhalai pa lein aur kufr se nikal kar imaan mein aa jayen.

Haan iska jawab yeh ho sakta hai ke ba-aitbar-e-ghalbay ke unhein bhi aulad mein shamil kar liya gaya, jaise ke aayat (اَمْ كُنْتُمْ شُهَدَاۗءَ اِذْ حَضَرَ يَعْقُوْبَ الْمَوْتُ ۙ اِذْ قَالَ لِبَنِيْهِ مَا تَعْبُدُوْنَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِيْ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 133) mein Hazrat Ismail A.S ko, jo aulad-e-Yaqoob A.S ke chacha thay, baapon mein shumar kar liya gaya hai. Haan yeh bhi khayal rahe ke Hazrat Isa A.S ko aulad-e-Ibrahim A.S ya aulad-e-Nooh A.S mein ginna is bina par hai ke ladkiyon ki aulad yani nawasay bhi aulad mein dakhil hain, kyunke Hazrat Isa A.S bin-baap ke paida hue thay. Riwayat mein hai Hajjaj ne Hazrat Yahya bin Ya'mar ke paas aadmi bheja ke mujhe maloom hua hai ke tu Hasan R.A aur Hussain R.A ko Aan-Hazrat ﷺ ki aulad mein ginta hai aur kehta hai ke yeh Quran se sabit hai, lekin main toh pooray Quran mein kisi jagah yeh nahin pata. Aap ne jawab diya kya tu ne Surah An'am mein aayat (وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِهٖ دَاوٗدَ وَسُلَيْمٰنَ وَاَيُّوْبَ وَيُوْسُفَ وَمُوْسٰي وَهٰرُوْنَ ۭوَكَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِيْنَ) (Surah Al-An'am: 84) nahin padha? Usne kaha haan yeh toh padha hai. Kaha phir dekho is mein Hazrat Isa A.S ka naam hai aur unka koi baap tha hi nahin, toh maloom hua ke ladki ki aulad bhi aulad hi hai. Hajjaj ne kaha beshak aap sachay hain. Isi liye masla hai ke jab koi shakhs apni zurriyat ke liye wasiyat kare ya waqf kare ya hiba kare toh ladkiyon ki aulad bhi is mein dakhil hai. Haan agar usne apne ladkon ko diya hai ya un par waqf kiya hai toh uske apne sulbi ladke aur ladkon ke ladke is mein shamil honge. Iski daleel Arabi shayar ka yeh sher suniye: Banuna banu abna'ina wa banatuna banu hunna abna'ur-rijali al-ajanib. Yani hamare ladkon ke ladke toh hamare ladke hain aur hamari ladkiyon ke ladke ajnabiyon ke ladke hain. Aur log kehte hain ke ladkiyon ke ladke bhi in mein dakhil hain kyunke Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki hadith mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne Hazrat Hasan bin Ali R.A ki nisbat farmaya: "Mera yeh ladka Sayyid hai aur Insha'Allah iski wajah se musalmanon ki do badi jamaton mein Allah Ta'ala sulah kara dega." Pas nawasay ko apna ladka kehne se ladkiyon ki aulad ka bhi apni aulad mein dakhil hona sabit hua aur log kehte hain ke yeh majaz hai. Iske baad farmaya unke baap-daday, unki auladein, unke bhai, al-gharaz usool-o-furoo aur ahl-e-tabqa ka zikr aa gaya ke hidayat aur pasandidagi in sab ko ghere hue hai, yeh Allah ki sachi aur seedhi raah par laga diye gaye hain.

Yeh jo kuch unhein hasil hua yeh Allah ki meherbani us ki taufiq aur us ki hidayat se hai. Phir shirk ka kamil burai logon ke zehan mein aajaye is liye farmaya ke agar bilfarz nabiyon ka yeh giroh bhi shirk kar baithe to un ki bhi tamam tar nekiyan zaya hojayengi jaise irshad hai ayat (Walaqad uhiya ilaika wa ilalladhina min qablika la'in ashrakta layahbattanna 'amaluka walatakunanna minal-khasirin) (Surah Az-Zumar: 65). Tujh par aur tujh se pehle ke ek ek nabi par yeh wahi bhej di gayi ke agar tu ne shirk kiya to tere a'mal akarat hojayenge. Yeh yaad rahe ke yeh shart hai aur shart ka waqay hona hi zaroori nahin jaise farman hai ayat (Qul in kana lir-Rahmani waladun fa'ana awwalul-'abidin) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 81). Ya'ni agar Allah ki aulad ho to main to sab se pehle manne wala ban jaunga aur jaise aur ayat mein hai ayat (Law aradna an nattakhidha lahwan lattakhadhnahu min ladunna in kunna fa'ilin) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 17). Ya'ni agar khel tamasha banana hi chahte ho to apne paas se hi bana lete aur farman hai ayat (Law aradallahu an yattakhidha waladan lastafa mimma yakhluqu ma yasha'u subhanahu) (Surah Az-Zumar: 4). Agar Allah Ta'ala aulad ka hi irada karta to apni makhluq mein se jise chahta chun leta lekin woh is se pak hai aur woh yakta aur ghalib hai. Phir farmaya bandon par rahmat nazil farmane ke liye hum ne unhein kitab hikmat aur nabuwat ata farmayi. Pas agar yeh log ya'ni ahl-e-Makkah is ke sath ya'ni nabuwat ke sath ya kitab-o-hikmat-o-nabuwat ke sath kufr karein, yeh agar in ne'maton ka inkar karein khwah Quraish hon khwah ahl-e-kitab hon khwah koi aur arabi ya ajami hon to koi harj nahin. Hum ne ek qoum aisi bhi tayyar kar rakhi hai jo is ke sath kabhi kufr na karegi. Ya'ni muhajireen, ansar aur un ki tabedari karne wale un ke baad aane wale. Yeh log na kisi amr ka inkar karenge na tahrif ya radd-o-badal karenge balkeh iman-e-kamil le aayenge, har har harf ko manenge, muhkam mutashabeh sab ka iqrar karenge, sab par aqida rakhenge. Allah Ta'ala hamein bhi apne fazl-o-karam se in hi ba-iman logon mein kar de. Phir apne paighambar (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se khitab kar ke farmata hai jin ambiya-e-kiram (Alaihimas Salam) ka zikr hua aur jo mujmal taur par un ke baron chhoton aur lawahiqeen mein se mazkoor hue yahi sab ahl-e-hidayat hain to apne nabi-e-akhir-uz-zaman hi ki iqtida aur itteba' karo aur jab yeh hukm nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hai to zahir hai ke aap ki ummat bator-e-aula is mein dakhil hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein is ayat ki tafsir mein hadith laye hain. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) se aap ke shagird-e-rashid Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah / R.H) ne sawal kiya ke kya Surah Sad mein sajda hai? Aap ne farmaya haan hai phir aap ne yeh ayat tilawat farmayi aur farmaya An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko un ki tabedari ka hukm hua hai.

Phir farmata hai ke ae Nabi! In mein elaan kar do ke yeh main toh Quran pahunchane ka koi muawza ya badla ya ujrat tum se nahin chahta. Yeh toh sirf duniya ke liye nasihat hai ke woh andhe-pan ko chhod kar aankhon ka noor hasil kar lein aur burai se kat kar bhalai pa lein aur kufr se nikal kar imaan mein aa jayen.

Khalil-ur-Rahman ko basharat-e-aulad. Allah Ta'ala apna ehsan bayan farma raha hai ke Khalil-ur-Rahman ko us ne un ke burhapay ke waqt beta ata farmaya jin ka naam Ishaq (A.S) hai. Us waqt aap bhi aulad se mayoos ho chuke thay aur aap ki biwi sahiba Hazrat Sarah (R.A) bhi mayoos ho chuki thin. Jo farishtay basharat sunanay aatay hain woh Qaum-e-Loot ki halakat ke liye ja rahay thay. Un se basharat sun kar mai sahiba sakht muta'ajib ho kar kehti hain main burhiya khosat ho chuki, mere khawand umar se utar chukay, hamaray yahan bacha hona ta'ajub ki baat hai. Farishton ne jawab diya Allah ki qudrat mein aisay ta'ajubat aam hotay hain. Ae Nabi ke gharanay walo tum par Rabb ki rahmatain aur barkatain nazil hon, Allah bari tareefon wala aur bari buzurgi wala hai. Itna hi nahin ke tumharay yahan bacha hoga balkay woh Nabi-zada khud bhi Nabi hoga aur us se tumhari nasl phailey gi aur baqi rahay gi. Quran ki aur ayat mein basharat ke alfaaz mein "Nabiyan" ka lafz bhi hai. Phir lutf yeh hai ke aulad ki aulad bhi tum dekh lo ge, Ishaq (A.S) ke ghar Yaqub (A.S) paida hon ge aur tumhain khushi par khushi hogi aur phir potay ka naam Yaqub rakhna jo "Aqab" se mushtaq hai, khushkhabri hai is amr ki ke yeh nasl jaari rahay gi. Fi-al-waqai Khalilullah (A.S) is basharat ke qabil bhi thay, qaum ko chora, un se munh mora, shehar ko chora, hijrat ki. Allah ne duniya mein bhi inaam diye, itni nasl phailai jo aaj tak duniya mein abad hai. Farman-e-Ilahi hai ke jab Ibrahim (A.S) ne apni qaum ko aur un ke maboodon ko chora to hum ne unhain Ishaq (A.S) o Yaqub (A.S) bakhsha aur dono ko Nabi banaya. Yahan farmaya un sab ko hum ne hidayat di thi aur un ki bhi nek aulad duniya mein baqi rahi. Toofan-e-Nooh mein kuffar sab gharq ho gaye phir Hazrat Nooh (A.S) ki nasl phaili, ambiya unhi ki nasl mein se hotay rahay. Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke baad to nabuwwat unhi ke gharanay mein rahi jaise farman hai ayat: (Waja'alna fi zurriyatihi an-nubuwwata wal-kitaba wa ataynahu ajrahu fid-dunya) (29. Al-Ankabut: 27) hum ne un hi ki aulad mein nabuwwat aur kitab rakhi. Aur ayat mein hai: (Walaqad arsalna Noohan wa Ibrahima wa ja'alna fi zurriyatihima an-nubuwwata wal-kitaba faminhum muhtadin wa kathirum minhum fasiqoon) (57. Al-Hadid: 26) yani hum ne Nooh (A.S) aur Ibrahim (A.S) ko Rasool bana kar phir un hi dono ki aulad mein nabuwwat aur kitab kar di. Aur ayat mein hai yeh hain jin par inaam-e-Ilahi hua. Nabiyon mein se Adam (A.S) ki aulad mein se aur jinhein hum ne Nooh (A.S) ke sath kashti mein le liya tha aur Ibrahim (A.S) aur Israel (A.S) ki aulad mein se aur jinhein hum ne hidayat ki thi aur pasand kar liya tha, un par jab Rahman ki aayatein parhi jati thin to rotay girgiratay sajday mein gir partay thay. Phir farmaya hum ne is ki aulad mein se Dawood (A.S) o Sulaiman (A.S) ko hidayat ki, is mein agar zameer ka marja' Nooh (A.S) ko kiya jaye to theek hai is liye ke zameer se pehlay sab se qareeb naam yahi hai.

Tamam rasool insaan hi hain. Allah ke rasoolon ke jhutlane wale darasal Allah ki azmat ke manne wale nahin. Abdullah bin Kathir (R.H) kehte hain kuffar-e-Quraish ke haq mein yeh aayat utri hai aur qaul hai ke Yahood ki ek jamaat ke haq mein hai aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Fakhass Yahoodi ke haq mein aur yeh bhi hai ke Malik bin Saif ke bare mein kaha gaya hai. Sahih baat yeh hai ke pehla qaul haq is liye hai ke aayat Makkiyah hai aur is liye bhi ke Yahoodi aasman se kitab utarne ke bilkul munkir na thay, haan albatta Quraishi aur aam Arab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ke qail na thay aur kehte thay ke insaan Allah ka rasool nahin ho sakta jaise Quran un ka ta'ajjub naqal karta hai aayat (A-kana lin-nasi 'ajaban an au-hainaa ila rajulim minhum an an-zirin-nasa wa bash-shirillazina aamanu anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim) (10. Yunus: 2) yani kya logon ko is baat par ajambha hua ke hum ne unhi mein se ek shakhs ki taraf wahi nazool farmayi ke woh logon ko hoshiyar kar de aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa ma mana'an-nasa ay-yu'minu iz jaa-ahumul hudaa illaa an qalu aba'asallahu basharar rasula) (17. Al-Isra: 94) logon ke is khayal ne hi ke kya Allah ne insaan ko apna rasool bana liya unhein imaan se rok diya hai, suno agar zameen mein farishtay baste hote to hum bhi aasman se kisi farishtay ko rasool bana kar bhejte. Yahan bhi kuffar ka yahi aitraz bayan kar ke farmata hai ke unhein jawab do ke tum jo bilkul inkar karte ho ke kisi insaan par Allah Ta'ala ne kuch bhi nazil nahin farmaya yeh tumhari kaisi khuli ghalti hai? Bhala batlao Musa (A.S) par Taurat kis ne utari thi jo sarasar noor-o-hidayat thi. Al-gharaz Taurat ke tum sab qail ho jo mushkil masail aasan karne wali, kufr ke andheron ko chhaantne, shubha ko hatane aur rah-e-raast dikhane wali hai, tum ne is ke tukray tukray kar rakhe hain, sahih aur asli kitab mein se bohat sa hissa chhupa rakha hai, kuch is mein se likh late ho aur phir use bhi tahreef kar ke logon ko bata rahe ho, apni baton apne khayalat ko Allah ki kitab ki taraf mansoob karte ho, Quran to woh hai jo tumhare samne woh uloom pesh karta hai jin se tum aur tumhare aglay aur tumhare baray sab mehroom thay, pichli sachi khabrein is mein mojood, aane wale waqiyat ki sahih khabrein is mein mojood hain jo aaj tak duniya ke ilm mein nahin aayi thin. Kehte hain is se murad mushrikeen-e-Arab hain aur ba'az kehte hain is se murad musalman hain. Phir hukum deta hai ke yeh log to is ka jawab kya denge ke Taurat kis ne utari? To khud keh de ke Allah ne utari hai, phir unhein un ki jahalat-o-zalalat mein hi khelta hua chhor de yahan tak ke unhein maut aaye aur yaqeen ki aankhon se khud hi dekh lein ke is jahan mein yeh achhay rehte hain ya musalman muttaqi?

Yeh kitab yani Quran-e-Karim hamara utara hua hai, yeh babarakat hai yeh agli kitabon ki tasdeeq karne wala hai hum ne ise teri taraf is liye nazil farmaya ke tu Ahl-e-Makkah ko, is ke paas walon ko yani Arab ke qabail aur ajmiyon ko hoshiyar kar de aur darawa de de. Man haulaha se murad sari duniya hai aur ayat mein hai (Qul ya-ayyuhan-nasu inni rasulullahi ilaikum jami'anilladhi lahu mulkus-samawati wal-ard) (Surah Al-A'raf: 158) yani ae duniya jahan ke logo main tum sab ki taraf Allah ka paighambar hoon aur ayat mein hai (Wa uhiya ilayya hadhal-qur'anu li-undhirakum bihi wa man balagh) (Surah Al-An'am: 19) taake main tumhein bhi aur jise yeh pahunche use dara doon aur Quran suna kar azabon se khabardar kar doon aur farman hai ayat (Wa man yakfuru bihi minal-ahzabi fannaru maw'iduhu fala taku fi miryatin minhu innahul-haqqu mir-rabbika wa lakinna aktharan-nasi la yu'minun) (Surah Hud: 17) jo bhi is ke sath kufr kare is ka thikana jahannam hai aur ayat mein farmaya gaya ayat (Tabarakalladhi nazzalal-furqana 'ala 'abdihi liyakuna lil-'alamina nadhira) (Surah Al-Furqan: 1) yani Allah barkaton wala hai jis ne apne bande par Quran nazil farmaya taake woh tamam jahan walon ko aagah kar de aur ayat mein irshad hai ayat (Wa qul lilladhina utul-kitaba wal-ummiyyina a-aslamtum fa-in aslamu faqad-ihtadaw wa in tawallaw fa-innama 'alaikal-balaghu wallahu basirum-bil-'ibad) (Surah Al-Imran: 20) yani Ahl-e-Kitab se aur an-parhon se bas se keh do ke kya tum Islam qabool karte ho? Agar qabool kar lein to rah-e-rast par hain aur agar munh mor lein to tujh par to sirf pahuncha dena hai Allah apne bande ko khoob dekh raha hai, Bukhari o Muslim ki hadith mein hai Rasulullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mujhe paanch cheezein di gayi hain jo mujh se pehle kisi nabi ko nahin di gayin in ko bayan farmate hue ek yeh bayan farmaya ke har nabi sirf ek qoum ki taraf bheja jata tha lekin main tamam logon ki taraf bheja gaya hoon isi liye yahan bhi irshad hua ke Qayamat ke mu'taqid to ise maante hain jaante hain ke yeh Quran Allah ki sachi kitab hai aur woh namazein bhi sahi waqton par barabar parha karte hain Allah ke is farz ke qayam mein aur is ki hifazat mein susti aur kahili nahin karte.

Tamam rasool insaan hi hain. Allah ke rasoolon ke jhutlane wale darasal Allah ki azmat ke manne wale nahin. Abdullah bin Kathir (R.H) kehte hain kuffar-e-Quraish ke haq mein yeh aayat utri hai aur qaul hai ke Yahood ki ek jamaat ke haq mein hai aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke Fakhass Yahoodi ke haq mein aur yeh bhi hai ke Malik bin Saif ke bare mein kaha gaya hai. Sahih baat yeh hai ke pehla qaul haq is liye hai ke aayat Makkiyah hai aur is liye bhi ke Yahoodi aasman se kitab utarne ke bilkul munkir na thay, haan albatta Quraishi aur aam Arab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki risalat ke qail na thay aur kehte thay ke insaan Allah ka rasool nahin ho sakta jaise Quran un ka ta'ajjub naqal karta hai aayat (A-kana lin-nasi 'ajaban an au-hainaa ila rajulim minhum an an-zirin-nasa wa bash-shirillazina aamanu anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim) (10. Yunus: 2) yani kya logon ko is baat par ajambha hua ke hum ne unhi mein se ek shakhs ki taraf wahi nazool farmayi ke woh logon ko hoshiyar kar de aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa ma mana'an-nasa ay-yu'minu iz jaa-ahumul hudaa illaa an qalu aba'asallahu basharar rasula) (17. Al-Isra: 94) logon ke is khayal ne hi ke kya Allah ne insaan ko apna rasool bana liya unhein imaan se rok diya hai, suno agar zameen mein farishtay baste hote to hum bhi aasman se kisi farishtay ko rasool bana kar bhejte. Yahan bhi kuffar ka yahi aitraz bayan kar ke farmata hai ke unhein jawab do ke tum jo bilkul inkar karte ho ke kisi insaan par Allah Ta'ala ne kuch bhi nazil nahin farmaya yeh tumhari kaisi khuli ghalti hai? Bhala batlao Musa (A.S) par Taurat kis ne utari thi jo sarasar noor-o-hidayat thi. Al-gharaz Taurat ke tum sab qail ho jo mushkil masail aasan karne wali, kufr ke andheron ko chhaantne, shubha ko hatane aur rah-e-raast dikhane wali hai, tum ne is ke tukray tukray kar rakhe hain, sahih aur asli kitab mein se bohat sa hissa chhupa rakha hai, kuch is mein se likh late ho aur phir use bhi tahreef kar ke logon ko bata rahe ho, apni baton apne khayalat ko Allah ki kitab ki taraf mansoob karte ho, Quran to woh hai jo tumhare samne woh uloom pesh karta hai jin se tum aur tumhare aglay aur tumhare baray sab mehroom thay, pichli sachi khabrein is mein mojood, aane wale waqiyat ki sahih khabrein is mein mojood hain jo aaj tak duniya ke ilm mein nahin aayi thin. Kehte hain is se murad mushrikeen-e-Arab hain aur ba'az kehte hain is se murad musalman hain. Phir hukum deta hai ke yeh log to is ka jawab kya denge ke Taurat kis ne utari? Al-Ma'idah: 28) hai aur ayat mein (وَّيَبْسُطُوْٓا اِلَيْكُمْ اَيْدِيَهُمْ وَاَلْسِنَتَهُمْ بالسُّوْۗءِ وَوَدُّوْا لَوْ تَكْفُرُوْنَ) (60. Al-Mumtahinah: 2) hai. Zahhak aur Abu Saleh ne bhi yahi tafseer ki hai, khwah Quran ki ayat mein (يَضْرِبُوْنَ وُجُوْهَهُمْ وَاَدْبَارَهُمْ ۚ وَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ الْحَرِيْقِ) (8. Al-Anfal: 50) majood hai yani kafiron ki maut ke waqt farishte un ke munh par aur kamar par marte hain. Yahi bayan yahan hai ke farishte un ki jaan nikalne ke liye unhein maar peet karte hain aur kehte hain apni jaanein nikalo. Kafiron ki maut ke waqt farishte unhein azabon, zanjeeron, tauqon ki, garam kholte hue jahannam ke pani aur Allah ke ghazab-o-ghusse ki khabar sunate hain jis se un ki rooh un ke badan mein chhupti phirti hai aur nikalna nahin chahti, is par farishte unhein maar peet kar jabran ghaseet-te hain aur kehte hain ke ab tumhari badtareen ihanat hogi aur tum buri tarah ruswa kiye jaoge jaise ke tum Allah ki ayaton ka inkar karte the us ke farman ko nahin mante the aur us ke Rasoolon ki tabedari se charhte the. Momin-o-Kafir ki maut ka manzar jo ahadees mein aaya hai woh sab ayat (يُثَبِّتُ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا بالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الْاٰخِرَةِ ۚ وَيُضِلُّ اللّٰهُ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ ڐ وَيَفْعَلُ اللّٰهُ مَا يَشَاۗءُ) (14. Ibrahim: 27) ki tafseer mein hai, Ibn Marduyah ne is jagah ek bahut lambi hadees bayan ki hai lekin is ki sanad ghareeb hai wallahu a'lam, phir farmata hai ke jis din unhein un ki qabron se uthaya jayega us din un se kaha jayega ke tum to ise bahut door aur mahal mante the to ab dekh lo jis tarah shuru shuru mein hum ne tumhein paida kiya tha ab dobara bhi paida kar diya. Jo kuch maal-o-mata hum ne tumhein duniya mein diya tha sab tum wahin apne peeche chhor aaye.

Rasoolullah (ﷺ) farmate hain insaan kehta hai mera maal mera maal halankeh tera maal wahi hai jise tu ne kha pi liya woh toh fana ho gaya ya tu ne pehan odh liya woh phata purana ho kar zaya ho gaya ya tu ne naam-e-Maula par khairat kiya woh baqi raha is ke siwa jo kuch hai use toh tu auron ke liye chhod kar yahan se jaane wala hai. Hasan Basri (R.H) farmate hain insaan ko Qayamat ke din Allah ke samne khada kiya jayega aur Rabb-ul-Aalameen us se daryaft farmayega ke jo tu ne jama kiya tha woh kahan hai? Yeh jawab dega ke khoob badha chadha kar use duniya mein chhod aaya hoon. Allah Ta'ala farmayega ae Ibn-e-Adam peeche chhoda hua toh yahan nahin hai albatta aage bheja hua yahan majood hai ab jo yeh dekhega toh kuch bhi na payega phir aap ne yahi aayat padhi, phir unhein un ka shirk yaad dila kar dhamkaya jayega ke jinhein tum apna shareek samajh rahe the aur jin par naaz kar rahe the ke hamein bacha lenge aur nafa denge woh aaj tumhare sath kyun nahin? Woh kahan reh gaye? Unhein shafa'at ke liye kyun aage nahin badhate? Haq yeh hai ke Qayamat ke din saare jhoot bohtan iftira khul jayenge. Allah Ta'ala sab ko suna kar un se farmayega jinhein tum ne mere shareek thehra rakha tha woh kahan hain? Aur un se kaha jayega ke jin ki tum Allah ke siwa ibadat karte the woh kahan hain? Kya wajah hai ke na woh tumhari madad karte hain na khud apni madad woh aap karte hain. Tum toh duniya mein unhein mustahiq-e-ibadat samajhte rahe. Bainakum ki ek qira'at bainakum bhi hai yani tumhari yakjehti toot gayi aur pehli qira'at par yeh ma'ani hain ke jo ta'alluqat tum mein the jo waseele tum ne bana rakhe the sab kat gaye ma'aboodan-e-batil se jo ghalat mansoobe tum ne baandh rakhe the sab barbad ho gaye jaise farman-e-Bari hai aayat (Iza tabarra-allazeena uttubi'u minal-lazeena ittaba'u wa ra-awul-azaba wa taqatta'at bihimul-asbab) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 166) yani tabedari karne wale un se bezar honge jin ki tabedari woh karte rahe aur saare rishte naate aur ta'alluqat kat jayenge us waqt tabedar log hasrat-o-afsos se kahenge ke agar hum duniya mein wapas jayen toh tum se bhi aise hi bezar ho jayenge jaise tum hum se bezar huye. Isi tarah Allah Ta'ala unhein un ke kartoot dikhayega un par hasratein hongi aur yeh Jahannam se nahin niklenge aur aayat mein hai jab soor phoonka jayega toh aapas ke nasab munqata ho jayenge aur koi kisi ka pursan-e-haal na hoga aur aayat mein hai ke jin jin ko tum ne apna ma'abood thehra rakha hai aur un se dostiyan rakhte ho woh Qayamat ke din tumhare aur tum un ke munkir ho jaoge aur ek dusre par la'nat karoge toh tum sab ka thikana Jahannam hoga aur koi bhi tumhara madadgar khada na hoga aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa qeelad'u shuraka-akum fada'auhum falam yastajeebu lahum wa ra-awul-azaba law annahum kanu yahtadoon) (Surah Al-Qasas: 64).

(Al-Qasas: 64) Ya'ni un se kaha jaye ga ke apne shareekon ko aawaz do, woh pukaren ge lekin unhein koi jawab na mile ga aur aayat mein hai, aayat: (Wa yauma nahshuruhum jamee'an summa naqoolu lillazeena ashrakoo aina shuraka'ukumullazeena kuntum taz'umoon) (6. Al-An'am: 22) Ya'ni Qayamat ke din hum un sab ka hashr karenge, phir mushrikon se farmayenge kahan hain tumhare shareek? Is bare ki aur aayatein bhi bahut hain.

Isi tarah Allah Ta'ala unhein un ke kartoot dikhayega un par hasratein hongi aur yeh Jahannam se nahin niklenge aur aayat mein hai jab soor phoonka jayega toh aapas ke nasab munqata ho jayenge aur koi kisi ka pursan-e-haal na hoga aur aayat mein hai ke jin jin ko tum ne apna ma'abood thehra rakha hai aur un se dostiyan rakhte ho woh Qayamat ke din tumhare aur tum un ke munkir ho jaoge aur ek dusre par la'nat karoge toh tum sab ka thikana Jahannam hoga aur koi bhi tumhara madadgar khada na hoga aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa qeelad'u shuraka-akum fada'auhum falam yastajeebu lahum wa ra-awul-azaba law annahum kanu yahtadoon) (Surah Al-Qasas: 64).

(Al-Qasas: 64) Ya'ni un se kaha jaye ga ke apne shareekon ko aawaz do, woh pukaren ge lekin unhein koi jawab na mile ga aur aayat mein hai, aayat: (Wa yauma nahshuruhum jamee'an summa naqoolu lillazeena ashrakoo aina shuraka'ukumullazeena kuntum taz'umoon) (6. Al-An'am: 22) Ya'ni Qayamat ke din hum un sab ka hashr karenge, phir mushrikon se farmayenge kahan hain tumhare shareek? Is bare ki aur aayatein bhi bahut hain.

Is ki hairat-naak qudrat daanon se khetiyan, beej aur guthli se darakht Allah hi ugata hai, tum toh unhein mitti mein daal kar chale aate ho, wahan unhein Allah Ta'ala phaarta hai. Konpal nikalta hai, phir woh barhte hain, qawi darakht ban jaate hain aur daane aur phal paida hote hain. Phir goya isi ki tafseer mein farmaya ke zinda darakht aur zinda kheti ko murda beej aur murda daane se woh nikalta hai, jaise Surah Yaseen mein irshad hai, aayat (Wa-ayatul lahumul ardul maitatu ahyainaha wa akhrajna minha habban faminhu ya'kulun) (Surah Yaseen: 33). Mukhrij ka atf faliq par hai aur mufassireen ne dusre andaaz se in jumlon mein rabt qaim kiya hai lekin matlab sab ka yahi hai aur isi ke qareeb qareeb hai. Koi kehta hai murghi ka ande se nikalna aur murgh se ande ka nikalna murad hai. Bad shakhs ke yahan nek aulad hona aur nekon ki aulad ka bad hona murad hai, waghera. Aayat darhaqiqat in tamam suraton ko ghere hue hai. Phir farmata hai in tamam kaamon ka karne wala akela Allah hi hai, phir kya wajah ke tum haq se phir jaate ho? Aur us La-Shareek ke sath dusron ko shareek karne lagte ho? Wohi din ki roshni ka laane wala aur raat ke andhere ka paida karne wala hai. Jaise ke is surat ke shuru mein farmaya tha ke wohi noor-o-zulmat ka paida karne wala hai. Raat ke ghata-top andhere ko din ki nooraniyat se badal deta hai. Raat apne andheron samet chup jaati hai aur din apni tajalliyon samet kainat par qabza jama leta hai, jaise farman hai wohi din raat charhata hai. Al-garaz cheez aur us ki zid us ke zer-e-ikhtiyar hai aur yeh us ki be-inteha azmat aur bahut bari saltanat par daleel hai. Din ki roshni aur us ki chehal-pehal, zulmat aur us ka sukoon us ki azeem-ush-shan qudrat ki nishaniyan hain. Jaise farman hai aayat (Wad-duha, wal-laili iza saja) aur jaise is aayat mein farmaya aayat (Wal-laili iza yaghsha, wan-nahari iza tajalla) (Surah Al-Lail: 1-2) aur aayat mein hai (Wan-nahari iza jallaha, wal-laili iza yaghshaha) (Surah Ash-Shams: 3-4). In tamam aayaton mein din raat ka aur noor-o-zulmat, roshni aur andhere ka zikr hai. Hazrat Suhaib Rumi R.H se ek baar un ki biwi sahiba ne kaha ke raat har ek ke liye aaram ki hai lekin mere khawand Hazrat Suhaib ke liye woh bhi aaram ki nahin, is liye ke woh raat ko aksar hissa jaag kar kaat-te hain. Jab unhein Jannat yaad aati hai toh shauq barh jaata hai aur yaad-e-Allah mein raat guzaar dete hain aur jab Jahannam ka khayal aa jaata hai toh maare khauf ke un ki neend ur jaati hai. Suraj chand us ko muqarrar kiye hue andaze par barabar chal rahe hain, koi taghayyur aur iztirab is mein nahin hota. Har ek ki manzil muqarrar hai, jaare ki alag, garmi ki alag aur isi aitbaar se din raat zahir hote hain, chote aur bare hote hain, jaise farman hai aayat (Huwallazi ja'alash-shamsa diya'an wal-qamara nuran wa qaddarahu manazila lita'lamu adadas-sineena wal-hisab) (Surah Yunus: 5).

Yunus: 5) Usi Allah ne suraj ko roshan aur chand ko munawwar kiya hai, unki manzilein muqarrar kardi hain aur aayat mein hai (La-shamsu yanbaghi laha an tudrikal-qamara wa lallailu sabiqun-nahar) (Surah Yaseen: 40). Na toh aaftab hi se ban padta hai ke chand ko ja le aur na raat din par sabqat le sakti hai, har ek apne falak mein tairta phirta hai aur jagah farmaya suraj chand sitare sab uske farman ke ma-taht hain. Yahan farmaya yeh sab andaze us Allah ke muqarrar karda hain jise koi rok nahin sakta, jiske khilaf koi kuch nahin kar sakta. Jo har cheez ko janta hai, jiske ilm se ek zarra bahar nahin. Zameen-o-aasman ki koi makhlooq us se posheeda nahin. Umooman Quran-e-Kareem jahan kahin raat din suraj chand ki paidaish ka zikr karta hai wahan kalam ka khatma Allah Jalla-o-Ala ne apni izzat-o-ilm ki khabar par kiya hai, jaise is aayat mein aur (Wa aayatul-lahumul-lail) mein aur Surah Ha-Meem Sajdah ki shuru ki aayat (Wa zayyannas-sama-ad-dunya bimasaabeeha wa hifza, zalika taqdeerul-azizil-aleem) (Surah Fussilat: 12) mein. Phir farmaya sitare tumhein khushki aur tari mein raah dikhane ke liye hain. Baaz salaf ka qaul hai ke sitaron mein in teen fawaid ke ilawa agar koi aur kuch maane toh usne khata ki aur Allah par jhoot bandha. Ek toh yeh ke yeh aasman ki zeenat hain, dusre yeh shaitan par aag ban kar baraste hain jabke woh aasmanon ki khabrein lene ko chadhein, teesre yeh ke musafiron aur muqeem logon ko yeh rasta dikhate hain. Phir farmaya hum ne aqalmandon, aalimon aur waqif-kar logon ke liye apni aayatein bit-tafseel bayan farma di hain.
