Qudrat ki nishaniyan. Farmata hai ke tum sab insanon ko Allah Ta'ala ne tan-e-wahid yani Hazrat Adam A.S se paida kiya hai jaise aur ayat mein hai: "Logon apne us Rabb se daro jis ne tumhein ek nafs se paida kiya, usi se us ka joda paida kiya, phir un donon se mard-o-aurat khoob phaila diye." Mustaqar se murad maa ka pet aur mustawda se murad baap ki peeth hai aur qaul hai ke jaye-e-qarar duniya hai aur supurdagi ki jagah maut ka waqt hai. Saeed bin Jubair R.H farmate hain maa ka pet, zameen aur jab marta hai sab jaye-e-qarar ki tafseer hai. Hasan Basri R.H farmate hain jo mar gaya us ke amal ruk gaye, yahi murad mustaqar se hai. Ibn Masood R.A ka farman hai mustaqar akhirat mein hai lekin pehla qaul hi zyada zahir hai, Wallahu A'lam. Samajhdaron ke samne nishan-haye-qudrat bahut kuch aa chuke, Allah ki bahut si baatein bayan ho chukin jo kafi-o-wafi hain. Wahi Allah hai jis ne aasman se pani utara nihayat sahih andaze se, bada babarakat pani jo bandon ki zindagani ka ba'is bana aur sare jahan par Allah ki rahmat ban kar barsa. Isi se tamam-tar taro-taza cheezein ugein jaise farman hai ayat: (Wa ja'alna minal ma'i kulla shai'in hayy, afala yu'minun) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 30) "Pani se hum ne har cheez ki zindagani qaim kar di." Phir us se sabza yani kheti aur darakht ugte hain jis mein se dane aur phal nikalte hain, dane bahut sare hote hain guthe hue, teh-ba-teh chadhe hue aur khajoor ke khushe jo zameen ki taraf jhuke padte hain. Ba'az darakht-e-khurma chhote hote hain aur khushe chimte hue hote hain. Qinwan ko qabeela-e-Tameem qinyan kehta hai, is ka mufrad qinw hai, jaise sinwan sinw ki jama hai aur baghat angooron ke. Pas Arab ke nazdeek yahi donon meway sab mewon se a'la hain, khajoor aur angoor aur filhaqiqat hain bhi ye isi darje ke. Quran ki dusri ayat: (Wa min thamaratinnakhili wal-a'nabi tattakhizuna minhu sakaran wa rizqan hasana, inna fi dhalika la'ayatal-liqawmin ya'qilun) (Surah An-Nahl: 67) mein Allah Ta'ala ne in hi donon cheezon ka zikr farma kar apna ehsan bayan farmaya hai. Is mein jo sharab banane ka zikr hai us par ba'az hazrat kehte hain ke hurmat-e-sharab ke nazil hone se pehle ki ye ayat hai aur ayat mein bhi bagh ke zikr mein farmaya ke hum ne is mein khajoor-o-angoor ke darakht paida kiye the. Zaitoon bhi hain, anar bhi hain, aapas mein milte julte phal, alag alag, shakl-o-surat, maza, halawat, fawaid waghera har ek ke juda-gana. In darakhton mein phalon ka aana aur un ka pakna mulahiza kar aur Allah ki in qudraton ka nazara apni aankhon se karo ke lakdi mein mewa nikalta hai, adam se wajood mein lata hai, sookhe ko geela karta hai, mithas, lazzat, khushbu sab kuch paida karta hai, rang, roop, shakl-o-surat deta hai, fawaid rakhta hai.

Jaise aur jagah farmaya hai ke pani ek, zameen ek, khetiyan, baghat mile jule lekin hum jise chahein jab chahein bana dein, khatas, mithas, kami, ziyadati sab hamare qabze mein hai. Yeh sab Khaliq ki qudrat ki nishaniyan hain jin se imandar apna aqeeda mazboot karte hain.

Phir us se sabza yani kheti aur darakht ugte hain jis mein se dane aur phal nikalte hain, dane bahut sare hote hain guthe hue, teh-ba-teh chadhe hue aur khajoor ke khushe jo zameen ki taraf jhuke padte hain. Ba'az darakht-e-khurma chhote hote hain aur khushe chimte hue hote hain. Qinwan ko qabeela-e-Tameem qinyan kehta hai, is ka mufrad qinw hai, jaise sinwan sinw ki jama hai aur baghat angooron ke. Pas Arab ke nazdeek yahi donon meway sab mewon se a'la hain, khajoor aur angoor aur filhaqiqat hain bhi ye isi darje ke. Quran ki dusri ayat: (Wa min thamaratinnakhili wal-a'nabi tattakhizuna minhu sakaran wa rizqan hasana, inna fi dhalika la'ayatal-liqawmin ya'qilun) (Surah An-Nahl: 67) mein Allah Ta'ala ne in hi donon cheezon ka zikr farma kar apna ehsan bayan farmaya hai. Is mein jo sharab banane ka zikr hai us par ba'az hazrat kehte hain ke hurmat-e-sharab ke nazil hone se pehle ki ye ayat hai aur ayat mein bhi bagh ke zikr mein farmaya ke hum ne is mein khajoor-o-angoor ke darakht paida kiye the. Zaitoon bhi hain, anar bhi hain, aapas mein milte julte phal, alag alag, shakl-o-surat, maza, halawat, fawaid waghera har ek ke juda-gana. In darakhton mein phalon ka aana aur un ka pakna mulahiza kar aur Allah ki in qudraton ka nazara apni aankhon se karo ke lakdi mein mewa nikalta hai, adam se wajood mein lata hai, sookhe ko geela karta hai, mithas, lazzat, khushbu sab kuch paida karta hai, rang, roop, shakl-o-surat deta hai, fawaid rakhta hai.

Jaise aur jagah farmaya hai ke pani ek, zameen ek, khetiyan, baghat mile jule lekin hum jise chahein jab chahein bana dein, khatas, mithas, kami, ziyadati sab hamare qabze mein hai. Yeh sab Khaliq ki qudrat ki nishaniyan hain jin se imandar apna aqeeda mazboot karte hain.

Shaitani wa'day dhoka hain. Jo log Allah ke siwa auron ki ibadat karte thay, jinnat ko poojte thay, un par inkar farma raha hai. Un ke kufr-o-shirk se apni bezari ka elaan farmata hai. Agar koi kahe ke jinnon ki ibadat kaise hui, woh toh buton ki pooja paat karte thay, toh jawab yeh hai ke but-parasti ke sikhane wale jinnat hi thay, jaise khud Quran-e-Kareem mein hai, aayat: (In yadda'una min dunihi illa inasan wa in yadda'una illa shaitanum marida) (Surah An-Nisa: 117), yani yeh log Allah ke siwa jinhein pukar rahe hain woh sab auratein hain aur yeh siwaye sarkash mal'oon shaitan ke aur kisi ko nahin pukarte. Woh toh pehle hi keh chuka hai ke kuch na kuch insanon ko toh main apna kar hi loonga, unhein behka kar sabz bagh dikha kar apna muti' bana loonga. Phir toh woh buton ke naam par janwaron ke kaan kaat kar chhor denge. Allah ki paida karda haiyat ko bigadne lagenge. Haqiqatan Allah ko chhor kar shaitan ki dosti karne wale ke nuqsan mein kya shak hai? Shaitani wa'day toh sirf dhokay baziyan hain. Aur aayat mein hai, aayat: (Afa-tattakhizunahu wa zurriyatahu auliya'a min duni wa hum lakum 'aduwwun bi'sa liz-zalimina badala) (Surah Al-Kahf: 50), kya tum mujhe chhor kar shaitan aur aulad-e-shaitan ko apna wali banate ho? Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne apne walid se farmaya, aayat: (Ya abati la ta'budish-shaitana innash-shaitana kana lir-Rahmani 'asiyya) (Surah Maryam: 44), mere baap! Shaitan ki parastish na karo, woh toh Allah ka nafarman hai. Surah Yaseen mein hai ke kya main ne tum se yeh ahd nahin liya tha ke ae aulad-e-Adam! Tum shaitan ki ibadat na karna, woh tumhara khula dushman hai aur yeh ke tum sirf meri hi ibadat karna, seedhi raah yahi hai. Qayamat ke din farishtay bhi kahenge, aayat: (Qalu subhanaka anta waliyyuna min dunihim bal kanu ya'budunal jinna aksaruhum bihim mu'minun) (Surah Saba: 41), yani Tu pak hai, yeh nahin balkay saccha wali hamara toh Tu hi hai, yeh log toh jinnon ko poojte thay, un mein se aksar logon ka un par iman tha. Pas yahan farmaya hai ke unhon ne jinnat ki parastish shuru kar di halankay parastish ke liye sirf Allah hai, woh sab ka Khaliq hai. Jab Khaliq wahi hai toh Ma'bood bhi wahi hai. Jaise Hazrat Khalilullah (A.S) ne farmaya, aayat: (Qala ata'buduna ma tanhitun) (Surah As-Saffat: 95), yani kya tum un ki ibadat karte ho jinhein khud ghar lete ho halankay tumhare aur tumhare tamam kamon ka Khaliq Allah Ta'ala hai. Yani Ma'bood wahi hai jo Khaliq hai. Phir un logon ki hamaqat-o-zalalat bayan ho rahi hai jo Allah ki aulad, betay betiyan qarar dete thay. Yahudi Hazrat Uzair (A.S) ko aur Nasrani Hazrat Isa (A.S) ko Allah ka beta, jabke mushrikeen-e-Arab farishton ko Allah ki larkiyan kehte thay. Yeh sab un ki man-gharat aur khud tarashida baat thi aur mehez ghalat aur jhoot tha.

Haqeeqat se bahut door nira bohtan bandha tha aur besamjhi se Allah ki shaan ke khilaf ek zaban se apni jahalat se keh diya tha bhala Allah ko beton aur betiyon se kya wasta na uski aulad na uski biwi na uski kufw ka koi. Woh sab ka khaliq woh kisi ki shirkat se pak woh kisi ki hissa dari se pak, yeh gumrah jo keh rahe hain sab se woh pak aur bartar sab se door aur bala tar hai.

Allah be-misal hai, Wahdahu La-Sharika hai. Zameen-o-Aasman ka maujid baghair kisi misal aur namunay ke unhein adam se wajood mein lane wala Allah hi hai. Bid'at ko bhi bid'at isi liye kehte hain ke pehle is ki koi nazeer nahin hoti. Bhala is ka sahib-e-aulad hona kaise mumkin hai jabke is ki biwi hi nahin, aulad ke liye to jahan baap ka hona zaroori hai wahin maa ka wajood bhi lazmi hai. Allah ke mushaba jabke koi nahin hai aur jora to saath ka aur jins ka hota hai, phir is ki biwi kaise? Aur biwi nahin to aulad kahan? Woh har cheez ka khaliq hai aur yeh bhi is ke munafi hai ke is ki aulad aur zauja ho. Jaise farman hai ayat: (Wa qalu-ttakhazar-Rahmanu walada) (Surah Maryam: 88). Log kehte hain Allah ki aulad hai. In ki bari fazool aur ghalat afwah hai. Ajab nahin ke is baat ko sun kar aasman phat jayen aur zameen shaq ho jaye aur pahar reza reza ho jayen. Rahman aur aulad? Woh to aisa hai ke aasman-o-zameen ki kul makhlooq is ki bandagi mein masroof hai. Sab par is ka ghalba, sab par is ka ilm, sab is ke samne fardan fardan aane wale. Woh khaliq-e-kul hai aur aalim-e-kul hai. Is ki jor ka koi nahin, woh aulad se aur biwi se pak hai aur mushrikon ke is bayan se bhi pak hai.

Hamari aankhein aur Allah Jalla Shanuhu jis ke yeh ausaf hain yahi tumhara Allah hai, yahi tumhara palanhaar hai, yahi sab ka khaliq hai tum isi ek ki ibadat karo, us ki wahdaniyat ka iqrar karo. Us ke siwa kisi ko ibadat ke laiq na samjho. Us ki aulad nahin, us ke maa baap nahin, us ki biwi nahin, us ki barabari ka us jaisa koi nahin, woh har cheez ka hafiz nigahban aur wakeel hai har kaam ki tadbeer wahi karta hai sab ki roziyan isi ke zimma hain, har ek ki har waqt wahi hifazat karta hai. Salaf kehte hain duniya mein koi aankh Allah ko nahin dekh sakti. Haan Qayamat ke din mominon ko Allah ka deedar hoga, Hazrat Ayesha Siddiqa R.A se marwi hai ke jo kahe ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne Rab ko dekha hai us ne jhoot kaha phir aap ne yahi aayat padhi. Ibn Abbas R.A se is ke bar khilaf marwi hai unhon ne riwayat ko mutlaq rakha hai aur farmate hain apne dil se Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne do martaba Allah ko dekha Surah Najm mein yeh masla poori tafseel se bayan hoga Insha'Allah Ta'ala, Ismaeel bin Ali farmate hain ke duniya mein koi shakhs Allah ko nahin dekh sakta aur hazrat farmate hain yeh to aam taur par bayan hua hai phir is mein se Qayamat ke din mominon ka Allah ko dekhna makhsoos kar liya hai haan Mu'tazila kehte hain duniya aur aakhirat mein kahin bhi Allah ka deedar na hoga. Is mein unhon ne Ahle-Sunnat ki mukhalifat ke ilawa Kitabullah aur Sunnat-e-Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se bhi nadani barti, Kitabullah mein majood hai aayat (وُجُوْهٌ يَّوْمَىِٕذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ 22 اِلٰى رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ 23) (Surah Al-Qiyamah: 22-23) yani us din bohat se chehre taro taza honge apne Rab ki taraf dekhne wale honge aur farman hai aayat (كَلَّآ اِنَّهُمْ عَنْ رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ لَّمَحْجُوْبُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Mutaffifin: 15) yani kuffar Qayamat wale din apne Rab ke deedar se mehroom honge. Imam Shafi R.H farmate hain is se saaf zahir hai ke mominon ke liye Allah Ta'ala ka hijab nahin hoga mutawatir ahadees se bhi yahi sabit hai. Hazrat Abu Saeed, Abu Huraira, Anas, Juraij, Suhaib, Bilal R.A waghera se marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya ke momin Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ko Qayamat ke maidanon mein Jannat ke baghon mein dekhenge. Allah Ta'ala apne fazl-o-karam se hamein bhi unhi mein se kare Ameen! Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke use aankhein nahin dekh patin yani aqlein, lekin yeh qaul bohat door ka hai aur zahir ke khilaf hai aur goya ke idraak ko us ne ru'yat ke ma'ni mein samjha, Wallahu A'lam, aur hazrat deedar ke dekhne ko sabit shuda maante hue lekin idraak ke inkar ke bhi mukhalif nahin is liye ke idraak ru'yat se khaas hai aur khaas ki nafi aam ki nafi ko lazim nahin hoti. Ab jis idraak ki yahan nafi ki gayi hai yeh idraak kya hai aur kis qisam ka hai is mein kayi qaul hain maslan ma'rifat-e-haqeeqat pas haqeeqat ka aalim bajuz Allah ke aur koi nahin go momin deedar karenge lekin haqeeqat aur cheez hai chand ko log dekhte hain lekin us ki haqeeqat us ki zaat us ki sakht tak kis ki rasai hoti hai?

Pas Allah Ta'ala toh bemisal hai. Ibn-e-Ali farmate hain na dekhna duniya ki aankhon ke sath makhsoos hai, baaz kehte hain idraak akhas hai ru'yat se kyunke idraak kehte hain ihata kar lene ko aur adam-e-ihata se adam-e-ru'yat lazim nahin aati jaise ilm ka ihata na hone se mutlaq ilm ka na hona sabit nahin hota. Ihata-e-ilm ka na hona is aayat se sabit hai ke aayat (Yalamu ma baina aideehim wa ma khalfahum wa la yuheetoona bihi ilma) (Surah Taha: 110). Sahih Muslim mein hai hadith (La uhsi thana'an alayka kama athnaita ala nafsik) yani ae Allah main teri sana ka ihata nahin kar sakta lekin zahir hai ke is se murad mutlaq sana ka na karna nahin, Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul hai ke kisi ki nigah Malik-ul-Mulk ko gher nahin sakti. Hazrat Ikrama se kaha gaya ke aayat (La tudrikuhul absaru wa huwa yudrikul absara wa huwal lateeful khabeer) (Surah Al-An'am: 103) toh aap ne farmaya kya tu aasman ko nahin dekh raha? Usne kaha haan, farmaya phir sab dekh chuka hai? Qatada farmate hain Allah is se bahut bada hai ke use aankhein idraak kar lein. Chunancha Ibn-e-Jareer mein aayat (Wujoohun yauma'izin nadirah) (Surah Al-Qiyamah: 22) ki tafseer mein hai ke Allah ki taraf dekhenge unki nigahein uski azmat ke ba'is ihata na kar sakengi aur uski nigah un sab ko ghere hue hogi. Is aayat ki tafseer mein ek marfoo hadith mein hai agar insaan, jinn, shaitan, farishte sab ke sab ek saf baandh lein aur shuru se lekar aakhir tak ke sab maujooda hon taham namumkin hai ke kabhi bhi woh Allah ka ihata kar sakein. Yeh hadith ghareeb hai iski is ke siwa koi sanad nahin na Sahah-e-Sitta walon mein se kisi ne is hadith ko riwayat kiya hai. Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Ikrama farmate hain main ne Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas se suna ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala ko dekha toh main ne kaha kya Allah Ta'ala ne yeh nahin farmaya ke Allah ko aankhein nahin pa saktin aur woh tamam nigahon ko gher leta hai, toh aap ne mujhe farmaya yeh Allah ka noor hai aur woh jo us ka zaati noor hai jab woh apni tajalli kare toh us ka idraak koi nahin kar sakta aur riwayat mein hai us ke bilmuqabil koi cheez nahin theher sakti, isi jawab ke mutaradif ma'ani woh hadith hai jo Bukhari Muslim mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala sota nahin na use sona laiq hai woh tarazu ko jhukata hai aur uthata hai us ki taraf din ke amal raat se pehle aur raat ke amal din se pehle chadh jaate hain us ka hijab noor hai ya naar hai agar woh hat jaaye toh us ke chehre ki tajalliyan har us cheez ko jala dein jo us ki nigahon tale hai.

Agli kitabon mein hai ke Hazrat Musa Kaleemullah (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala se deedar dekhne ki khwahish ki toh jawab mila ke ae Musa! Jo zinda mujhe dekhega woh mar jayega aur jo khushk mujhe dekh lega woh reza reza ho jayega, khud Quran mein hai ke jab tere Rab ne pahar par tajalli dali toh woh tukre tukre ho gaya aur Musa (A.S) behosh ho kar gir pare, afaqa ke baad kehne lage Allah tu pak hai main teri taraf tauba karta hoon aur main sab se pehla momin hoon. Yaad rahe ke is khaas idraak ke inkaar se Qayamat ke din mominon ke apne Rab ke dekhne se inkaar nahin ho sakta. Is ki kaifiyat ka ilm usi ko hai. Haan beshak us ki haqeeqi azmat, jalalat, qudrat, buzurgi waghera jaisi hai woh bhala kahan kisi ki samajh mein aa sakti hai? Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain aakhirat mein deedar hoga aur duniya mein koi bhi Allah ko nahin dekh sakta aur yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Pas jis idraak ki nafi ki hai woh ma'ani mein azmat-o-jalalat ki riwayat ke hai jaisa ke woh hai. Yeh toh insaan kya farishton ke liye bhi namumkin hai, haan woh sab ko ghere hue hai, jab woh Khaliq hai toh Aalim kyun na hoga? Jaise farman hai aayat (Ala ya'lamu man khalaqa wa huwal latiful khabir) (Surah Al-Mulk: 14) Kya woh nahin janega jo paida karta hai jo lutf-o-karam wala aur bari khabardari wala hai? Aur ho sakta hai ke nigah se murad nigah-e-wala ho yani use koi nahin dekh sakta aur woh sab ko dekhta hai, woh har ek ko nikalne mein latif hai aur un ki jagah se khabir hai, Wallahu A'lam. Jaise ke Hazrat Luqman (A.S) ne apne bete ko wa'z kehte hue farmaya tha ke beta agar koi bhalai ya burai rai ke dana ke barabar bhi ho khwah patthar mein ho ya aasmanon mein ya zameen mein Allah use layega, Allah Ta'ala bara bareek been aur khabardar hai.

Agli kitabon mein hai ke Hazrat Musa Kaleemullah (A.S) ne Allah Ta'ala se deedar dekhne ki khwahish ki toh jawab mila ke ae Musa! Jo zinda mujhe dekhega woh mar jayega aur jo khushk mujhe dekh lega woh reza reza ho jayega, khud Quran mein hai ke jab tere Rab ne pahar par tajalli dali toh woh tukre tukre ho gaya aur Musa (A.S) behosh ho kar gir pare, afaqa ke baad kehne lage Allah tu pak hai main teri taraf tauba karta hoon aur main sab se pehla momin hoon. Yaad rahe ke is khaas idraak ke inkaar se Qayamat ke din mominon ke apne Rab ke dekhne se inkaar nahin ho sakta. Is ki kaifiyat ka ilm usi ko hai. Haan beshak us ki haqeeqi azmat, jalalat, qudrat, buzurgi waghera jaisi hai woh bhala kahan kisi ki samajh mein aa sakti hai? Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain aakhirat mein deedar hoga aur duniya mein koi bhi Allah ko nahin dekh sakta aur yahi aayat tilawat farmayi. Pas jis idraak ki nafi ki hai woh ma'ani mein azmat-o-jalalat ki riwayat ke hai jaisa ke woh hai. Yeh toh insaan kya farishton ke liye bhi namumkin hai, haan woh sab ko ghere hue hai, jab woh Khaliq hai toh Aalim kyun na hoga? Jaise farman hai aayat (Ala ya'lamu man khalaqa wa huwal latiful khabir) (Surah Al-Mulk: 14) Kya woh nahin janega jo paida karta hai jo lutf-o-karam wala aur bari khabardari wala hai? Aur ho sakta hai ke nigah se murad nigah-e-wala ho yani use koi nahin dekh sakta aur woh sab ko dekhta hai, woh har ek ko nikalne mein latif hai aur un ki jagah se khabir hai, Wallahu A'lam. Jaise ke Hazrat Luqman (A.S) ne apne bete ko wa'z kehte hue farmaya tha ke beta agar koi bhalai ya burai rai ke dana ke barabar bhi ho khwah patthar mein ho ya aasmanon mein ya zameen mein Allah use layega, Allah Ta'ala bara bareek been aur khabardar hai.

Hidayat-o-shifa Quran-o-Hadith mein hai. Basair se murad daleelein aur hujjatein hain jo Quran-o-Hadith mein majood hain. Jo inhe dekhe aur un se nafa hasil kare woh apna hi bhala karta hai, jaise farman hai ke raah paane wala apne liye raah paata hai aur gumrah hone wala apna hi bigadta hai. Yahan bhi farmaya andha apna hi nuqsan karta hai kyunke aakhir gumrahi ka usi par asar padta hai, jaise irshad hai aankhein andhi nahin hotin balkay seenon ke andar dil andhay hojate hain. Main tum par nigahban, hafiz, chaukidar nahin balkay main toh sirf muballigh hoon, hidayat Allah ke haath hai. Jis tarah Tauheed ke dalail wazeh farmaye usi tarah apni aayaton ko khol khol kar tafseer aur wazahat ke sath bayan farmaya taake koi jahil na reh jaye aur mushrikeen, mukazzibeen aur kafireen yeh na keh dein ke tune aye Nabi Ahl-e-Kitab se yeh dars liya hai, un se padha hai, unhi ne tujhe sikhaya hai. Ibn Abbas (R.A) se yeh ma'ani bhi marwi hain ke tune padh sunaya, tune jhagda kiya, toh yeh usi aayat ki tarah aayat hogi jahan bayan hai aayat (Wa qalal-lazina kafaroo in haza illa ifkuniftarahu wa a'anahu alaihi qawmun aakharoon faqad ja'oo zulman wa zoora) (25. Al-Furqan: 4). Kafiron ne kaha ke yeh toh sirf bohtan hai jisay us ne ghad liya hai aur dusron ne is ki ta'eed ki hai. Aur aayaton mein un ke baday ka qaul hai ke us ne bohat kuch ghaur-o-khauz ke baad faisla kiya ke yeh toh chalta hua jadoo hai, yaqeenan yeh insani qaul hai aur is liye ke hum ulama ke samne wazahat kardein taake woh haq ke qail aur batil ke dushman ban jayen. Rabb ki maslahat wahi jaanta hai ke jo ek giroh ko hidayat aur dusre ko zalalat ata karta hai, jaise farmaya is ke sath bohat ko hidayat karta hai aur bohat ko gumrah karta hai. Aur aayat mein hai taake woh shaitan ke ilqa ko bimar dilon ke liye sabab-e-fitna kar de aur farmaya aayat (Wa ma ja'alna ashaban-nari illa mala'ikah wa ma ja'alna iddatahum illa fitnatal-lillazina kafaru) (74. Al-Muddaththir: 31). Ya'ni hum ne dozakh ke pasban farishtay muqarrar kiye hain, un ki muqarrara tadaad bhi kafiron ke liye fitna hai taake Ahl-e-Kitab kamil yaqeen kar lein, imandar imaan mein badh jayen, Ahl-e-Kitab aur momin shak-o-shuba se alag hojayen aur bimar dil kufr walay kehte hain ke is misaal se Allah ki kya murad hai? Isi tarah jisay Allah chahe gumrah karta hai aur jisay chahe raah-e-raast dikhata hai, tere Rabb ke lashkaron ko bajuz is ke koi nahin jaanta aur aayat mein hai aayat (Wa nunazzilu minal-Qur'ani ma huwa shifa'un wa rahmatul-lil-mu'mineen wa la yazeeduz-zalimeena illa khasara) (17. Bani Israel: 82).

(Al-Isra: 82) Ya'ni hum ne Quran utara hai jo mominon ke liye shifa aur rahmat hai, albatta zalimon ko toh nuqsan hi milta hai aur ayat mein hai ke yeh iman walon ke liye hidayat-o-shifa hai aur be-imanon ke kanon mein bojh hai aur un par andha-pan ghalib hai, yeh door ki jagah se pukare ja rahe hain aur bhi is mazmoon ki bahut si ayatein hain jin se sabit hota hai ke Quran se log nasihat hasil karte hain aur gumrah bhi hote hain. Darast ki dusri qira'at darast bhi hai ya'ni padha aur seekha aur yeh ma'ani hain ke ise toh muddat guzar chuki, yeh toh tu pehle se laya hua hai, yeh toh tu padhaya gaya hai aur sikhaya gaya hai. Ek qira'at mein dars bhi hai lekin yeh ghareeb hai, Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) farmate hain Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne darast padhaya hai.

Wahi ke mutabiq amal karo. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aur aap ki ummat ko hukm ho raha hai ke Wahi-e-Ilahi ki itteba aur isi ke mutabiq amal karo. Jo Wahi Allah ki janib se utarti hai woh sarasar haq hai, us ke haq hone mein zara sa bhi shuba nahin. Mabood-e-barhaq sirf wahi hai. Mushrikeen se darguzar kar, un ki eeza-dahi par sabr kar, un ki bad-zabani bardasht kar le, un ki bad-zabani sun le, yaqeen maan kar teri fatah ka, tere ghalbe ka, teri taqat-o-quwwat ka waqt door nahin. Allah ki maslahaton ko koi nahin jaanta, der ho magar andhera nahin. Agar Allah chahta to sab ko hidayat deta, us ki mashiyat, us ki hikmat wahi jaanta hai, na koi us se baaz-purs kar sake na us ka haath thaam sake. Woh sab ka haakim aur sab se sawal karne par qadir hai. Tu us ke aqwal-o-a'maal ka muhafiz nahin, tu un ke rizq waghera umoor ka wakeel nahin. Tere zimme sirf Allah ke hukm ko pahuncha dena hai, jaise farmaya: Nasihat kar de kyunke tera kaam yahi hai, tu un par darogha nahin aur farmaya: Tumhari zimmedari to sirf pahuncha dena hai, hisab hamare zimme hai.

Sauda bazi nahin hogi. Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko aur aap ke manne walon ko mushrikeen ke maboodon ko gaaliyan dene se mana farmata hai, go ke is mein kuch maslahat bhi ho lekin is mein mufsada bhi hai aur woh bahut bada hai, yani aisa na ho ke mushrik apni nadani se Allah ko gaaliyan dene lag jayen. Ek riwayat mein hai ke mushrikeen ne aisa irada zahir kiya tha, is par yeh aayat utri. Qatada (R.H) ka qaul hai ke aisa hua tha is liye yeh aayat utri aur mumanat kar di gayi. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein Suddi (R.H) se marwi hai ke Abu Talib ki maut ki bimari ke waqt Quraishiyon ne aapas mein kaha ke chalo chal kar Abu Talib se kahein ke woh apne bhatije (Hazrat Muhammad Rasoolullah ﷺ) ko rok dein, warna yeh yaqeeni baat hai ke ab hum use maar dalenge to mumkin hai ke Arab ki taraf se aawaz uthe ke chacha ki maujoodgi mein to Quraishiyon ki chali nahin, us ki maut ke baad maar dala. Yeh mashwara kar ke Abu Jahl, Abu Sufyan, Nazeer bin Haris, Umayyah bin Abi Khalaf, Uqbah bin Abi Mu'ait, Amr bin Aas aur Aswad bin Bakhtari chale. Matlab nami ek shakhs ko Abu Talib ke paas bheja ke woh un ke aane ki khabar dein aur ijazat lein. Us ne ja kar kaha ke aap ki qaum ke sardar aap se milna chahte hain. Abu Talib ne kaha bula lo. Yeh log gaye aur kehne lage, aap ko hum apna bada aur sardar maante hain, aap ko maloom hai ke Muhammad (ﷺ) ne hamein sata rakha hai, woh hamare maboodon ko bura kehta hai, hum chahte hain ke aap bula kar mana kar dijiye, hum bhi is se ruk jayenge. Abu Talib ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ko bulaya, aap tashreef laye. Abu Talib ne kaha, aap dekhte hain aap ki qaum ke bade yahan jama hain, yeh sab aap ke kunbe, qabeele aur rishte ke hain, yeh chahte hain ke aap inhe aur in ke maboodon ko chhod dein, yeh bhi aap ko aur aap ke Allah ko chhod denge. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, khair ek baat main kehta hoon, yeh sab log soch samajh kar is ka jawab dein. Main in se sirf ek kalma talab karta hoon aur wada karta hoon ke agar yeh meri ek baat maan lein to tamam Arab in ka matahat ho jaye, tamam Ajam in ki mamlikat mein aa jaye, badi badi saltanatein inhe khiraj ada karein. Yeh sun kar Abu Jahl ne kaha, qasam hai ek hi nahin aisi das baatein bhi agar aap ki hon to hum manne ko maujood hain, farmayiye woh kalma kya hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, bas La Ilaha Illallah keh do. Is par un sab ne inkar kiya aur naak bhon chadhayi.

Yeh baat dekh kar Abu Talib ne kaha pyare bhatije aur koi baat kaho dekho tumhari qoum ke sardaron ko tumhari yeh baat pasand nahin aayi. Aap ne farmaya chacha jaan aap mujhe kya samajhte hain Allah ki qasam mujhe isi ek kalma ki dhun hai agar yeh log suraj ko la kar mere haath mein rakh dein jab bhi main koi aur kalma nahin kahunga. Yeh sun kar woh log aur bigre aur kehne lage bas hum keh dete hain ke ya toh aap hamare maboodon ko gaaliyan dene se ruk jayen warna phir hum bhi aap ko aur aap ke mabood ko gaaliyan denge. Is par Rabb-ul-Aalameen ne yeh aayat utari, isi maslahat ko mad-e-nazar rakh kar Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya woh maloon hai jo apne maa baap ko gaaliyan de. Sahaba ne kaha huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) koi shakhs apne maa baap ko gaali kaise de ga? Aap ne farmaya is tarah ke yeh dusre ke baap ko gaali de, dusra is ke baap ko, yeh kisi ki maa ko gaali de woh is ki maa ko, phir farmata hai isi tarah agli ummatein bhi apni gumrahi ko apne haq mein hidayat samajhti rahin. Yeh bhi Rabb ki hikmat hai yaad rahe ke sab ka lautna Allah hi ki taraf hai woh unhein un ke sab bure bhale aamal ka badla de ga aur zaroor de ga.

Mojzon ke talib log sirf musalmanon ko dhoka dene ke liye aur is liye bhi ke khud musalman shak-o-shuba mein par jayen, kafir log qasmein kha kha kar bare zor se kehte the ke hamare talab karda mojze hamein dikha diye jayen to wallah hum bhi musalman ho jayen. Is ke jawab mein Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko hidayat farmata hai ke aap keh dein ke mojze mere qabze mein nahin, yeh Allah ke hath mein hain, woh chahe dikhaye chahe na dikhaye. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke mushrikeen ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se kaha ke aap farmate hain Hazrat Musa (A.S) ek patthar par lakri marte the to us se barah chashme nikle the aur Hazrat Isa (A.S) murdon mein jaan daal dete the aur Hazrat Thamud ne oontni ka mojza dikhaya tha, to aap bhi jo mojza hum kahein dikha dein, wallah hum sab aap ki nabuwat ko maan lenge. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya kya mojza dekhna chahte ho? Unhon ne kaha ke aap Safa pahar ko hamare liye sone ka bana dein, phir to qasam Allah ki hum sab aap ko sacha janne lagenge. Aap (ﷺ) ko un ke is kalam se kuch umeed bandh gayi aur aap ne khare ho kar Allah Ta'ala se dua mangni shuru ki, wahin Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye aur farmane lage suniye agar aap chahein to Allah bhi is Safa pahar ko sone ka kar dega lekin agar yeh iman na laye to Allah ka azab in sab ko fana kar dega, warna Allah Ta'ala apne azabon ko roke hue hai, mumkin hai in mein nek samajh wale bhi hon aur woh hidayat par aa jayen. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya nahin Allah Ta'ala main Safa ka sona nahin chahta balki main chahta hoon ke tu in par meherbani farma kar inhe azab na kar aur in mein se jise chahe hidayat naseeb farma. Isi par yeh ayatein (Wa lakinna aksarahum yajhaloon) (Surah Al-An'am: 111) tak nazil huin. Yeh hadith go mursal hai lekin is ke shahid bohat hain, chunancha Quran-e-Kareem mein aur jagah hai ayat (Wa ma mana'ana an nursila bil-ayati illa an kazzaba bihal-awwaloon) (Surah Bani Israel: 59) yani mojzon ke utarne se sirf yeh cheez mani hai ke un se aglon ne bhi inhe jhutlaya. Annaha ki dusri qirat innaha bhi hai aur la yu'minoon ki dusri qirat la tu'minoon hai, is surat mein mani yeh honge ke ae mushrikeen kya khabar mumkin hai khud tumhare talab karda mojzon ke aa jane ke baad bhi tumhein iman lana naseeb na ho. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is ayat mein khitab mominon se hai, yani ae musalmano tum nahin jante yeh log in nishaniyon ke zahir ho chukne par bhi be-iman hi rahenge. Is surat mein innaha alif ke zer ke sath bhi ho sakta hai aur alif ke zabar ke sath bhi, yash'urukum ka mamool ho kar aur la yu'minoon ka laam is surat mein sila hoga jaise ayat (Qala ma mana'aka alla tasjuda iz amartuka) (Surah Al-A'raf: 12) mein. Aur ayat (Wa haramun ala qaryatin ahlaknaha annahum la yarji'oon) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 95) mein, to matlab yeh hota ke ae momino tumhare paas is ka kya suboot hai ke yeh apni man-mani aur munh mangi nishani dekh kar iman layenge bhi?

Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke 'innaha' ma'ani mein 'la'allaha' ke hai, balkeh Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) ki qira'at mein 'innaha' ke badle 'la'allaha' hi hai, Arab ke muhawaray mein aur sher'on mein bhi yahi paya gaya hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) isi ko pasand farmate hain aur is ke bohat se shawahid bhi unhon ne pesh kiye hain, Wallahu A'alam. Phir farmata hai ke un ke inkar aur kufr ki wajah se un ke dil aur un ki nigahain hum ne pher di hain, ab yeh kisi baat par iman lane wale hi nahin. Iman aur un ke darmiyan deewar hail ho chuki hai, roo-e-zameen ke nishanat dekh lenge to bhi be-iman hi rahenge agar iman qismat mein hota to haq ki awaz par pehle hi labbaik pukar uthte. Allah Ta'ala un ki baat se pehle yeh janta tha ke yeh kya kahenge? Aur un ke amal se pehle janta tha ke yeh kya karenge? Isi liye us ne batla diya ke aisa hoga, farmata hai ayat (Wala yunabbi'uka mithlu khabir) (Surah Fatir: 14). Allah Ta'ala jo kamil khabar rakhne wala hai aur is jaisi khabar aur kaun de sakta hai? Us ne farmaya ke yeh log Qayamat ke roz hasrat-o-afsos ke sath arzoo karenge ke agar ab laut kar duniya ki taraf jayen to nek aur bhale ban kar rahen. Lekin Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala farmata hai agar bilfarz yeh lauta bhi diye jayen to bhi yeh aise ke aise hi rahenge aur jin kamon se roke gaye hain unhi ko karenge, hargiz na chhodenge, yahan bhi farmaya ke mojzon ka dekhna bhi un ke liye mufeed na hoga, un ki nigahain haq ko dekhne wali hi nahin rahin, un ke dil mein haq ke liye koi jagah khali hi nahin. Pehli baar hi unhein iman naseeb nahin hua isi tarah nishanon ke zahir hone ke baad bhi iman se mehroom rahenge. Balkeh apni sarkashi aur gumrahi mein hi behakte aur bhatakte hairan-o-sargardan rahenge. (Allah Ta'ala hamare dilon ko apne deen par sabit rakhe. Ameen).

Mojzon ke talib log sirf musalmanon ko dhoka dene ke liye aur is liye bhi ke khud musalman shak-o-shuba mein par jayen, kafir log qasmein kha kha kar bare zor se kehte the ke hamare talab karda mojze hamein dikha diye jayen to wallah hum bhi musalman ho jayen. Is ke jawab mein Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko hidayat farmata hai ke aap keh dein ke mojze mere qabze mein nahin, yeh Allah ke hath mein hain, woh chahe dikhaye chahe na dikhaye. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke mushrikeen ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se kaha ke aap farmate hain Hazrat Musa (A.S) ek patthar par lakri marte the to us se barah chashme nikle the aur Hazrat Isa (A.S) murdon mein jaan daal dete the aur Hazrat Thamud ne oontni ka mojza dikhaya tha, to aap bhi jo mojza hum kahein dikha dein, wallah hum sab aap ki nabuwat ko maan lenge. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya kya mojza dekhna chahte ho? Unhon ne kaha ke aap Safa pahar ko hamare liye sone ka bana dein, phir to qasam Allah ki hum sab aap ko sacha janne lagenge. Aap (ﷺ) ko un ke is kalam se kuch umeed bandh gayi aur aap ne khare ho kar Allah Ta'ala se dua mangni shuru ki, wahin Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) aaye aur farmane lage suniye agar aap chahein to Allah bhi is Safa pahar ko sone ka kar dega lekin agar yeh iman na laye to Allah ka azab in sab ko fana kar dega, warna Allah Ta'ala apne azabon ko roke hue hai, mumkin hai in mein nek samajh wale bhi hon aur woh hidayat par aa jayen. Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya nahin Allah Ta'ala main Safa ka sona nahin chahta balki main chahta hoon ke tu in par meherbani farma kar inhe azab na kar aur in mein se jise chahe hidayat naseeb farma. Isi par yeh ayatein (Wa lakinna aksarahum yajhaloon) (Surah Al-An'am: 111) tak nazil huin. Yeh hadith go mursal hai lekin is ke shahid bohat hain, chunancha Quran-e-Kareem mein aur jagah hai ayat (Wa ma mana'ana an nursila bil-ayati illa an kazzaba bihal-awwaloon) (Surah Bani Israel: 59) yani mojzon ke utarne se sirf yeh cheez mani hai ke un se aglon ne bhi inhe jhutlaya. Annaha ki dusri qirat innaha bhi hai aur la yu'minoon ki dusri qirat la tu'minoon hai, is surat mein mani yeh honge ke ae mushrikeen kya khabar mumkin hai khud tumhare talab karda mojzon ke aa jane ke baad bhi tumhein iman lana naseeb na ho. Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is ayat mein khitab mominon se hai, yani ae musalmano tum nahin jante yeh log in nishaniyon ke zahir ho chukne par bhi be-iman hi rahenge. Is surat mein innaha alif ke zer ke sath bhi ho sakta hai aur alif ke zabar ke sath bhi, yash'urukum ka mamool ho kar aur la yu'minoon ka laam is surat mein sila hoga jaise ayat (Qala ma mana'aka alla tasjuda iz amartuka) (Surah Al-A'raf: 12) mein. Aur ayat (Wa haramun ala qaryatin ahlaknaha annahum la yarji'oon) (Surah Al-Anbiya: 95) mein, to matlab yeh hota ke ae momino tumhare paas is ka kya suboot hai ke yeh apni man-mani aur munh mangi nishani dekh kar iman layenge bhi?

Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke 'innaha' ma'ani mein 'la'allaha' ke hai, balkeh Hazrat Ubayy bin Ka'ab (R.A) ki qira'at mein 'innaha' ke badle 'la'allaha' hi hai, Arab ke muhawaray mein aur sher'on mein bhi yahi paya gaya hai, Imam Ibn-e-Jarir (R.H) isi ko pasand farmate hain aur is ke bohat se shawahid bhi unhon ne pesh kiye hain, Wallahu A'alam. Phir farmata hai ke un ke inkar aur kufr ki wajah se un ke dil aur un ki nigahain hum ne pher di hain, ab yeh kisi baat par iman lane wale hi nahin. Iman aur un ke darmiyan deewar hail ho chuki hai, roo-e-zameen ke nishanat dekh lenge to bhi be-iman hi rahenge agar iman qismat mein hota to haq ki awaz par pehle hi labbaik pukar uthte. Allah Ta'ala un ki baat se pehle yeh janta tha ke yeh kya kahenge? Aur un ke amal se pehle janta tha ke yeh kya karenge? Isi liye us ne batla diya ke aisa hoga, farmata hai ayat (Wala yunabbi'uka mithlu khabir) (Surah Fatir: 14). Allah Ta'ala jo kamil khabar rakhne wala hai aur is jaisi khabar aur kaun de sakta hai? Us ne farmaya ke yeh log Qayamat ke roz hasrat-o-afsos ke sath arzoo karenge ke agar ab laut kar duniya ki taraf jayen to nek aur bhale ban kar rahen. Lekin Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala farmata hai agar bilfarz yeh lauta bhi diye jayen to bhi yeh aise ke aise hi rahenge aur jin kamon se roke gaye hain unhi ko karenge, hargiz na chhodenge, yahan bhi farmaya ke mojzon ka dekhna bhi un ke liye mufeed na hoga, un ki nigahain haq ko dekhne wali hi nahin rahin, un ke dil mein haq ke liye koi jagah khali hi nahin. Pehli baar hi unhein iman naseeb nahin hua isi tarah nishanon ke zahir hone ke baad bhi iman se mehroom rahenge. Balkeh apni sarkashi aur gumrahi mein hi behakte aur bhatakte hairan-o-sargardan rahenge. (Allah Ta'ala hamare dilon ko apne deen par sabit rakhe. Ameen).

Farmata hai ke yeh kuffar jo qasmein kha kha kar tum se kehte hain ke agar koi mojiza woh dekh lete toh zaroor imaan le aate. Yeh ghalat kehte hain tumhein un ke imaan lane se mayoos ho jana chahiye. Yeh kehte hain ke agar farishtay utarte toh hum maan lete lekin yeh bhi jhoot hai, farishton ke aa jane par bhi aur un ke keh dene par bhi ke yeh Rasool bar-haq hain inhe imaan naseeb nahin hoga, yeh sirf imaan na lane ke bahane tarashte hain ke kabhi keh dete hain Allah ko le aa, kabhi kehte hain farishton ko le aa, kabhi kehte hain agle nabiyon jaise mojize le aa, yeh sab hujjat bazi aur heele hawalay hain, dilon mein takabbur bhara hua hai, zaban se sarkashi aur burai zahir karte hain, agar murday bhi qabron se uth kar aa jayen aur keh dein ke yeh Rasool bar-haq hain un ke dilon par is ka bhi koi asar nahin hoga. (Qubulan) ki doosri qira'at (Qubulan) hai jis ke ma'ani muqablay aur mu'aina ke hote hain, ek qaul mein (Qubulan) ke ma'ani bhi yahi bayan kiye gaye hain, haan Mujahid R.H se marwi hai ke is ke ma'ani garoh garoh ke hain. Un ke samne agar ek ummat aa jati aur Rasoolon ki hidayat de de, woh jo karna chahe koi us se pooch nahin sakta aur woh chunke hakim-e-kul hai har ek se baz-purs kar sakta hai, woh Aleem-o-Hakeem hai, hakim-o-ghalib-o-qahhar hai aur aayat mein hai (Innal-lazina haqqat 'alaihim kalimat-u-Rabbika la yu'minun) (Surah Yunus: 96), ya'ni jin logon ke zimme kalma-e-azab sabit ho gaya hai woh tamam tar nishaniyan dekhte hue bhi imaan na layenge jab tak ke almanaak azab na dekh lein.

Har Nabi ko eza di gayi. Irshad hota hai ke ae Nabi (ﷺ) aap tang-e-dil aur magmoom na hon, jis tarah aap ke zamane ke yeh kuffar aap ki dushmani karte hain, isi tarah har Nabi ke zamane ke kuffar apne apne Nabiyon ke sath dushmani karte rahe hain. Jaise aur aayat mein tasalli dete hue farmaya: Aayat (Walaqad kuzzibat rusulum min qablika fasabaru 'ala ma kuzzibu wa uozu hatta atahum nasruna, wala mubaddila likalimatillahi, walaqad ja'aka min naba'il mursalin) (Surah Al-An'am: 34). Tujh se pehle ke paighambaron ko bhi jhutlaya gaya, unhein bhi eza'ein pahunchayi gayin jis par unhon ne sabr kiya. Aur aayat mein kaha gaya hai ke tujh se bhi wahi kaha jata hai jo tujh se pehle ke Nabiyon ko kaha gaya tha. Tera Rab badi maghfirat wala hai aur sath hi alamnak azab karne wala bhi hai. Aur aayat mein hai (Wakadhalika ja'alna likulli nabiyyin 'aduwwam minal mujrimin, wakafa birabbika hadiyan wanaseera) (Surah Al-Furqan: 31). Hum ne gunahgaron ko har Nabi ka dushman bana diya hai. Yehi baat Waraqa bin Naufal ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) se kahi thi ke aap jaisi cheez jo Rasool bhi le kar aaya us se adawat ki gayi. Nabiyon ke dushman shareer insaan bhi hote hain aur jinnaat bhi. 'Adduwan' se badal 'Shayatinul insi wal jinn' hai, insanon mein bhi shaitan hain aur jinon mein bhi. Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ek din namaz parh rahe the to Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ne un se farmaya: Kya tum ne shayatin-e-ins-o-jinn se Allah ki panah bhi mang li? Sahabi ne pucha: Kya insanon mein bhi shaitan hain? Aap ne farmaya: Haan. Yeh hadith munqata hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke main Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hua aur is majlis mein aap der tak tashreef farma rahe, mujh se farmane lage: Abu Zar tum ne namaz parh li? Main ne kaha: Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ) nahin parhi. Aap ne farmaya: Utho aur do rakat ada kar lo. Jab main farigh ho kar aaya to farmane lage: Kya tum ne insaan-o-jinnat shayatin se Allah ki panah mangi thi? Main ne kaha: Nahin, kya insanon mein bhi shaitan hain? Aap ne farmaya: Haan aur woh jinon ke shaitan se bhi zyada shareer hain. Is mein bhi inqita hai. Ek muttasil riwayat Musnad-e-Ahmad mein mutawwal hai, is mein yeh bhi hai ke yeh waqia masjid ka hai aur riwayat mein Huzoor (ﷺ) ka is farman ke baad yeh parhna bhi marwi hai ke aayat (Wakadhalika ja'alna likulli nabiyyin 'aduwwan shayatinul insi wal jinni yuhi ba'duhum ila ba'din zukhrufal qawli ghuroora) (Surah Al-An'am: 112).

(Al-An'am: 112) Al-gharz yeh hadith bohat si sanadon se marwi hai jis se quwwat-e-sehat ka faida ho jata hai, Wallahu A'lam. Ikrama se marwi hai ke insanon mein shaitan nahin, jinnat ke shaitan ek dusre se kana-phusi karte hain. Aap se yeh bhi marwi hai ke insanon ke shaitan jo insanon ko gumrah karte hain aur jinnon ke shaitan jo jinnon ko gumrah karte hain, jab aapas mein milte hain to ek dusre se apni karguzari bayan karte hain ke main ne falan ko is tarah behkaya, to falan ko is tarah behkaya, ek dusre ko gumrahi ke tariqe batate hain. Is se Imam Ibn-e-Jarir to yeh samjhe hain ke shaitan to jinnon mein se hi hote hain lekin ba'az insanon par lage hue hote hain, ba'az jinnat par, to yeh matlab Ikrama ke qaul se to zahir hai, haan Suddi ke qaul mein mutahammil hai. Ek qaul mein Ikrama aur Suddi dono se yeh marwi hai. Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain jinnat ke shaitan hain jo unhein behkate hain jaise insanon ke shaitan jo unhein behkate hain aur ek dusre se mil kar mashwara dete hain ke ise is tarah behka. Sahih wahi hai jo Hazrat Abu Zar wali hadith mein upar guzra. Arabi mein har sarkash sharir ko shaitan kehte hain. Sahih Muslim mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne siyah rang ke kutte ko shaitan farmaya hai, to is ke ma'ani yeh hue ke woh kutton mein shaitan hai, Wallahu A'lam. Mujahid farmate hain kuffar jinn kuffar insanon ke kanon mein soor phonkte rehte hain. Ikrama farmate hain main Mukhtar Ibn-e-Abi Ubaid ke paas gaya, us ne meri bari ta'zeem-o-takreem ki, apne yahan mehman bana kar thehraya, raat ko bhi shayad apne yahan sulata lekin mujh se us ne kaha ke jao logon ko kuch sunao. Main ja kar baitha hi tha ke ek shakhs ne mujh se pucha aap wahi ke bare mein kya farmate hain? Main ne kaha wahi ki do qismen hain, ek Allah ki taraf se jaise farman hai ayat (BIMA AWHAINA ILAIKA HADHAL QUR'AN WA IN KUNTA MIN QABLIHI LAMINAL GHAFILIN) (12. Yusuf: 3) aur dusri wahi-e-shaitani jaise farman hai (WA KADHALIKA JA'ALNA LIKULLI NABIYYIN ADUWWAN SHAYATINAL INSI WAL JINNI YUHI BA'DUHUM ILA BA'DIN ZUKH RUFAL QAWLI GHURURA) (6. Al-An'am: 112). Itna sunte hi log mere upar pal pare, qareeb tha ke pakar kar maar-peet shuru kar dein, main ne kaha are bhaiyo! Yeh tum mere sath kya karne lage? Main ne to tumhare sawal ka jawab diya aur main to tumhara mehman hoon, chunancha unhon ne mujhe chor diya. Mukhtar mal'oon logon se kehta tha ke mere paas wahi aati hai. Uski behan Hazrat Safiya, Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) ke ghar mein thin aur bari deendar thin. Jab Hazrat Abdullah ko Mukhtar ka yeh qaul maloom hua to aap ne farmaya woh theek kehta hai, Quran mein hai (WA INNASH SHAYATINA LAYUHIWNA ILA AWLIYAIHIM LIYUJADILUKUM WA IN ATA'TUMUHUM INNAKUM LAMUSHRIKUN) (6. Al-An'am: 121).

(Al-An'am: 121) Ya'ni Shaitan bhi apne doston ki taraf wahi le jate hain, al-gharaz aise mutakabbir sarkash jinnat-o-ins aapas mein ek dusre ko dhoke-bazi ki baatein sikhate hain yeh bhi Allah Ta'ala ki qaza-o-qadar aur chahat-o-mashiyat hai woh in ki wajah se apne nabiyon ki ulul-azmi apne bandon ko dikha deta hai, toh in ki adawat ka khayal bhi na kar, in ka jhoot tujhe kuch bhi nuqsan na pahuncha sake ga toh Allah par bharosa rakh isi par tawakkul kar aur apne kaam use saunp kar be-fikr ho ja, woh tujhe kafi hai aur wahi tera madadgar hai, yeh log jo is tarah ki khurafaat karte hain yeh mahaz isliye ke be-imano ke dil in ki nigahein aur in ke kaan in ki taraf jhuk jayen woh aisi baton ko pasand karein is se khush ho jayen pas in ki baatein wahi qabool karte hain jinhein aakhirat par iman nahin hota, aise wasil-e-jahannam hone wale behke hue log hi in ki fazool aur chikni chupri baton mein phans jate hain phir woh karte hain jo in ke qabil hai.

Allah ke faislay atal hain. Hukm hota hai ke mushrik jo ke Allah ke siwa dusron ki parastish kar rahe hain un se keh dijiye ke kya main aapas mein faisla karne wala bajuz Allah Ta'ala ke kisi aur ko talash karoon? Isi ne saaf khulay faislay karne wali kitab nazil farma di hai. Yahood-o-Nasara jo sahib-e-kitab hain aur jin ke paas aglay nabiyon ki basharatain hain woh bakhoobi jaantay hain ke yeh Quran-e-Kareem Allah ki taraf se haq ke sath nazil shuda hai, tujhay shakki logon mein na milna chahiye, jaisay farman hai (Fa-in kunta fi shakkin mimma anzalna ilaika fas-alillazeena yaqra-oonal kitaba min qablika laqad ja-akal haqqu mir rabbika fala takoonanna minal mumtareen) (Surah Yunus: 94). Ya'ni hum ne jo kuch wahi teri taraf utari hai agar tujhay is mein shak ho to jo log agli kitabein parhtay hain to un se pooch le, yaqeen maan ke teray Rab ki janib se teri taraf haq utar chuka hai, pas tu shak karne walon mein na ho. Yeh shart hai aur shart ka waqay hona kuch zaroori nahin, isi liye marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya na main shak karoon na kisi se sawal karoon. Teray Rab ki baatein sadaqat mein poori hain, is ka har hukm adl hai, woh apne hukm mein bhi aadil hai aur khabron mein sadiq hai aur yeh khabar sadaqat par mabni hai, jo khabrein us ne di hain woh bila shuba durust hain aur jo hukm farmaya hai woh sarasar adl hai aur jis cheez se roka woh yaksar batil hai kyunke woh jis cheez se rokta hai woh burai wali hi hoti hai, jaisay farman hai aayat (Ya-muruhum bil-ma'roofi wa yan-hahum 'anil munkari wa yuhillu lahumut tayyibati wa yuharrimu 'alaihimul khaba-itha wa yada'u 'anhum israhum wal-agh-lalallati kanat 'alaihim) (Surah Al-A'raf: 157). Woh unhein bhali baton ka hukm deta hai aur buri baton se rokta hai. Koi nahin jo is ke farman ko badal sakay, is ke hukm atal hain, duniya mein kya aur aakhirat mein kya is ka koi hukm tal nahin sakta. Is ka ta'aqub koi nahin kar sakta. Woh apne bandon ki baatein sunta hai aur un ki harkat-o-sakanat ko bakhoobi jaanta hai. Har aamil ko us ke buray bhalay amal ka badla woh zaroor de ga.

Allah ke faislay atal hain. Hukm hota hai ke mushrik jo ke Allah ke siwa dusron ki parastish kar rahe hain un se keh dijiye ke kya main aapas mein faisla karne wala bajuz Allah Ta'ala ke kisi aur ko talash karoon? Isi ne saaf khulay faislay karne wali kitab nazil farma di hai. Yahood-o-Nasara jo sahib-e-kitab hain aur jin ke paas aglay nabiyon ki basharatain hain woh bakhoobi jaantay hain ke yeh Quran-e-Kareem Allah ki taraf se haq ke sath nazil shuda hai, tujhay shakki logon mein na milna chahiye, jaisay farman hai (Fa-in kunta fi shakkin mimma anzalna ilaika fas-alillazeena yaqra-oonal kitaba min qablika laqad ja-akal haqqu mir rabbika fala takoonanna minal mumtareen) (Surah Yunus: 94). Yeh shart hai aur shart ka waqay hona kuch zaroori nahin, isi liye marwi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya na main shak karoon na kisi se sawal karoon. Teray Rab ki baatein sadaqat mein poori hain, is ka har hukm adl hai, woh apne hukm mein bhi aadil hai aur khabron mein sadiq hai aur yeh khabar sadaqat par mabni hai, jo khabrein us ne di hain woh bila shuba durust hain aur jo hukm farmaya hai woh sarasar adl hai aur jis cheez se roka woh yaksar batil hai kyunke woh jis cheez se rokta hai woh burai wali hi hoti hai, jaisay farman hai aayat (Ya-muruhum bil-ma'roofi wa yan-hahum 'anil munkari wa yuhillu lahumut tayyibati wa yuharrimu 'alaihimul khaba-itha wa yada'u 'anhum israhum wal-agh-lalallati kanat 'alaihim) (Surah Al-A'raf: 157). Woh unhein bhali baton ka hukm deta hai aur buri baton se rokta hai. Koi nahin jo is ke farman ko badal sakay, is ke hukm atal hain, duniya mein kya aur aakhirat mein kya is ka koi hukm tal nahin sakta. Is ka ta'aqub koi nahin kar sakta. Woh apne bandon ki baatein sunta hai aur un ki harkat-o-sakanat ko bakhoobi jaanta hai. Har aamil ko us ke buray bhalay amal ka badla woh zaroor de ga.

Bekar khayalon mein giraftar log: Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke aksar log duniya mein gumrah kun hote hain jaise farman hai ayat (Wa laqad dallah qablahum aksarul awwaleen) (Surah As-Saffat: 71) aur jagah hai ayat (Wa ma aksarun nasi wa lau harasta bi mu'mineen) (Surah Yusuf: 103) go tu hirs kare lekin aksar log iman lane wale nahin. Phir yeh log apni gumrahi mein bhi kisi yaqeen par nahin, sirf batil guman aur bekar khayalon ka shikar hain, andaze se baatein bana lete hain phir un ke peeche ho lete hain, khayalat ke parau hain, toham parasti mein ghire hue hain. Yeh sab mashiyat-e-Ilahi hai, woh gumrahon ko bhi janta hai aur un par gumrahiyan asan kar deta hai, woh rah-yafta logon se bhi waqif hai aur unhein hidayat asan kar deta hai, har shakhs par wahi kaam asan hote hain jin ke liye woh paida kiya gaya hai.

Bekar khayalon mein giraftar log: Allah Ta'ala khabar deta hai ke aksar log duniya mein gumrah kun hote hain jaise farman hai ayat (Wa laqad dallah qablahum aksarul awwaleen) (Surah As-Saffat: 71) aur jagah hai ayat (Wa ma aksarun nasi wa lau harasta bi mu'mineen) (Surah Yusuf: 103) go tu hirs kare lekin aksar log iman lane wale nahin. Phir yeh log apni gumrahi mein bhi kisi yaqeen par nahin, sirf batil guman aur bekar khayalon ka shikar hain, andaze se baatein bana lete hain phir un ke peeche ho lete hain, khayalat ke parau hain, toham parasti mein ghire hue hain. Yeh sab mashiyat-e-Ilahi hai, woh gumrahon ko bhi janta hai aur un par gumrahiyan asan kar deta hai, woh rah-yafta logon se bhi waqif hai aur unhein hidayat asan kar deta hai, har shakhs par wahi kaam asan hote hain jin ke liye woh paida kiya gaya hai.

Sirf Allah Ta'ala ke naam ka zabiha halal baqi sab haram. Hukm bayan ho raha hai ke jis janwar ko Allah ka naam le kar zibah kiya jaye use kha liya karo. Is se maloom hota hai ke jis janwar ke zibah ke waqt Allah ka naam na liya gaya ho us ka khana mubah nahin, jaise mushrikeen az-khud mar gaya ho aur murdar janwar, buton aur thalon par zibah kiya hua janwar kha liya karte thay. Koi wajah nahin ke jin halal janwaron ko shariat ke hukm ke mutabiq zibah kiya jaye us ke khane mein haraj samjha jaye, bilkhusoos us waqt ke har haram janwar ka bayan khol khol kar diya gaya hai. Fasl ki dusri qirat 'fasala' hai, woh haram janwar khane mamnoo hain siwaye majboori aur sakht bebasi ke ke us waqt jo mil jaye us ke kha lene ki ijazat hai. Phir kafiron ki ziyadti bayan ho rahi hai ke woh murdar janwar ko aur un janwaron ko jin par Allah ke siwa dusron ke naam liye gaye hon halal jante thay. Yeh log bila ilm sirf khwahish parasti kar ke dusron ko bhi rah-e-haq se hata rahe hain. Aison ki iftira pardazi, darogh bafi aur ziyadti ko Allah bakhoobi janta hai.

Sirf Allah Ta'ala ke naam ka zabiha halal baqi sab haram. Hukm bayan ho raha hai ke jis janwar ko Allah ka naam le kar zibah kiya jaye use kha liya karo. Is se maloom hota hai ke jis janwar ke zibah ke waqt Allah ka naam na liya gaya ho us ka khana mubah nahin, jaise mushrikeen az-khud mar gaya ho aur murdar janwar, buton aur thalon par zibah kiya hua janwar kha liya karte thay. Koi wajah nahin ke jin halal janwaron ko shariat ke hukm ke mutabiq zibah kiya jaye us ke khane mein haraj samjha jaye, bilkhusoos us waqt ke har haram janwar ka bayan khol khol kar diya gaya hai. Fasl ki dusri qirat 'fasala' hai, woh haram janwar khane mamnoo hain siwaye majboori aur sakht bebasi ke ke us waqt jo mil jaye us ke kha lene ki ijazat hai. Phir kafiron ki ziyadti bayan ho rahi hai ke woh murdar janwar ko aur un janwaron ko jin par Allah ke siwa dusron ke naam liye gaye hon halal jante thay. Yeh log bila ilm sirf khwahish parasti kar ke dusron ko bhi rah-e-haq se hata rahe hain. Aison ki iftira pardazi, darogh bafi aur ziyadti ko Allah bakhoobi janta hai.

Zahiri aur batini gunahon ko tark kardo, chote bade poshida aur zahir, har gunah ko chhodo. Na khuli badkar aurton ke han jao na chori chhupe badkariyan karo, khulam khula un aurton se nikah na karo jo tum par haram kardi gayi hain, garz har gunah se door raho, kyunke har badkari ka bura badla hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke gunah kise kehte hain? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya jo tere dil mein khatke aur tu na chahe ke kisi ko is ki ittila ho jaye.

Sudhaye hue kutton ka shikar yahi aayat hai jis se baaz ulama ne yeh samjha hai ke go kisi musalman ne hi zibah kiya ho lekin agar ba-waqt-e-zibah Allah ka naam nahin liya toh us zabiha ka khana haram hai, is bare mein ulama ke teen qaul hain ek toh wahi jo mazkoor hua, khwah jaan boojh kar Allah ka naam na liya ho ya bhool kar, is ki daleel aayat (فَكُلُوْا مِمَّآ اَمْسَكْنَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَاذْكُرُوا اسْمَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْهِ ۠ وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ ۭاِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِيْعُ الْحِسَابِ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 4) hai yani jis shikar ko tumhare shikari kutte rok rakhein tum use kha lo aur Allah ka naam us par lo, is aayat mein isi ki takeed ki aur farmaya ke yeh khuli nafarmani hai yani us ka khana ya ghair-e-Allah ke naam par zibah karna, ahadees mein bhi shikar ke aur zabiha ke mutaliq hukum warid hua hai Aap (ﷺ) farmate hain jab tu apne sudhaye hue kutte ko Allah ka naam le kar chhore jis janwar ko woh tere liye pakar kar rok le toh use kha le aur hadees mein hai jo cheez khoon baha de aur Allah ka naam bhi us par liya gaya ho use kha liya karo, jinnon se Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya tha tumhare liye har woh haddi ghiza hai jis par Allah ka naam liya jaye, Eid ki qurbani ke mutaliq Aap (ﷺ) ka irshad marwi hai ke jis ne namaz-e-Eid parhne se pehle hi zibah kar liya woh us ke badle dusra janwar zibah kar le aur jis ne qurbani nahin ki woh hamare sath Eid ki namaz parhe phir Allah ka naam le kar apni qurbani ke janwar ko zibah kare, chand logon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) se poocha ke baaz nau-muslim hamein gosht dete hain kya khabar unhon ne in janwaron ke zibah karne ke waqt Allah ka naam bhi liya ya nahin? Toh Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya tum un par Allah ka naam lo aur kha lo, al-gharaz is hadees se bhi yeh mazhab qawi hota hai kyunke sahaba ne bhi samjha ke Bismillah parhna zaroori hai aur yeh log ahkam-e-Islam se sahih taur par waqif nahin abhi abhi musalman hue hain kya khabar Allah ka naam lete bhi hain ya nahin? Toh Huzoor (ﷺ) ne unhein bator-e-mazeed ehtiyat farma diya ke tum khud Allah ka naam le lo taake bil-farz unhon ne na bhi liya ho toh yeh us ka badla ho jaye, warna har musalman par zahiran husn-e-zan hi hoga, dusra qaul is masle mein yeh hai ke ba-waqt-e-zibah Bismillah ka parhna shart nahin balkay mustahab hai agar chhoot jaye go amdan ho ya bhool kar, koi haraj nahin. Is aayat mein jo farmaya gaya hai ke yeh fisq hai us ka matlab yeh log yeh lete hain ke is se murad ghair-e-Allah ke liye zibah kiya hua janwar hai jaise aur aayat mein hai (اَوْ فِسْقًا اُهِلَّ لِغَيْرِ اللّٰهِ بِهٖ) (Surah Al-An'am: 145) ba-qaul-e-Ata in janwaron se roka gaya hai jinhein kuffar apne maboodon ke naam zibah karte the aur majoosiyon ke zabiha se bhi man'a ki gayi, is ka jawab baaz muta'akhireen ne yeh bhi diya hai ke (wa-innahu) mein wao-e-haliya hai, toh fisq fa-alaihi haliya par lazim aayega, lekin yeh daleel us ke baad ke jumle (wa inna-sh-shayateena) se hi toot jati hai is liye ke woh toh yaqeenan aatifa jumla hai.

Toh jis aglay wao ko haaliya kaha gaya hai agar usay haaliya maan liya jaye toh phir us par is jumlay ka atf na-jaiz hoga aur agar usay pehlay ke haaliya jumlay par atf dala jaye toh jo aitraaz yeh doosray par waarid kar rahay thay wahi in par paray ga, haan agar is wao ko haaliya na maana jaye toh yeh aitraaz hat sakta hai lekin jo baat aur dawa tha woh siray se baatil ho jaye ga. Wallahu A'lam. Ibn-e-Abbas ka qaul hai muraad is se murdaar jaanwar hai jo apni maut aap mar gaya ho. Is mazhab ki ta'eed Abu Dawood ki aik mursal hadith se bhi ho sakti hai jis mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farmaan hai ke musalman ka zabiha halaal hai us ne Allah ka naam liya ho ya na liya ho kyunke agar woh leta toh Allah ka naam hi leta. Is ki mazbooti Dar-e-Qutni ki is riwayat se hoti hai ke Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas ne farmaya jab musalman zibah karay aur Allah ka naam na zikr karay toh kha liya karo kyunke musalman Allah ke naamon mein se aik naam hai, isi mazhab ki daleel mein woh hadith bhi pesh ho sakti hai jo pehlay bayaan ho chuki hai ke nau-muslimon ke zabiha ke khanay ki jis mein dono ehtemaal thay aap ne ijazat di toh agar Bismillah ka kehna shart aur laazim hota toh Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) tehqeeq karnay ka hukum detay, teesra qaul yeh hai ke agar Bismillah kehna ba-waqt-e-zibah bhool gaya hai toh zabiha par amdan Bismillah na kahi jaye woh haraam hai isi liye Imam Abu Yusuf aur mashaikh ne kaha hai ke agar koi haakim usay bachnay ka hukum bhi de toh woh hukum jaari nahin ho sakta kyunke ijma ke khilaaf hai lekin sahib-e-Hidayah ka yeh qaul mehez ghalat hai, Imam Shafi (R.H) se pehlay bhi bohat se aimma is ke khilaaf thay chunancha oopar jo doosra mazhab bayaan hua hai ke Bismillah parhna shart nahin balkay mustahab hai yeh Imam Shafi (R.H) ka, un ke sab sathiyon ka aur aik riwayat mein Imam Ahmed (R.H) ka aur Imam Malik (R.H) ka aur Ash-hab bin Abdul Aziz ka mazhab hai aur yahi bayaan kiya gaya hai. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Hazrat Abu Hurairah (R.A), Hazrat Atta bin Abi Rabah (R.H) ka is se ikhtilaf hai. Phir ijma ka dawa karna kaisay durust ho sakta hai Wallahu A'lam. Imam Abu Jafar bin Jareer (R.H) farmatay hain ke jin logon ne ba-waqt-e-zibah Bismillah bhool kar na kahay jaanay par bhi zabiha haraam kaha hai unhon ne aur dalail se is hadith ki bhi mukhalifat ki hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya musalman ko us ka naam hi kaafi hai agar woh zibah ke waqt Allah ka naam zikr karna bhool gaya toh Allah ka naam le aur kha lay. Yeh hadith Baihaqi mein hai lekin is ka marfoo riwayat karna khata hai aur yeh khata Mu'qal bin Ubaidullah Kharzami ki hai, hain toh yeh Sahih Muslim ke raawiyon mein se magar Saeed bin Mansoor aur Abdullah bin Zubair Hameeri isay Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) se mauqoof riwayat kartay hain. Ba-qaul Imam Baihaqi yeh riwayat sab se zyada sahih hai. Sha'bi aur Muhammad bin Sireen is jaanwar ka khana makrooh jaantay thay jis par Allah ka naam na liya gaya ho go bhool se hi reh gaya ho. Zahir hai ke salaf karahiyat ka itlaq hurmat par kartay thay. Wallahu A'lam.

Haan yeh yaad rahe ke Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ka qaida yeh hai ke woh un do ek qaulon ko koi cheez nahin samajhte jo jumhoor ke mukhalif hon aur usey ijma shumar karte hain. Wallahul Muwaffiq. Imam Hasan Basri (R.H) se ek shakhs ne masla poocha ke mere paas bahut se parind zibah shuda aaye hain un mein se baaz ke zibah ke waqt Bismillah padhi gayi hai aur baaz par bhool se reh gayi hai aur sab ghalat malat ho gaye hain, aap ne fatwa diya ke sab kha lo, phir Muhammad bin Sirin se yahi sawal hua to aap ne farmaya jin par Allah ka naam zikr nahin kiya gaya unhein na khao. Is teesre mazhab ki daleel mein yeh hadith bhi pesh ki jaati hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya Allah Ta'ala ne meri ummat ki khata ko, bhool ko aur jis kaam par zabardasti ki jaye us ko maaf farma diya hai lekin is mein zu'f hai. Ek hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaya aur kaha Ya Rasool Allah! bataiye to hum mein se koi shakhs zibah kare aur Bismillah kehna bhool jaye? Aap ne farmaya Allah ka naam har musalman ki zaban par hai (ya'ni woh halal hai) lekin is ki asnaad za'eef hain, Mardan bin Salim Abu Abdullah Shami is hadith ka raawi hai aur un par bahut se aimma ne jarh ki hai, Wallahu A'lam. Main ne is masle par ek mustaqil kitab likhi hai us mein tamam mazahib aur un ke dalail waghera tafseel se likhe hain aur poori behas ki hai, bazahir daleelon se yahi maloom hota hai ke zibah ke waqt Bismillah kehna zaroori hai lekin agar kisi musalman ki zaban se jaldi mein ya bhoole se ya kisi aur wajah se na nikle aur zibah ho gaya to woh haram nahin hota (Wallahu A'lam mutarjim). Aam ahl-e-ilm to kehte hain ke is aayat ka koi hissa mansookh nahin lekin baaz hazraat kehte hain is mein ahl-e-kitab ke zabiha ka istisna kar liya gaya hai aur un ka zibah kiya hua halal janwar kha lena hamare yahan halal hai to go woh apni istilah mein usey naskh se ta'beer karein lekin darasal yeh ek makhsoos soorat hai. Phir farmaya ke shaitan apne waliyon ki taraf wahi karte hain. Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar (R.A) se jab kaha gaya ke Mukhtar guman karta hai ke us ke paas wahi aati hai to aap ne isi aayat ki tilawat farma kar farmaya woh theek kehta hai. Shaitan bhi apne doston ki taraf wahi karte hain aur riwayat mein hai ke us waqt Mukhtar hajj ko aaya hua tha. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ke is jawab se ke woh sacha hai us shakhs ko sakht ta'ajjub hua, us waqt aap ne tafseel bayan farmayi ke ek to Allah ki wahi jo An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki taraf aayi aur ek shaitani wahi hai jo shaitan ke doston ki taraf aati hai. Shaitani wasawas ko le kar lashkar-e-shaitan Allah walon se jhagarte hain. Chunancha yahudiyon ne An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke yeh kya andher hai? Ke hum apne hath se mara hua janwar to kha lein aur jise Allah maar de ya'ni apni maut aap mar jaye usey na khayein?

Is par yeh aayat utri aur bayan farmaya ke wajah-e-hillat Allah ke naam ka zikr hai lekin hai yeh qissa ghaur talab. Awwalan is wajah se ke Yahudi az-khud mare hue janwar ka khana halal nahin jante the, dusre is wajah se bhi ke Yahudi toh Madine mein the aur yeh poori Surah Makka mein utri hai. Teesre yeh ke yeh hadith Tirmidhi mein marwi toh hai lekin mursal Tabrani mein hai ke is hukm ke nazil hone ke baad ke jis par Allah ka naam liya gaya ho use kha lo aur jis par Allah ka naam na liya gaya ho use na khao, toh Ahl-e-Fars ne Quraishiyon se kehwa bheja ke Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se woh jhagrein aur kahein ke jise tum apni chhuri se zibah karo woh toh halal aur jise Allah Ta'ala sone ki chhuri se khud zibah kare woh haram? Ya'ni maitah az-khud mara hua janwar. Is par yeh aayat utri, pas shayateen se murad Farsi hain aur unke auliya Quraish hain aur bhi is tarah ki bahut si riwayatein kayi ek sanadon se marwi hain lekin kisi mein bhi Yahood ka zikr nahin. Pas sahih yahi hai kyunke aayat Makki hai aur Yahudi Madine mein the aur is liye bhi ke Yahudi khud murdar-khwar na the. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jise tumne zibah kiya yeh toh woh hai jis par Allah ka naam liya gaya aur jo az-khud mar gaya woh woh hai jis par Allah ka naam nahin liya gaya. Mushrikeen-e-Quraish Farsiyon se khat-o-kitabat kar rahe the aur Rumiyon ke khilaf unhein mashware aur imdad pahunchate the aur Farsi Quraishiyon se khat-o-kitabat rakhte the aur Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke khilaf unhein uksate aur unki imdad karte the, isi mein unhone mushrikeen ki taraf yeh aitraz bhi bheja tha aur mushrikeen ne Sahaba se yahi aitraz kiya aur ba'az Sahaba ke dilon mein bhi yeh baat khatki, is par yeh aayat utri. Phir farmaya agar tumne unki tabedari ki toh tum mushrik ho jaoge ke tumne Allah ki shariat aur farman-e-Quran ke khilaf dusre ki maan li aur yahi shirk hai ke Allah ke qaul ke muqabil dusre ka qaul maan liya. Chunancha Quran-e-Kareem mein hai aayat: (Ittakhazu ahbarahum wa ruhbanahum arbaban min dunillahi wal-masihabna maryam, wa ma umiru illa liya'budu ilahan wahida, la ilaha illa huwa, subhanahu 'amma yushrikun) (Surah At-Tawbah: 31) ya'ni unhone apne aalimon aur darwesho ko ilah bana liya hai. Tirmidhi mein hai ke jab Hazrat Adi bin Hatim (R.A) ne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha ke Huzoor unhone unki ibadat nahin ki toh Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya unhone haram ko halal kaha aur halal ko haram kaha aur unhone unka kehna mana yahi ibadat hai.

Momin aur kafir ka taqabuli jaiza. Momin aur kafir ki misaal bayan ho rahi hai. Ek toh woh jo pehle murda tha yani kufr-o-gumrahi ki halat mein hairan-o-sargashta tha, Allah ne use zinda kiya, iman-o-hidayat bakhshi, itteba-e-Rasool (ﷺ) ka chaska diya, Quran jaisa noor ata farmaya jiske munawwar ahkaam ki roshni mein woh apni zindagi guzarta hai, Islam ki nooraniyat uske dil mein rach gayi hai. Dusra woh jo jahalat-o-zalalat ki tareekiyon mein ghira hua hai jo un mein se nikalne ki koi raah nahin pata. Kya yeh dono barabar ho sakte hain? Isi tarah Muslim-o-Kafir mein bhi tafawat hai, noor-o-zulmat ka farq aur iman-o-kufr ka farq zahir hai. Aur ayat mein hai (Allahu waliyyul-lazina amanu yukhrijuhum minaz-zulumati ilan-noor) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 257). Iman daron ka wali Allah Ta'ala hai, woh unhein andheron se nikal kar noor ki taraf lata hai aur kafiron ke wali taghoot hain jo unhein noor se hata kar andheron mein le jate hain, yeh abadi jahannami hain. Aur ayat mein hai (Afamay yamshi mukibban ala wajhihi) yani khameeda qamat wala tedhi raah chalne wala aur seedhe qamat wala seedhi raah chalne wala kya barabar hai? Aur ayat mein hai in dono firqon ki misaal andhe behre aur sunte dekhte ki tarah hai ke dono mein farq numaya hai, afsos phir bhi tum ibrat hasil nahin karte. Aur jagah farman hai andha aur beena, andhera aur roshni, saya aur dhoop, zinde aur murde barabar nahin. Allah jise chahe suna de lekin tu qabr walon ko suna nahin sakta, tu toh sirf aagah kar dene wala hai. Aur bhi ayatein is mazmoon ki bahut si hain. Is surat ke shuru mein zulumat aur noor ka zikr tha, isi munasibat se yahan bhi momin aur kafir ki yahi misaal bayan farmayi gayi. Baaz kehte hain murad is se woh khaas muayyan shakhs hain jaise Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ke yeh pehle gumrah the, Allah ne unhein islami zindagi bakhshi aur unhein noor ata farmaya jise le kar logon mein chalte phirte hain. Aur kaha gaya hai ke is se murad Hazrat Ammar bin Yasir (R.A) hain aur zulumat mein jo phansa hua hai is se murad Abu Jahl hai. Sahih yahi hai ke ayat aam hai, har momin aur kafir ki misaal hai. Kafiron ki nigah mein unki apni jahalat-o-zalalat isi tarah aarasta-o-pairasta kar ke dikhayi jati hai. Yeh bhi Allah Ta'ala ki qaza-o-qadar hai ke woh apni buraiyon ko hi achhaiyan samajhte hain. Musnad ki ek hadith mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne apni makhlooq ko andhere mein paida kar ke phir apna noor un par dala, jise is noor ka hissa mila usne duniya mein aa kar raah payi aur jo wahan mehroom raha woh yahan bhi behka hi raha, jaise farman hai ke Allah apne bandon ko andheron se ujale ki taraf le jata hai aur jaise farman hai andha aur dekhta aur andhera aur roshni barabar nahin.

Bastiyon ke raees gumrah hojayein toh tabahi ki alamat hote hain. In aayaton mein bhi Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (ﷺ) ki taskeen farmata hai aur saath hi kuffar ko hoshiyar karta hai, farmata hai ke jaise aap ki is basti mein rusaye-kufr majood hain jo dusron ko bhi deen-e-barhaq se rokte hain isi tarah har paighambar ke zamane mein uski basti mein kufr ke sutoon aur markaz rahe hain lekin aakhir-kaar woh gharat aur tabah hote hain aur natija hamesha nabiyon ka hi achha rehta hai. Jaise farmaya ke har Nabi ke dushman unke zamane ke gunahgar rahe aur aayat mein hai hum jab kisi basti ko tabah karna chahte hain toh wahan ke raeeson ko kuch hukm-e-ahkaam dete hain jis mein woh khullam-khulla hamari nafarmani karte hain, pas itaat se gurez karne par azabon mein ghir jate hain, wahan ke shareer log auj par aajate hain phir basti halak hoti hai aur qismat ka an-mit likha samne aajata hai. Chunancha aur aayaton mein hai ke jahan kahin koi paighambar aaya wahan ke raeeson aur bade logon ne jhat se keh diya ke hum tumhare risalat ke munkir hain, maal mein aulad mein hum tum se zyada hain aur hum ise bhi mante nahin ke hamein saza ho. Aur aayat mein hai ke hum ne jis basti mein jis Rasool ko bheja wahan ke bade logon ne jawab diya ke hum ne toh jis tariqe par apne badon ko paya hai hum toh usi par chale chalenge. Makr se murad gumrahi ki taraf bulana hai aur apni chikni chupdi baton mein logon ko phansana hai jaise ke qaum-e-Nuh ke bare mein hai aayat (Wa makaru makran kubbara) (71. Nuh: 22). Qayamat ke din bhi jabke yeh zalim Allah ke samne khade honge ek dusre ko moreed-e-ilzam thehrayenge, jhoote log bade logon se kahenge ke agar tum na hote toh hum toh musalman hojate, woh jawab denge ke hum ne tumhein hidayat se kab roka tha? Tum toh khud gunahgar the, yeh kahenge tumhari din-raat ki fitna-angeziyon ne aur kufr-o-shirk ki dawat ne hamein gumrah kardiya. Makr ke ma'ani Hazrat Sufiyan ne har jagah amal ke kiye hain. Phir farmata hai ke unke makr ka wabaal inhi par padega lekin unhein iska shaoor nahin, jin logon ko unhon ne behkaya unka wabaal bhi unhi ke dosh par hoga jaise farman hai aayat (Wa layahmilunna asqalahum wa asqalan ma'a asqalihim wa layus'alunna yaumal qiyamati amma kanu yaftarun) (29. Al-Ankabut: 13) yani apne bojh ke saath unke bojh bhi dhoenge, jin ko be-ilmi ke saath unhon ne behkaya tha. Jab koi nishan aur daleel dekhte hain toh keh dete hain ke kuch bhi ho jab tak Allah ka paigham farishte ki ma'rifat khud hamein na aaye hum toh bawar karne wale nahin. Kaha karte the ke hum par farishte kyun nazil nahin hote? Allah hamein apna deedar kyun nahin dikhata? Halanke risalat ke mustahiq ki asli jagah ko Allah hi janta hai. Unka ek aitraz yeh bhi tha ke in dono bastiyon mein kisi bade raees par yeh Quran kyun na utra?

Jis ke jawab mein Allah Azza wa Jall ne farmaya kya tere Rab ki Rahmat ke taqseem karne wale woh hain? Pas Makkah ya Taif ke kisi raees par Quran ke nazil na hone se woh Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ) ki tahqeer ka irada karte thay aur yeh sirf zid aur takabbur ki bina par tha, jaise farman hai ke tujhe dekhte hi yeh log mazaq urate hain aur keh dete hain ke kya yahi hai jo tumhare maboodon ka zikr kiya karta hai? Yeh log Zikr-e-Rahman ke munkir hain, kaha karte thay ke achha yahi hain jinhein Allah ne apna Rasool banaya? Nateeja yeh hua ke in maskharon ka maskhara-pan inhi par ulta para, unhein manna hi para tha ke Aap shareef-un-nasab hain, Aap sachay aur ameen hain yahan tak ke nabuwwat se pehle qoum ki taraf se Aap ko Ameen ka khitab mila tha. Abu Sufyan jaise in kafir Quraishiyon ke sardar ne bhi darbar-e-Heraclius mein bhi Huzoor (ﷺ) ke aali nasab hone aur sachay hone ki shahadat di thi. Jis se Shah-e-Room ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ki sadaqat, taharat, nabuwwat waghera ko maan liya tha. Musnad ki hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne aulad-e-Ibrahim se Ismail ko pasand farmaya. Aulad-e-Ismail se Banu Kinana ko pasand farmaya. Banu Kinana se Quraish ko, Quraish mein se Banu Hashim ko aur Banu Hashim mein se mujhe. Farman hai ke yakay baad deegray qarnon mein se main sab se behtar zamane mein paighambar banaya gaya. Ek martaba jabke Aap ko logon ki ba'az kahi hui baatein pahunchin to Aap mimbar par tashreef laye aur logon se poocha main kaun hoon? Unhon ne kaha Aap Allah ke Rasool hain. Farmaya main Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Abdul Muttalib hoon, Allah Ta'ala ne apni tamam makhlooq mein mujhe behtar banaya hai, makhlooq ko jab do hisson mein taqseem kiya to mujhe un donon mein jo behtar hissa tha us mein kiya, phir qabeelon ki taqseem ke waqt mujhe sab se behtar qabeelay mein kiya, phir jab ghar-dariyon mein taqseem kiya to mujhe sab se achhay gharanay mein banaya, pas main gharanay ke aitbar se aur zaat ke aitbar se tum sab se behtar hoon, Salawatullahi wa Salamuhu Alaih. Hazrat Jibraeel (A.S) ne ek martaba Aap se farmaya main ne tamam mashriq-o-maghrib tatol liya lekin Aap se zyada afzal kisi ko nahin paya (Hakim, Baihaqi). Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Allah Ta'ala ne apne bandon ke dilon ko dekha aur sab se behtar dil Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ) ka paya. Phir makhlooq ke dilon par nigah dali to sab se behtar dil wale Ashab-e-Rasool paye, pas Huzoor (ﷺ) ko apna khaas cheeda Rasool banaya aur Ashab ko Aap ka wazeer banaya jo Aap ke deen ke dushmanon ke dushman hain. Pas yeh Musalman jis cheez ko behtar samjhein woh Allah Wahdahu La Shareeka ke nazdeek bhi behtar hai aur jisay yeh bura samjhein woh Allah ke nazdeek bhi buri hai. Ek bahar ke shakhs ne Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) ko masjid ke darwazay se aata hua dekh kar mar'oob ho kar logon se poocha yeh kaun buzurg hain? Logon ne kaha yeh Rasool-e-Kareem (ﷺ) ke chacha ke larkay Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas (R.A) hain.

Toh un ke munh se besakhta yeh aayat nikli ke nabuwwat ki jagah ko Allah hi bakhoobi jaanta hai, phir farmata hai ke jo log is azeem-ush-shan Nabi (ﷺ) ki nabuwwat mein shak-o-shuba kar rahe hain, ita'at se munh pher rahe hain, unhein Allah ke saamne Qayamat ke din badi zillat uthani padegi. Duniya ke takabbur ki saza khwari ki surat mein unhein milegi jo un par daimi hogi. Jaise farman hai ke jo log meri ibadat se jee churata hain woh zaleel-o-khwar ho kar Jahannam mein jayenge. Unhein un ke makr ki saza aur sakht saza milegi, chunke makkaroon ki chaalein khufiya aur halki hoti hain, is ke badle mein azaab alaniya aur sakht honge. Yeh Allah ka zulm nahin balki un ka poora badla hai. Us din saari chupi ayyariyan khul jayengi. Huzoor (ﷺ) ka irshad hai ke har bad-ahd ki raano ke paas Qayamat ke din ek jhanda lehrata hoga aur elaan hota hoga ke yeh falan bin falan ki ghaddari hai, pas is duniya ki poshidgi is tarah Qayamat ke din zahir hogi. Allah hamein bachaye.

Allah hamein bachaye.

Jis par Allah ka karam us pe rah-e-hidayat aasaan. Allah ka irada jise hidayat karne ka hota hai us par neki ke raaste aasaan ho jate hain, jaise farman hai aayat (Afaman sharahallahu sadrahu lil-islami fahuwa 'ala noorim mir rabbihi) al-kh, yani Allah un ke seene Islam ki taraf khol deta hai aur unhein apna noor ata farmata hai. Aur aayat mein farmaya aayat (Wa lakinnallaha habbaba ilaikumul-imana wa zayyanahu fi qulubikum wa karraha ilaikumul-kufra wal-fusuqa wal-'isyana, ula'ika humur-rashidun) (49. Al-Hujurat: 7). Allah ne tumhare dilon mein iman ki mohabbat paida kardi aur use tumhare dilon mein zeenat-dar bana diya aur kufr, fisq aur nafarmani ki tumhare dilon mein karahiyat daal di, yahi log rah-yafta aur nek-bakht hain. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A farmate hain is ka dil iman-o-tauheed ki taraf kushada ho jata hai. Huzoor ﷺ se sawal hua ke sab se zyada dana kaun sa momin hai? Farmaya sab se zyada maut ko yaad rakhne wala aur sab se zyada maut ke baad ki zindagi ke liye taiyariyan karne wala. Huzoor ﷺ se is aayat ki babat sawal hua to farmaya ke is ke dil mein ek noor daal diya jata hai jis se is ka seena khul jata hai. Logon ne is ki nishani daryaft ki to farmaya jannat ki taraf jhukna aur is ki janib raghbat qaim rakhna aur duniya ke fareb se bhagna aur alag hona aur maut ke aane se pehle taiyariyan karna. Zaiqan ki ek qira'at (Zaiqan) bhi hai, (Harajan) ki dusri (Harajan) bhi hai, yani gunehgar ya donon ke ek hi ma'ani yani tang jo hidayat ke liye na khule aur iman is mein jagah na paye. Ek martaba ek badiyanasheen buzurg se Hazrat Umar Farooq R.A ne harajan ke bare mein daryaft farmaya to us ne kaha yeh ek darakht hota hai jis ke paas na to charwahe jate hain na janwar na wehshi. Aap ne farmaya sach hai aisa hi munafiq ka dil hota hai ke is mein koi bhalai jagah pati hi nahin. Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka qaul hai ke Islam bawajood aasaan aur kushada hone ke use sakht aur tang maloom hota hai. Khud Quran mein hai aayat (Wa ma ja'ala 'alaikum fid-deeni min haraj) (22. Al-Hajj: 78). Allah ne tumhare deen mein koi tangi nahin rakhi. Lekin munafiq ka shaki dil is ne'mat se mehroom rehta hai, use La ilaha illallah ka iqrar ek museebat maloom hoti hai, jaise kisi par aasman par charhai mushkil ho, jaise woh is ke bas ki baat nahin, isi tarah tauheed-o-iman bhi is ke qabze se bahar hain, pas murda dil wale kabhi bhi Islam qabool nahin karte. Isi tarah Allah Ta'ala be-imano par shaitan muqarrar kar deta hai jo unhein behkate rehte hain aur khair se un ke dil ko tang karte rehte hain. Nahusat un par barasti rehti hai aur azab un par utar aate hain.

Quran-e-Hakim hi Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki tashreeh hai. Gumrahon ka tareeqa bayan farma kar apne is Deen-e-Haq ki nisbat farmata hai ke seedhi aur saaf raah jo be-rok Allah ki taraf pahuncha de yahi hai. (Mustaqeeman) ka nasb haliyat ki wajah se hai. Pas Shar-e-Muhammadi, Kalam-e-Bari Ta'ala hi raah-e-raast hai. Chunancha hadith mein bhi Quran ki sifat mein kaha gaya hai ke Allah ki seedhi raah, Allah ki mazboot rassi aur hikmat wala zikr yahi hai (mulaiza ho Tirmidhi, Musnad waghera). Jinhein Allah ki janib se aql-o-fahm-o-amal diya gaya hai un ke samne toh wazahat ke sath Allah ki ayatein aa chukein. In imandaron ke liye Allah ke haan jannat hai, jaise ke yeh salamti ki raah yahan chalein waise hi Qayamat ke din salamti ka ghar unhein milega. Wohi salamtiyon ka maalik Allah Ta'ala hai, un ka kaar-saaz aur dili dost hai. Hafiz-o-Nasir, Mu'ayyid-o-Maula un ka wohi hai. Un ke nek aamal ka badla yeh paak ghar hoga jahan hameshangi hai aur yaksar rahat-o-itminan, suroor aur khushi hi khushi hai.

Quran-e-Hakim hi Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki tashreeh hai. Gumrahon ka tareeqa bayan farma kar apne is Deen-e-Haq ki nisbat farmata hai ke seedhi aur saaf raah jo be-rok Allah ki taraf pahuncha de yahi hai. (Mustaqeeman) ka nasb haliyat ki wajah se hai. Pas Shar-e-Muhammadi, Kalam-e-Bari Ta'ala hi raah-e-raast hai. Chunancha hadith mein bhi Quran ki sifat mein kaha gaya hai ke Allah ki seedhi raah, Allah ki mazboot rassi aur hikmat wala zikr yahi hai (mulaiza ho Tirmidhi, Musnad waghera).
