In imandaron ke liye Allah ke haan jannat hai, jaise ke yeh salamti ki raah yahan chalein waise hi Qayamat ke din salamti ka ghar unhein milega. Wohi salamtiyon ka maalik Allah Ta'ala hai, un ka kaar-saaz aur dili dost hai. Hafiz-o-Nasir, Mu'ayyid-o-Maula un ka wohi hai. Un ke nek aamal ka badla yeh paak ghar hoga jahan hameshangi hai aur yaksar rahat-o-itminan, suroor aur khushi hi khushi hai.

Yaum-e-Hashr woh din bhi qareeb hai jabke Allah Ta'ala un sab ko jama karega. Janab-e-insan, aabid, mabood sab ek maidan mein kharay honge. Us waqt jinnaat se irshad hoga ke tum ne insanon ko khoob behkaya aur warghalaya. Insanon ko yaad dilaya jayega ke main ne toh tumhein pehle hi keh diya tha ke shaitan ki na manna woh tumhara dushman hai, meri hi ibadat karte rehna, yahi seedhi raah hai, lekin tum ne samajh se kaam na liya aur shaitani raag mein aa gaye. Us waqt jinnaat ke dost insan jawab denge ke haan, unhon ne hukum diya aur hum ne amal kiya, duniya mein ek dusre ke sath rahe aur faida hasil karte rahe. Jahiliyat ke zamana mein jo musafir kahin utarta toh kehta ke is wadi ke baray jin ki panah mein main aata hoon. Insanon se jinnaat ko bhi faida pahunchta tha ke woh apne aap ko un ka sardar samajhne lage thay, maut ke waqt tak yahi halat rahi. Us waqt unhein kaha jayega ke achha ab bhi tum sath hi jahannam mein jao, wahin hamesha paray rehna. Yeh istisna jo hai woh raaje' hai barzakh ki taraf, baaz kehte hain duniya ki muddat ki taraf. Is ka poora bayan Surah Hud ki aayat (Khālidīna fīhā mā dāmatis-samāwātu wal-ardu illā mā shā'a rabbuk, inna rabbaka fa'ʿālul limā yurīd) (11. Hud: 107) ki tafsir mein aayega Insha'Allah. Is aayat se maloom ho raha hai ke koi kisi ke liye jannat dozakh ka faisla nahin kar sakta. Sab mashiyat-e-Rabb par mauqoof hai.

Hum mizaj hi dost hote hain, logon ki dostiyan aamal par hoti hain. Momin ka dil momin se hi lagta hai, go woh kahin ka ho aur kaisa hi ho, aur kafir-o-kafir bhi ek hi hain, go woh mukhtalif mumalik aur mukhtalif zaat paat ke hon. Iman tamannaon aur zahir dariyon ka naam nahin. Is matlab ke ilawa is ayat ka ek matlab yeh bhi hai ke isi tarah yeke baad degare tamam kuffar jahannam mein jhonk diye jayenge. Malik bin Dinar R.H kehte hain, main ne Zaboor mein padha hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Main munafiqon se inteqam munafiqon ke sath hi lunga, phir sab se hi inteqam lunga. Is ki tasdeeq Quran ki mandarja bala ayat se bhi hoti hai ke hum wali banayenge ba'az zalimon ka, yani zalim jinn aur zalim ins. Phir aap ne ayat (وَمَنْ يَّعْشُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ الرَّحْمٰنِ نُـقَيِّضْ لَهٗ شَيْطٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهٗ قَرِيْنٌ) (Surah Az-Zukhruf: 36) ki tilawat ki aur farmaya ke hum sarkash jinnon ko sarkash insanon par musallat kar denge. Ek marfoo hadith mein hai, jo zalim ki madad karega, Allah Ta'ala usi ko us par musallat kar dega. Kisi shayar ka qaul hai: Wa ma min yadin illa yadullahi fauqaha, wa ma zalimin illa sayubla bi-zalimin. Yani har hath, har taqat par Allah ka hath aur Allah ki taqat bala hai aur har zalim dusre zalim ke panje mein phansne wala hai. Matlab ayat ka yeh hai ke hum ne jis tarah in nuqsan yafta insanon ke dost in behkane wale jinnon ko bana diya, isi tarah zalimon ko ba'az ko ba'az ka wali bana dete hain aur ba'az ba'az se halak hote hain aur hum un ke zulm-o-sarkashi aur baghawat ka badla ba'az se ba'az ko dila dete hain.

Jinn aur insaan aur padash-e-amal yeh aur sarzanish aur daant-dapat hai jo Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se insaanon aur jinnon ko hogi. Un se sawal hoga ke kya tum mein se hi tumhare paas mere bheje hue Rasool nahin aaye the. Yeh yaad rahe ke Rasool kul ke kul insaan hi the, koi jinn Rasool nahin hua. Aimma-e-Salaf-o-Khalaf ka mazhab yahi hai. Jinnat mein nek log aur jinnon ko neki ki taleem karte the, badi se rokte the lekin Rasool sirf insaanon mein se hi aate rahe. Zahhak bin Muzahim se ek riwayat marwi hai ke jinnat mein bhi Rasool hote hain aur un ki daleel ek toh yeh aayat hai, so yeh koi daleel nahin is liye ke is mein sarahat nahin aur yeh aayat toh bilkul waisi hi hai jaise aayat (Marajal-bahraini yaltaqiyan) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 19) se (Yakhruju minhumal lu'lu'u wal marjan) (Surah Ar-Rahman: 22) tak ki aayatein. Saaf zahir hai ke moti marjan sirf khari pani ke samundaron mein nikalte hain, meethe pani se nahin nikalte, lekin in aayaton mein dono qisam ke samundaron mein se motiyon ka nikalna paya jata hai ke un ki jins mein se murad yahi hai. Is tarah is aayat mein murad jinnon insaanon ki jins mein se hai na ke un dono mein se har ek mein se. Aur Rasoolon ke sirf insaan hi hone ki daleel aayat (Inna auhaina ilaika kama auhaina ila Nuhin wan-nabiyyina mim ba'dihi, wa auhaina ila Ibrahima wa Isma'ila wa Ishaqa wa Ya'quba wal-asbati wa 'Isa wa Ayyuba wa Yunusa wa Haruna wa Sulaimana, wa ataina Dawuda Zabura. Wa rusulan qad qasasnahum 'alaika min qablu wa rusulan lam naqsushum 'alaika, wa kallamallahu Musa taklima. Rusulan mubashshirina wa munzirina li'alla yakuna linnasi 'alallahi hujjatum ba'dar-rusul) (Surah An-Nisa: 163-165) aur (Wa ja'alna fi zurriyyatihiman-nubuwwata wal-kitaba faminhum muhtadin, wa kasirum minhum fasiqun) (Surah Al-Hadid: 26). Pas sabit hota hai ke Khalilullah Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke baad nubuwwat ka inhasar aap hi ki aulad mein ho raha. Aur yeh bhi zahir hai ke is anokhi baat ka qail ek bhi nahin ke aap se pehle nabi hote the aur phir un mein se nubuwwat chheen li gayi. Aur aayat is se bhi saaf hai, farman hai aayat (Wama arsalna qablaka minal-mursalina illa innahum laya'kulunat-ta'ama wa yamshuna fil-aswaqi, wa ja'alna ba'dakum liba'din fitnatan, atasbiruna, wa kana Rabbuka basira) (Surah Al-Furqan: 20). Yani tujh se pehle jitne Rasool hum ne bheje sab khana khate the aur bazaron mein aate jate the. Aur aayat mein hai aur us ne yeh masla bilkul saaf kar diya hai, farmata hai aayat (Wama arsalna min qablika illa rijalan nuhi ilaihim min ahlil-qura) (Surah Yusuf: 109).

(Yusuf: 109) Ya'ni tujh se pehle hum ne mardon ko hi bheja hai jo shahron ke hi the jin ki taraf hum ne apni wahi nazil farmayi thi. Chunancha jinat ka yahi qaul Quran mein majood hai ayat (Wa iz sarafna ilaika nafaran minal jinni yastami'unal qur'an, falamma hadaru hu qalu ansitu, falamma qudiya wallau ila qaumihim munzirin) (46. Al-Ahqaf: 29) jabke hum ne jinnon ki ek jama'at ko teri taraf phera jo Quran sunte rahe jab sun chuke to wapas apni qaum ke paas gaye aur unhein aagah karte hue kehne lage ke hum ne Musa ke baad ki nazil shuda kitab suni jo apne se pehle ki kitabon ki tasdeeq karti hai aur rah-e-haq dikhati hai aur sirat-e-mustaqeem ki rehbari karti hai, pas tum sab Allah ki taraf dawat dene wale ki mano aur us par iman lao taake Allah tumhare gunahon ko bakhshe aur tumhein alamnak azabon se bachaye. Allah ki taraf se jo pukarne wala hai us ki na manne wale Allah ko aajiz nahin kar sakte na us ke siwa apna koi aur karsaz aur wali pa sakte hain balkeh aise log khuli gumrahi mein hain. Tirmidhi waghera ki hadith mein hai ke is mauqa par jinat ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Surah Ar-Rahman parh kar sunayi thi jis mein ek ayat (Sanafrughu lakum ayyuhath thaqalan) (55. Ar-Rahman: 31) hai ya'ni ae jino insano hum sirf tumhari hi taraf tamam tar tawajjo karne ke liye anqareeb farigh honge. Phir tum apne Rab ki kis ne'mat ko jhutla rahe ho? Al-gharaz insanon aur jinnon ko is ayat mein nabiyon ke in mein se bhejne mein bator-e-khitab ke shamil kar liya hai warna Rasool sab insan hi hote hain. Nabiyon ka kaam yahi raha ke woh Allah ki ayatein sunayein aur Qayamat ke din se darayein. Is sawal ke jawab mein sab kahenge ke haan hamein iqrar hai tere Rasool hamare paas aaye aur tera kalam bhi pahunchaya aur us din se bhi mutanabbeh kar diya tha. Phir Janab-e-Bari farmata hai unhon ne duniya ki zindagi dhoke mein guzari, Rasoolon ko jhutlate rahe, mojizon ki mukhalifat karte rahe, duniya ki araish par jaan dete reh gaye, shahwat parasti mein pare rahe, Qayamat ke din apni zabanon se apne kufr ka iqrar karenge ke haan beshak hum ne nabiyon ki nahin mani. Salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaihim.

Hujjat tamam jinn aur insanon ki taraf Rasool bhej kar, kitabein utaar kar un ke uzr khatam kar diye is liye ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ka usool nahin ke woh kisi basti ke logon ko apni mansha maloom karaye baghair chup chaap apne azabon mein jakar le aur apna paigham pohanchaye baghair bila wajah zulm ke sath halak kar de, farmata hai aayat (Wa-in min ummatin illa khala feeha nazeer) (35. Fatir: 24) yani koi basti aisi nahin jahan koi aagah karne wala na aaya ho aur aayat mein hai hum ne har ummat mein Rasool bheja ke ae logo Allah hi ki ibadat karo aur us ke siwa har ek ki ibadat se bacho aur jagah hai hum Rasoolon ko bhejne se pehle azab nahin kiya karte. Surah Tabarak mein hai jab jahannam mein koi jamaat jaye gi to wahan ke daroghay un se kahenge ke kya tumhare paas aagah karne wale nahin aaye thay? Woh kahenge aaye thay aur bhi is mazmoon ki bahut si aayatein hain is aayat ke pehle jumle ke ek ma'ani Imam Ibn-e-Jareer (R.H) ne aur bhi bayan kiye hain aur filwaqea woh ma'ani bahut durust hain Imam sahab ne bhi isi ko tarjeeh di hai yani yeh ke kisi basti walon ke zulm aur gunahon ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala unhein usi waqt halak nahin karta jab tak Nabiyon ko bhej kar unhein ghaflat se bedaar na kar de, har aamil apne amal ke badle ka mustahiq hai. Nek neki ka aur bad badi ka. Khwah insaan ho khwah jinn ho. Badkaron ke jahannam mein darje un ki badkari ke mutabiq muqarrar hain jo log khud bhi kufr karte hain aur dusron ko bhi rah-e-Ilahiya se rokte hain unhein azab par azab honge aur un ke fasaad ka badla mile ga har aamil ka amal Allah par roshan hai taake Qayamat ke din har shakhs ko us ke kiye huye ka badla mil jaye.

Sab se beniaz Allah, Allah Ta'ala apni tamam makhlooq se beniaz hai, use kisi ki koi haajat nahin. Use kisi se koi faida nahin, woh kisi ka mohtaj nahin. Sari makhlooq apne har haal mein uski mohtaj hai. Woh badi hi rafat-o-rahmat wala hai, raham-o-karam uski khaas sifatein hain. Jaise farman hai aayat (Innal-laha bin-nasi la-ra'ufur-rahim) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 143). Allah apne bandon ke sath meherbani aur lutf se pesh aane wala hai, toh jo uski mukhalifat kar rahe ho toh yaad rakho ke agar woh chahe toh tumhein ek aan mein gharat kar sakta hai aur tumhare baad aise logon ko basa sakta hai jo uski itaat karein. Yeh uski qudrat mein hai, tum dekh lo usne aakhir auron ke qaim-maqam tumhein bhi kiya hai. Ek qarn ke baad dusra qarn wahi lata hai, ek ko maar dalta hai, dusre ko paida kar deta hai, lane le jaane par use mukammal qudrat hai. Jaise farman hai, agar woh chahe toh ae logon tum sab ko fana kar de aur dusron ko le aaye, woh is par qadir hai. Farman hai aayat (Ya ayyuhan-nasu antumul-fuqara'u ilal-lahi, wallahu huwal-ghaniyyul-hamid) (Surah Fatir: 15). Logo tum sab ke sab Allah ke mohtaj ho aur Allah Ta'ala beniaz aur tareefon wala hai. Agar woh chahe toh tum sab ko fana kar de aur nayi makhlooq le aaye, Allah ke liye koi anokhi baat nahin aur farman hai aayat (Wallahul-ghaniyyu wa antumul-fuqara'u) (Surah Muhammad: 38). Allah ghani hai aur tum sab faqeer ho. Farmata hai agar tum nafarman ho gaye toh woh tumhein badal kar aur qoum layega jo tum jaise na honge. Zurriyat se murad asl-o-nasl hai, ae Nabi aap inse keh dijiye ke Qayamat, Jannat, Dozakh waghera ke jo wade tum se kiye ja rahe hain woh yaqeenan sache hain aur yeh sab kuch hone wala hai, tum Allah ko aajiz nahin kar sakte, woh tumhare a'ade par qadir hai. Tum gal sad kar mitti ho jaoge phir woh tumhein nayi paidaish mein paida karega, us par koi amal mushkil nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ae Bani Adam agar tum mein aql hai toh apne tayin murdon mein shumar karo. Wallah, Allah ki farmayi hui sab baatein ba-yaqeen hone wali hain, koi nahin jo Allah ke irade mein use nakam kar de, uski chahat ko na hone de. Logon tum apni karni kiye jao, main apne tareeqe par qaim hoon, abhi abhi maloom ho jayega ke hidayat par kaun tha aur zalalat par kaun tha? Kaun nek anjam hota hai aur kaun ghutnon mein sar daal kar rota hai. Jaise farmaya be-imano se keh do ke tum apne shugal mein raho, main bhi apne kaam mein laga hoon. Tum muntazir raho hum bhi intezar mein hain, maloom ho jayega ke anjam ke lihaz se kaun acha raha? Yaad rakho Allah ne jo wade apne Rasool se kiye hain sab atal hain.

Chunancha duniya ne dekh liya ke woh Nabi (ﷺ) jis ka chappa chappa mukhalif tha, jis ka naam lena do-bhar tha, jo yakka-o-tanha tha, jo watan se nikal diya gaya tha, jis ki dushmani ek-ek karta tha, Allah ne usey ghalba diya. Lakhon dilon par us ki hukumat ho gayi. Us ki zindagi mein hi tamam Jazeerat-ul-Arab ka woh tanha maalik ban gaya. Yaman aur Bahrain par bhi us ke samne us ka jhanda lehrane laga. Phir us ke janasheenon ne duniya ko khangal dala, badi badi saltanaton ke munh pher diye. Jahan gaye ghalba paya, jidhar rukh kiya, fatah hasil ki. Yehi Allah ka wada tha ke main aur mere Rasool (ﷺ) ghalib aayenge, mujh se zyada quwwat-o-izzat kisi ki nahin. Farma diya tha ke hum apne Rasoolon ki aur imandaron ki madad farmayenge duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi. Rasoolon ki taraf us ne wahi bheji thi ke hum zalimon ko teh-o-bala kar denge aur un ke baad zameenon ke sartaj tumhein bana denge kyunke tum mujh se aur mere azabon se darne wale ho. Woh pehle hi farma chuka tha ke tum mein se imandaron aur nek-karon ko main zameen ka sultan bana doonga jaise ke pehle se yeh dastoor chala aa raha hai. Aise logon ko Allah Ta'ala un ke deen mein mazbooti aur kushaish dega jis ke deen se woh khush hai aur un ke khauf ko aman se badal dega ke woh meri ibadat karein aur mere sath kisi ko shareek na thehrayein. Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ne is ummat se apna yeh wada poora farmaya. Falillahil hamdu wal minnah awwalan wa aakhiran wa zahiran wa batinan.

Chunancha duniya ne dekh liya ke woh Nabi (ﷺ) jis ka chappa chappa mukhalif tha, jis ka naam lena do-bhar tha, jo yakka-o-tanha tha, jo watan se nikal diya gaya tha, jis ki dushmani ek-ek karta tha, Allah ne usey ghalba diya. Lakhon dilon par us ki hukumat ho gayi. Us ki zindagi mein hi tamam Jazeerat-ul-Arab ka woh tanha maalik ban gaya. Yaman aur Bahrain par bhi us ke samne us ka jhanda lehrane laga. Phir us ke janasheenon ne duniya ko khangal dala, badi badi saltanaton ke munh pher diye. Jahan gaye ghalba paya, jidhar rukh kiya, fatah hasil ki. Yehi Allah ka wada tha ke main aur mere Rasool (ﷺ) ghalib aayenge, mujh se zyada quwwat-o-izzat kisi ki nahin. Farma diya tha ke hum apne Rasoolon ki aur imandaron ki madad farmayenge duniya mein bhi aur aakhirat mein bhi. Rasoolon ki taraf us ne wahi bheji thi ke hum zalimon ko teh-o-bala kar denge aur un ke baad zameenon ke sartaj tumhein bana denge kyunke tum mujh se aur mere azabon se darne wale ho. Woh pehle hi farma chuka tha ke tum mein se imandaron aur nek-karon ko main zameen ka sultan bana doonga jaise ke pehle se yeh dastoor chala aa raha hai. Aise logon ko Allah Ta'ala un ke deen mein mazbooti aur kushaish dega jis ke deen se woh khush hai aur un ke khauf ko aman se badal dega ke woh meri ibadat karein aur mere sath kisi ko shareek na thehrayein. Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ne is ummat se apna yeh wada poora farmaya. Falillahil hamdu wal minnah awwalan wa aakhiran wa zahiran wa batinan.

Sab se beniaz Allah, Allah Ta'ala apni tamam makhlooq se beniaz hai, use kisi ki koi haajat nahin. Use kisi se koi faida nahin, woh kisi ka mohtaj nahin. Sari makhlooq apne har haal mein uski mohtaj hai. Woh badi hi rafat-o-rahmat wala hai, raham-o-karam uski khaas sifatein hain. Jaise farman hai aayat (Innal-laha bin-nasi la-ra'ufur-rahim) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 143). Allah apne bandon ke sath meherbani aur lutf se pesh aane wala hai, toh jo uski mukhalifat kar rahe ho toh yaad rakho ke agar woh chahe toh tumhein ek aan mein gharat kar sakta hai aur tumhare baad aise logon ko basa sakta hai jo uski itaat karein. Yeh uski qudrat mein hai, tum dekh lo usne aakhir auron ke qaim-maqam tumhein bhi kiya hai. Ek qarn ke baad dusra qarn wahi lata hai, ek ko maar dalta hai, dusre ko paida kar deta hai, lane le jaane par use mukammal qudrat hai. Jaise farman hai, agar woh chahe toh ae logon tum sab ko fana kar de aur dusron ko le aaye, woh is par qadir hai. Farman hai aayat (Ya ayyuhan-nasu antumul-fuqara'u ilal-lahi, wallahu huwal-ghaniyyul-hamid) (Surah Fatir: 15). Logo tum sab ke sab Allah ke mohtaj ho aur Allah Ta'ala beniaz aur tareefon wala hai. Agar woh chahe toh tum sab ko fana kar de aur nayi makhlooq le aaye, Allah ke liye koi anokhi baat nahin aur farman hai aayat (Wallahul-ghaniyyu wa antumul-fuqara'u) (Surah Muhammad: 38). Allah ghani hai aur tum sab faqeer ho. Farmata hai agar tum nafarman ho gaye toh woh tumhein badal kar aur qoum layega jo tum jaise na honge. Zurriyat se murad asl-o-nasl hai, ae Nabi aap inse keh dijiye ke Qayamat, Jannat, Dozakh waghera ke jo wade tum se kiye ja rahe hain woh yaqeenan sache hain aur yeh sab kuch hone wala hai, tum Allah ko aajiz nahin kar sakte, woh tumhare a'ade par qadir hai. Tum gal sad kar mitti ho jaoge phir woh tumhein nayi paidaish mein paida karega, us par koi amal mushkil nahin. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ae Bani Adam agar tum mein aql hai toh apne tayin murdon mein shumar karo. Wallah, Allah ki farmayi hui sab baatein ba-yaqeen hone wali hain, koi nahin jo Allah ke irade mein use nakam kar de, uski chahat ko na hone de. Logon tum apni karni kiye jao, main apne tareeqe par qaim hoon, abhi abhi maloom ho jayega ke hidayat par kaun tha aur zalalat par kaun tha? Kaun nek anjam hota hai aur kaun ghutnon mein sar daal kar rota hai. Jaise farmaya be-imano se keh do ke tum apne shugal mein raho, main bhi apne kaam mein laga hoon. Tum muntazir raho hum bhi intezar mein hain, maloom ho jayega ke anjam ke lihaz se kaun acha raha? Yaad rakho Allah ne jo wade apne Rasool se kiye hain sab atal hain.

Alhamdulillah, Allah Ta'ala ne is ummat se apna yeh wada poora farmaya. Falillahil hamdu wal minnah awwalan wa aakhiran wa zahiran wa batinan.

Hidayat ka aaghaz mushrikeen ki ek nau-ijaad (bid'at) jo kufr-o-shirk ka ek tareeqa thi bayan ho rahi hai ke har cheez paida ki hui toh hamari hai phir yeh is mein se nazrana ka kuch hissa hamare naam ka thehrate hain aur kuch apne ghare hue maboodon ka jinhein woh hamara shareek banaye hue hain, isi ke saath hi yeh bhi karte hain ke Allah ke naam ka thehraya hua nazrana buton ke naam wale mein mil gaya toh woh toh buton ka ho gaya lekin agar buton ke liye thehraye hue mein se kuch Allah ke naam wale mein mil gaya toh use jhat se nikal lete thay. Koi zabiha apne maboodon ke naam ka karein toh bhool kar bhi is par Allah ka naam nahin lete yeh kaisi buri taqseem karte hain. Awalan toh yeh taqseem hi jahalat ki alamat hai ke sab cheezein Allah ki paida ki hui usi ki malkiyat phir in mein se dusre ke naam ki kisi cheez ko nazar karne wale yeh kaun? Jo Allah La-Shareek hai unhein is ke shareek thehrane ka kya maqsad? Phir is zulm ko dekho Allah ke hisse mein se toh buton ko pahunch jaye aur buton ka hissa hargiz Allah ko na pahunch sake yeh kaise bad-tareen usool hain. Aisi hi ghalti yeh bhi thi ke Allah ke liye ladkiyan aur apne liye ladke toh tumhare hon aur jin ladkiyon se tum bezar woh Allah ki hon. Kaisi buri taqseem hai.

Shaitan ke chelay jaise ke shaitanon ne unhein raah par laga diya hai ke woh Allah ke liye khairaat karein toh apne buzurgon ke naam ka bhi hissa nikalain, isi tarah unhein shaitan ne is raah par bhi laga rakha hai ke woh apni auladon ko be-wajah qatl kar dein. Koi is wajah se ke hum isay khilayenge kahan se? Koi is wajah se ke in betiyon ki bina par hum kisi ke khusar banenge waghera. Is shaitani harkat ka natija halakat aur deen ki uljhan hai. Yahan tak ke yeh badtareen tareeqa un mein phail gaya tha ke ladki ke hone ki khabar un ke chehray siyah kar deti thi, un ke munh se yeh nikalta na tha ke mere haan ladki hui. Quran ne farmaya ke in be-gunah zinda dar-gor ki hui bachiyon se Qayamat ke din sawal hoga ke woh kis gunah par qatl kar di gayin. Pas yeh sab waswasay shaitani thay lekin yeh yaad rahe ke Rabb ka irada aur ikhtiyar is se alag na tha, agar woh chahta toh mushrik aisa na kar sakte. Lekin is mein bhi us ki hikmat hai, is se koi baaz-purs nahin kar sakta aur us ki baaz-purs se koi bach nahin sakta. Pas ae Nabi (ﷺ), tu in se aur in ki is iftara-pardazi se alaidgi ikhtiyar kar lo, Allah khud in se nimat lega.

Allah ka muqarrar karda rasta. Hijr ke ma'ani ahram ke hain. Yeh tareeqay shaitani thay koi Allah ka muqarrar karda rasta na tha. Apne maboodon ke naam yeh cheezein kar dete thay. Phir jisay chahtay khilate. Jaise farman hai aayat (Qul ara'aitum ma anzala Allahu lakum min rizqin faja'altum minhu haraman wa halala) (Surah Yunus: 59) yani batlao toh yeh Allah ke diye rizq mein se tum jo apne tor par halal haram muqarrar kar lete ho is ka hukum tumhein Allah ne diya hai ya tum ne khud hi khud par tarash liya hai? Dusri aayat mein saaf farmaya aayat (Ma ja'ala Allahu min bahiratin wa la sa'ibatin wa la wasilatin wa la hamin wa lakinnal-lazina kafaru yaftaruna 'ala Allahi al-kaziba wa aksaruhum la ya'qilun) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 103) yani yeh kafiron ki nadani, iftira aur jhoot hai. Bahira, sa'ibah aur haam naam rakh kar in janwaron ko apne maboodan-e-batil ke naam par daagh dete thay phir in se sawari nahin lete thay, jab in ke bachay hote thay toh unhein zibah karte thay, hajj ke liye bhi in janwaron par sawari karna haram jante thay. Na kisi kaam mein in ko lagate thay na in ka doodh nikalte thay phir in kamon ko shar'i kaam qarar dete thay aur Allah ka farman jante thay. Allah unhein in ke is kartoot ka aur bohtan bazi ka badla de ga.

Nazr-o-Niyaz: Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) farmate hain, jahiliyat mein yeh bhi riwaj tha ke jin chaupayon ko woh apne maboodan-e-batil ke naam kar dete the, un ka doodh sirf mard peete the. Jab unhein bacha hota to agar nar hota to sirf mard hi khate, agar mada hota to use zibah hi na karte aur agar pet hi se murda nikalta to mard aurat sab khate. Allah ne is fe'l se bhi roka. Sha'bi ka qaul hai ke baheera ka doodh sirf mard peete aur agar woh mar jata to gosht mard aurat sab khate. Un ki in jhooti baton ka badla Allah unhein de ga, kyunke yeh sab un ka jhoot Allah par bandha hua tha, falah-o-najat isi liye un se door kar di gayi thi. Yeh apni marzi se kisi ko halal kisi ko haram kar lete the, phir use Rabb ki taraf mansoob kar dete the. Allah jaise Hakeem ka koi fe'l, koi qaul, koi shar'a, koi taqdeer be-hikmat nahin thi. Woh apne bandon ke khair-o-shar se dana hai aur unhein badle dene wala hai.

Aulad ke qatil, aulad ke qatil Allah ke halal ko haram karne wale dono jahan ki barbadi apne upar lene wale hain. Duniya ka ghata toh zahir hai, unke yeh dono kaam khud unhein nuqsan pahunchane wale hain, be-aulad yeh ho jayenge, maal ka ek hissa unka tabah ho jayega. Raha akhirat ka nuqsan, so chunke yeh muftari hain, kazzab hain, wahan ki badtareen jagah unhein milegi, azabon ke sazawar honge. Jaise farman hai ke Allah par jhoot bandhne wale nijat se mehroom, kamyabi se door hain. Yeh duniya mein go kuch fayda utha lein lekin akhir toh hamare bas mein aayenge, phir toh hum unhein sakht-tar azab chakhayenge kyunke yeh kafir thay. Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) se marvi hai ke agar tu Islam se pehle ke Arabon ki bad-khaslati maloom karna chahe toh Surah An'am ki ek sau tees (130) aayat ke baad aayat (QAD KHASIRALLAZINA KAZZABU BI-LIQA-ILLAH) (Surah Al-An'am: 31) wali riwayat padho. (Sahih Bukhari, Kitab Manaqib-e-Quraish)

Masail-e-Zakat aur Ushr, Mazahir-e-Qudrat-e-Khaliq-e-Kul Allah Ta'ala hi hai. Khetiyan, phal, chaupaye sab usi ke paida kiye hue hain. Kafiron ko koi haq nahin ke haram-o-halal ki taqseem az-khud karein. Darakht baaz toh bail wale hain jaise angoor waghera ke woh mehfooz hote hain, baaz khade jo jangalon aur pahadon par khade hue hain. Dekhne mein ek dusre se milte julte magar phalon ke zaiqay ke lihaz se alag alag. Angoor, khajoor yeh darakht tumhein dete hain ke tum khao, maza uthao, lutf pao. Is ka haq is ke katne aur naap-tol hone ke din hi do, yani farz zakat jo is mein muqarrar ho woh ada kar do. Pehle log kuch nahin dete the, shariat ne daswan hissa muqarrar kiya aur waise bhi maskeenon aur bhookon ka khayal rakhna. Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmad ki hadith mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farman-e-sadir farmaya tha ke jis ki khajoorein das wasq se zyada hon woh chand khushey masjid mein la kar latka de taake masakeen kha lein. Yeh bhi murad hai ke zakat ke siwa aur kuch sulook bhi apni khetiyon, badiyon aur baghat ke phalon se Allah ke bandon ke sath karte raho, maslan phal todne aur khet katne ke waqt umooman muflis log pahunch jaya karte hain, unhein kuch chhod do taake maskeenon ke kaam aaye. Un ke janwaron ka chara ho, zakat se pehle bhi haq-daron ko kuch na kuch dete raha karo. Pehle toh yeh bator-e-wajoob tha lekin zakat ki farziyat ke baad bator-e-nafl reh gaya. Zakat is mein ushr ya nisf-ushr muqarrar kar di gayi lekin is se faskh na samjha jaye. Pehle kuch dinar hota tha phir miqdar muqarrar kar di gayi. Zakat ki miqdar san 002 Hijri mein muqarrar hui. Wallahu A'lam. Kheti kaat-te waqt aur phal utarte waqt sadqa na dene walon ki Allah Ta'ala ne muzammat bayan farmayi. Surah Kahf mein un ka qissa bayan farmaya ke un bagh walon ne qasmein kha kar kaha ke subh hote hi aaj ke phal hum utaar lenge, is par unhon ne Insha'Allah bhi na kaha. Yeh abhi raat ko be-khabari ki neend mein hi the wahan aafat-e-nagahani aa gayi aur sara bagh aisa ho gaya goya phal tod liya gaya hai, balkay jala kar khakastar kar diya gaya hai. Yeh subh ko uth kar ek dusre ko jaga kar posheeda tor se chup-chap chale ke aisa na ho hasb-e-aadat faqeer maskeen jama ho jayen aur unhein kuch dena pade. Yeh apne dilon mein yahi sochte hue ke abhi phal tod layenge, bade ehtimam ke sath subh sawere hi wahan pahunche toh kya dekhte hain ke sara bagh toh khak bana hua hai. Awalan toh kehne lage bhai hum rasta bhool gaye, kisi aur jagah aa gaye, hamara bagh toh sham tak leh-laha raha tha. Phir kehne laga nahin bagh toh yahi hai, hamari qismat phoot gayi, hum mehroom ho gaye. Is waqt un mein jo ba-khabar shakhs tha kehne laga dekho main tum se na kehta tha ke Allah ka shukr karo, us ki pakeezgi bayan karo. Ab toh sab ke sab kehne lage hamara Rabb paak hai, yaqeenan hum ne zulm kiya. Phir ek dusre ko malamat karne lage ke haye hamari badbakhti ke hum sarkash aur had se guzar jane wale ban gaye the.

Hamein ab bhi Allah Azza-wa-Jal se umeed hai ke woh hamein is se behtar ata farmaye ga, hum ab sirf apne Rab se umeed rakhte hain. Nashukri karne aur tanha-khori pasand karne walon par isi tarah hamare azab aaya karte hain aur abhi Akhirat ke bade azab baqi hain, lekin afsos ke yeh samajh boojh aur ilm-o-aql se kaam hi nahin lete. Yahan is ayat mein sadqa dene ka hukum farma kar khatmay par farmaya ke fazool kharchi se bacho, fazool kharch Allah ka dost nahin. Apni auqat se zyada na luta, fakhr-o-riya ke taur par apna maal barbad na karo. Hazrat Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas (R.A) ne apne khajooron ke bagh se khajoorein utarein aur ahd kar liya ke aaj jo lene aayega main use dunga, log toot pade, shaam ko un ke paas ek khajoor bhi na rahi. Is par yeh farman utra. Har cheez mein israf mana hai, Allah ke hukum se tajawuz kar jaane ka naam israf hai khwah woh kisi baare mein ho. Apna sara hi maal luta kar faqeer ho kar dusron par apna inbaar daal dena bhi israf hai aur mana hai, yeh bhi matlab hai ke sadqa na roko jis se Allah ke nafarman ban jao, yeh bhi israf hai. Goya matlab is ayat ke hain lekin bazahir alfaaz se yeh maloom hota hai ke pehle khane ka zikr hai to israf apne khane peene mein karne ki mumanat yahan hai kyunke is se aql mein aur badan mein zarar pahuncha hai. Quran ki aur ayat mein hai ayat (Wa kulu wash-rabu wa la tusrifu, innahu la yuhibbul musrifeen) (Surah Al-A'raf: 31) khao piyo aur israf na karo. Sahih Bukhari mein hai khao piyo pehno odho lekin israf aur kibr se bacho, Wallahu A'lam. Isi Allah ne tumhare liye chopaye paida kiye hain, un mein se baaz to bojh dhone wale hain jaise oont, ghode, khachar, gadhe waghera aur baaz pasta-qad hain jaise bakri waghera, inhe (Farshan) is liye kaha gaya ke yeh qad-o-qamat mein past hote hain, zameen se mile rehte hain. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke (Hamulatan) se murad sawari ke janwar aur (Farshan) se murad jin ka doodh piya jata hai aur jin ka gosht khaya jata hai, jo sawari ke qabil nahin un ke baalon se lihaf aur farsh tayar hote hain. Yeh qaul Hazrat Suddi (R.H) ka hai aur bahut hi munasib hai. Khud Quran ki Surah Yaseen mein majood hai ke kya unhon ne is baat par nazar nahin ki? Ke hum ne un ke liye chopaye paida kar diye hain jo hamare hi hathon ke banaye hue hain aur ab yeh un ke maalik ban baithe hain, hum ne hi to inhe un ke bas mein kar diya hai ke baaz sawariyan kar rahe hain aur baaz ko yeh khane ke kaam mein late hain aur ayat mein hai ayat (Wa inna lakum fil an'aami la'ibratan, nusqikum mimma fi butunihi mim baini farsin wa damin labanan khalisan sa'ighal lish-sharibeen) (Surah An-Nahl: 66).

(An-Nahl: 66) Matlab yeh hai ke hum tumhein in chopayon ka doodh pilate hain aur un ke baal oon waghera se tumhare odhne bichhone aur tarah tarah ke fayde uthane ki cheezein banate hain aur jagah hai Allah woh hai jis ne tumhare liye chopaye janwar paida kiye taake tum un par sawariyan karo unhein khao aur bhi fayde uthao un par apne safar tay kar ke apne kaam poore karo isi ne tumhari sawari ke liye kashtiyan bana dein woh tumhein apni beshumar nishaniyan dikha raha hai batao toh kis kis nishani ka inkar karoge? Phir farmata hai Allah ki rozi khao phal, anaaj, gosht waghera. Shaitani raah par na chalo, us ki tabedari na karo jaise ke mushrikon ne Allah ki cheezon mein az-khud halal haram ki taqseem kar di tum bhi yeh kar ke shaitan ke sathi na bano. Woh tumhara dushman hai, use dost na samjho. Woh toh apne sath tumhein bhi Allah ke azabon mein phansana chahta hai, dekho kahin us ke behkane mein na aa jana isi ne tumhare baap Adam (A.S) ko jannat se bahar niklwaya, is khule dushman ko bhoole se bhi apna dost na samjho. Us ki zurriyat se aur us ke yaron se bhi bacho. Yaad rakho zalimon ko bura badla mile ga. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi ayatein Kalam-e-Allah Sharif mein bohat si hain.

Wallahu A'lam. Kheti kaat-te waqt aur phal utarte waqt sadqa na dene walon ki Allah Ta'ala ne muzammat bayan farmayi. Surah Kahf mein un ka qissa bayan farmaya ke un bagh walon ne qasmein kha kar kaha ke subh hote hi aaj ke phal hum utaar lenge, is par unhon ne Insha'Allah bhi na kaha. Yeh abhi raat ko be-khabari ki neend mein hi the wahan aafat-e-nagahani aa gayi aur sara bagh aisa ho gaya goya phal tod liya gaya hai, balkay jala kar khakastar kar diya gaya hai. Yeh subh ko uth kar ek dusre ko jaga kar posheeda tor se chup-chap chale ke aisa na ho hasb-e-aadat faqeer maskeen jama ho jayen aur unhein kuch dena pade. Yeh apne dilon mein yahi sochte hue ke abhi phal tod layenge, bade ehtimam ke sath subh sawere hi wahan pahunche toh kya dekhte hain ke sara bagh toh khak bana hua hai. Awalan toh kehne lage bhai hum rasta bhool gaye, kisi aur jagah aa gaye, hamara bagh toh sham tak leh-laha raha tha. Phir kehne laga nahin bagh toh yahi hai, hamari qismat phoot gayi, hum mehroom ho gaye. Is waqt un mein jo ba-khabar shakhs tha kehne laga dekho main tum se na kehta tha ke Allah ka shukr karo, us ki pakeezgi bayan karo. Ab toh sab ke sab kehne lage hamara Rabb paak hai, yaqeenan hum ne zulm kiya. Phir ek dusre ko malamat karne lage ke haye hamari badbakhti ke hum sarkash aur had se guzar jane wale ban gaye the.

Hamein ab bhi Allah Azza-wa-Jal se umeed hai ke woh hamein is se behtar ata farmaye ga, hum ab sirf apne Rab se umeed rakhte hain. Nashukri karne aur tanha-khori pasand karne walon par isi tarah hamare azab aaya karte hain aur abhi Akhirat ke bade azab baqi hain, lekin afsos ke yeh samajh boojh aur ilm-o-aql se kaam hi nahin lete. Yahan is ayat mein sadqa dene ka hukum farma kar khatmay par farmaya ke fazool kharchi se bacho, fazool kharch Allah ka dost nahin. Apni auqat se zyada na luta, fakhr-o-riya ke taur par apna maal barbad na karo. Hazrat Thabit bin Qais bin Shammas (R.A) ne apne khajooron ke bagh se khajoorein utarein aur ahd kar liya ke aaj jo lene aayega main use dunga, log toot pade, shaam ko un ke paas ek khajoor bhi na rahi. Is par yeh farman utra. Har cheez mein israf mana hai, Allah ke hukum se tajawuz kar jaane ka naam israf hai khwah woh kisi baare mein ho. Apna sara hi maal luta kar faqeer ho kar dusron par apna inbaar daal dena bhi israf hai aur mana hai, yeh bhi matlab hai ke sadqa na roko jis se Allah ke nafarman ban jao, yeh bhi israf hai. Goya matlab is ayat ke hain lekin bazahir alfaaz se yeh maloom hota hai ke pehle khane ka zikr hai to israf apne khane peene mein karne ki mumanat yahan hai kyunke is se aql mein aur badan mein zarar pahuncha hai. Quran ki aur ayat mein hai ayat (Wa kulu wash-rabu wa la tusrifu, innahu la yuhibbul musrifeen) (Surah Al-A'raf: 31) khao piyo aur israf na karo. Sahih Bukhari mein hai khao piyo pehno odho lekin israf aur kibr se bacho, Wallahu A'lam. Isi Allah ne tumhare liye chopaye paida kiye hain, un mein se baaz to bojh dhone wale hain jaise oont, ghode, khachar, gadhe waghera aur baaz pasta-qad hain jaise bakri waghera, inhe (Farshan) is liye kaha gaya ke yeh qad-o-qamat mein past hote hain, zameen se mile rehte hain. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke (Hamulatan) se murad sawari ke janwar aur (Farshan) se murad jin ka doodh piya jata hai aur jin ka gosht khaya jata hai, jo sawari ke qabil nahin un ke baalon se lihaf aur farsh tayar hote hain. Yeh qaul Hazrat Suddi (R.H) ka hai aur bahut hi munasib hai. Khud Quran ki Surah Yaseen mein majood hai ke kya unhon ne is baat par nazar nahin ki? Ke hum ne un ke liye chopaye paida kar diye hain jo hamare hi hathon ke banaye hue hain aur ab yeh un ke maalik ban baithe hain, hum ne hi to inhe un ke bas mein kar diya hai ke baaz sawariyan kar rahe hain aur baaz ko yeh khane ke kaam mein late hain aur ayat mein hai ayat (Wa inna lakum fil an'aami la'ibratan, nusqikum mimma fi butunihi mim baini farsin wa damin labanan khalisan sa'ighal lish-sharibeen) (Surah An-Nahl: 66).

(An-Nahl: 66) Matlab yeh hai ke hum tumhein in chopayon ka doodh pilate hain aur un ke baal oon waghera se tumhare odhne bichhone aur tarah tarah ke fayde uthane ki cheezein banate hain aur jagah hai Allah woh hai jis ne tumhare liye chopaye janwar paida kiye taake tum un par sawariyan karo unhein khao aur bhi fayde uthao un par apne safar tay kar ke apne kaam poore karo isi ne tumhari sawari ke liye kashtiyan bana dein woh tumhein apni beshumar nishaniyan dikha raha hai batao toh kis kis nishani ka inkar karoge? Phir farmata hai Allah ki rozi khao phal, anaaj, gosht waghera. Shaitani raah par na chalo, us ki tabedari na karo jaise ke mushrikon ne Allah ki cheezon mein az-khud halal haram ki taqseem kar di tum bhi yeh kar ke shaitan ke sathi na bano. Woh tumhara dushman hai, use dost na samjho. Woh toh apne sath tumhein bhi Allah ke azabon mein phansana chahta hai, dekho kahin us ke behkane mein na aa jana isi ne tumhare baap Adam (A.S) ko jannat se bahar niklwaya, is khule dushman ko bhoole se bhi apna dost na samjho. Us ki zurriyat se aur us ke yaron se bhi bacho. Yaad rakho zalimon ko bura badla mile ga. Is mazmoon ki aur bhi ayatein Kalam-e-Allah Sharif mein bohat si hain.

Khud-sakhta halal-o-haram jahalat ka samar hai. Islam se pehle Arabon ki jahalat bayan ho rahi hai ke unhon ne chopaye janwaron mein taqseem kar ke apne taur par bahut se halal banaye thay aur bahut se haram kar liye thay jaise Baheera, Sa'iba, Waseela aur Haam waghera. Isi tarah khet aur baghat mein bhi taqseem kar rakhi thi. Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke sab ka khaliq Allah hai, khet hon baghat hon, chopaye hon. Phir in chopayon ki qismein bayan farmayin: bher, mendha, bakri, bakra, oont, oontni, gaye, bail. Allah ne yeh sab cheezein tumhare khane peene, sawariyan lene, aur doosri qisam ke faidon ke liye paida ki hain. Jaise farman hai ayat (Wa anzala lakum minal an'aami samaniyata azwaajin, yakhluqukum fee butooni ummahatikum khalqan mim ba'di khalqin fee zulumatin salaas) (Surah Az-Zumar: 6). Is ne tumhare liye aath qisam ke maweshi paida kiye hain. Bachon ka zikr is liye kiya ke in mein bhi kabhi woh mardon ke liye makhsoos kar ke aurton par haram kar dete thay. Phir un se hi sawal hota hai ke aakhir is hurmat ki koi daleel, koi kaifiyat, koi wajah to pesh karo. Char qisam ke janwar aur mada aur nar mila kar aath qisam ke ho gaye, in sab ko Allah ne halal kiya hai. Kya tum apni dekhi suni keh rahe ho? Is farman-e-Ilahi ke waqt tum majood thay? Kyun jhoot keh kar iftira pardazi kar ke baghair ilm ke baatein bana kar Allah ki makhlooq ki gumrahi ka bojh apne oopar laad kar sab se barh kar zalim ban rahe ho? Agar yahi haal raha to dastoor-e-Rabbani ke matehat hidayat-e-Ilahi se mehroom ho jaoge. Sab se pehle yeh napak rasm Amr bin Luhay bin Qama'a khabees ne nikali thi, isi ne ambiya ke deen ko sab se pehle badla aur ghair-Allah ke naam par janwar chhore. Jaise ke sahih hadith mein aa chuka hai.

Allah Ta'ala ke muqarrar karda halal-o-haram. Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal apne bande aur Nabi Hazrat Muhammad (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum deta hai ke aap in kafiron se jo Allah ke halal ko apni taraf se haram karte hain farma dein ke jo Wahi-e-Ilahi mere paas aayi hai us mein to haram sirf un cheezon ko kiya gaya hai, jo main tumhein sunata hoon, is mein woh cheezain hurmat wali nahin, jin ki hurmat ko tum ra'ij kar rahe ho, kisi khane wale par haiwanon mein se siwa un janwaron ke jo bayan hue hain koi bhi haram nahin. Is ayat ke mafhoom ka raf'a karne wali Surah Ma'idah ki aayinda aayatein aur dusri hadeesein hain jin mein hurmat ka bayan hai woh bayan ki jayengi, ba'az log ise naskh kehte hain aur aksar muta'akhireen ise naskh nahin kehte kyunke is mein to asli mubah ko utha dena hai. Wallahu A'lam. Khoon woh haram hai jo ba-waqt-e-zibh beh jata hai, ragon mein aur gosht mein jo khoon makhloot ho woh haram nahin. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) gadhon aur darindon ka gosht aur handiya ke oopar jo khoon ki surkhi aa jaye, is mein koi haraj nahin janti thin. Amr bin Dinar ne Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah se sawal kiya ke log kehte hain ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Jang-e-Khaibar ke mauqa par paltu gadhon ka khana haram kar diya hai, aap ne farmaya, haan Hakam bin Amr to Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se yahi riwayat karte hain lekin Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas is ka inkar karte hain aur ayat (Qul la ajidu) tilawat karte hain, Ibn-e-Abbas ka farman hai ke Ahl-e-Jahiliyat ba'az cheezain khate the ba'az ko ba-wajah-e-tab'i karahiyat ke chhor dete the. Allah ne apne Nabi ko bheja, apni Kitab utari, halal-o-haram ki tafseel kar di, pas jise halal kar diya woh halal hai aur jise haram kar diya woh haram hai aur jis se khamosh rahe woh mu'af hai. Phir aap ne isi ayat (Qul la ajidu) ki tilawat ki. Hazrat Sauda bint-e-Zama ki bakri mar gayi, jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se zikr hua to aap ne farmaya tum ne is ki khaal kyun na utaar li? Jawab diya ke kya murda bakri ki khaal utaar leni ja'iz hai? Aap ne yahi ayat tilawat farma kar farmaya ke "Is ka sirf khana haram hai, lekin tum ise dabaghat de kar nafa hasil kar sakte ho". Chunancha unhon ne aadmi bhej kar khaal utarwa li aur is ki mashk banwayi jo un ke paas muddaton rahi aur kaam aayi.

(Bukhari waghera) Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar R.A se Qunfud (ya'ni khaar pusht jisay Urdu mein sahi bhi kehte hain) ke khane ki nisbat sawal hua toh aap ne yehi aayat parhi. Is par ek buzurg ne farmaya main ne Hazrat Abu Hurairah R.A se suna hai ke ek martaba is ka zikr Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne aaya tha toh aap ne farmaya woh khabison mein se ek khabis hai. Isay sun kar Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar R.A ne farmaya agar Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh farmaya hai toh woh yaqeenan waisi hi hai jaise aap ne irshad farma diya (Abu Dawood waghera). Phir farmaya jo shakhs in haram cheezon ko khane par majboor ho jaye lekin woh baghi aur had se tajawuz karne wala na ho toh usay is ka kha lena jaiz hai. Allah usay bakhash de ga kyunke woh Ghafoor-o-Rahim hai. Is ki kamil tafsir Surah Al-Baqarah mein guzar chuki hai. Yahan toh mushrikon ke is fe'l ki tardeed manzoor hai jo unhon ne Allah ke halal ko haram kar diya tha. Ab bata diya gaya ke yeh cheezain tum par haram hain, is ke ilawa koi cheez haram nahin. Agar Allah ki taraf se woh bhi haram hotin toh un ka zikr bhi aa jata. Phir tum apni taraf se halal kyun muqarrar karte ho? Is bina par phir aur cheezon ki hurmat baqi rehti jaise ke gharon ke paltu gadhon ki muman'at aur darindon ke gosht ki aur jungle wale parindon ki jaise ke ulama ka mashhoor mazhab hai (Yeh yaad rahe ke in ki hurmat qat'i hai kyunke sahih ahadith se sabit hai aur Quran ne hadith ka manna bhi farz kiya hai. Mutarjim).

Mazeed tafseel mutaliqa halal-o-haram nakhun-dar janwar chopayon aur parindon mein se woh hain, jin ki ungliyan khuli hui na hon jaise oont, shutur-murgh, batakh waghera. Saeed bin Jubair ka qaul hai ke "jo khuli ungliyon wala na ho". Ek riwayat mein un se marwi hai ke har ek juda ungliyon wala aur inhi mein se murgh hai. Qatada ka qaul hai "jaise oont, shutur-murgh aur bahut se parind, machliyan, batakh aur is jaise janwar jin ki ungliyan alag alag hain. In ka khana Yahudiyon par haram tha. Isi tarah gaye bakri ki charbi bhi un par haram thi. Yahud ka maqoola tha ke Israel ne ise haram kar liya tha, is liye hum bhi ise haram kehte hain. Haan jo charbi peeth ke sath lagi hui ho, antriyon ke sath, ojhri ke sath, haddi ke sath ho woh un par halal thi, yeh bhi un ke zulm, takabbur aur sarkashi ka badla tha aur hamari nafarmani ka anjam, jaise farman hai aayat (Fabizulmin minallazina hadu) Yahudiyon ke zulm-o-sitam aur rah-e-haq se rok ki wajah se hum ne un par ba'az pakeeza cheezein bhi haram kar di thin aur is jaza mein hum aadil hi thay aur jaisi khabar hum ne tujhe aye Nabi di hai, wahi sach aur haq hai. Yahudiyon ka yeh kehna ke Hazrat Israel ne ise haram kiya tha, is liye hum ise apne aap par bhi haram karte hain. Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ko jab maloom hua ke Samra ne sharab faroshi ki hai to aap ne farmaya Allah use gharat kare, kya yeh nahin janta ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya hai Allah Ta'ala ne Yahudiyon par la'nat ki ke jab un par charbi haram hui to unhon ne ise pighla kar bechna shuru kar diya. Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah (R.A) ne Fatah-e-Makkah wale saal farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala ne aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne sharab, murdar, suwar aur buton ki khareedo-farokht haram farmayi hai. Aap se daryaft kiya gaya ke murdar ki charbiyon ke bare mein kya hukm hai? Is se chamray rangay jate hain aur kashtiyon par charhaya jata hai aur chiragh mein jalaya jata hai, aap ne farmaya woh bhi haram hai. Phir is ke sath hi aap ne irshad farmaya ke Allah Ta'ala Yahudiyon ko gharat kare, jab un par charbi haram hui to unhon ne ise pighla kar bech kar is ki qeemat khana shuru kar di (Bukhari, Muslim). Ek martaba aap Khana-e-Ka'aba mein Maqam-e-Ibrahim ke peeche baithe hue thay, aasman ki taraf nazar uthayi aur teen martaba Yahudiyon par la'nat farmayi aur farmaya! Allah ne un par charbi haram ki to unhon ne ise bech kar is ki qeemat khayi. Allah Ta'ala jin par jo cheez haram karta hai un par us ki qeemat bhi haram farma deta hai. Ek martaba aap Masjid-e-Haram mein Hateem ki taraf mutawajja ho kar baithe hue thay, aasman ki taraf dekh kar hanse aur yahi farmaya (Abu Dawood, Ibn Marduyah, Musnad-e-Ahmad). Hazrat Usama bin Zaid (R.A) waghera Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki bimari ke zamane mein aap ki ayadat ke liye gaye, us waqt aap Adan ki chadar orhay hue letay thay, aap ne chehra se chadar hata kar farmaya, Allah Yahudiyon par la'nat kare ke bakriyon ki charbi ko haram mante hue us ki qeemat khate hain.

Abu Dawood mein Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marfoo'an marwi hai ke Allah jab kisi qoum par kisi cheez ka khana haram karta hai toh us ki qeemat bhi haram farma deta hai.

Mushrik ho ya kafir tauba karle to maaf! Ab bhi agar tere mukhalif Yahudi aur mushrik waghera tujhe jhoota batayein to bhi tu unhein meri rahmat se mayoos na kar balkay unhein Rabb ki rahmat ki wus'at yaad dilata ke unhein Allah ki raza-joi ki tableegh ho jaye, saath hi unhein Allah ke atal azabon se bachne ki taraf bhi mutawajja kar. Pas raghbat, rahbat, umeed, darr dono hi ek saath suna de. Quran-e-Kareem mein umeed ke saath khauf aksar bayan hota hai isi surat ke aakhir mein farmaya tera Rabb jald azab karne wala hai aur Ghafoor-o-Raheem bhi hai aur aayat mein hai (Inna Rabbaka la-zu maghfiratin wa zu iqabin aleem) 43. Fussilat: 43. Tera Rabb logon ke gunahon par unhein bakhshne wala bhi hai aur woh sakht tar azab karne wala bhi hai. Ek aayat mein irshad hai mere bandon ko mere Ghafoor-o-Raheem hone ki aur mere azabon ke bade hi dard-naak hone ki khabar pahuncha de aur jagah hai woh gunahon ka bakhshne wala aur tauba ka qabool karne wala hai. Neez kayi aayaton mein hai tere Rabb ki pakad badi bhari aur nihayat sakht hai. Wohi ibtida karta hai aur wohi dobara lautayega woh Ghafoor hai, Wadood hai, bakhshish karne wala hai, meharban aur mohabbat karne wala hai aur bhi is mazmoon ki bahut si aayatein hain.

Ghalat soch se baaz raho. Mushrik log daleel pesh karte thay ke hamare shirk ka, halal ko haram karne ka haal toh Allah ko maloom hi hai aur yeh bhi zahir hai ke woh agar chahe toh is ke badalne par bhi qadir hai. Is tarah ke hamare dil mein imaan daal de ya kufr ke kaamon ki hamein qudrat hi na de, phir bhi agar woh hamari is raush ko nahin badalta toh zahir hai ke woh hamare in kaamon se khush hai. Agar woh chahta toh hum kya, hamare buzurg bhi shirk na karte, jaise un ka yahi qaul aayat (Lau sha-ar-Rahman) mein aur Surah Nahl mein hai. Allah farmata hai isi shubha ne un se pehli qaumon ko tabah kar diya. Agar yeh baat sach hoti toh un ke pehle baap dada par hamare azaab kyun aate? Rasoolon ki nafarmani aur shirk-o-kufr par musir rehne ki wajah se woh roo-e-zameen se zillat ke sath yun hata diye jaate? Achha tumhare paas Allah ki razamandi ka koi certificate ho toh pesh karo. Hum toh dekhte hain ke tum wahm-parast ho, faasid aqaid par jame hue ho aur atkal-pachoo baatein Allah ke zimme ghad lete ho. Woh bhi yahi kehte thay, tum bhi yahi kehte ho ke hum in maboodon ki ibadat isliye karte hain ke yeh hamein Allah se mila dein, halankeh woh na milane wale hain na is ki unhein qudrat hai. Un se toh Allah ne samajh boojh cheen rakhi hai. Hidayat-o-gumrahi ki taqseem mein bhi Allah ki hikmat aur us ki hujjat hai, sab kaam us ke irade se ho rahe hain, woh mominon ko pasand farmata hai aur kafiron se na-khush hai. Farman hai aayat (Wa lau sha-allahu la-jama'ahum alal huda fala takoonanna minal jahileen) (Surah Al-An'am: 35). Agar Allah chahta toh un sab ko rah-e-haq par jama kar deta. Aur aayat mein hai agar tere Rab ki chahat hoti toh sab logon ko ek hi ummat kar deta, yeh toh ikhtilaf se nahin hatenge siwaye un logon ke jin par tera Rab raham kare, balkeh unhein Allah ne isi liye paida kiya hai. Tere Rab ki yeh baat haq hai ke main jinnat aur insaan se jahannam ko pur kar doonga. Haqeeqat bhi yahi hai ke nafarmanon ki koi hujjat Allah ke zimme nahin balkeh Allah ki hujjat bandon par hai. Tum ne khwah-makhwah apni taraf se janwaron ko haram kar rakha hai, un ki hurmat par kisi ki shahadat toh pesh kar do. Agar yeh aisi shahadat wale layein toh tu in jhoote logon ki haan mein haan na milana. In munkireen-e-qayamat, munkireen-e-Kalamullah Sharif ke jhaanse mein kahin tum bhi na aa jana.

Allah farmata hai isi shubha ne un se pehli qaumon ko tabah kar diya. Agar yeh baat sach hoti toh un ke pehle baap dada par hamare azaab kyun aate? Rasoolon ki nafarmani aur shirk-o-kufr par musir rehne ki wajah se woh roo-e-zameen se zillat ke sath yun hata diye jaate? Achha tumhare paas Allah ki razamandi ka koi certificate ho toh pesh karo. Hum toh dekhte hain ke tum wahm-parast ho, faasid aqaid par jame hue ho aur atkal-pachoo baatein Allah ke zimme ghad lete ho. Woh bhi yahi kehte thay, tum bhi yahi kehte ho ke hum in maboodon ki ibadat isliye karte hain ke yeh hamein Allah se mila dein, halankeh woh na milane wale hain na is ki unhein qudrat hai. Un se toh Allah ne samajh boojh cheen rakhi hai. Hidayat-o-gumrahi ki taqseem mein bhi Allah ki hikmat aur us ki hujjat hai, sab kaam us ke irade se ho rahe hain, woh mominon ko pasand farmata hai aur kafiron se na-khush hai. Farman hai aayat (Wa lau sha-allahu la-jama'ahum alal huda fala takoonanna minal jahileen) (Surah Al-An'am: 35). Agar Allah chahta toh un sab ko rah-e-haq par jama kar deta. Aur aayat mein hai agar tere Rab ki chahat hoti toh sab logon ko ek hi ummat kar deta, yeh toh ikhtilaf se nahin hatenge siwaye un logon ke jin par tera Rab raham kare, balkeh unhein Allah ne isi liye paida kiya hai. Tere Rab ki yeh baat haq hai ke main jinnat aur insaan se jahannam ko pur kar doonga. Haqeeqat bhi yahi hai ke nafarmanon ki koi hujjat Allah ke zimme nahin balkeh Allah ki hujjat bandon par hai. Tum ne khwah-makhwah apni taraf se janwaron ko haram kar rakha hai, un ki hurmat par kisi ki shahadat toh pesh kar do. Agar yeh aisi shahadat wale layein toh tu in jhoote logon ki haan mein haan na milana. In munkireen-e-qayamat, munkireen-e-Kalamullah Sharif ke jhaanse mein kahin tum bhi na aa jana.

Ghalat soch se baaz raho. Mushrik log daleel pesh karte thay ke hamare shirk ka, halal ko haram karne ka haal toh Allah ko maloom hi hai aur yeh bhi zahir hai ke woh agar chahe toh is ke badalne par bhi qadir hai. Is tarah ke hamare dil mein imaan daal de ya kufr ke kaamon ki hamein qudrat hi na de, phir bhi agar woh hamari is raush ko nahin badalta toh zahir hai ke woh hamare in kaamon se khush hai. Agar woh chahta toh hum kya, hamare buzurg bhi shirk na karte, jaise un ka yahi qaul aayat (Lau sha-ar-Rahman) mein aur Surah Nahl mein hai. Allah farmata hai isi shubha ne un se pehli qaumon ko tabah kar diya. Agar yeh baat sach hoti toh un ke pehle baap dada par hamare azaab kyun aate? Rasoolon ki nafarmani aur shirk-o-kufr par musir rehne ki wajah se woh roo-e-zameen se zillat ke sath yun hata diye jaate? Achha tumhare paas Allah ki razamandi ka koi certificate ho toh pesh karo. Hum toh dekhte hain ke tum wahm-parast ho, faasid aqaid par jame hue ho aur atkal-pachoo baatein Allah ke zimme ghad lete ho. Woh bhi yahi kehte thay, tum bhi yahi kehte ho ke hum in maboodon ki ibadat isliye karte hain ke yeh hamein Allah se mila dein, halankeh woh na milane wale hain na is ki unhein qudrat hai. Aur aayat mein hai agar tere Rab ki chahat hoti toh sab logon ko ek hi ummat kar deta, yeh toh ikhtilaf se nahin hatenge siwaye un logon ke jin par tera Rab raham kare, balkeh unhein Allah ne isi liye paida kiya hai. Tere Rab ki yeh baat haq hai ke main jinnat aur insaan se jahannam ko pur kar doonga. Haqeeqat bhi yahi hai ke nafarmanon ki koi hujjat Allah ke zimme nahin balkeh Allah ki hujjat bandon par hai. Tum ne khwah-makhwah apni taraf se janwaron ko haram kar rakha hai, un ki hurmat par kisi ki shahadat toh pesh kar do. Agar yeh aisi shahadat wale layein toh tu in jhoote logon ki haan mein haan na milana. In munkireen-e-qayamat, munkireen-e-Kalamullah Sharif ke jhaanse mein kahin tum bhi na aa jana.

Nabi-e-Akram (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki Wasiyyatein. Ibn-e-Mas'ud (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain jo shakhs Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki is wasiyyat ko dekhna chahta ho jo Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aakhri wasiyyat thi to woh in aayaton ko (Tattaqun) tak padhe. Ibn-e-Abbas (Razi Allahu Anhu / R.A) farmate hain Surah-e-An'am mein muhkam aayatein hain, phir yahi aayatein Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne tilawat farmayin. Ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne as-haab se farmaya, tum mein se koi shakhs hai jo mere haath par in teen baaton ki bai'at kare, phir Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yahi aayatein tilawat farmayin aur farmaya jo ise pura karega, woh Allah se ajar payega aur jo in mein se kisi baat ko pura na karega to duniya mein hi use shar'i saza de di jayegi aur agar saza na di gayi to phir uska muamla Qayamat par hai, agar Allah chahe to use bakhsh de chahe to saza de (Musnad, Hakim). Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai "Tum log mere haath par bai'at karo, Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na karne ki". Is aayat mein Allah Ta'ala apne Nabi (Alaihis Salam / A.S) se farmata hai ke "In mushrikeen ko jo Allah ki aulad ke qail hain, Allah ke rizq mein se ba'az ko apni taraf se halal aur ba'az ko haram kehte hain, Allah ke saath dusron ko poojte hain, keh dijiye ke sach-much jo cheezein Allah ki haram karda hain unhein mujh se sun lo jo main bazariya-e-Wahi-e-Ilahi bayan karta hoon, tumhari tarah khwahish-e-nafs, tawam-parasti aur atkal-o-guman ki bina par nahin kehta. Sab se pehli baat to yeh hai ke jis ki woh tumhein wasiyyat karta hai ke Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na karna, yeh kalam-e-Arab mein hota hai ke ek jumla ko hazf kar diya phir dusra jumla aisa keh diya jis se hazf shuda jumla maloom ho jaye, is aayat ke aakhri jumle (Zalikum Wassakum) se (Alla Tushriku) is se pehle ke mehzoof jumle (Awsakum) par dalalat ho gayi. Arab mein yun bhi keh diya karte hain (Amartuka An La Taqoom). Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Rasool-e-Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain mere paas Jibra'eel (Alaihis Salam / A.S) aaye aur mujhe yeh khushkhabri sunayi ke Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki ummat mein se jo shakhs Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na kare woh dakhil-e-Jannat hoga, to main ne kaha go us ne zina kiya ho go us ne chori ki ho? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya haan go us ne zina aur chori ki ho, main ne phir yahi sawal kiya mujhe phir yahi jawab mila, phir bhi main ne yeh baat poochhi, ab ke jawab diya ke go sharab noshi bhi ki ho.

Baaz riwayaton mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se muwahhid ke jannat mein dakhil hone ka sun kar Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) ne yeh sawal kiya tha aur Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne yeh jawab diya tha aur aakhri martaba farmaya tha aur Abu Zar ki naak khaak aalood ho, chunancha rawi-e-hadith jab ise bayan farmate to yahi lafz dohra dete. Sunan mein marwi hai ke Allah Ta'ala farmata hai: Ae Ibn-e-Adam! Tu jab tak mujh se dua karta rahega aur meri zaat se umeed rakhega, main bhi teri khataon ko maaf farmata rahunga khwah woh kaisi hi hon, koi parwah na karunga. Tu agar mere paas zameen bhar kar khatayen layega to main tere paas utni hi maghfirat aur bakhshish le kar aaunga, bashart-e-ke tu ne mere saath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho. Go tu ne khatayen ki hon yahan tak ke woh aasman tak pahunch gayi hon, phir bhi tu mujh se istighfar kare to main tujhe bakhsh dunga. Is hadith ki shahadat mein yeh aayat aa sakti hai: (اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَغْفِرُ اَنْ يُّشْرَكَ بِهٖ وَيَغْفِرُ مَا دُوْنَ ذٰلِكَ لِمَنْ يَّشَاۗءُ ۚوَمَنْ يُّشْرِكْ باللّٰهِ فَقَدِ افْتَرٰٓى اِثْمًا عَظِيْمًا) (Surah An-Nisa: 48) yani mushrik ko to Allah mutlaq na bakhshega, baqi gunehgar Allah ki mashiyat par hain jise chahe bakhsh de. Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai, jo tawheed par mare woh jannati hai. Is bare mein bahut si aayatein aur hadeesein hain. Ibn-e-Marduyah mein hai ke Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na karo go tumhare tukde tukde kar diye jayen ya tumhein sooli chadha diya jaye ya tumhein jala diya jaye. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai ke hamein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne saat baaton ka hukum diya: 1. Allah ke saath kisi ko shareek na karna go tum jala diye jao ya kaat diye jao ya sooli de diye jao. Is aayat mein tawheed ka hukum de kar phir maa baap ke saath ehsan karne ka hukum hua. Baaz ki qira'at (ووصی ربک الا تعبدو الا ایاہ وبالوالدین احسانا) bhi hai. Quran-e-Kareem mein aksar yeh dono hukum ek hi jagah bayan hue hain, jaise aayat (اَنِ اشْكُرْ لِيْ وَلِوَالِدَيْكَ ۭ اِلَيَّ الْمَصِيْرُ) (Surah Luqman: 14) mein. Mushrik maa baap ke saath bhi ba-qadr-e-zaroorat ehsan karne ka hukum hua hai aur aayat (لَقَدْ اَخَذْنَا مِيْثَاقَ بَنِيْٓ اِسْرَاۗءِيْلَ وَاَرْسَلْنَآ اِلَيْهِمْ رُسُلًا ۭكُلَّمَا جَاۗءَهُمْ رَسُوْلٌۢ بِمَا لَا تَهْوٰٓى اَنْفُسُهُمْ  فَرِيْقًا كَذَّبُوْا وَفَرِيْقًا يَّقْتُلُوْنَ) (Surah Al-Ma'idah: 70) mein bhi dono hukum ek saath bayan hue hain aur bhi bahut si is mafhoom ki aayatein hain. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain, main ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya ke kaunsa amal afzal hai? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya: Namaz waqt par padhna. Main ne poocha phir? Farmaya: Maa baap ke saath neki karna. Main ne poocha phir? Farmaya: Allah ki raah mein jihad karna.

Main agar aur bhi daryaft karta toh Huzoor (ﷺ) bata dete, Ibn-e-Marduyah mein Ubadah bin Samit aur Abu Darda (R.A) se marwi hai ke mujhe mere Khalil Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ne wasiyat ki ke apne walidain ki itaat kar agarche woh tujhe hukum dein ke tu un ke liye sari duniya se alag ho jaye toh bhi maan le, is ki sanad zaeef hai. Baap dadaon ki wasiyat kar ke aulad aur aulad ki aulad ki baat wasiyat farmayi ke unhein qatl na karo jaise ke shayateen ne is kaam ko tumhein sikha rakha hai. Ladkiyon ko toh woh log wajah-e-aar ke maar daalte thay aur baaz ladkon ko bhi wajah is ke ke un ke khane ka saman kahan se layenge, maar daalte thay. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ne ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ) se daryaft kiya ke sab se bada gunah kya hai? Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya Allah ke sath shareek karna halanke isi akele ne paida kiya hai. Poocha phir kaunsa gunah hai? Farmaya apni aulad ko is khauf se qatl karna ke yeh mere sath khayegi. Poocha phir kaunsa hai? Farmaya apni pados ki aurat se badkari karna. Phir Huzoor (ﷺ) ne aayat (وَالَّذِيْنَ لَا يَدْعُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰــهًا اٰخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُوْنَ النَّفْسَ الَّتِيْ حَرَّمَ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بالْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُوْنَ ۚ وَمَنْ يَّفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَلْقَ اَثَامًا) (Surah Al-Furqan: 68) ki tilawat farmayi aur aayat mein hai (وَلَا تَقْتُلُوْٓا اَوْلَادَكُمْ خَشْـيَةَ اِمْلَاقٍ ۭ نَحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَاِيَّاكُمْ ۭ اِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْاً كَبِيْرًا) (Surah Al-Isra: 31) apni aulad ko faqiri ke khauf se qatl na karo, isi liye is ke baad hi farmaya ke hum unhein rozi dete hain aur tumhari rozi bhi hamare zimme hai. Yahan chunke farmaya tha ke faqiri ki wajah se aulad ka gala na ghonto toh sath hi farmaya tumhein rozi hum denge aur unhein bhi hum hi de rahe hain. Phir farmaya kisi zahir aur posheeda burai ke paas bhi na jao jaise aur aayat mein hai (قُلْ اِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ رَبِّيَ الْفَوَاحِشَ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ وَالْاِثْمَ وَالْبَغْيَ بِغَيْرِ الْحَقِّ وَاَنْ تُشْرِكُوْا باللّٰهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهٖ سُلْطٰنًا وَّاَنْ تَقُوْلُوْا عَلَي اللّٰهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ) (Surah Al-A'raf: 33), yani tamam zahiri, batini buraiyan, zulm-o-ziyadati, shirk-o-kufr aur jhoot bohtan sab kuch Allah ne haram kar diya hai. Is ki poori tafsir aayat (wa zaru zahiral ithmi wa batinahu) ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hai. Sahih hadith mein hai Allah se zyada ghairat wala koi nahin isi wajah se tamam behayaiyan Allah ne haram kar di hain khwah woh zahir hon ya posheeda hon. Saad bin Ubadah (R.A) ne kaha ke agar main kisi ko apni biwi ke sath dekh loon toh main toh ek hi waar mein us ka faisla kar doon, jab Huzoor (ﷺ) ke paas un ka yeh qaul bayan hua toh farmaya kya tum Saad ki ghairat par ta'ajjub kar rahe ho?

Wallahi main is se zyada ghairat wala hoon aur mera Rab mujh se zyada ghairat wala hai, isi wajah se tamam fahash kaam zahir-o-poshida us ne haram kar diye hain (Bukhari-o-Muslim). Ek martaba Huzoor (ﷺ) se kaha gaya ke hum ghairat mand log hain, aap ne farmaya wallahi main bhi ghairat wala hoon aur Allah mujh se zyada ghairat wala hai. Yeh ghairat hi hai jis ki wajah se us ne tamam buri baton ko haram qarar de diya hai. Is hadith ki sanad Tirmidhi ki baab par hai. Tirmidhi mein yeh hadith hai ke meri ummat ki umrein saath sattar (60-70) ke darmiyan hain. Is ke baad kisi ke nahaq qatl ki hurmat ko bayan farmaya, go woh bhi fawahish mein dakhil hai lekin is ki ahmiyat ki wajah se ise alag kar ke bayan farma diya. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai ke jo musalman Allah ki tawheed aur meri risalat ka iqrar karta ho use qatl karna bajuz teen baton ke jaiz nahin: ya to shadi shuda ho kar phir zina kare, ya kisi ko qatl kar de, ya deen ko chhod de aur jamaat se alag ho jaye. Muslim mein hai us ki qasam jis ke siwa koi mabood nahin, kisi musalman ka khoon halal nahin. Abu Dawood aur Nasai mein teesra shakhs woh bayan kiya gaya hai jo Islam se nikal jaye aur Allah ke Rasoolon se jang karne lage, use qatl kar diya jaye ga ya saleeb par chadha diya jaye ga ya musalmanon ke mulk se jala-watan kar diya jaye ga. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Usman bin Affan (R.A) ne us waqt jabke baghi aap ko muhasray mein liye hue thay, farmaya: Main ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) se suna hai, kisi musalman ka khoon bajuz in teen ke halal nahin: ek to Islam ke baad kafir ho jane wala, dusra shadi ho jane ke baad zina karne wala, aur baghair qisas ke kisi ko qatl kar dene wala. Allah ki qasam na to main ne jahiliyat mein zina kiya na Islam lane ke baad, aur na Islam lane ke baad kabhi main ne kisi aur deen ki tamanna ki aur na main ne kisi ko bila-wajah qatl kiya. Phir tum mera khoon bahane ke darpay kyun ho? Harbi kafiron mein se jo aman talab kare aur musalmanon ke muahida-e-aman mein aa jaye, us ke qatl karne wale ke haq mein bhi bahut wa'eed aayi hai aur us ka qatl bhi shar'an haram hai. Bukhari mein hai muahida-e-aman ka qatil jannat ki khushbu bhi na paye ga halankeh is ki khushbu chalees saal ke raaste tak pahunch jati hai, aur riwayat mein hai kyunke us ne Allah ka zimma toda, is mein hai pachaas baras ke raaste ke faaslay se hi jannat ki khushbu pahunchti hai. Phir farmata hai yeh hain Allah ki wasiyatein aur us ke ahkaam taake tum deen-e-haq ko, us ke ahkaam ko aur us ki mana karda baton ko samajh lo.

Yateemon ke sath husn-e-sulook ki takeed Abu Dawood waghera mein hai ke jab aayat (Wala taqrabu) aur aayat (Innal-lazina ya'kuluna amwalal-yatama zulma) nazil huin toh Ashab-e-Rasool (R.A) ne yateemon ka khana peena apne khane peene se bilkul alag thalag kardiya. Is mein alawa un logon ke nuqsan aur mehnat ke yateemon ka nuqsan bhi hone laga, agar bach raha toh ya toh woh basi khayen ya sar kar kharab hojaye. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ) se is ka zikr hua toh aayat (فِى الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ ۭ وَيَسْــَٔـلُوْنَكَ عَنِ الْيَتٰمٰي ۭ قُلْ اِصْلَاحٌ لَّھُمْ خَيْرٌ ۭوَاِنْ تُخَالِطُوْھُمْ فَاِخْوَانُكُمْ ۭ وَاللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ الْمُفْسِدَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِ ۭ وَلَوْ شَاۗءَ اللّٰهُ لَاَعْنَتَكُمْ ۭ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَزِيْزٌ حَكِيْمٌ) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 220) nazil hui ke un ke liye khair-khwahi karo, un ka khana peena sath rakhne mein koi harj nahin, woh tumhare bhai hain. Ise parh kar sun kar Sahaba (R.A) ne un ka khana apne sath mila liya. Yeh hukm un ke sinn-e-balugh tak pahunchne tak hai, go baaz ne tees saal, baaz ne chalees saal aur baaz ne sath saal kahe hain lekin yeh sab qaul yahan munasib nahin, Allah A'lam. Phir hukm farmaya ke len-den mein naap tol mein kami beshi na karo, un ke liye halakat hai jo lete waqt poora lein aur dete waqt kam dein. Un ummaton ko Allah ne gharat kardiya jin mein yeh bad-khaslat thi. Jame Abu Isa Tirmidhi mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ) ne naapne aur tolne walon se farmaya tum ek aisi cheez ke wali banaye gaye ho, jis ki sahih nigrani na rakhne wale tabah hogaye. Phir farmata hai, kisi par us ki taqat se zyada bojh hum nahin ladte, yani agar kisi shakhs ne apni taqat bhar koshish karli, dusre ka haq de diya, apne haq se zyada na liya, phir bhi nadanistagi mein ghalti se koi baat reh gayi ho toh Allah ke han us ki pakar nahin. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Aap (ﷺ) ne aayat ke yeh dono jumle tilawat kar ke farmaya ke jis ne sahih niyat se wazan kiya, tola, phir bhi waqay mein koi kami zyadati bhool chook se hogayi toh us ka muakhiza na hoga. Yeh hadith mursal aur ghareeb hai. Phir farmata hai baat insaf ki kaha karo, chahe qarabat-dari ke mamle mein hi kuch kehna pare. Jaise farman hai aayat (يٰٓاَيُّھَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا كُوْنُوْا قَوّٰمِيْنَ بالْقِسْطِ شُهَدَاۗءَ لِلّٰهِ) (Surah An-Nisa: 135) aur Surah Nisa mein bhi yahi hukm diya ke har shakhs ko har haal mein sachai aur insaf na chhorna chahiye. Jhooti gawahi aur ghalat faisle se bachna chahiye. Allah ke ahd ko poora karo, us ke ahkam baja lao, us ki mana karda cheezon se alag raho, us ki kitab us ke Rasool (ﷺ) ki sunnat par chalte raho, yahi us ke ahd ko poora karna hai. Inhi cheezon ke bare Allah ka takeedi hukm hai, yahi farman tumhare wa'z-o-nasihat ka zariya hain taake tum jo is se pehle nikamme balkay bure kamon mein thay, ab un se alag ho jao. Baaz ki qirat mein (Tazakkarun) bhi hai.

Shaitani raahein firqa saazi yeh aur un jaisi aayaton ki tafsir mein Ibn-e-Abbas R.A ka qaul toh yeh hai ke Allah Ta'ala mominon ko baham aitimaad ka hukum deta hai aur ikhtilaf-o-firqa bandi se rokta hai, is liye ke agle log Allah ke deen mein phoot daalne hi se tabah huye thay. Musnad mein hai ke Allah ke Nabi ﷺ ne ek seedhi lakeer khenchi aur farmaya Allah ki seedhi raah yahi hai, phir us ke daayein baayein aur lakeerein khench kar farmaya in tamam raahon par shaitan hai jo apni taraf bula raha hai, phir aap ﷺ ne is aayat ka ibtidai hissa tilawat farmaya. Isi hadith ki shahid woh hadith hai jo Musnad waghera mein Hazrat Jabir R.A se marvi hai ke hum Nabi ﷺ ke paas baithe huye thay ke aap ﷺ ne apne saamne ek seedhi lakeer khenchi aur farmaya yeh shaitani raahein hain aur beech ki lakeer par ungli rakh kar is aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Ibn-e-Majah mein aur Bazzar mein bhi yeh hadith hai. Ibn-e-Masood R.A se kisi ne poocha Sirat-e-Mustaqeem kya hai? Aap R.A ne farmaya jis par hum ne apne Nabi ﷺ ko chhora usi ka doosra sira jannat mein ja milta hai, us ke daayein baayein bahut si aur raahein hain jin par log chal rahe hain aur doosron ko bhi apni taraf bula rahe hain, jo un raahon mein se kisi raah ho liya woh jahannam mein pahuncha, phir aap R.A ne isi aayat ki tilawat farmayi. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain Allah Ta'ala ne Sirat-e-Mustaqeem ki misaal bayan farmayi. Is raaste ke dono taraf do deewarein hain jin mein bahut se darwaze hain aur sab chaupat khule pade hain aur un par parde latke huye hain. Is seedhi raah ke sire par ek pukarne wala hai, pukarta rehta hai ke logo tum sab is Sirat-e-Mustaqeem par aa jao, raaste mein bikhar na jao. Beech raah ke bhi ek shakhs hai, jab koi shakhs un darwazon mein se kisi ko kholna chahta hai toh woh kehta hai khabardar ise na khol, khologe toh seedhi raah se door nikal jao ge. Pas seedhi raah Islam hai, dono deewarein Allah ki hudood hain, khule huye darwaze Allah ki haram karda cheezein hain, numaya shakhs Allah ki Kitab hai, oopar se pukarne wala Allah ki taraf ka nasihat karne wala hai jo har momin ke dil mein hai (Tirmidhi). Is nukte ko na bhoolna chahiye ke apni raah ke liye sabeel wahid ka lafz bola gaya aur gumrahi ki raahon ke liye subul jama ka lafz istemaal kiya gaya, is liye ke raah-e-haq ek hi hoti hai aur na-haq ke bahut se tareeqe hua karte hain, jaise aayat (Allah-u-wali-ul-lazeena aamanoo yukhrijuhum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noor) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 257) mein zulumaat ko jama ke lafz se aur noor ko wahid ke lafz se zikr kiya gaya hai. Huzoor ﷺ ne ek martaba (Qul ta'alau) se teen aayaton tak tilawat kar ke farmaya tum mein se kaun kaun in baaton par mujh se bai'at karta hai?

Phir farmaya jis ne is bai'at ko apna liya is ka ajar Allah ke zimme hai aur jis ne in mein se kisi baat ko tod diya is ki do suratein hain ya to duniya mein hi is ki saza-e-shar'i use mil jayegi ya Allah Ta'ala aakhirat tak use muhlat de phir Rabb ki mashiyat par munhasir hai agar chahe saza de agar chahe to maaf farma de.

Jinno ne Quran-e-Hakim suna. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne toh lafz 'Summa' ko tarteeb ke liye mana hai, yani un se yeh bhi keh de aur hamari taraf se yeh khabar bhi pahuncha de, lekin main kehta hoon 'Summa' ko tarteeb ke liye maan kar khabar ka khabar par atf kar dein toh kya harj? Aisa hota hai aur sher-on mein maujood hai. Chunke Quran-e-Karim ki madh ayat (Inna haza sirati mustaqima) mein guzri thi, is liye is par atf daal kar Taurat ki madh bayan kar di. Jaise ke aur bhi bahut si aayaton mein hai. Chunancha farman hai ayat (Wa min qablihi kitabu Musa imaman wa rahmata, wa haza kitabu musaddiqun lisanan arabiyya) yani is se pehle Taurat imam-o-rahmat thi aur ab yeh Quran-e-Arabi tasdeeq karne wala hai. Isi surat ke awwal mein hai ayat (Qul man anzala al-kitaba allazi ja'a bihi Musa nuran wa hudan lin-nas) (6. Al-An'am: 91), is ayat mein bhi Taurat ke bayan ke baad is Quran ka bayan hai. Kafiron ka haal bayan karte hue farmaya gaya hai ayat (Falamma ja'ahumu al-haqqu min indina) (10. Yunus: 76), jab un ke paas hamari taraf se haq aa pahuncha toh kehne lage ise us jaisa kyun na mila jo Musa ko mila tha? Jis ke jawab mein farmaya gaya, kya unhon ne Musa ki is kitab ke sath kufr nahin kiya tha? Kya saaf taur se nahin kaha tha ke yeh dono jadugar hain aur hum toh har ek ke munkir hain.

Jinno ka qaul bayan hua hai ke unhon ne apni qaum se kaha hum ne woh kitab suni hai jo Musa ke baad utri hai, jo apne se agli kitabon ko saccha kehti hai aur rah-e-haq ki hidayat karti hai. Woh kitab jame aur kamil thi. Shariat ki jin baton ki us waqt zaroorat thi sab is mein maujood thin. Yeh ehsan tha nek karon ki nekiyon ke badle ka. Jaise farman hai, ehsan ka badla ehsan hi hai aur jaise farman hai ke Bani Israel ko hum ne un ka imam bana diya jabke unhon ne sabr kiya aur hamari aayaton par yaqeen rakha. Garz yeh bhi Allah ka fazl tha aur nekon ki nekiyon ka sila. Ehsan karne walon par Allah bhi ehsan pura karta hai, yahan aur wahan bhi.

Imam Ibn-e-Jarir 'Allazi' ko masdariya maante hain, jaise ayat (Khuf tum kallazi khasu) mein Ibn-e-Rawaha ka sher hai:
Wa thabbatallahu ma ataka min hasanin, fil-mursalina wa nasra kallazi nasaru
(Allah teri acchaiyan badhaye aur agle nabiyon ki tarah teri bhi madad farmaye).

Baaz kehte hain yahan 'Allazi' ma'ani mein 'Allazina' ka hai. Abdullah bin Mas'ud R.A ki qirat (Lamma ma 'ala allazina ahsanu) hai. Pas mominon aur nek logon par Allah ka yeh ehsan hai aur pura ehsan hai. Baghawi kehte hain murad is se ambiya aur aam momin hain. Yani un sab par hum ne is ki fazeelat zahir ki, jaise farman hai ayat (Qala ya Musa inni astafaituka 'alan-nasi bi-risalati wa bi-kalami) (7. Al-A'raf: 144), yani ae Musa! Main ne apni risalat aur apne kalam se tujhe logon par buzurgi ata farmayi.

Haan Hazrat Musa A.S ki is buzurgi se Hazrat Muhammad ﷺ jo Khatam-ul-Anbiya hain aur Hazrat Ibrahim A.S jo Khalilullah hain mustasna hain ba-sabab un dalail ke jo warid ho chuke hain. Yahya bin Ya'mar 'Ahsan-u-hu' ko mahzoof maan kar 'Ahsan' parhte thay, ho sakta hai? Imam Ibn-e-Jarir farmate hain main is qirat ko jaiz nahin rakhunga agarche arabiyat ki bina par is mein nuqsan nahin. Aayat ke is jumle ka ek matlab yeh bhi bayan kiya gaya hai ke Hazrat Musa A.S par ehsan-e-Rabb ko tamam karne ke liye yeh Allah ki kitab un par nazil hui, in dono ke matlab mein koi tafawat nahin. Phir Taurat ki tareef bayan farmayi ke is mein har hukm ba-tafseel hai aur woh hidayat-o-rahmat hai taake log roz-e-qayamat apne Rabb se milne ka yaqeen kar lein. Phir Quran-e-Kareem ki itteba ki raghbat dilata hai, is mein gaur-o-fikr ki dawat deta hai aur is par amal karne ki hidayat farmata hai aur is ki taraf logon ko bulane ka hukm deta hai, barkat se is ka wasf bayan farmata hai ke jo bhi is par kar-band ho jaye woh dono jahan ki barkatein hasil karega is liye ke yeh Allah ki taraf mazboot rassi hai.

(Allah teri acchaiyan badhaye aur agle nabiyon ki tarah teri bhi madad farmaye).

Laaf-zani aib hai, dusron ko bhi neki se rokne wale badtareen insaan hain. Farmata hai ke is aakhri kitab ne tumhare tamam uzr khatam kar diye, jaise farman hai (Wa lau la an tuseebahum museebatum bima qaddamat aydeehim fayaqooloo rabbana lau la arsalta ilaina rasoolan fanattabi'a aayatika wa nakoon minal mu'mineen) (Surah Al-Qasas: 47), yani agar inhe unki bad-aamaliyon ki wajah se koi museebat pahunchti to keh dete ke tu ne hamari taraf koi rasool kyun na bheja ke hum tere farman ko maante. Agli do jamaton se murad Yahood-o-Nasrani hain. Agar yeh Arabi zaban ka Quran na utarta to woh yeh uzr kar dete ke hum par to hamari zaban mein koi kitab nahin utri, hum Allah ke farman se bilkul ghafil rahe, phir hamein saza kyun ho? Na yeh uzr baqi raha na yeh ke agar hum par aasaan kitab utarti to hum to aglon se aage nikal jaate aur khoob nekiyan karte. Jaise farman hai aayat (Lau la arsalta ilaina rasoolan fanattabi'a aayatika wa nakoon minal mu'mineen) (Surah Al-Qasas: 47), yani mu'akkad qasmein kha kha kar laaf-zani karte the ke hum mein agar koi Nabi aa jaye to hum hidayat ko maan lein. Allah farmata hai ab to tumhare paas tumhare Rab ki taraf se hidayat-o-rahmat bhara Quran ba-zaban-e-Rasool-e-Arabi aa chuka jis mein halal-o-haram ka bakhoobi bayan hai aur dilon ki hidayat ki kaafi nooraniyat aur Rab ki taraf se imaan walon ke liye sarasar rahmat-o-rahm hai. Ab tum hi batao ke jis ke paas Allah ki aayatein aa jayen aur woh inhe jhutlaye, un se faida na uthaye, na amal kare, na yaqeen laye, na neki kare, na badi chhore, na khud maane na auron ko manne de, us se barh kar zalim kaun hai? Isi surat ke shuru mein farmaya hai aayat (Wa lau la an tuseebahum museebatum bima qaddamat aydeehim fayaqooloo rabbana lau la arsalta ilaina rasoolan fanattabi'a aayatika wa nakoon minal mu'mineen) (Surah Al-Qasas: 47). Khud is ke mukhalif auron ko bhi ise manne se rokte hain, darasal apna hi bigarte hain, jaise farmaya aayat (Innal ladheena kafaroo wa saddoo 'an sabeelillahi qad dalloo dalalam ba'eeda) (Surah An-Nisa: 168), yani jo log khud kufr karte hain aur rah-e-Ilahi se rokte hain inhe hum azaab barhate rahenge. Pas yeh log hain jo na maante the na farman-bardar hote the, jaise farman hai aayat (Fala saddaqa wa la salla) (Surah Al-Qiyamah: 31), yani na tu ne maana na namaz parhi, balkeh na maan kar munh pher liya. In dono tafseeron mein pehli bahut achi hai, yani khud bhi inkaar kiya aur dusron ko bhi inkaar par aamada kiya.
