Qayamat aur bebasi Allah Ta'ala kafiron ko aur paighambaron ke mukhalifon ko aur apni aayat ke jhutlane walon ko aur apni raah se rokne walon ko dara raha hai ke kya unhein Qayamat ka intezar hai? Jabke farishtay bhi aayenge aur khud Allah Qahhar bhi. Woh bhi waqt hoga jab imaan bhi besood aur tauba bhi bekar, Bukhari Sharif mein is aayat ki tafsir mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Qayamat qaim na hogi jab tak ke suraj maghrib se na nikle jab yeh nishan zahir ho jayega to zameen par jitne log honge sab imaan layenge lekin us waqt ka imaan mehez besood hai. Phir aap ne yehi aayat padhi aur hadith hai jab Qayamat ki teen nishaniyan zahir ho jayen to be-imaan ko imaan lana, khair se ruke hue logon ko us ke baad neki ya tauba karna kuch sood mand na hoga. Suraj ka maghrib se nikalna, Dajjal ka aana, Dabbatul-Arz ka zahir hona. Ek aur riwayat mein is ke sath hi ek dhuwein ke aane ka bhi bayan hai aur hadith mein hai suraj ke maghrib se tulu hone se beshtar jo tauba kare us ki tauba maqbool hai. Hazrat Abu Zar (R.A) se ek martaba Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne pucha jante ho yeh suraj ghuroob ho kar kahan jata hai? Jawab diya ke nahin farmaya arsh ke qareeb ja kar sajde mein gir padta hai aur thehra rehta hai yahan tak ke use ijazat mile aur kaha jaye laut ja qareeb hai ke ek din us se keh diya jaye ke jahan se aaya hai wahin laut ja yehi woh waqt hoga ke imaan lana benafa ho jayega. Ek martaba log Qayamat ki nishaniyon ka zikr kar rahe the itne mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) bhi tashreef le aaye aur farmane lage Qayamat qaim na hogi jab tak tum das nishaniyan na dekh loge. Suraj ka maghrib se tulu hona, dhuan, Dabbatul-Arz, Yajuj Majuj ka aana, Isa bin Maryam (A.S) ka aana aur Dajjal ka nikalna, mashriq, maghrib aur jazeera-e-Arab mein teen jagah zameen ka dhans jana aur Aden ke darmiyan se ek zabardast aag ka nikalna jo logon ko hank le jayegi raat din un ke peeche hi peeche rahegi (Muslim waghera). Hazrat Huzaifa (R.A) ne Aan-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se daryaft kiya ke suraj ke maghrib se tulu hone ka nishan kya hai? Aap ne farmaya woh raat bahut lambi ho jayegi baqadr do raton ke log mamool ke mutabiq apne kaam kaaj mein honge aur tahajjud guzari mein bhi. Sitaray apni jagah thehre hue honge phir log so jayenge phir uthenge kaam mein lagenge phir soyenge phir uthenge lekin dekhenge ke na sitaray hate hain na suraj nikla hai karwatein dukhne lengi lekin subah na hogi ab to ghabra jayenge aur dehshat zada ho jayenge muntazir honge ke kab suraj nikle mashriq ki taraf nazrein jamaye hue honge ke achanak maghrib ki taraf se suraj nikal aayega us waqt to tamam roo-e-zameen ke insaan musalman ho jayenge lekin us waqt ka imaan mehez besood hoga.

(Ibn-e-Marduyah) ek hadith mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka is ayat ke is jumle ko tilawat farma kar is ki tafsir mein suraj ka maghrib se nikalna farmana bhi hai, ek riwayat mein hai sab se pehli nishani yahi hogi aur hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala ne maghrib ki taraf ek bada darwaza khol rakha hai jis ka arz sattar saal ka hai yeh tauba ka darwaza hai yeh band na hoga jab tak ke suraj maghrib se na nikle aur hadith mein hai logon par ek raat aayegi jo teen raaton ke barabar hogi ise tahajjud guzar jaan lenge yeh khade honge ek mamool ke mutabiq tahajjud padh kar phir so jayenge phir uthenge apna mamool ada kar ke phir letenge log is lambai se ghabra kar cheekh pukar shuru kar denge aur daude bhage masjidon ki taraf jayenge ke nagahan dekhenge ke suraj tulu ho gaya yahan tak ke wast-e-aasman mein pahunch kar phir laut jayega aur apne tulu hone ki jagah se tulu hoga, yahi woh waqt hai jis waqt iman soodmand nahin aur riwayat mein hai ke teen musalman shakhs Marwan ke paas baithe hue the Marwan un se keh rahe the ke sab se pehli nishani Dajjal ka khurooj hai yeh sun kar yeh log Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) ke paas gaye aur yeh bayan kiya aap ne farmaya us ne kuch nahin kaha mujhe Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman khoob mehfooz hai ke sab se pehli nishani suraj ka maghrib se nikalna hai aur Dabbatul-Arz ka din chadhe zahir hona hai. In dono mein se jo bhi pehle zahir ho isi ke baad dusri zahir hogi, Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) kitab padhte jate the farmaya mera khayal hai ke pehle suraj ka nishan zahir hoga woh ghuroob hote hi arsh tale jata hai aur sajda kar ke ijazat mangta hai ijazat mil jati hai jab mashiyat-e-Ilahi se maghrib se hi nikalna hoga to us ki baar baar ki ijazat talbi par bhi jawab na milega raat ka waqt khatam hone ke qareeb hoga aur yeh samajh lega ke ab agar ijazat mili bhi to mashriq mein nahin pahunch sakta to kahega ke ya Allah duniya ko sakht takleef hogi to us se kaha jayega yahin se tulu ho chunancha woh maghrib se hi nikal aayega phir Hazrat Abdullah (R.A) ne yahi ayat tilawat farmayi, Tabrani mein hai ke jab suraj maghrib se niklega Iblees sajde mein gir padega aur zor zor se kahega Ilahi mujhe hukm kar main manunga jise tu farmaye main sajda karne ke liye taiyar hoon us ki zurriyat us ke paas jama ho jayegi aur kahegi yeh haye waye kaisi hai? Woh kahega mujhe yahin tak ki dheel di gayi thi, ab woh aakhri waqt aa gaya phir Safa ki pahadi ke ghaar se Dabbatul-Arz niklega us ka pehla qadam Antakiya mein padega woh Iblees ke paas pahunchega aur use thappad marega. Yeh hadith bahut hi ghareeb hai is ki sanad bilkul zaeef hai mumkin hai ke yeh un kitabon mein se Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr (R.A) ne li ho jin ke do thailay unhein Yarmouk ki ladai wale din mile the. Un ka farman-e-Rasool hona na-qabil-e-tasleem hai Allah A'alam. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain hijrat munqata na hogi jab tak ke dushman barsar-e-paikar rahe.

Hijrat ki do qismein hain, ek toh gunahon ko chhodna, dusre Allah aur uske Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas tark-e-watan kar ke jana. Yeh bhi baqi rahega jab tak ke tauba qabool hoti hai aur tauba qabool hoti rahegi jab tak ke suraj maghrib se na nikle. Suraj ke maghrib se nikalte hi phir jo kuch jis haal mein hai usi par mohar lag jayegi aur aamal besood ho jayenge. Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) ka farman hai ke bahut se nishanat guzar chuke, sirf chaar baqi reh gaye hain: suraj ka nikalna, Dajjal, Dabbatul-Ardh aur Yajuj Majuj ka aana. Jis alamat ke sath aamal khatam ho jayenge woh tulu-e-shams min janib-e-maghrib hai. Ek taweel marfoo ghair munkar hadith mein hai ke us din suraj chand mile jule tulu honge, aadhe aasman se wapas chale jayenge phir hasb-e-aadat ho jayenge. Is hadith ka toh marfoo hone ka dawa is hadith ke mauzoo hone ka suboot hai. Haan, Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A) ya Wahab bin Munabbah (R.H) par mauqoof hone ki haisiyat se mumkin hai mauzoo ki ginti se nikal jaye, Wallahu A'lam. Hazrat Ayesha (R.A) farmati hain qayamat ki pehli nishani ke sath hi aamal ka khatma hai. Us din kisi kafir ka musalman hona besood hoga, haan momin jo is se pehle nek aamal wala hoga woh behtari mein rahega aur jo nek amal na hoga uski tauba bhi us waqt maqbool na hogi, jaise ke pehle hadithein guzar chukin. Bure logon ke nek aamal bhi is nishan-e-azeem ko dekh lene ke baad kaam na aayenge. Phir kafiron ko tanbeeh ki jati hai ke achha tum intezar mein hi raho ta-aan-ke tauba ke aur imaan ke qabool na hone ka waqt aa jaye aur qayamat ke zabardast aasar zahir ho jayen. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Hal yanzuruna illas-sa'ah) al-kh, qayamat ke achanak aa jane ka hi intezar hai, is ki bhi alamat zahir ho chuki hain, is ke aa chukne ke baad nasihat ka waqt kahan? Aur aayat mein hai (Falamma ra'au ba'sana), hamare azabon ka mushahida kar lene ke baad ka imaan aur shirk se inkar besood hai.

Ahl-e-Bid'at gumrah hain kehte hain ke yeh aayat Yahood-o-Nasara ke bare mein utri hai. Yeh log Huzoor (ﷺ) ki nabuwwat se pehle sakht ikhtilafat mein thay jin ki khabar yahan di ja rahi hai. Ek hadith mein hai shai'i tak is aayat ki tilawat farma kar Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya woh bhi tujh se koi mel nahin rakhte. Is ummat ke ahl-e-bid'at shak shuba wale aur gumrahi wale hain. Is hadith ki sanad sahih nahin. Ya'ni mumkin hai yeh Hazrat Abu Huraira (R.A) ka qaul ho. Abu Umama (R.A) farmate hain is se murad Khawarij hain. Yeh bhi marfoo'an marwi hai lekin sahih nahin. Ek aur ghareeb hadith mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ) farmate hain murad is se ahl-e-bid'at hai. Is ka bhi marfoo' hona sahih nahin. Baat yeh hai ke aayat aam hai jo bhi Allah Rasool ke deen ki mukhalifat kare aur is mein phoot aur iftiraq paida kare gumrahi ki aur khwahish parasti ki pairwi kare naya deen ikhtiyar kare naya mazhab qabool kare wohi wa'eed mein dakhil hai kyunke Huzoor (ﷺ) jis haq ko le kar aaye hain woh ek hi hai kayi ek nahin. Allah ne apne Rasool ko firqa bandi se bachaya hai aur aap ke deen ko bhi is la'nat se mehfooz rakha hai. Isi mazmoon ki dusri aayat (شَرَعَ لَكُمْ مِّنَ الدِّيْنِ) (Surah Ash-Shura: 13) hai. Ek hadith mein bhi hai ke hum jama'at-e-ambiya 'allaati bhai hain. Hum sab ka deen ek hi hai. Pas Sirat-e-Mustaqeem aur deen-e-pasandida Allah ki tauheed aur Rasoolon ki itteba hai is ke khilaf jo ho zalalat, jahalat, raye, khwahish aur bad-deeni hai aur Rasool (ﷺ) is se bezar hain un ka mamla supurd-e-Rabb hai wohi unhein un ke kartoot se aagah kare ga jaise aur aayat mein hai ke mominon, yahudiyon, sabiyon aur nasraniyon mein majusiyon mein mushrikon mein Allah khud Qayamat ke din faisle kar de ga is ke baad apne ehsan, hukm aur adl ka bayan farmata hai.

Neki ka das guna sawab aur ghalti ki saza barabar barabar. Ek aur aayat mein mujmalan yeh aaya hai ke (Falahu khairun minha) jo neki laye us ke liye us se behtar badla hai. Isi aayat ke mutabiq bahut si hadeesein bhi warid hoti hain. Ek mein hai tumhara Rabb-e-Azz-o-Jal bahut bada Raheem hai, neki ke sirf qasd par neki ke karne ka sawab ata farma deta hai aur ek neki ke karne par das se saath tak badha deta hai aur bhi bahut zyada aur bahut zyada. Aur agar burai ka qasd hua phir na kar saka to bhi neki milti hai aur agar us burai ko kar guzra to ek burai hi likhi jati hai aur bahut mumkin hai ke Allah maaf hi farma de aur bilkul hi mita de. Sach to yeh hai ke halakat wale hi Allah ke haan halak hote hain (Bukhari, Muslim, Nasai waghera). Ek Hadees-e-Qudsi mein hai neki karne wale ko das guna sawab hai aur phir bhi main zyada kar deta hoon aur burai karne wale ko ikahra azab hai aur main maaf bhi kar deta hoon. Zameen bhar tak jo shakhs khatayein le aaye agar us ne mere sath kisi ko shareek na kiya to main utni hi rahmat se us ki taraf mutawajja hota hoon. Jo meri taraf balisht bhar aaye main us ki taraf ek haath badhta hoon aur jo haath bhar aaye main us ki taraf do haath badhta hoon aur jo meri taraf chalta hua aaye main us ki taraf daudta hua jata hoon (Muslim, Musnad waghera). Is se pehle guzri hui hadees ki tarah ek aur hadees bhi hai, is mein farmaya hai ke burai ka irada kar ke phir use chhod dene wale ko bhi neki milti hai. Is se murad woh shakhs hai jo Allah ke darr se chhod de, chunancha baaz riwayaton mein tashreeh aa bhi chuki hai. Dusri surat chhod dene ki yeh hai ke use yaad hi na aaye, bhool bisar jaye to use na sawab hai na azab kyunke us ne Allah se darr kar nek niyati se use tark nahin kiya. Aur agar badniyati se us ne koshish bhi ki, use puri tarah karna bhi chaha lekin aajiz ho gaya, kar na saka, mauqa hi na mila, asbab hi na bane, thak kar baith gaya to aise shakhs ko us burai ke karne ke barabar hi gunah hota hai. Chunancha hadees mein hai jab do musalman talwarein le kar ek dusre se jang karein to jo maar dale aur jo maar dala jaye dono jahannami hain. Logon ne kaha maar dalne wala to khair lekin jo mara gaya woh jahannam mein kyun jaye ga? Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya is liye ke woh bhi dusre ko maar dalne ka aarzoo mand tha. Aur hadees mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain neki ke mahaz irade par neki likh li jati hai aur amal mein lane ke baad das nekiyan likhi jati hain. Burai ke mahaz irade ko likha nahin jata, agar amal kar le to ek hi gunah likha jata hai aur agar chhod de to neki likhi jati hai, Allah Ta'ala farmata hai us ne gunah ke kaam ko mere khauf se tark kar diya. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain logon ki chaar qismein hain aur aamal ki chhe qismein hain. Baaz log to woh hain jinhein duniya aur aakhirat mein wus'at aur kushadgi di jati hai, baaz woh hain jin par duniya mein kushadgi hoti hai aur aakhirat mein tangi, baaz woh hain jin par duniya mein tangi rehti hai aur aakhirat mein unhein kushadgi mile gi.

Ba'az woh hain jo dono jahan mein badbakht rehte hain, yahan bhi wahan bhi be-aabru. A'maal ki chhe qismein yeh hain: do qismein toh sawab wajib kar dene wali hain, ek barabar ka, ek das guna aur ek saat sau guna. Wajib kar dene wali do cheezein woh hain: jo shakhs Islam-o-Imaan par mare, Allah ke sath kisi ko shareek na kiya ho, us ke liye Jannat wajib hai aur jo kufr par mare us ke liye Jahannam wajib hai. Aur jo neki ka irada kare go ke na ho, use ek neki milti hai, is liye ke Allah janta hai ke us ke dil ne ise samjha, us ki hirs ki. Aur jo shakhs burai ka irada kare us ke zimme gunah nahin likha jata aur jo kar guzre use ek hi gunah hota hai aur woh barhta nahin hai. Aur jo neki ka kaam kare use das nekiyan milti hain aur jo rah-e-Allah Azza-wa-Jal mein kharch kare use saat sau guna milta hai (Tirmidhi).

Farman hai ke Jumma mein aane wale log teen tarah ke hain: ek woh jo wahan laghw karta hai, us ke hisse mein toh wahi laghw hai; ek dua karta hai, use agar Allah chahe de, chahe na de; teesra woh shakhs hai jo sukoot aur khamoshi ke sath khutbe mein baithta hai, kisi Musalman ki gardan phalang kar masjid mein aage nahin barhta, na kisi ko eeza deta hai, us ka Jumma agle Jumma tak gunahon ka kaffara ho jata hai, balkeh aur teen din tak ke gunahon ka bhi, is liye ke wa'da-e-Ilahi mein hai aayat: (Man ja'a bil-hasanati falahu 'ashru amthaliha, wa man ja'a bis-sayyi'ati fala yujza illa mithlaha wahum la yuzlamun) (Surah Al-An'am: 160). Jo neki kare use das guna ajar milta hai. Tabarani mein hai: Jumma Jumma tak balkeh aur teen din tak kaffara hai, is liye ke Allah ka farman hai neki karne wale ko us jaisi das nekiyon ka sawab milta hai.

Farmate hain jo shakhs har mahine mein teen roze rakhe use saal bhar ke rozon ka, yani tamam umr sara zamana roze se rehne ka sawab das rozon ka milta hai (Tirmidhi). Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) aur salaf ki ek jama'at se manqool hai ke is aayat mein 'hasana' se murad kalma-e-tauheed hai aur 'sayyi'a' se murad shirk hai. Ek marfoo hadith mein bhi yeh hai lekin is ki koi sahih sanad meri nazar se nahin guzri. Is aayat ki tafseer mein aur bhi bahut si hadeesein aur aasar hain lekin Insha'Allah yeh hi kaafi hain.

Bewaqoof wahi hai jo Deen-e-Hanif se munh mor le warna Deen-e-Islam qadeemi hai. Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum ho raha hai ke aap par Allah ki jo ne'amat hai us ka elaan kar dein ke us Rabb ne aap ko Sirat-e-Mustaqeem dikha di hai jis mein koi kaji ya kami nahin, woh sabit aur salim seedhi aur suthri raah hai. Ibrahim Hanif ki millat hai jo mushrikon mein na thay. Is deen se wahi hat jata hai jo mehez bewaqoof ho aur aayat mein hai: Allah ki raah mein poora jihad karo, wahi Allah hai jis ne tumhein barguzida kiya aur kushada deen ata farmaya jo tumhare baap Ibrahim ka deen hai, Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) Allah ke sachay farmanbardar thay, mushrik na thay, Allah ki ne'amaton ke shukarguzar thay, Allah ke pasandeeda thay, raah-e-mustaqeem ki hidayat paye hue thay, duniya mein bhi hum ne unhein bhalai di thi aur maidan-e-Qayamat mein bhi woh nek-kar logon mein honge. Phir hum ne teri taraf wahi ki ke millat-e-Ibrahim Hanif ki pairwi kar ke woh mushrikeen mein na tha. Yeh yaad rahe ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aap ki millat ki pairwi ka hukum hone se yeh lazim nahin aata ke Khalilullah aap se afzal hain, is liye ke Huzoor ka qayam is par poora hua aur yeh deen aap hi ke hathon kamal ko pahuncha. Isi liye hadith mein hai ke main nabiyon ka khatam karne wala hoon aur tamam aulad-e-Adam ka ala-al-itlaq sardar hoon aur Maqam-e-Mahmood wala hoon jis se sari makhlooq ko umeed hogi yahan tak ke Khalilullah (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko bhi. Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) subah ke waqt farmaya karte thay hadith: (Asbahna ala millatil Islam wa kalimatil ikhlas wa deeni nabiyyina wa millati Ibrahima hanifa wa ma kana minal mushrikeen) yani hum ne millat-e-Islamia par, kalma-e-ikhlas par, hamare Nabi ke deen par aur millat-e-Ibrahim Hanif par subah ki hai jo mushrik na thay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke sab se zyada mehboob deen Allah ke nazdeek kaun sa hai? Aap ne farmaya woh jo yaksooi aur aasani wala hai. Musnad ki hadith mein hai ke jis din Hazrat Ayesha (R.A / Razi Allahu Anha) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke mondhon par munh rakh kar habshiyon ke jangi kartab mulahiza farmaye thay us din aap ne yeh bhi farmaya tha ke yeh is liye ke Yahoodiya jaan lein ke hamare deen mein kushadagi hai aur main yaksooi wala aasani wala deen de kar bheja gaya hoon. Aur hukum hota hai ke aap mushrikon se apna mukhalif hona bhi bayan farma dein, woh Allah ke siwa dusron ki ibadat karte hain, dusron ke naam par zabiha karte hain, main sirf apne Rabb ki ibadat karta hoon, usi ke naam par zabiha karta hoon. Chunancha Baqra Eid ke din Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jab do bheray zibah kiye to Inni Wajjahtu... ke baad yahi aayat parhi. Aap hi is ummat mein awwal muslim thay is liye ke yun to har Nabi aur un ki manne wali ummat muslim hi thi, sab ki dawat Islam hi ki thi, sab Allah ki khalis ibadat karte rahe jaise farman hai aayat: (Wa ma arsalna min qablika illa rijalan noohi ilaihim fas-alu ahlaz zikri in kuntum la ta'lamoon) (16:43).

(An-Nahl: 43) Ya'ni tujh se pehle bhi jitne Rasool hum ne bheje sab ki taraf wahi ki ke mere siwa koi mabood nahin tum sab meri hi ibadat karo. Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ka farman Quran mein majood hai ke aap ne apni qoum se farmaya ke main tum se koi ujrat talab nahin karta mera ajar toh mere Rab ke zimme hai mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main musalmanon mein rahoon aur ayat mein hai (Wama arsalna min qablika illa rijalan noohi ilaihim fas'alu ahla-zikri in kuntum la ta'lamoon) (An-Nahl: 43). Millat-e-Ibrahimi se wahi hatta hai jis ki qismat phoot gayi ho, woh duniya mein bhi barguzida-e-Rab tha aur aakhirat mein bhi saleh logon mein se hai, use jab us ke Rab ne farmaya toh tabe-dar ban ja us ne jawab diya ke main Rabbul-Aalameen ka farmanbardar hoon. Isi ki wasiyat Ibrahim (A.S) ne apne bachon ko ki thi aur Yaqub (A.S) ne apni aulad ko ke ae mere bacho Allah ne tumhare liye deen ko pasand farma liya hai. Pas tum Islam hi par marna. Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ki aakhri dua mein hai ya Allah tu ne mujhe mulk ata farmaya khwab ki tabeer sikhayi aasman-o-zameen ka ibtida mein paida karne wala tu hi hai tu hi duniya aur aakhirat mein mera wali hai mujhe Islam ki halat mein faut karna aur nek karon mein mila dena. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne apni qoum se farmaya tha mere bhaiyo agar tum imandar ho agar tum muslim ho toh tumhein Allah hi par bharosa karna chahiye, sab ne jawab diya ke hum ne Allah hi par tawakkul rakha hai, Allah! hamein zalimon ke liye fitna na bana aur hamein apni rahmat ke sath in kafiron se bacha le aur ayat mein farman-e-Bari hai (Inna anzalnat-Taurata feeha hudan wa noor) (Al-Ma'idah: 44) hum ne Taurat utari jis mein hidayat-o-noor hai jis ke mutabiq woh ambiya hukum karte hain jo muslim hain yahudiyon ko bhi aur rabbaniyon ko bhi aur ahbar ko bhi aur farman hai ayat (Wa iz auhaitu ilal-hawariyyina an aaminoo bee wa bi-rasooli qaloo aamanna wash-had bi-annana muslimoon) (Al-Ma'idah: 111) main ne hawariyon ki taraf wahi ki ke mujh par aur mere Rasool par iman lao sab ne kaha hum ne iman qabool kiya hamare musalman hone par tum gawah raho. Yeh ayatein saaf batla rahi hain ke Allah ne apne nabiyon ko Islam ke sath hi bheja hai, han yeh aur baat hai ke woh apni apni makhsoos shariyaton ke sath mukhtas thay ahkam ka adal badal hota rehta tha yahan tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke deen ke sath pehle ke kul deen mansookh ho gaye aur na mansookh hone wala na badalne wala hamesha rehne wala deen-e-Islam aap ko mila jis par ek jamaat qayamat tak qaim rahegi aur is pak deen ka jhanda abdal-aabad tak lehrata rahega.

An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke hum Ambiya ki jamaat 'allati bhai hain hum sab ka deen ek hi hai, bhaiyon ki ek qism toh 'allati hai jin ka baap ek ho maayen alag alag hon, ek qism akhyafi jin ki maa ek ho aur baap juda-gana hon aur ek 'aini bhai hain jin ka baap bhi ek ho aur maa bhi ek ho. Pas kul Ambiya ka deen ek hai yani Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki ibadat aur shariyat mukhtalif hain ba-aitibar-e-ahkam ke. Is liye unhein 'allati bhai farmaya. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) takbir-e-ula ke baad namaz mein (Inni Wajjahtu) aur yeh aayat parh kar phir yeh parhte: (Allahumma Antal-Maliku La ilaha illa Anta, Anta Rabbi wa ana 'abduka, zalamtu nafsi wa'taraftu bi-zambi faghfirli zunubi jami'an, la yaghfiruz-zunuba illa Anta, wahdini li-ahsanil-akhlaqi la yahdi li-ahsaniha illa Anta, wasrif 'anni sayyi'aha la yasrifu 'anni sayyi'aha illa Anta, tabarakta wa ta'alaita, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaik). Yeh hadith lambi hai is ke baad rawi ne ruku-o-sajda aur tashahhud ki duaon ka zikr kiya hai (Muslim).

Bewaqoof wahi hai jo Deen-e-Hanif se munh mor le warna Deen-e-Islam qadeemi hai. Sayyid-ul-Mursaleen (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko hukum ho raha hai ke aap par Allah ki jo ne'amat hai us ka elaan kar dein ke us Rabb ne aap ko Sirat-e-Mustaqeem dikha di hai jis mein koi kaji ya kami nahin, woh sabit aur salim seedhi aur suthri raah hai. Ibrahim Hanif ki millat hai jo mushrikon mein na thay. Is deen se wahi hat jata hai jo mehez bewaqoof ho aur aayat mein hai: Allah ki raah mein poora jihad karo, wahi Allah hai jis ne tumhein barguzida kiya aur kushada deen ata farmaya jo tumhare baap Ibrahim ka deen hai, Ibrahim (A.S / Alaihis Salam) Allah ke sachay farmanbardar thay, mushrik na thay, Allah ki ne'amaton ke shukarguzar thay, Allah ke pasandeeda thay, raah-e-mustaqeem ki hidayat paye hue thay, duniya mein bhi hum ne unhein bhalai di thi aur maidan-e-Qayamat mein bhi woh nek-kar logon mein honge. Phir hum ne teri taraf wahi ki ke millat-e-Ibrahim Hanif ki pairwi kar ke woh mushrikeen mein na tha. Yeh yaad rahe ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko aap ki millat ki pairwi ka hukum hone se yeh lazim nahin aata ke Khalilullah aap se afzal hain, is liye ke Huzoor ka qayam is par poora hua aur yeh deen aap hi ke hathon kamal ko pahuncha. Isi liye hadith mein hai ke main nabiyon ka khatam karne wala hoon aur tamam aulad-e-Adam ka ala-al-itlaq sardar hoon aur Maqam-e-Mahmood wala hoon jis se sari makhlooq ko umeed hogi yahan tak ke Khalilullah (A.S / Alaihis Salam) ko bhi. Ibn Marduyah mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) subah ke waqt farmaya karte thay hadith: (Asbahna ala millatil Islam wa kalimatil ikhlas wa deeni nabiyyina wa millati Ibrahima hanifa wa ma kana minal mushrikeen) yani hum ne millat-e-Islamia par, kalma-e-ikhlas par, hamare Nabi ke deen par aur millat-e-Ibrahim Hanif par subah ki hai jo mushrik na thay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se sawal hua ke sab se zyada mehboob deen Allah ke nazdeek kaun sa hai? Aap ne farmaya woh jo yaksooi aur aasani wala hai. Musnad ki hadith mein hai ke jis din Hazrat Ayesha (R.A / Razi Allahu Anha) ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke mondhon par munh rakh kar habshiyon ke jangi kartab mulahiza farmaye thay us din aap ne yeh bhi farmaya tha ke yeh is liye ke Yahoodiya jaan lein ke hamare deen mein kushadagi hai aur main yaksooi wala aasani wala deen de kar bheja gaya hoon. Aur hukum hota hai ke aap mushrikon se apna mukhalif hona bhi bayan farma dein, woh Allah ke siwa dusron ki ibadat karte hain, dusron ke naam par zabiha karte hain, main sirf apne Rabb ki ibadat karta hoon, usi ke naam par zabiha karta hoon. Chunancha Baqra Eid ke din Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne jab do bheray zibah kiye to Inni Wajjahtu... ke baad yahi aayat parhi. Aap hi is ummat mein awwal muslim thay is liye ke yun to har Nabi aur un ki manne wali ummat muslim hi thi, sab ki dawat Islam hi ki thi, sab Allah ki khalis ibadat karte rahe jaise farman hai aayat: (Wa ma arsalna min qablika illa rijalan noohi ilaihim fas-alu ahlaz zikri in kuntum la ta'lamoon) (16:43).

(An-Nahl: 43) Ya'ni tujh se pehle bhi jitne Rasool hum ne bheje sab ki taraf wahi ki ke mere siwa koi mabood nahin tum sab meri hi ibadat karo. Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ka farman Quran mein majood hai ke aap ne apni qoum se farmaya ke main tum se koi ujrat talab nahin karta mera ajar toh mere Rab ke zimme hai mujhe hukum diya gaya hai ke main musalmanon mein rahoon aur ayat mein hai (Wama arsalna min qablika illa rijalan noohi ilaihim fas'alu ahla-zikri in kuntum la ta'lamoon) (An-Nahl: 43). Millat-e-Ibrahimi se wahi hatta hai jis ki qismat phoot gayi ho, woh duniya mein bhi barguzida-e-Rab tha aur aakhirat mein bhi saleh logon mein se hai, use jab us ke Rab ne farmaya toh tabe-dar ban ja us ne jawab diya ke main Rabbul-Aalameen ka farmanbardar hoon. Isi ki wasiyat Ibrahim (A.S) ne apne bachon ko ki thi aur Yaqub (A.S) ne apni aulad ko ke ae mere bacho Allah ne tumhare liye deen ko pasand farma liya hai. Pas tum Islam hi par marna. Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ki aakhri dua mein hai ya Allah tu ne mujhe mulk ata farmaya khwab ki tabeer sikhayi aasman-o-zameen ka ibtida mein paida karne wala tu hi hai tu hi duniya aur aakhirat mein mera wali hai mujhe Islam ki halat mein faut karna aur nek karon mein mila dena. Hazrat Musa (A.S) ne apni qoum se farmaya tha mere bhaiyo agar tum imandar ho agar tum muslim ho toh tumhein Allah hi par bharosa karna chahiye, sab ne jawab diya ke hum ne Allah hi par tawakkul rakha hai, Allah! hamein zalimon ke liye fitna na bana aur hamein apni rahmat ke sath in kafiron se bacha le aur ayat mein farman-e-Bari hai (Inna anzalnat-Taurata feeha hudan wa noor) (Al-Ma'idah: 44) hum ne Taurat utari jis mein hidayat-o-noor hai jis ke mutabiq woh ambiya hukum karte hain jo muslim hain yahudiyon ko bhi aur rabbaniyon ko bhi aur ahbar ko bhi aur farman hai ayat (Wa iz auhaitu ilal-hawariyyina an aaminoo bee wa bi-rasooli qaloo aamanna wash-had bi-annana muslimoon) (Al-Ma'idah: 111) main ne hawariyon ki taraf wahi ki ke mujh par aur mere Rasool par iman lao sab ne kaha hum ne iman qabool kiya hamare musalman hone par tum gawah raho. Yeh ayatein saaf batla rahi hain ke Allah ne apne nabiyon ko Islam ke sath hi bheja hai, han yeh aur baat hai ke woh apni apni makhsoos shariyaton ke sath mukhtas thay ahkam ka adal badal hota rehta tha yahan tak ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke deen ke sath pehle ke kul deen mansookh ho gaye aur na mansookh hone wala na badalne wala hamesha rehne wala deen-e-Islam aap ko mila jis par ek jamaat qayamat tak qaim rahegi aur is pak deen ka jhanda abdal-aabad tak lehrata rahega.

An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke hum Ambiya ki jamaat 'allati bhai hain hum sab ka deen ek hi hai, bhaiyon ki ek qism toh 'allati hai jin ka baap ek ho maayen alag alag hon, ek qism akhyafi jin ki maa ek ho aur baap juda-gana hon aur ek 'aini bhai hain jin ka baap bhi ek ho aur maa bhi ek ho. Pas kul Ambiya ka deen ek hai yani Allah Wahdahu La Sharika Lahu ki ibadat aur shariyat mukhtalif hain ba-aitibar-e-ahkam ke. Is liye unhein 'allati bhai farmaya. An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) takbir-e-ula ke baad namaz mein (Inni Wajjahtu) aur yeh aayat parh kar phir yeh parhte: (Allahumma Antal-Maliku La ilaha illa Anta, Anta Rabbi wa ana 'abduka, zalamtu nafsi wa'taraftu bi-zambi faghfirli zunubi jami'an, la yaghfiruz-zunuba illa Anta, wahdini li-ahsanil-akhlaqi la yahdi li-ahsaniha illa Anta, wasrif 'anni sayyi'aha la yasrifu 'anni sayyi'aha illa Anta, tabarakta wa ta'alaita, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilaik). Yeh hadith lambi hai is ke baad rawi ne ruku-o-sajda aur tashahhud ki duaon ka zikr kiya hai (Muslim).

Bewaqoof wahi hai jo Deen-e-Hanif se munh mor le warna Deen-e-Islam qadeemi hai. Yeh hadith lambi hai is ke baad rawi ne ruku-o-sajda aur tashahhud ki duaon ka zikr kiya hai (Muslim).

Jhoote mabood ghalat sahare kafiron ko na toh khuloos-e-ibadat naseeb hai na saccha tawakkul-e-Rabb mayassar hai. In se keh de ke kya main bhi tumhari tarah apne aur sab ke sacche mabood ko chhod kar jhoote mabood bana loon? Meri parwarish karne wala, hifazat karne wala, mujhe bachane wala, mere kaam banane wala, meri bigdi ko sanwarne wala toh Allah Ta'ala hi hai, phir main dusre ka sahara kyun loon? Malik-o-Khaliq ko chhod kar bebas aur mohtaj ke paas kyun jaaun? Goya is aayat mein tawakkul-e-Alallah aur ibadat-e-Rabb ka hukum hota hai. Yeh dono cheezein umooman ek saath bayan hua karti hain jaise aayat (Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'een) mein aur (Fa'budhu wa tawakkal alaih) mein aur (QUL HUWAR RAHMANU AMANNA BIHI WA ALAIHI TAWAKKALNA FASATA'LAMUNA MAN HUWA FI DALALIM MUBIN) (Surah Al-Mulk: 29) mein aur (RABBUL MASHRIQI WAL MAGHRIBI LA ILAHA ILLA HUWA FATTAKHIDHU WAKILA) (Surah Al-Muzzammil: 9) mein aur dusri aayaton mein bhi. Phir Qayamat ke din ki khabar deta hai ke har shakhs ko us ke a'maal ka badla adl-o-insaf se milega. Nekon ko nek, badon ko bad. Ek ke gunah dusre par nahin jayenge. Koi qarabat-dar dusre ke ewaz pakda na jayega. Us din zulm bilkul hi na hoga. Na kisi ke gunah badhaye jayenge na kisi ki neki ghatayi jayegi, apni apni karni apni apni bharni. Haan jin ke dayein haath mein a'maal-name mile hain un ke nek a'maal ki barkat un ki aulad ko bhi pahunchegi jaise farman hai aayat (WALLADHINA AMANU WATTABA'ATHUM DHURRIYYATUHUM BIIMANIN ALHAQNA BIHIM DHURRIYYATAHUM WAMA ALATNAHUM MIN AMALIHIM MIN SHAYIN KULLUMRIIM BIMA KASABA RAHIN) (Surah At-Tur: 21) yani jo iman laye aur un ki aulad ne bhi un ke iman mein un ki tabedari ki hum un ki aulad ko bhi un ke buland darjon mein pahuncha denge go un ke a'maal us darje ke na hon lekin chunke un ki iman mein shirkat hai is liye darjat mein bhi badha denge aur yeh darje maa baap ke darje ghata kar na badhenge balki yeh Allah Ta'ala ka fazl-o-karam hoga. Haan bure log apne bad a'maal ke jhagde mein ghire honge. Tum bhi a'mal kiye ja rahe ho hum bhi kiye ja rahe hain, Allah Ta'ala ke haan sab ko jana hai wahan a'maal ka hisab hona hai, phir maloom ho jayega ke is ikhtilaf mein haq aur raza-e-Rabb, marzi-e-Maula kis ke saath thi? Hamare a'maal se tum aur tumhare a'maal se hum Allah Ta'ala ke haan puche na jayenge. Qayamat ke din Allah Ta'ala ke haan sacche faisle honge aur woh ba-ilm Allah Ta'ala hamare darmiyan sacche faisle farma dega.

Allah ki Rahmat Allah ke ghazab par ghalib hai. Us Allah ne tumhein zameen ka abad-kar banaya hai, woh tumhein yakke baad deegare paida karta rehta hai. Aisa nahin kiya ke zameen mein khalifa bana kar aazmaye ke tum kaise aamal karte ho? Us ne tumhare darmiyan mukhtalif tabaqat banaye, koi ghareeb hai, koi khush-kho hai, koi bad-akhlaq, koi khoobsurat hai, koi bad-surat, yeh bhi us ki hikmat hai. Isi ne roziyan taqseem ki hain, ek ko ek ke matehat kar diya hai. Farman hai aayat (UNZUR KAYFA FAZZALNA BA'DAHUM 'ALA BA'DIN, WA LAL-AKHIRATU AKBARU DARAJATIN WA AKBARU TAFZILA) (17. Al-Isra: 21) dekh le ke hum ne in mein se ek ko ek par kaise fazeelat di hai? Is se mansha yeh hai ke aazmaish-o-imtehan ho jaye, ameer aadmiyon ka shukr, faqiron ka sabr maloom ho jaye. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain duniya meethi aur sabz rang hai, Allah tumhein is mein khalifa bana kar dekh raha hai ke tum kaise aamal karte ho? Pas tumhein duniya se hoshiyar rehna chahiye aur aurton ke bare mein bahut ehtiyat se rehna chahiye, Bani Israel ka pehla fitna auratein hi thin. Is surat ki aakhri aayat mein apne dono wasf bayan farmaye, azab ka bhi, sawab ka bhi, pakad ka bhi aur bakhshish ka bhi, apne nafarmanon par narazgi ka aur apne farmabardaron par razamandi ka. Umooman Quran-e-Kareem mein yeh dono sifatein ek saath hi bayan farmayi jati hain. Jaise farman hai aayat (WA INNA RABBAKA LA-ZU MAGHFIRATIN LIN-NASI 'ALA ZULMIHIM, WA INNA RABBAKA LASHADIDUL 'IQAB) (13. Ar-Ra'd: 6) aur aayat mein hai aayat (NABBI' 'IBADI ANNI ANAL GAFURUR RAHIM) (15. Al-Hijr: 49) yani tera Rabb apne bandon ke gunah bakhshne wala bhi hai aur woh sakht aur dard-nak azab dene wala bhi hai. Pas in aayaton mein raghbat-o-rahbat dono hain, apne fazl ka aur jannat ka lalach bhi deta hai aur aag ke azab se dhamkata bhi hai. Kabhi kabhi in dono wasfon ko alag alag bayan farmata hai taake azabon se bachne aur nematon ke hasil karne ka khayal paida ho. Allah Ta'ala hamein apne ahkam ki pabandi aur apni narazgi ke kamon se nafrat naseeb farmaye aur hamein kamil yaqeen ata farmaye ke hum us ke kalam par iman-o-yaqeen rakhein. Woh Qareeb-o-Mujeeb hai, woh duaon ka sunne wala hai, woh Jawad, Kareem aur Wahab hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain agar momin sahih taur par Allah ke azab se waqif ho jaye to apne gunahon ki wajah se jannat ke husool ki aas hi na rahe aur agar kafir Allah ki rahmat se kamahaqqahu waqif ho jaye to kisi ko bhi jannat se mayoosi na ho. Allah ne sau rahmatein banayi hain jin mein se sirf ek bandon ke darmiyan rakhi hai, isi se ek dusre par raham-o-karam karte hain, baqi ninnanve to sirf Allah hi ke paas hain. Yeh hadith Tirmidhi aur Muslim Sharif mein bhi hai. Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne makhlooq ki paidaish ke waqt ek kitab likhi jo us ke paas Arsh par hai ke meri rahmat mere ghazab par ghalib hai.

Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai, Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain: Allah Ta'ala ne rahmat ke sau hissay kiye, jin mein se ek kam ek sau toh apne paas rakhe aur ek hissa zameen par nazil farmaya. Isi ek hissay mein makhlooq ko ek dusre par shafqat-o-karam hai, yahan tak ke janwar bhi apne bache ke jism se apna paon raham kha kar utha leta hai ke kahin use takleef na ho.
